The nakshatra padas and the navamsha both divide the zodiac into 108 parts."

  - One navamsha = 3°20′; one pada = 3°20′

Pushkara navamsha are not given in many texts. They form the secret part of vedic astrology in which when you dig deep you come up with gems of analysis. The mystery was essential to avoid disclosing the real essence of Jyotish to everyone."

planet's nakshatra + pada

sutton_nakshatras.description: Nakshatras of Ketu (Ashwini, Magha, Mula), Mercury (Ashlesha, Jyeshta, Revati) and Mars (Mrigasira, Chitra, Dhanishta).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Nakshatras of Ketu (Ashwini, Magha, Mula), Mercury (Ashlesha, Jyeshta, Revati) and Mars (Mrigasira, Chitra, Dhanishta).
sutton_nakshatras.effect:
"do not have any pushkara navamsha." Her reasoning:
  - Ketu nakshatras "show the beginning of the soul's search and as there hasn't been time to collect any debris from this life they may be unwilling to let go of their past karmas. The soul has to search here without having the awareness of how to transform. The idealism is strong and as the soul is coming into contact with all that is new, it is not ready to change until it has a complete picture of its new life."
  - Mars nakshatras "are at a midpoint where the quality of the soul changes."
  - Mercury nakshatras "are areas of transformation where the debris of all the soul's negativity gets collected and we have to learn to transcend."
  - General law: "The beginning, middle and last nakshatras do not have pushkara navamshas in each of the pariyayas or cycles."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
nakshatra of the planet
Confidence: definite (a structural fact) + her interpretive reason
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The navamsha signs the pushkaras fall in.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The navamsha signs the pushkaras fall in.
sutton_nakshatras.effect:
- "The rulerships of the navamshas are by benefic planets."
  - "Jupiter and Venus rule nine pushkara each. Jupiter and Venus are the great gurus of the Vedas as Brihaspati and Shukracharya. Both of them nourish and guide the cosmos to make the right choices. They help the planets placed in their padas to find the right direction."
  - "The Moon and Mercury rule three pushkara each. As the two planets of the mind they help to nourish it so the person is calm and ready to develop their spiritual self."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
the navamsha sign of the pushkara pada (Table C3.3)
Confidence: definite; arithmetically exact (9+9+3+3 = 24)
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A planet in a pushkara navamsha.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A planet in a pushkara navamsha.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Planets in pushkara navamsha act like they are exalted. The main difference being while the exalted planet will follow in natural qualities, a planet in pushkara navamsha will need to cultivate its better qualities to find the best in itself. It will be strongly influenced by the ruler of its pushkara and therefore imbibe some of those qualities in a positive way only. Pushkara is auspicious, so the planets placed in them will also become so."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
planet's pada + the ruler of the pushkara navamsha sign
Confidence: definite — note the two qualifications: it must be *cultivated*, and the pushkara ruler's influence is positive only
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: *Ashtam* = eight, *amsha* = division. "The position when the planet is placed in the 8th sign in the navamsha/pada from its rashi sign." Her example: "If the Sun is at 11° Virgo, it is in Aries pada, it is placed in the 8th sign in the navamsha from …
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: *Ashtam* = eight, *amsha* = division. "The position when the planet is placed in the 8th sign in the navamsha/pada from its rashi sign." Her example: "If the Sun is at 11° Virgo, it is in Aries pada, it is placed in the 8th sign in the navamsha from its position in the rashi."
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "This creates an inner tension between the rashi, nakshatra and navamsha; a disconnection between what you want to achieve on a soul level and the physical one. Ashtamamsha is the most difficult position for the planet to be placed in. The individual soul does not understand what the universal soul wants. There is lack of integration. The mind is telling you something whereas your circumstances are giving other indications. This position of planets has to be handled with great sensitivity. Lack of cohesiveness, great inner conflict, being pulled in two different directions, causes problems. You must face transformation before you can understand the true message."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
rashi sign + navamsha (pada) sign of the planet; count 8th from the rashi sign
Confidence: definite — "the most difficult position"
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: "There are only eight nakshatras that have ashtamamsha. They are Bharani, Ardra, Ashlesha, Hasta, Vishakha, Mula, Dhanishta and Uttara Bhadra."
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: "There are only eight nakshatras that have ashtamamsha. They are Bharani, Ardra, Ashlesha, Hasta, Vishakha, Mula, Dhanishta and Uttara Bhadra."
sutton_nakshatras.effect:
"Each of these nakshatras show difficult aspects of soul growth where there are struggles to integrate the inner needs with the outer desires." The specific challenges:
  - Bharani — "learns lessons in discipline; understands blocks in life and gains the knowledge of death and transformation."
  - Ardra — "creates desire for perfection where we destroy what does not match up."
  - Ashlesha — "is learning about the poisons of life, to embrace and to understand pain."
  - Hasta — "gives mental distress, lack of peace of mind. Material aspirations create conflict with a more spiritual path."
  - Vishakha — "shows you heaven but does not give it."
  - Mula — "destroys materialism and security in search for moksha. Can separate you from those you love."
  - Dhanishta — "makes you satisfy others' needs before your own. Unfulfilled personal ambitions can create frustrations."
  - Uttara Bhadra — "faces the final struggles before they can embrace spirituality. It is a most profound position but can be the most difficult."

nakshatra + pada of the planet (the specific ashtamamsha pada per nakshatra is in Table C3.4)
Confidence: definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.effect: ⭐ "Rahu revels in Uttara Phalguni. There is the power and discernment." They have no problem in aspiring to be the greatest even knowing they cannot match up. ⚠️ "This can create many worldly needs, as they want more and more." But there is also an understanding of a greater purpose, which only comes once the disappointment of consumerism raises its head.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Rahu's nakshatra.
Confidence: Definite; the higher outcome is time/experience-dependent.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Ketu in Uttara Phalguni.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Ketu in Uttara Phalguni.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: ⚠️ "Ketu does not like being in Uttara Phalguni, where he cannot be a leader as he has no head. Leadership needs an ego; Ketu has none." Reading: a past life where it has already experienced all these issues but now can ignore society. ⭐ "These people will not follow the rules and should enjoy being different."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Ketu's nakshatra.
Confidence: Definite, with prescriptive advice.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any planet in Uttara Phalguni pada 1 (26°40′–30°00′ Leo, Sagittarius navamsha) — PUSHKARA NAVAMSHA.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any planet in Uttara Phalguni pada 1 (26°40′–30°00′ Leo, Sagittarius navamsha) — PUSHKARA NAVAMSHA.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "All the planets become positive by being placed here." A great place for Jupiter, Mars and the Sun.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet longitude to pada level.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Lagna in Uttara Phalguni pada 1 (pushkara).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Lagna in Uttara Phalguni pada 1 (pushkara).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: The lagna embodies the principles of Uttara Phalguni, and ⭐ "even any weakness of the lagna lord — who also is the nakshatra lord — is supported due to the lagna being pushkara."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Lagna's exact longitude to pada level + the condition of the lagna lord.
Confidence: Definite; a named strength-rescue mechanism.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Sun in Uttara Phalguni pada 1 (own nakshatra, pushkara navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Sun in Uttara Phalguni pada 1 (own nakshatra, pushkara navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Very strong in its own nakshatra, as it understands the path suggested by these impulses. This is ONE OF THE MOST PERFECT POSITIONS FOR THE SUN TO BE IN."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Sun's exact longitude.
Confidence: Definite; a superlative.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Mars in Uttara Phalguni pada 2 (00°00′–03°20′ Virgo, Capricorn navamsha) — enemy sign, exalted navamsha.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Mars in Uttara Phalguni pada 2 (00°00′–03°20′ Virgo, Capricorn navamsha) — enemy sign, exalted navamsha.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Becomes very strong. "A thinking Mars is a planner and very logical. These people are not afraid to speak their mind. MANY GREAT STRATEGISTS HAVE MARS IN THIS POSITION."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Mars' exact longitude.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Jupiter in Uttara Phalguni pada 2 — debilitated by pada (Capricorn navamsha, Virgo rashi).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Jupiter in Uttara Phalguni pada 2 — debilitated by pada (Capricorn navamsha, Virgo rashi).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Practical and less open to new ideas. "Debilitated Jupiter can bring commercialism to the wisdom, and this can make people utilise their knowledge profitably." ⭐ "This position will also give MORE FEMALE CHILDREN, as both Virgo and Capricorn are female signs."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Jupiter's exact longitude (rashi and navamsha rashi, and their gender).
Confidence: Definite; the progeny rule is stated flatly.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any planet in Uttara Phalguni pada 3 (03°20′–06°40′ Virgo, Aquarius navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any planet in Uttara Phalguni pada 3 (03°20′–06°40′ Virgo, Aquarius navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Added strength to Saturn and Rahu. No planet is exalted or debilitated here. ⚠️ "Aquarius and Virgo are such diverse emotions that all planets would struggle in establishing what is right." ⭐ "In this pada, the soul goes from being concerned just about its immediate environment to a much bigger picture. These people learn not just to do right by their own society and family but also by the greater family."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet longitude to pada level.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any planet in Uttara Phalguni pada 4 (06°40′–10°00′ Virgo, Pisces navamsha) — PUSHKARA; the end of the 4th cycle of spiritual development.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any planet in Uttara Phalguni pada 4 (06°40′–10°00′ Virgo, Pisces navamsha) — PUSHKARA; the end of the 4th cycle of spiritual development.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "All planets are boosted when placed here." "Virgo and Pisces are combining the opposites. It is a life lived in two worlds. People will change drastically at some stage of their life. They remain happy in opposing views"; being pushkara, all points of view add strength and allow the soul to develop from worldly to spiritual — to live in the world of matter but be totally in tune with the more spiritual world within.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet longitude to pada level.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Mercury in Uttara Phalguni pada 4 — exalted by rashi (Virgo) but debilitated by pada (Pisces navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Mercury in Uttara Phalguni pada 4 — exalted by rashi (Virgo) but debilitated by pada (Pisces navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "This can create a visionary person, who can see beyond the restrictions the mind brings. They may not always make good worldly decisions but can take themselves beyond the barriers that the mind erects."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Mercury's exact longitude (rashi dignity and navamsha dignity).
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Venus in Uttara Phalguni pada 4 — debilitated rashi → exalted pada, plus pushkara.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Venus in Uttara Phalguni pada 4 — debilitated rashi → exalted pada, plus pushkara.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Finds extra help from the pushkara. "Venus represents true creativity and drives the next process of soul evolution; it sows the seeds to move on to the fifth level of soul development." This is the pada that helps combine the outer demands with inner purity (the rescue for the general Venus affliction in this nakshatra).
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Venus' exact longitude.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Rahu or Ketu in Uttara Phalguni pada 4 — "the nodal axis reverses in the pada, so Rahu goes into Pisces and Ketu into Virgo."
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Rahu or Ketu in Uttara Phalguni pada 4 — "the nodal axis reverses in the pada, so Rahu goes into Pisces and Ketu into Virgo."
sutton_nakshatras.effect: ⭐ "This pada is the bridge from past life. The past and the present are playing a cosmic dance. What karma these people create now can only move forward if they reconcile with the past. Rahu has to learn to respect the past and recognise it and then reconcile with it — it cannot remain in denial. Ketu must accept the present. Not easy, lots of churning, but there are answers out there."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Rahu/Ketu exact longitudes and their navamsha rashis.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any planet in Hasta (10°00′–23°20′ Virgo).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any planet in Hasta (10°00′–23°20′ Virgo).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: ⭐ "Hasta nakshatra is where we think we can achieve whatever we desire and therefore can concentrate on our own efforts and forget the divine blessings that come with it." These people can be respected and honoured — but ⚠️ if the ego gets out of control they can be brought down to earth by collective karmic forces.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planetary longitudes to nakshatra level.
Confidence: Definite, with a stated conditional downfall.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Devata = Savitar, the deity of the Gayatri Mantra (Rig-Veda III/62/10).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Devata = Savitar, the deity of the Gayatri Mantra (Rig-Veda III/62/10).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Hasta people can bring ancient wisdom to earth and explain it to ordinary individuals — but only once they have learnt CONTROL OF THE MIND. ⭐ Remedy: "regular chanting of the Gayatri Mantra will help Hasta people develop their higher selves and free them from their material ties." The Gayatri is chanted three times a day, at the three sandhyas — morning, midday and evening; its main function is to free the soul from the bondage of Maya.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon/Lagna nakshatra (or any afflicted planet in Hasta); the daily sandhya times.
Confidence: Definite prescription with exact timing.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Both the Moon (nakshatra lord) and Mercury (rashi lord) rule the mind, and both influence Hasta.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Both the Moon (nakshatra lord) and Mercury (rashi lord) rule the mind, and both influence Hasta.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Words inspire thought, and thoughts can create mental disturbances if the mind is not under control. ⭐ Mantras/sacred sounds give power over the mind; the ability to blank the mind at will makes it peaceful, calm and open to higher areas of thought and consciousness.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Position and condition of both the Moon and Mercury.
Confidence: Definite; and the *pair* is her stated diagnostic.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Hasta ruled by the Moon.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Hasta ruled by the Moon.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Changing perspectives and moving realities; the individual can change and grow in different directions; potential developed through self-effort and understanding the laws of nature. ⚠️ "These people can be moody and reflect the waxing and waning phases of the Moon. Although they appear confident and in control, the inner self is vulnerable, insecure and in conflict, as they are always questioning themselves."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon/Lagna nakshatra; the Moon's own phase/paksha.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Hasta entirely in Virgo — the belief that they can control the flow of their destiny.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Hasta entirely in Virgo — the belief that they can control the flow of their destiny.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: ⚠️ ⭐ "These people genuinely believe that they can change their relationships to suit their way, and this can lead them into partnerships that are inherently flawed." More broadly: knowing everything (or thinking they do) either gives them immense power or restricts their personal growth; they can limit themselves to material desires and control a limited vision, and compromise many of their bigger principles in chasing Virgo's perfection.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon/Lagna nakshatra; 7th house / Venus context for the partnership reading.
Confidence: Definite warning.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Symbol = the palm of the hand (reflecting destiny and individual effort).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Symbol = the palm of the hand (reflecting destiny and individual effort).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Full correspondence set: right/left hand = positive/negative, male/female, past/future lives; four fingers = Artha, Kama, Dharma, Moksha + the four directions; three digits per finger = Rajas, Tamas, Sattva + Vata, Pitta, Kapha; fingers and thumbs = five senses + five elements; the joints on the four fingers = the twelve zodiac signs; the joints of thumbs and fingers together = 30 = the days of the solar month; the hand also reflects the solar system and its planets. → "They are masters of knowledge."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon/Lagna nakshatra (as an indicator of aptitude for hand-reading/knowledge systems).
Confidence: Symbolic/structural; the mastery claim is definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Motivation = Moksha; Hasta = "the dawn of spiritual consciousness".
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Motivation = Moksha; Hasta = "the dawn of spiritual consciousness".
sutton_nakshatras.effect: They crave a degree of perfection in which they sublimate the ego, but their outward karma is in the material field. ⭐ "They turn to YOGA, which teaches them to balance their physical life with the spiritual direction. There is conflict to begin with as they learn the lessons of letting go, but they achieve peace and harmony." ⭐ "Hasta people will be happy leading their mundane lives, but within them will be an emptiness and feeling of incompleteness. As consciousness of the higher truths dawns on them, it will fill the void."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon/Lagna nakshatra.
Confidence: Definite, with a stated remedy (yoga).
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Sacred animal = the Buffalo (Mahisha), destroyed by Durga as Mahishasura Mardani.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Sacred animal = the Buffalo (Mahisha), destroyed by Durga as Mahishasura Mardani.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: ⚠️ "Hasta people have to be careful they do not develop an ego like Mahisha and think themselves all powerful." ⭐ "Hasta can also indicate the fight to defeat one's inner demons. It takes a long time to do so, but if there is the blessing of the goddess, then victory is guaranteed." The battle is celebrated at Navaratri, when the new Moon and Sun are in Virgo; the 10th tithi is Vijaya Dashami.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon/Lagna nakshatra; yoni (Buffalo) for compatibility; panchanga for the Navaratri/Vijaya Dashami timing.
Confidence: Definite, with an explicit remedial route (blessing of the goddess).
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Hasta's Ayurvedic dosha = Vata.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Hasta's Ayurvedic dosha = Vata.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Action, agility and conflict. ⚠️ "In Hasta, this nervousness IS apparent beneath a calm persona. Hasta people are always trying to control their tensions and they can stress out easily." ⭐ Prescription: "Hasta are drawn to yoga. Any kind of physical discipline that addresses both the mind and the body will be good for Hasta, as they need to express yet harness their vata energy."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon/Lagna nakshatra.
Confidence: Definite, with a stated remedy.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any planet in Hasta — general diagnostic.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any planet in Hasta — general diagnostic.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: ⭐ "Hasta always shows a person who thinks too much, which is both their strength and their weakness." They can be great thinkers and good at words, but troubled if their mind is not at peace. Most Hasta people want only material inspiration, and this keeps their mind unsteady.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planetary longitudes to nakshatra level.
Confidence: Definite ("always").
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Lagna in Hasta.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Lagna in Hasta.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: They feel that whatever they desire, they can achieve — but can feel frustrated, as it does not always bring inner peace. ⭐ "They must link the higher notes of Hasta — then the world opens up." A strong connection with words and self-effort. The position of Mercury and the Moon decides how they are going to work the Hasta energy.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Lagna nakshatra + positions of Mercury and the Moon (explicitly the deciding factors).
Confidence: Definite; explicitly requires Mercury/Moon confirmation.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Sun in Hasta.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Sun in Hasta.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Strong — it finds a way to inspire. Words matter. *Case: John Lennon used the power of words to influence a whole generation, first materially, then by inspiring people with higher knowledge.*
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Sun's nakshatra.
Confidence: Definite; one worked example.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Moon in Hasta (its own nakshatra).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Moon in Hasta (its own nakshatra).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: ⚠️ "More troubled, as the mind tries for control and is mostly unsuccessful. The Moon is fickle and does not remain focused." The mind is very bright and inspirational, yet the lack of peace makes these people unsure and indecisive, which further adds to their troubles.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's nakshatra and pada (pada 2 = exalted, "where the mind is calm").
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Moon in Hasta → first Vimshottari dasha is the Moon (up to 10 years).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Moon in Hasta → first Vimshottari dasha is the Moon (up to 10 years).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The Moon as the first dasha can be fun. These people develop their intellect early but must learn to control their wayward minds. There can be many changes and an unsettled life."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's nakshatra + dasha balance at birth.
Confidence: Generally.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Mars in Hasta.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Mars in Hasta.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: ⚠️ "Not at his best here" — overly critical or unsure about their direction. ⭐ "Hasta gives power but not of combative skills — more of planning and thinking. If Mars can use this energy and become a thinking leader or warrior, they can become GREAT LEADERS." *Case list: Bill Clinton, Nelson Mandela, Yasser Arafat, Bill Gates, Winston Churchill — "they learned to talk the war, and use the words as weapons in their success as leaders and warriors."*
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Mars' nakshatra and pada (pada 1 gains; pada 4 debilitated).
Confidence: Conditional — the great-leader outcome requires Mars to convert force into thought; five worked examples.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Mercury in Hasta — "Mercury is exalted in Hasta; its exact degree falls here."
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Mercury in Hasta — "Mercury is exalted in Hasta; its exact degree falls here."
sutton_nakshatras.effect: It is at its best. It understands words and their power to encourage and inspire; it can change the way people think and help them to connect with the sacred sounds.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Mercury's exact longitude (the exact exaltation degree is 15°00′ Virgo — see S-N13-023).
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Jupiter in Hasta.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Jupiter in Hasta.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Usually finds it difficult to deal with the ambitions of Hasta, but can feel the divine power. These people know about the destiny that binds us but can be proactive about learning to harness and change it; they use their wisdom through their words. ⚠️ "The weakness can be of individuals who use their words to control the people around them. Jupiter in Hasta has the power to influence and make others feel their wisdom is the right one, even if it isn't."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Jupiter's nakshatra and pada (pada 4 = exalted).
Confidence: Generally ("usually"), with a stated abuse-risk.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Venus in Hasta.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Venus in Hasta.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: ⚠️ "Venus in Hasta promotes talking ABOUT relationships rather than experiencing them. In Hasta, Venus is weak, so this talk disturbs the relationships that it was meant to help."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Venus' nakshatra.
Confidence: Definite and negative.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Saturn in Hasta.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Saturn in Hasta.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Does not fare well in the Moon's nakshatra, but it is strong in Virgo." Saturn uses the power of Hasta to inspire discipline and try to control the wayward mind. The words spoken will be few and well thought out. ⭐ "These people will DO rather than SPEAK — walk the talk — this is their strength."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Saturn's nakshatra and rashi.
Confidence: Definite; a mixed but net-constructive verdict.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Rahu in Hasta (a Moon-ruled nakshatra).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Rahu in Hasta (a Moon-ruled nakshatra).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Emphasises the attempts of man to control his destiny through his own efforts. ⚠️ Rahu's placement in the intellectual part of Hasta can restrict spiritual growth through fear and mistrust. ⭐ "The essence of Rahu in Hasta lies in the karmic relationship between the Moon and Rahu: at the time of a LUNAR ECLIPSE Rahu's shadow becomes visible, indicating that the MOON-RULED NAKSHATRAS CAN EXPOSE THE TRUTH ABOUT THE NODE. If Rahu allows itself to look beyond the inner darkness, it can see the light that leads to the path of enlightenment."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Rahu's nakshatra; the Moon's condition; eclipse periods.
Confidence: Definite; stated as a general property of the Moon-ruled nakshatras (Rohini, Hasta, Shravana).
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Ketu in Hasta.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Ketu in Hasta.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Brings a lot of frustrations into this life, but the essence is the ability to recognise life beyond its present restrictions. ⚠️ "Ketu has no head, so it cannot articulate the words that Hasta wants it to speak." ⭐ Remedy: "here the intuitive words and the powers of the MANTRAS will bring out the hidden issues of Ketu."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Ketu's nakshatra.
Confidence: Definite, with a stated remedy.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any planet in Hasta pada 1 (10°00′–13°20′ Virgo, Aries navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any planet in Hasta pada 1 (10°00′–13°20′ Virgo, Aries navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: ⭐ "This is the ONLY nakshatra where the first pada is Ashtamamsha, and therefore there must be changes, unexpected and unplanned, to reveal the Hasta message." "A place of struggle for all planets. Ashtamamsha means unexpected changes when least expected." New rules in conflict with the outer aspects of the chart; the fifth cycle of soul development begins with transformation and planets placed here are continuously experiencing that.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet longitude to pada level.
Confidence: Definite; a named structural uniqueness.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Lagna, Sun, Mars or Saturn in Hasta pada 1.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Lagna, Sun, Mars or Saturn in Hasta pada 1.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Lagna — troubled, as there are the opposites of Mars and Mercury to deal with; a major transformation is experienced. Sun and Mars — gain in strength by being in their good pada, but the ashtamamsha does not give them an easy ride; both want to focus more on their martial strengths than their mental ones. Saturn — debilitated: "the impulsiveness of Aries does not allow for control, and this creates problems in facing up to reality, and how to use the power of Hasta in a productive way."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Exact longitudes to pada level.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any planet in Hasta pada 2 (13°20′–16°40′ Virgo, Taurus navamsha) — PUSHKARA.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any planet in Hasta pada 2 (13°20′–16°40′ Virgo, Taurus navamsha) — PUSHKARA.
sutton_nakshatras.effect:
"All planets benefit here, even Ketu." Taurus, the natural 2nd sign, reflects the quality of voice and the spoken word, and gives the stability of mind that Hasta seeks.
  - Moon: goes from an enemy rashi to an exalted sign and finds peace — "this is where the mind is calm and can know the great picture that is promised by Hasta."
  - Mercury: ⭐ its EXACT EXALTATION DEGREE, 15°00′ Virgo, falls in this pada, supported by Virgo + Hasta + Taurus. Mercury is karaka of speech — "this is the place where the word and speech rule supreme. The path of self-realisation is made clearer by the divine word."
  - Rahu: revels here — wants all the knowledge and will talk about it to everyone; ⭐ whether the talk serves their own ends or the good of others "depends usually on how it relates to the Moon and Mercury."
  - Ketu: cannot deal with Virgo's analysis and Taurus' materialism — a tough position; but the pushkara allows it to understand on a subliminal level that this path is essential. "These people can find their inner soul through the practice of mantras."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet longitude to pada level (and to the exact degree for Mercury); Moon and Mercury condition to adjudicate Rahu.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

Planet longitude to pada level.

Planetary longitudes to nakshatra level.

Moon/Lagna nakshatra; the native's stage of development (non-chart input, but she ties it to Mars — see S-N14-004).

sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon/Lagna nakshatra.

Nakshatra of the Sun / Lagna / 10th lord.

Exact longitude — the rashi must be recorded alongside the nakshatra, since the reading changes at 30°00′ Virgo / 00°00′ Libra.

sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon/Lagna nakshatra.

sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

Moon's nakshatra and pada (pada 4 = debilitated).

Planet longitude to pada level.

Sun's exact longitude.

Saturn's exact longitude.

Planet longitude to pada level.

sutton_nakshatras.combination:
planet's exact longitude (pada level)

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any planet — or the Lagna — in Mula pada 4 (10°00′–13°20′ Sagittarius, Cancer navamsha = ashtamamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any planet — or the Lagna — in Mula pada 4 (10°00′–13°20′ Sagittarius, Cancer navamsha = ashtamamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Ashtamamsha in Mula indicates that from now on it is all change, life cannot remain the same." People with planets here will undergo a profound transformation at some point in their lives. Those with the lagna will feel insecure. The Moon remains stressed even though it is in its own house. Sudden unexpected events will take place that separate the soul from its material entanglements. Cancer wants to create a home where spirituality can live, but the ashtamamsha makes this home fragile at best and subject to the vagaries of karma and past desires.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
exact longitude of the planet or Lagna (pada level) + navamsha
Confidence: definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Mars in Mula pada 4 (Cancer navamsha — debilitated).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Mars in Mula pada 4 (Cancer navamsha — debilitated).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "This is not a good position for Mars." They opt for comforts and emotional support and forget their wars and the need to fight for their causes; physical and spiritual weakness stops them letting go of emotional dependence. *"Like Arjuna, not wanting to fight his friends and enemies, here Mars may also not want to fight for the sake of dharma, or may fight for the wrong causes."*
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Mars's exact longitude + navamsha

sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Jupiter in Mula pada 4 (own rashi Sagittarius + exalted by Cancer pada + ashtamamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Only Jupiter has the capacity to survive the negativity of the ashtamamsha and become strong." It will use the secret codes of Mula and develop itself and help others with this knowledge. There can be interest in tantra.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Jupiter's exact longitude + navamsha
Confidence: definite — and an explicit exception to the ashtamamsha damage
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

Moon's nakshatra (yoni + dosha)

sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

The true personality and nature reveal themselves however hard they are suppressed; they express karmic qualities and in the end reach their goals regardless of the hindrances they face. Discovery of new possibilities, externalisation of latent faculties, sudden revelation of meaning, hidden knowledge uncovered, intuitive faculties sharpened. Highly creative with many talents.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's / Lagna's nakshatra
Confidence: definite ("in the end reach their goals regardless")
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any planet in Purva Ashadha — the Apas "water in a container" principle.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any planet in Purva Ashadha — the Apas "water in a container" principle.

sutton_nakshatras.combination:
which planets occupy the nakshatra

sutton_nakshatras.combination:
which planets occupy the nakshatra
Confidence: prescriptive — the clearest lifestyle remedy in this range

sutton_nakshatras.combination:

sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planets in Purva Ashadha — the guru-rivalry (Brihaspati vs Shukracharya) influence.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Drawn to differing ideas, which may either confuse them or allow them to see both sides of the argument. "In order to develop the higher self they must know how to suppress the demons, and this knowledge is available to Shukracharya. The demonic energies will bow down to the message of Venus whereas they may not be ready to listen to Jupiter's advice." Purva Ashadha planets have the gift of imbibing a bit of both gurus — which her guru Dr Ajit Sinha held was necessary to be a great teacher.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
which planets occupy the nakshatra + condition of Jupiter and Venus
Confidence: definite as a structural influence; the "gift" is stated positively
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's nakshatra + the houses/karakas of the blocking area (7th, 10th, 4th, 11th as applicable)

sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

Sun's nakshatra and pada

Moon's nakshatra + rashi (the 8th-from-Sagittarius reasoning)

Moon's nakshatra + dasha balance at birth

Rahu's nakshatra

sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Ketu's nakshatra
Confidence: positive, with a prescription
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

planet's exact longitude (pada level)

Sun's exact longitude + rashi + navamsha; pushkara status of the pada

planet's exact longitude (pada level)

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any planet or the lagna in Shravana (10°00′–23°20′ Capricorn), Moon-ruled, Vishnu-devata.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any planet or the lagna in Shravana (10°00′–23°20′ Capricorn), Moon-ruled, Vishnu-devata.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: The theme is *listening* — to scripture, to the guru, to the inner self. Total silence of mind; ability to see through the illusions of life; assimilation rather than assertion. Success requires quietness and reflection.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of the planet/lagna in question
Confidence: Definite (defining signature of the nakshatra)
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Lagna in Shravana.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Lagna in Shravana.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Wants to control their life; may feel they are seeing life in a new way; sensitive underneath though may appear aloof and self-contained; mind still active, emotions strong.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Lagna degree + nakshatra
Confidence: Generally
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Lagna in Shravana — question of whether the mind can be controlled.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Lagna in Shravana — question of whether the mind can be controlled.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Depends on the mutual position of Saturn and the Moon.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Lagna nakshatra + house/sign positions and mutual aspect/angle of Saturn and Moon
Confidence: Stated as the determining factor (conditional rule)
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Sun in Shravana.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Sun in Shravana.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Strong and getting stronger by the day, finding its spiritual light; dominant in spiritual pursuits and in making transformations in life (Vishnu controls the nakshatra).
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Sun's nakshatra
Confidence: Definite (strength claim)
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Moon in Shravana (Moon in its own nakshatra).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Moon in Shravana (Moon in its own nakshatra).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Must learn equilibrium and peace — difficult because the Moon's nature is changeable; own-nakshatra placement emphasises emotions. Struggle with the dictates of Saturn (Capricorn). Perpetual studying and learning; thirst for knowledge; studious childhood. Remedy/method: scriptures, philosophy, yoga to still the mind, detachment.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's nakshatra (+ Saturn's condition)
Confidence: Definite for the emotional emphasis; the outcome is conditional on developing detachment
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Moon in Shravana — Vimshottari dasha sequence.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Moon in Shravana — Vimshottari dasha sequence.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: The first dasha is of the Moon, which makes for an easier childhood.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's nakshatra (dasha at birth is derived from it)
Confidence: Definite (mechanical consequence of Vimshottari)
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Mars in Shravana.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Mars in Shravana.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Mars remains exalted (Capricorn) — shows both strength and weakness. Mars is not always good at listening, but has the strength and courage to enter Shravana's new world. Shravana can expose the weakness of Mars.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Mars's nakshatra + pada
Confidence: Definite dignity; the weakness is a tendency
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Mercury in Shravana.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Mercury in Shravana.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Uncomfortable with Shravana's intuitiveness; wants to understand the scriptures but must first develop steadiness of mind. Loves to read and understand life; appears practical outwardly but is also intuitive — thinks outside the box.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Mercury's nakshatra
Confidence: A tendency
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Jupiter in Shravana (Capricorn, its debilitation rashi).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Jupiter in Shravana (Capricorn, its debilitation rashi).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Remains debilitated by rashi, but the underlying conditions change — Shravana is ruled by the Moon, which exalts Jupiter, and Shravana fosters the study of scriptures. Jupiter becomes empowered; natural beneficence starts returning. Contrast: in Uttara Ashadha Jupiter is very weak; in Shravana it reconnects with eternal wisdom and finally finds itself.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Jupiter's rashi + nakshatra (+ pada — see S-N22-013)
Confidence: Definite (explicit qualification of neechabhanga-style reasoning via nakshatra lord)
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Venus in Shravana.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Venus in Shravana.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Struggles with desires and emotions; higher vibration connected to knowledge. As Shukracharya (one of the two gurus) the mantle of Venus shifts from material comforts to discipline and higher knowledge. Not an easy nakshatra for marriage or relationships, but helpful for spiritual development.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Venus's nakshatra (esp. for marriage questions)
Confidence: Definite negative for marriage; positive for sadhana
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Saturn in Shravana.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Saturn in Shravana.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Unsettled — this is the nakshatra where Saturn's weakness is exposed. Must relax its rigidity (scriptures, listening, Moon rulership). An uneasy platform for Saturn's pursuits; struggles with emotions and coldness until an even plane is found.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Saturn's nakshatra
Confidence: Definite weakness claim
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Rahu in Shravana / Ketu in Shravana.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Rahu in Shravana / Ketu in Shravana.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: *Rahu:* intensifies fear of the mind; must bring steadiness and grounding to its search; initially cannot sit still long enough to hear the sounds of silence — total lack of peace of mind while the soul searches; eventually learns to experience the silence of the soul and master its restlessness. *Ketu:* quietness and reflection were part of the previous life; that meditation brought inner understanding; the soul searches for that silence again in this life. In the past life they learnt to control the mind — it helps Ketu to focus.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Rahu/Ketu nakshatra (+ pada)
Confidence: Generally
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in Shravana pada 1 (10°00′–13°20′ Capricorn, Aries navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in Shravana pada 1 (10°00′–13°20′ Capricorn, Aries navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Sun exalted (first exaltation after the Sun enters Uttarayana) — finds its inner light by paying homage to Saturn's rigidity through knowledge. Saturn weak in its own sign — pragmatism suffers under Shravana's philosophy; the need to control the mind overshadows Saturn's mission; underlying emotions throw Saturn off balance; not an easy result. Mars strong — exalted rashi and own pada.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's exact longitude → nakshatra pada
Confidence: Definite (dignity statements)
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in Shravana pada 2 (13°20′–16°40′ Capricorn, Taurus navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in Shravana pada 2 (13°20′–16°40′ Capricorn, Taurus navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Pushkara navamsha — all planets gain. Moon exalted (mind at peace, right thinking, calmness). Rahu exalted (understands something concrete will come of the future; agitation lessens). Venus in own house — gains. Ketu debilitated — past life of study and responsibility, but Taurus makes it guilty about wealth and comfort; the pushkara nature helps Ketu let go of remorse.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's exact longitude → pada
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in Shravana pada 3 (16°40′–20°00′ Capricorn, Gemini navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in Shravana pada 3 (16°40′–20°00′ Capricorn, Gemini navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Mercury gains — own sign. No planet is exalted or debilitated here. The soul wants to embark on a new way of thinking; thoughts similar to Gemini rashi but at a higher vibration.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's exact longitude → pada
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in Shravana pada 4 (20°00′–23°20′ Capricorn, Cancer navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in Shravana pada 4 (20°00′–23°20′ Capricorn, Cancer navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Most dramatic change for all planets — Saturn's restrictions replaced by Cancer's emotions; opposites rule, but Cancer issues finally dominate: emotions, comfort and home. Mars weak internally (exalted rashi, debilitated pada): appears brave, "may talk the talk… but when it comes to taking action, they are not able to walk the walk." Jupiter exalted — "the pada usually gives the final strength"; apparent weakness becomes strength, the right knowledge is imbibed, the right path taken; the power of Vamana is evident — wisdom triumphs over ego and power.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's exact longitude → pada
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet or lagna in the early part of Shravana pada 1.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet or lagna in the early part of Shravana pada 1.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Part of the first pada of Shravana belongs to Abhijit nakshatra, "showing the power of this part of the spiritual journey." Abhijit's qualities are additionally in play.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Exact longitude (to test the Abhijit overlap span, given separately at PDF 372ff.)
Confidence: Stated as fact; the precise overlap boundary is not repeated here
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Native with Shravana emphasis (esp. Moon/lagna) facing a difficult Saturn transit.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Native with Shravana emphasis (esp. Moon/lagna) facing a difficult Saturn transit.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Remedy — worship Hanuman. Per the myth, Saturn granted immunity from transit affliction to Hanuman's worshippers. Shravana people rooted in spiritual practice are not afraid of challenging transits and take the good with the bad in the same vein.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon/lagna + current Saturn transit
Confidence: Presented as an established remedial tradition
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Shravana emphasis in the chart (monkey yoni / Hanuman).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Shravana emphasis in the chart (monkey yoni / Hanuman).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Hanuman was celibate and many Shravana people choose celibacy.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon/lagna/Venus
Confidence: "Many" — a tendency
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Shravana motivation is Artha; Gana is Divine; caste Outcast; dosha Kapha.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Shravana motivation is Artha; Gana is Divine; caste Outcast; dosha Kapha.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Goal-orientated, focused on achievement; goals connected to business, building wealth (spiritual and material) and making an impact; pragmatic and disciplined. Artha here means practical ways of doing service for the good of humanity — they must let go of selfish needs to work for others. Kapha: philosophical, spiritual, emotional; must beware self-indulgence in emotions and food; calm in a crisis; helped in meditation and yoga.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon (for motivation/gana/dosha attribution)
Confidence: Generally
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Shravana native drunk with ego / not heeding the guru (Mahabali pattern).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Shravana native drunk with ego / not heeding the guru (Mahabali pattern).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Loss of everything given — "arrogance and pride should be abandoned if any advancement in life is to be made, and wealth should never be taken for granted since it can so easily be taken away." Ego blocks the ability to listen and to recognise what is really being presented.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon/lagna; condition of Jupiter (the planet of this avatar)
Confidence: Framed as the moral/psychological law of the nakshatra
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any planet or lagna in Dhanishta (23°20′ Capricorn – 6°40′ Aquarius), Mars-ruled, Ashta Vasu devata.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any planet or lagna in Dhanishta (23°20′ Capricorn – 6°40′ Aquarius), Mars-ruled, Ashta Vasu devata.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Wealthy in mind and spirit" — wealth of good character, thoughts and actions rather than material wealth. Spiritual wealth does not come easily; it is achieved through selfless work, dropping personal ego, and compassion/high ideals for the universal good. Must fight for their rights *and* do much service for others.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of the planet/lagna
Confidence: Definite (defining signature)
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Dhanishta placement — which of the two rashis the degree falls in.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Dhanishta placement — which of the two rashis the degree falls in.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Capricorn Dhanishta = wants to be responsible and do duty; gets so involved in what family/friends/children/parents want that they lose sight of what they want themselves. Aquarius Dhanishta = wants to take on the responsibility of the world — earth issues, environment.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Exact longitude (to determine the rashi within the nakshatra)
Confidence: Definite distinction
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in the Aquarius portion of Dhanishta.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in the Aquarius portion of Dhanishta.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Mars (nakshatra lord), Saturn (rashi lord) and Rahu (co-lord of Aquarius) are conflicting energies. Planets placed here find themselves caught in an internal conflict — which is the catalyst for change and transformation. Saturn creates responsibility and the ability to face pain; Rahu fears it may not reach its objective.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Exact longitude; condition of Mars, Saturn and Rahu
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Lagna in Dhanishta.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Lagna in Dhanishta.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Feels duty to others acutely; people dump their problems on them regularly. Caution: be aware why these responsibilities are taken on and avoid useless ones — they will not allow the soul to move ahead.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Lagna nakshatra
Confidence: Generally, with an explicit caution
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Sun in Dhanishta.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Sun in Dhanishta.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Both strong and weak. As the soul recognises its spirit it must sacrifice personal needs for the global good — but the Sun is not good at being of service; it has to learn to give.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Sun's nakshatra (+ pada — debilitated in pada 3)
Confidence: Mixed dignity, stated as definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Moon in Dhanishta.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Moon in Dhanishta.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Emotional need to give, not always easy; can be selfless and giving but must consider their own needs or be drowned in the demands of others. Learns to be detached yet responsible from a young age. Stubborn — once decided, will not give up.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's nakshatra
Confidence: Generally
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Moon in Dhanishta — Vimshottari dasha sequence.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Moon in Dhanishta — Vimshottari dasha sequence.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: First dasha is Mars; Rahu immediately follows. Mars as first dasha is good, but the Rahu succession means Dhanishta Moon people usually have an unusual start to life and can feel that they are outsiders even if they are leading conventional lives.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's nakshatra (birth dasha derived from it) + age at Mars/Rahu dasha change
Confidence: "Usually"
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Mars in Dhanishta, especially at 28° Capricorn.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Mars in Dhanishta, especially at 28° Capricorn.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Strong — this is Mars's exact exaltation degree. Defends spirituality and looks after others, treating it as dharma. "An excellent position for Mars." At the exact degree, expect a combative personality, always willing to fight their corner — not an easy personality.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Mars's exact longitude (degree-level, not just nakshatra)
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Mercury in Dhanishta.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Mercury in Dhanishta.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Flourishes. Learns about discipline and about different levels of consciousness. (Exalted in pada 2 — Virgo navamsha.)
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Mercury's nakshatra + pada
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Jupiter in Dhanishta.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Jupiter in Dhanishta.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Struggles with change; very practical outlook. "In Dhanishta it is said that the soul takes a break from its spiritual journey to pay off any residual karma" — Jupiter is uncomfortable with this, as it can forget the spiritual reason it adapted to material life. Jupiter in the Aquarius part of Dhanishta: finds a way to deal with their shadows positively and develops the higher self that reconnects to the light.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Jupiter's nakshatra + which rashi portion
Confidence: Generally
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Transit Jupiter entering Dhanishta in Aquarius.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Transit Jupiter entering Dhanishta in Aquarius.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Celebrated as Jupiter ending its debilitation — considered the time when the nectar of immortality was found and the darkness that encased humans disappeared. The Kumbha Mela is celebrated every twelve years in Prayag to honour this transit.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Transit Jupiter's longitude (mundane/muhurta application)
Confidence: Stated as established tradition
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Venus in Dhanishta, Capricorn portion.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Venus in Dhanishta, Capricorn portion.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Not strong. Attached to earthly desires and unable to let them go even though higher responsibilities must be fulfilled. (Debilitated in pada 2 — Virgo navamsha: fussy and critical about life, pleasures and relationships.)
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Venus's exact longitude → rashi portion + pada
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Saturn in Dhanishta.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Saturn in Dhanishta.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Will do all the service to others but struggles with ego, especially in the Leo pada (pada 1). Becomes more drawn to service and to taking on other people's responsibilities. *(In pada 3, Libra navamsha: own sign + exalted pada = very strong.)*
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Saturn's nakshatra + pada
Confidence: Definite, pada-conditional
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Rahu in Dhanishta / Ketu in Dhanishta.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Rahu in Dhanishta / Ketu in Dhanishta.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: *Rahu:* searches for material wealth; when that fails to bring happiness, searches for higher wealth — then the soul begins inner cleansing, sorting out inner demons to prepare the ground for divine aspirations. *Ketu:* past life of hard selfless work to acquire this wealth, ego let go, compassion and high ideals; Ketu in Dhanishta represents the inner cleansing of the soul to get it ready to receive divine music.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Rahu/Ketu nakshatra + pada
Confidence: "Usually"
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in Dhanishta pada 1 (23°20′–26°40′ Capricorn, Leo navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in Dhanishta pada 1 (23°20′–26°40′ Capricorn, Leo navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Ashtamamsha — sudden changes; no planet exalted or debilitated. Ego issues attach to the selfless giving of Capricorn and Dhanishta; it promises a major change. All planets experience change, conflict and unexpected life events. Even the Sun suffers from being in its own pada of Leo. The struggle between ego and responsibility is emphasised.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's exact longitude → pada
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Ashtamamsha falling at the *start* of a nakshatra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Ashtamamsha falling at the *start* of a nakshatra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Only two nakshatras begin with an ashtamamsha — Hasta and Dhanishta — "therefore these are significant changes taking place."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's exact longitude → nakshatra + pada
Confidence: Definite structural statement
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in Dhanishta pada 2 (26°40′–30°00′ Capricorn, Virgo navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in Dhanishta pada 2 (26°40′–30°00′ Capricorn, Virgo navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "This is where the message of Dhanishta is at its purest." Mars exact exaltation degree (28° Cap); Mercury exalted; Venus debilitated. Mars exalted *in its enemy sign and pada* — Mars in Mercury's signs gains the ability to think and plan, turning the warrior into a commander good at war and at strategy. Mercury: uses intellect for the good of others; ideas good for both practical living and the spiritual quest. Venus: cannot realize its role as creative power; fussy, critical, stuck.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's exact longitude → pada
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in Dhanishta pada 3 (Libra navamsha, 1st navamsha of Aquarius; degrees printed as "3°20′ to 6°40′ Aquarius" — see editor note).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in Dhanishta pada 3 (Libra navamsha, 1st navamsha of Aquarius; degrees printed as "3°20′ to 6°40′ Aquarius" — see editor note).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Sun debilitated (enemy sign + debilitated pada) — unsure at the start of this journey, glory and warmth depleted; must think of others, learn to depend on them, not be a loner, learn balance between self and other. Saturn exalted and in its own sign — very strong; expresses itself through remaining humble and breaking the negativity of ego.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's exact longitude → pada
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in Dhanishta pada 4 (Scorpio navamsha, 2nd navamsha of Aquarius; degrees printed as "6°40′ to 10°00′ Aquarius" — see editor note).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in Dhanishta pada 4 (Scorpio navamsha, 2nd navamsha of Aquarius; degrees printed as "6°40′ to 10°00′ Aquarius" — see editor note).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Moon and Rahu troubled; Ketu exalted; all planets challenged (Aquarius + Scorpio = two of the most complex rashis). Old karma in the shape of poisonous Scorpio issues must be dealt with before they can move on. Moon: unsettled mind, searching for peace, sometimes stuck in difficult situations — letting go helps, hanging on creates mental tensions. Rahu: explores dark deep secrets; weakness from addictive personality disorders, danger of the wrong type of dependency; over-values personal possessions, then a huge transformation forces a re-think. Ketu: thrives — past life of service and sacred knowledge used for others; deep occult knowledge and intuition; talent for humanitarian works.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's exact longitude → pada
