sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Lagna nakshatra
Confidence: Definite, with a prescribed correction
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Sun in Purva Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Sun in Purva Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Unsure whether the path they are on is the right one — there is the other half of the conundrum they do not yet know. Conditional: if they undertake an internal journey and trust their acquired wisdom, all will be revealed. Strong like the lion, yet lacking confidence in how to express their strength.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Sun's nakshatra + pada (exalted in pada 1)
Confidence: Conditional
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Moon in Purva Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Moon in Purva Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Does not know the entire picture; strong-minded about what it understands, but the duality of Purva Bhadra can make these people lack confidence. Spiritual yet adventurous. "This is not a very materialistic Moon" — a problem for practical purposes.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's nakshatra
Confidence: Generally
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Moon in Purva Bhadra — Vimshottari dasha sequence.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Moon in Purva Bhadra — Vimshottari dasha sequence.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: The first dasha will be of Jupiter, which is usually good, but Saturn follows it. Depending on how long the Jupiter dasha is, Purva Bhadra can soon experience the restrictions of Saturn and learn about the two sides of its nature. There are still some worldly issues to resolve before it can totally submerge itself in being one with the divine.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's exact longitude (balance of Jupiter dasha at birth) + Saturn's condition
Confidence: Explicitly conditional on the dasha balance
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Mars in Purva Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Mars in Purva Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Brings out the aggression of Purva Bhadra; at their best fighting for the causes dear to them. They feel acutely about spirituality and materialism; the duality of existence can frustrate them.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Mars's nakshatra + pada (debilitated in pada 4)
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Mercury in Purva Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Mercury in Purva Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: A fiery intellect that uses its knowledge to write, think and talk about fighting the causes dear to them — "But they may not take any action."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Mercury's nakshatra
Confidence: Definite, with the stated limitation
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Jupiter in Purva Bhadra (its own nakshatra).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Jupiter in Purva Bhadra (its own nakshatra).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: The soul must understand how to use wisdom for higher matters. Can be a good guide, philosopher and mentor. Failure mode: ignoring their own advice and lacking confidence in what they are; unnecessarily restricting themselves to seeking answers in the material world instead of trusting their inner wisdom.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Jupiter's nakshatra + pada (exalted in pada 4 = own sign + own nakshatra + exaltation)
Confidence: Definite, with a stated failure mode
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Venus in Purva Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Venus in Purva Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: A more alternative personality; they care for others but often do not know all the answers. This life is a journey to purity — Venus can show many forms in this nakshatra, from the adventurous to the divine.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Venus's nakshatra + pada
Confidence: A range rather than a single outcome
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Saturn in Purva Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Saturn in Purva Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: No attraction for worldly things — the karma has been fulfilled; the new energy is about letting go of time, giving up material responsibilities. Caution: Saturn must learn that its caution still has a role to play; the wisdom acquired through personal effort is still important.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Saturn's nakshatra + pada (debilitated in pada 1)
Confidence: Definite, with caution
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Rahu in Purva Bhadra / Ketu in Purva Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Rahu in Purva Bhadra / Ketu in Purva Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: *Rahu:* knows his personality is not perfect and through the shadows of its realm strives to bring out its elusive beauty; poor self-image (ugly-goat identification); struggles with the crystallizing karma — restrictions imposed by past life crises and mental blockages. *Ketu:* previous lives where the soul had almost reached its state of perfection when it chose to be re-born; struggles to accept material rewards, as they create desires leading to pain and sorrow; gives the soul courage to change the course of its life.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Rahu/Ketu nakshatra + pada
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in Purva Bhadra pada 1 (20°00′–23°20′ Aquarius, Aries navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in Purva Bhadra pada 1 (20°00′–23°20′ Aquarius, Aries navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Sun exalted; Saturn debilitated by pada. Sun: able to work for others yet remain true to themselves; nurture purity and idealism; fight for what is right and be confident; mission is to guard the spirit of humanity and protect people. Saturn: unsure what to do; can make the wrong effort; anger and frustration; bad self-image; unwilling to shoulder responsibility; "can regress from staid to childish in one breath." Aries is Saturn's testing ground and it will take Saturn time to adjust.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's exact longitude → pada
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in Purva Bhadra pada 2 (23°20′–26°40′ Aquarius, Taurus navamsha — pushkara).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in Purva Bhadra pada 2 (23°20′–26°40′ Aquarius, Taurus navamsha — pushkara).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Moon exalted; Rahu exalted; Ketu debilitated; pushkara helps all planets. Moon: happy, settled on the spiritual path, learning to detach. Rahu: finds peace — conscious of their duality but aware both sides want the same thing; desires become less troublesome. Ketu: unhappy at the blocks of materialism Taurus represents; feels it did not fulfil its mission in the past life — but pushkara usually suggests that they come to terms with it.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's exact longitude → pada; check pushkara
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in Purva Bhadra pada 3 (26°40′–30°00′ Aquarius, Gemini navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in Purva Bhadra pada 3 (26°40′–30°00′ Aquarius, Gemini navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: No dignities. Planets intellectually charged, thinking about how to assimilate the quality mentally. Thinking about the path and spiritual direction is important for all planets — "these are thoughts that can hinder spiritual progress yet they are essential for the growth process."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's exact longitude → pada
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in Purva Bhadra pada 4 (0°00′–3°20′ Pisces, Cancer navamsha — pushkara).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in Purva Bhadra pada 4 (0°00′–3°20′ Pisces, Cancer navamsha — pushkara).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The most auspicious place of the Bhadra, where there is understanding and assimilation of its spiritual journey." Mars debilitated; Jupiter exalted; all planets benefit from the blessings of Jupiter and the pushkara navamsha. Mars: "decisive action has no place in spiritual thought"; emotion clouds the warrior's actions; the Purva Bhadra sword will only be for peaceful purposes — but being pushkara, even Mars's debilitation has a different kind of strength: courage to develop ideas and become the true defender who gives peace a chance. Jupiter: "one of the best positions in the zodiac — in its own sign, nakshatra and exaltation" — higher knowledge, wisdom, right expansion, and the nurturing of the seed of creation all promoted.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's exact longitude → pada; check pushkara
Confidence: Definite; the strongest Jupiter statement in the chapter
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Purva Bhadra sword symbol prominent.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Purva Bhadra sword symbol prominent.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Dynamic in furthering their cause; will not hold back from fighting for it; can cut through negativity and see the path clearly if they use their sword wisely. The sword is an instrument for furthering an ideal — "the quality of the ideal is in the hands of the users; the question is how they go about achieving that ideal." It can be used to attack as well as to defend, for religious/spiritual causes as well as nefarious ones. "The pen has also been considered a verbal sword."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon/lagna/Mars/Mercury
Confidence: Definite, with the outcome explicitly dependent on the native's use
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Purva Bhadra prominent — sword symbol + Bhadra Kali link.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Purva Bhadra prominent — sword symbol + Bhadra Kali link.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Can make them very good at martial arts and always ready to right wrongs."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon/lagna/Mars
Confidence: "Can make" — a talent indication
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Purva Bhadra native reaching understanding of Maya (Bhadra Kali).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Purva Bhadra native reaching understanding of Maya (Bhadra Kali).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: The great goddess "showers blessings on the people who understand about the play of Maya or illusion. They learn to see beyond the weakness and strengths to the true vision of the divine with detachment." Kali is both benign and terrible, creating and nourishing as well as killing and destroying; "through her magic we see both good and bad, but in reality there is neither… God is beyond the pair of opposites which constitute this relative existence."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon/lagna
Confidence: Conditional on the native's realisation
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Purva Bhadra yoni Lion (vahana of Durga).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Purva Bhadra yoni Lion (vahana of Durga).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Purva Bhadra people can be in positions of power. They may have a powerful inner personality." The lion symbolises strong urges and ego that must be mastered on the path of self-realisation. Durga's ability to ride the lion indicates she can control the savagery of the lower urges — the model for the native. The war is metaphorical: the war at the final stages of self-realisation that planets in Purva Bhadra fight to calm their lower self.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon/lagna
Confidence: "Can be" — a tendency; the mastery is the prescription
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Purva Bhadra dosha Vata; motivation Artha; caste Brahmin; quality Fierce.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Purva Bhadra dosha Vata; motivation Artha; caste Brahmin; quality Fierce.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Vata = discontentment, inconsistency, agitation. Tensions and conflicts buried deep within. "They are worriers and can fret mostly about worldly issues: the world, environment, fair play, truth. They will hardly worry about themselves. This consumes their inner energy… They use up their entire fund of resources for the good of humanity." Artha here = 'the answer' on a subtle level — they look beyond practical artha and search for answers in the cosmos, from being in harmony with creation; also good at practical artha by supporting those who need it and creating support systems from which others can benefit. "Purva Bhadra people are spirituality itself. Their path is connected with giving. Their karma is compassion, kindness and fight for injustice."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Uttara Bhadra read alongside Purva Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Uttara Bhadra read alongside Purva Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: An extension of Purva Bhadra — a single principle split into two opposing forces. Jupiter rules Purva, Saturn rules Uttara; together Sun and Moon, light and darkness, fire and water, heat and cold, masculine and feminine, the lion and the cow — Uttara represents the latter qualities. "Jupiter bestows wisdom in Purva Bhadra and Saturn rewards all the trials and tribulations in Uttara Bhadra."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of the planet; condition of Jupiter and Saturn
Confidence: Definite structural pairing
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any planet or lagna in Uttara Bhadra (3°20′–16°40′ Pisces), Saturn-ruled, Ahir Budhnya devata, Gana Human, motivation Kama.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any planet or lagna in Uttara Bhadra (3°20′–16°40′ Pisces), Saturn-ruled, Ahir Budhnya devata, Gana Human, motivation Kama.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Blessed, auspicious, gracious — blessings from good deeds in past lives now experienced as good luck, but on a higher, more subtle plane, as the soul wants more than just the ordinary. Path: live life successfully on earth but remain detached from it; attachment to material pleasures has ended, but there is still a distance to the end of the road to enlightenment. Kama here is not sexual passion but "the intense passion to merge with the unconscious, to use the talents for the good of humanity."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of the planet/lagna
Confidence: Definite (defining signature)
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Uttara Bhadra prominent (Moon/lagna).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Uttara Bhadra prominent (Moon/lagna).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Uttara Bhadra people can remain passive and non-active until an event or happening makes them change their perception of life altogether. Then the journey of looking beyond their immediate circumstances begins and spirituality grows." Relationship consequence: "Their need to transcend ordinary life makes it difficult for them to have traditional relationships."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon/lagna; the triggering event is timed by dasha/transit (method not specified here)
Confidence: Definite pattern; the trigger event is asserted without a timing method — see Open items
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Uttara Bhadra prominent — Ahir Budhnya, the deep-ocean snake.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Uttara Bhadra prominent — Ahir Budhnya, the deep-ocean snake.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: The nakshatra straddles the opposite aspects of human nature. "The snake represents poisons, but can also show the ability to deal with them. The cow personifies an auspicious good nature, the need to care and nurture the world. The snake part of the nakshatra sheds its skin through painful life experiences and reveals its better nature, while Ahir as the cowherd shows the ability to shepherd the auspiciousness, to deal with the toxins."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon/lagna
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Uttara Bhadra native immersing wholly in spiritual life.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Uttara Bhadra native immersing wholly in spiritual life.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The water snake needs to come to the surface to breathe, therefore the soul of Uttara Bhadra cannot remain in water (spirituality) forever; it needs to periodically connect with the real world." Confirmed by the Saturn delineation: "in this life they can never be totally immersed in spirituality."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon/lagna; Saturn's condition
Confidence: Definite prescriptive rule
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Uttara Bhadra prominent — Ahir Budhnya as son of Vishwakarma the celestial architect.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Uttara Bhadra prominent — Ahir Budhnya as son of Vishwakarma the celestial architect.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Here the architect is laying the foundations for the next life time by doing the deeds now. Recognizing the contribution of this life leads to the smooth running of future lives."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon/lagna
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Lagna in Uttara Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Lagna in Uttara Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: A mind ready to submerge into spirituality, but material aspects keep getting in the way. They must work with their karmic responsibilities first and only then advance further. Method: "The position of Saturn and Jupiter will give a clearer picture."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Lagna nakshatra + house/sign/strength of Saturn and Jupiter
Confidence: Definite, with a named diagnostic
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Sun in Uttara Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Sun in Uttara Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Should try to sublimate their egos. Generous, giving and spiritual, yet ego and arrogance can get in the way. Full of knowledge — unless they learn humility they cannot experience the full advantage of their wisdom.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Sun's nakshatra + pada (debilitated *and* ashtamamsha in pada 3)
Confidence: Definite conditional (humility is the gate)
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Moon in Uttara Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Moon in Uttara Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Very bright, but must be particularly careful of their poisonous tendencies. Very spiritual, but underlying ways of thinking block future growth — "it is their own ways of thinking that limit their progress." Creative and idealistic. "Life will bring changes for them to truly find their way." Understands blessings on a higher, subtler plane; the soul wants more than just the ordinary.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's nakshatra + pada (difficult in pada 4)
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Moon in Uttara Bhadra — Vimshottari dasha sequence.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Moon in Uttara Bhadra — Vimshottari dasha sequence.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: The first dasha of Saturn can cause frustration, even misery, in childhood and teens, as it restricts the natural energy from expanding. These people may shoulder adult responsibilities as a child. With maturity, if they learn to use the Saturn forces properly, they can start on the path towards self-realisation.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's nakshatra (birth dasha) + balance of Saturn dasha at birth
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Mars in Uttara Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Mars in Uttara Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Courage to swim these choppy waters, from an inner wisdom to face life. But turbulent emotions and anger issues that erupt like a volcano unless addressed. Sexual desires can be a problem too, as Uttara Bhadra wants to be an ascetic while Mars wants passion.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Mars's nakshatra
Confidence: Definite, with an explicit conflict of natures
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Mercury in Uttara Bhadra (Pisces — Mercury's debilitation).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Mercury in Uttara Bhadra (Pisces — Mercury's debilitation).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Rational intellect does not work well; swamped by emotional issues; does not know how to deal with "this sea of spirituality where the language is different." ⭐ Positive: "an excellent position for writers and for working with your imagination." Negative: "purely from a practical point of view Mercury can feel a failure" — must work on the practical side or make mistakes and be susceptible to wrong judgements.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Mercury's nakshatra + pada (exalted by pada in pada 2, Virgo navamsha)
Confidence: Definite, explicitly split between vocation and practicality
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Jupiter in Uttara Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Jupiter in Uttara Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Revels in the spirituality of Uttara Bhadra and enjoys the fruits of a life lived on spiritual terms. "A great position for teachers and those with deep knowledge of esoteric wisdom." Caution: misuse of this wisdom "can only happen if there are negative aspects to Jupiter."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Jupiter's nakshatra + aspects to Jupiter (the stated condition for the negative outcome)
Confidence: Definite, with an explicitly aspect-conditional caveat
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Venus in Uttara Bhadra (Pisces — Venus's exaltation).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Venus in Uttara Bhadra (Pisces — Venus's exaltation).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Working towards sowing the seed of creation and ideas for future generations; wants good relationships, giving and generous. "There will be changes in life, and maybe some dissatisfaction with relationships, DESPITE Venus being exalted. Material relationships can fail to satisfy them fully as they want to make a more divine connection, demanding perfection and purity." Prescription: recognise that partners are an expression of the divine — "if they change their attitude to love it can be beautiful."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Venus's nakshatra + pada (debilitated by pada in pada 2)
Confidence: Definite — an explicit case of exaltation *not* preventing dissatisfaction
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Saturn in Uttara Bhadra (its own nakshatra).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Saturn in Uttara Bhadra (its own nakshatra).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Benefits from its own nakshatra, using the practical life to clear the final hurdles to spiritual evolution. "These people must deal with their responsibilities and in this life they can never be totally immersed in spirituality."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Saturn's nakshatra + pada (exalted by pada in pada 3, but "not in its best position from the rashi sign")
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Rahu in Uttara Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Rahu in Uttara Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "A journey to a beautiful place, yet the steps Rahu takes to reach this place will initially be wrong. It is at a threshold of change that cannot be expressed through self-will or personal importance." ⭐ "Uttara Bhadra is the 2nd nakshatra Rahu retrogrades into, and it thinks it understands the intensity but actually it is floundering in this deep cosmic ocean, not mature enough to cope with it."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Rahu's nakshatra + pada (difficult in pada 4)
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Ketu in Uttara Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Ketu in Uttara Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: A past life where the individual let go of their fears and moved towards the maturity of the soul. "The soul will want to remain in the spiritual, and this creates problems for them in totally honouring the practical and the here and now."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Ketu's nakshatra + pada (exalted in pada 4)
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in Uttara Bhadra pada 1 (3°20′–6°40′ Pisces, Leo navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in Uttara Bhadra pada 1 (3°20′–6°40′ Pisces, Leo navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: No planet exalted or debilitated. "In Leo, Pisces faces the reality of its material needs. Ego can be the big issue here. This is the final ego rearing its head and the soul must try to work it out. All planets need to reconcile with power, identity and creativity."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's exact longitude → pada
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in Uttara Bhadra pada 2 (6°40′–10°00′ Pisces, Virgo navamsha — pushkara).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in Uttara Bhadra pada 2 (6°40′–10°00′ Pisces, Virgo navamsha — pushkara).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Exalted Venus gets debilitated; debilitated Mercury becomes exalted; both benefit from the pushkara position. "Pushkara usually shows the ability of the planet to thrive regardless of its position." ⭐ "Pada is opposite to the rashi and this can bring a complete change in the life of a person with lagna or any planets placed here." Mercury: "the marrying of the spiritual and the practical together… Sort out the practical to get to the spiritual." Venus: material desires block its full beauty; fussier, more critical, unable to accept its path naturally; hidden weaknesses — pushkara will help to heal these.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's exact longitude → pada; check pushkara; check pada-opposite-to-rashi
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet or lagna in Uttara Bhadra pada 3 (10°00′–13°20′ Pisces, Libra navamsha — ASHTAMAMSHA).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet or lagna in Uttara Bhadra pada 3 (10°00′–13°20′ Pisces, Libra navamsha — ASHTAMAMSHA).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The pada where the main transformation takes place." The seas of Pisces are churned up and the journey becomes more clouded; "there cannot be detachment when the soul has to face major transformations." Lagna: "will feel the ashtamamsha acutely. Usually there is a major change in life that leads to a true understanding of their role." Sun: weak — debilitation AND ashtamamsha; wants props for the ego while Pisces demands letting go of dependency and individuality. Prescription: "be true to the Libra impulse — remain balanced and detached while all is changing. Being ready for sudden transformation is the key." Saturn: exalted by pada but "not in its best position from the rashi sign" — huge turbulence from the material world; will try to remain detached; old karma has to be dealt with and it will lead to a positive change.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's/lagna's exact longitude → pada; check ashtamamsha
Confidence: Definite; "usually" for the major life change
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in Uttara Bhadra pada 4 (13°20′–16°40′ Pisces, Scorpio navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in Uttara Bhadra pada 4 (13°20′–16°40′ Pisces, Scorpio navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The highest vibration of Scorpio at work — transformational, intuitive and full of deep secret knowledge." Difficult for the Moon and Rahu; Ketu exalted. Moon: emotional storms from both signs; clings to its desire-fuelled nature and struggles against transformation being forced — "here the poisons of Uttara Bhadra can be in evidence." Rahu: gets lost, digs deep into its negativity; needs understanding of its confusion to emerge unscathed. Ketu: "is in heaven" — deep past-life wisdom to handle today's difficulties; secure in their aspiration for moksha and will sacrifice all to achieve it; may need to let go of the final residue of negative thoughts, but usually happy to do so.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's exact longitude → pada
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The eighth movable karana, ruled by Bhadra (Saturn's sister), also called Vishti.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The eighth movable karana, ruled by Bhadra (Saturn's sister), also called Vishti.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "This karana… reflects Saturn's energy. This time is considered inauspicious to begin new projects as the fiery nature of Bhadra Devi consumes the good energy." Yet Bhadra is there to protect, just like Kali — "her persona of negativity is just how we view the forces of nature."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Panchanga — the karana running at the proposed start time
Confidence: Definite muhurta prohibition, softened by her reframing
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Uttara Bhadra prominent — Bhadra (Saturn's sister) persona.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Uttara Bhadra prominent — Bhadra (Saturn's sister) persona.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Uttara Bhadra can have a fierce nature and in extreme cases have a persona similar to Bhadra, and this can appear as a weakness." The interpretive instruction: "We have to go beyond the apparent fierceness of these deities in order to find the divine."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon/lagna
Confidence: "In extreme cases"
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Uttara Bhadra prominent (cow yoni; Shiva's five faces / Kalagni Rudra).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Uttara Bhadra prominent (cow yoni; Shiva's five faces / Kalagni Rudra).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Knowing the secret of the holy Ash and its use is to understand the key of Shiva, Shakti, Sun and Moon and transcending death." The five ashes and their effects: Vibhuti — gives wealth; Bhasma — removes the sins; Bhasitha — makes life glitter; Kshara — protects from dangers; Raksha — acts like a shield. "Uttara Bhadra represents the ability to gain this secret knowledge and with it to transcend its ties to the material world." The cow link also "suggests the honour and respect that these people can command."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon/lagna
Confidence: Presented as the nakshatra's own mystical endowment / remedial vocabulary
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Uttara Bhadra symbol — the Twins.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Uttara Bhadra symbol — the Twins.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Duality in every form: "it has found light so it must go into darkness, it is sattvic therefore it embraces tamas… loses interest in life yet has to live successfully in this world." The twin reflects the splitting of the atom, the gravitational pull of the earth. "All these polarities make this nakshatra extremely complex and full of intuitive energies."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon/lagna
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any planet in Pisces / Uttara Bhadra — material competence.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any planet in Pisces / Uttara Bhadra — material competence.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Pisces is a highly spiritual sign. The padas within it create the final blocks in finding self-realisation. This is not a sign where the material skills are good. They have to try hard to stay grounded or they can make wrong, even foolish choices in the material world." The fish cannot live out of water, unlike the Cancer crab or the Capricorn crocodile.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Rashi + nakshatra of the planet/lagna
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Uttara Bhadra dosha Pitta; caste Warrior; quality Fixed; shakti "Stabalizing" [sic].
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Uttara Bhadra dosha Pitta; caste Warrior; quality Fixed; shakti "Stabalizing" [sic].
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Adventurous and determined; use this dosha to take them into "the sea of nothingness", giving the dynamism to make this difficult task a reality. "There is no nervousness of vata or the philosophy and laid-back approach of kapha. Pitta people use their grit and determination to make the impossible happen."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Saturn's karmic mechanism operating through Uttara Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Saturn's karmic mechanism operating through Uttara Bhadra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Saturn is the planet of karmic retribution; it keeps an account of all the past acts and releases this karma unexpectedly." In childhood, teens and young adulthood this causes frustration as Saturn restricts the natural energy from expanding; with maturity they learn to use the Saturn forces properly. "The karmic debts still to be paid, or the unfulfilled desires, may be blocking the final doorway to the higher self for Uttara Bhadra. If they understand and reconcile, they can move towards the final transformation of the soul."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon/lagna; Saturn's placement and dasha periods; age
Confidence: Definite; age-staged
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any planet or lagna in Revati (16°40′–30°00′ Pisces), Mercury-ruled, Pushan devata, Gana Divine, guna Sattva-Sattva-Sattva, motivation Moksha.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any planet or lagna in Revati (16°40′–30°00′ Pisces), Mercury-ruled, Pushan devata, Gana Divine, guna Sattva-Sattva-Sattva, motivation Moksha.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Abundance/wealth, both spiritual and material (the harvest nakshatra). "It is in Revati where you sow the seed for fruition at a later date." Being the last nakshatra, Revati is powerful in realising the ultimate truths about ourselves, life, death, transformation and change; it changes the way of thinking towards a higher, deeper perspective and provides nourishment to the soul.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of the planet/lagna
Confidence: Definite (defining signature)

sutton_nakshatras.description: Revati prominent in an ordinary chart.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Revati prominent in an ordinary chart.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Not everyone is meant to be so highly spiritual. The average Revati individual aspires for the ideal, yet they remain stuck in their everyday lives. They feel let down by society and the world as it fails to live up to their ideal."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon/lagna; the rest of the chart's spiritual indicators
Confidence: Explicit caution against over-reading the nakshatra's spiritual promise
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Revati prominent (Pushan, the Aditya of the ayanas).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Revati prominent (Pushan, the Aditya of the ayanas).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Pushan guides both the living and the dead. He is the guardian of the transition stages of man. He helps people reach their right destination without fear or worry." This can be a direction in life or the higher direction where the soul transits from one realm to another. Revati = the connection to dawn, between night and day, death and rebirth; "that time of utter stillness that carries within it a promise of light and beginning of new dawn."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon/lagna; also relevant for death/transition questions and for Saturn (below)
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Venus in Revati (Pisces — Venus's exaltation), or Revati prominent for a marriage question.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Venus in Revati (Pisces — Venus's exaltation), or Revati prominent for a marriage question.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Venus is exalted. It provides the semen, the ideas, the seed for future development. Pushan, as the deity of the marriage ceremony, encourages people to find the right marriage that will keep their next generation alive. Marriage, children, ideas, future generations are all ensured by Venus placed here." Pushan represents the semen, an indication of the seed of creation, and connects to the marriage ceremony — "when couples marry they are no longer two but become one, a divine union."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Venus's nakshatra + pada + exact degree (27° Pisces = exaltation degree); 7th house/lord
Confidence: Definite positive — but see S-N27-018 for the gandanta reversal
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Lagna in Revati.

sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Lagna nakshatra + placement/strength of Mercury and Jupiter

Sun's nakshatra

They will try to be excellent in whatever they do, but unless their aim is spiritual, they may feel a failure."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's nakshatra + pada

With the start of Ketu dasha immediately after birth, the insecurities of Revati can be quite pronounced."

Moon's exact longitude (to test the gandanta zone and the Mercury-dasha balance at birth); age at the Mercury→Ketu dasha change

sutton_nakshatras.description: Mars in Revati.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Mars in Revati.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Mars is the spiritual warrior. He will be interested in keeping the flame alive but there can be turbulence. These people will not worry if their brand of spiritualism is acceptable to others or not."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Mars's nakshatra + pada (exalted in pada 2)
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Mercury in Revati (its own nakshatra, in Pisces).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Mercury in Revati (its own nakshatra, in Pisces).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Mercury is in its own nakshatra and HAS PASSED THE DEGREE OF ITS DEBILITATION, so the intellect works very differently in Revati than it does in Uttara Bhadra. Revati allows the mind to expand its horizons." Never good at material things — must train themselves to be practical. "But if you are looking for a profound thinker, then they are the ones to find. Their thinking knows no restrictions, they know no boundaries, and can therefore be great ideas people, thinkers and writers."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Mercury's exact longitude (its debilitation degree lies before Revati begins at 16°40′ Pisces); nakshatra + pada

sutton_nakshatras.description: Jupiter in Revati.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Jupiter in Revati.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Can be both strong and weak here. The wisdom must be used to build something good for the future; strong links to spirituality, creativity and nourishment. "The soul needs to be nourished. Future ideas have to be incubated. This usually involves teaching and passing on of knowledge. If the teachers do not do this, the seed does not flourish." Caution: "There is one pada to be careful about as Revati can debilitate Jupiter" — pada 2, Capricorn navamsha.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Jupiter's nakshatra + pada (essential — pada 1 = own sign and own pada; pada 2 = debilitated)
Confidence: Definite, explicitly pada-dependent
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Saturn in Revati.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Saturn in Revati.

"Two padas of Revati are ruled by Saturn, so it still has a role to play" (Capricorn and Aquarius padas). Task: pay the last debts to society and do what is right, so that it can flow with the river of creation. "Saturn deals with death and old age — a part of Revati's remit."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Saturn's nakshatra + pada
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Rahu/Ketu in Revati.

They face the transformational power of Revati; "the turbulence and deep secret wisdom make both Rahu Ketu confused." *Rahu:* like the demon Hayagriva, wants all the knowledge without truly understanding — "many lessons to learn before the true knowledge opens up to them." *Ketu:* carries all this profound wisdom yet does not know how to fully express it; may reject their wisdom — understanding the gift of past lives and using their intuitive knowledge will help them find themselves.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Rahu/Ketu nakshatra + pada
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in Revati pada 1 (16°40′–20°00′ Pisces, Sagittarius navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: No planet exalted or debilitated; "all have a strong message and are involved in a spiritual journey." "The last steps to be totally one with the spiritual connection." Great for Jupiter — in its own sign and own pada: "the wisdom is deep, the teaching great, the knowledge is passed on so that others can benefit."

Planet's exact longitude → pada

sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in Revati pada 2 (20°00′–23°20′ Pisces, Capricorn navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Mars exalted; Jupiter debilitated. "There is a residue of practical karma to be faced before the soul can be immersed completely in spirituality." Mars: "an extremely powerful position of Mars to make spiritual changes" — fights for the right causes, structures its life to achieve divine goals. Jupiter: "spiritual from above and calculating within" — "they should not try to hide their practical nature as hiding it only gives them a bad name."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's exact longitude → pada
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in Revati pada 3 (23°20′–26°40′ Pisces, Aquarius navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in Revati pada 3 (23°20′–26°40′ Pisces, Aquarius navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: No planet exalted or debilitated. All planets thinking of others, trying to complete their worldly responsibilities. "Aquarius is an air sign and can create storms within the Pisces ocean and make for confusion and turbulent emotions."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's exact longitude → pada
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in Revati pada 4 (26°40′–30°00′ Pisces, Pisces navamsha = VARGOTTAMA).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in Revati pada 4 (26°40′–30°00′ Pisces, Pisces navamsha = VARGOTTAMA).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "This is the final ending of the sign, nakshatra and navamsha/pada." "All planets here give potential for pushing the soul to the next level of its development. Planets according to their karakas can bring pain to your life, usually to enlighten and bring awareness of another facet of your subtle personality." Venus exalted (exaltation degree 27° Pisces, and vargottama); Mercury debilitated by rashi AND pada. Mercury: "the old rules do not work, the mind has to expand and reach for new horizons… the vargottama says that it is right for the mind to be so unconcerned. They will be happy in their spiritual role but not so good at practical matters or making decisions." Rahu: fascinated by the spiritual turmoil as it begins a new cycle; wants to embrace everything but does not always want to understand the deeper meaning. Ketu: "knows everything but it is cut off and hidden. It can feel insecure if it does not take refuge in its own intuition and trusts its inner voice."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's exact longitude → pada; check vargottama; test the last 48′ separately (S-N27-018/019)
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any planet (or the lagna) between 29°12′ and 30°00′ Pisces — the last 48′ of Revati pada 4, the end of the zodiac.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any planet (or the lagna) between 29°12′ and 30°00′ Pisces — the last 48′ of Revati pada 4, the end of the zodiac.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The end of Pisces is gandanta, the karmic knot where most of the toxins and poisons are collected. Pisces is the last sign and nakshatra, therefore crossing this gandanta is very complex." People with planets placed here are unable to move forward and are stuck in either (a) personal weaknesses, (b) lack of support from family, or (c) circumstances that do not allow them to complete this journey. "All planets placed in gandanta will be troubled according to their karaka and house rulerships. It is a complex situation and suffering can come with gandanta. The karmic knowledge is extremely difficult to unravel as this junction ends a complete cycle of soul growth and the planet stuck in a gandanta is not able to move forward."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Exact longitude of every planet and the lagna (degree-and-minute precision required); each planet's karaka significations and house rulerships (these determine *which* area is troubled)
Confidence: Definite and severe; the most emphatic negative in the chapter
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in the Pisces gandanta (29°12′–30°00′ Pisces).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in the Pisces gandanta (29°12′–30°00′ Pisces).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "It is important to accept the position and forgive the experiences that have come with this position. Only then can the soul be privy to great secret knowledge."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Exact longitude; identification of the experiences attached to that planet's karaka/houses

sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Venus in the Pisces gandanta (i.e. Venus exalted, vargottama, *and* gandanta).

Venus's exact longitude (must distinguish 26°40′–29°12′ from 29°12′–30°00′)

Godly time is different to human time, and as they develop they can move in differing time dimensions, and this can sometimes make it difficult to settle in the world they are in." Reinforced by the elephant: Revati's connection is with the flying elephants before the curse — "Revati has that ability to fly high, and for it to live on earth appears like a curse." Also: "Time moves at a different pace for Revati Pisces."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon/lagna
Confidence: Definite reading of the myth

sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon/lagna
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Revati motivation Moksha; caste Shudra; quality Soft; dosha Kapha.

The Revati spiritual path is SACRIFICE — "to give up what you desire for the good of others… through service to humanity, working, doing jobs that get no appreciation." Kapha: philosophical, calm and contented; they will work calmly through the greatest of stresses; "Revati people will stay calm in crises."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of Moon

sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any Mercury-ruled nakshatra (structural rule stated here).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any Mercury-ruled nakshatra (structural rule stated here).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Mercury nakshatras rule the ending of the nakshatra cycles, where the change of individual consciousness takes place by understanding and going beyond the limitations of intellect. Revati ends a major cycle of life where the consciousness meets the intellect to form new realities for the future." Underlying principle: "What Mercury perceives as reality is only a small part of the ultimate reality."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra lord of the planet in question
Confidence: Definite structural statement
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Revati / Pisces — the end-is-a-beginning principle.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Revati / Pisces — the end-is-a-beginning principle.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "In Revati, it is the end of a cycle, but within this ending there is a new beginning. SOMETHING IS CONCEIVED IN PISCES, TO BE BORN INTO A NEW CYCLE IN ARIES." "The fish is finally immersed in spirituality and higher consciousness. This is where they are the happiest. Intuitive wisdom and deep knowledge are the Pisces inheritance, so practical issues are not their forte."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra + rashi of the planet/lagna
Confidence: Definite
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A child is born; the Moon at birth occupies nakshatra X, pada Y.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A child is born; the Moon at birth occupies nakshatra X, pada Y.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: The child's name should begin with the akshara assigned to nakshatra X, pada Y in the Nama Nakshatra Table (§C.5). "This name will resonate with the nama nakshatra at birth and be forever like an auspicious chant."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's nakshatra and pada at birth.
Confidence: Definite — this is the stated tradition.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any nakshatra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any nakshatra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Each nakshatra carries four akshara, one per pada. The pada number of the Moon selects which of the four applies. (Worked: Chitra has four akshara Pay, Po, Raa, Re; a Moon in Chitra pada 2 takes Po.)
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's nakshatra + pada.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Male child born 19 February 2014, 4:43am, Los Angeles, California; Moon in Chitra pada 2 → akshara Po.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Male child born 19 February 2014, 4:43am, Los Angeles, California; Moon in Chitra pada 2 → akshara Po.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Suitable Indian names: Poorna, Poorna Chandra (both connected to the Moon), Poojan (worship). Western names: Pollux, Polar, Pomeroy. "There is a wide choice."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon nakshatra + pada; a name-list in any language beginning with the akshara.
Confidence: Illustrative — she explicitly notes the choice is wide, and that non-Indian names qualify equally.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The birth name's first consonant links to the nakshatra-pada of the Moon at birth.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The birth name's first consonant links to the nakshatra-pada of the Moon at birth.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "There is no need to check if the Moon is in a positive house or not." People embrace the nama nakshatra qualities.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Birth name's first consonant; Moon's nakshatra + pada.
Confidence: Definite, stated as an exemption clause.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The given/popular name does not begin with the Moon's akshara.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The given/popular name does not begin with the Moon's akshara.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Identify which nakshatra-pada the name's first consonant resounds with, then study what house that nakshatra-pada falls in (in the native's own chart, read from lagna — and, per the worked cases, also from the Moon). The nature of that nakshatra and that house then describes what the *name itself* will push the person toward.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Popular name's first consonant → nakshatra + pada → its rashi/degrees → its house from the native's lagna (and from the Moon).
Confidence: Definite method; the delineation itself is interpretive.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A person is commonly known by a different name from the one on the birth record (Robert Allen Zimmerman → Bob Dylan).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A person is commonly known by a different name from the one on the birth record (Robert Allen Zimmerman → Bob Dylan).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "We will be concerned with his popular name." The nama-nakshatra analysis is run on the name actually spoken.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
The name in daily public use.
Confidence: Definite — stated as her working choice, consistent with the "name as chant" rationale (S-CH5-001).
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Bob Dylan, 25 May 1941, 21:05, Duluth MN. Birth Moon = Krittika (pada 1, akshara Aa). Popular name begins Bo = Uttara Ashadha pada 2, in Capricorn. Lagna = Scorpio, so that pada falls in the 3rd house.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Bob Dylan, 25 May 1941, 21:05, Duluth MN. Birth Moon = Krittika (pada 1, akshara Aa). Popular name begins Bo = Uttara Ashadha pada 2, in Capricorn. Lagna = Scorpio, so that pada falls in the 3rd house.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: The name locates in the 3rd house of communication and motivation, "connected to writing and creativity too." Uttara Ashadha is a loner nakshatra, so "the name itself will encourage Bob Dylan to be private, spiritual and self-effacing. Whatever fame or wealth he has, he would never show off, mostly using his wealth to work for society."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Popular name's first consonant; lagna; the nakshatra's rashi.
Confidence: Worked case — presented as demonstrative.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A transiting planet crosses the nama nakshatra (and its pada).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A transiting planet crosses the nama nakshatra (and its pada).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Transits to these nakshatras can have effect according to their nature. Saturn transiting the nama nakshatra can bring obstacles, Jupiter can enhance the status and so on."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nama nakshatra + pada degrees; transit longitudes.
Confidence: Generally — "can have effect."
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: February 1961 — Dylan comes to New York to follow his musical career. Jupiter and Saturn conjoined at 1°53′ Capricorn, i.e. in pada 2 of Uttara Ashadha, his nama nakshatra pada (19 February 1961).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: February 1961 — Dylan comes to New York to follow his musical career. Jupiter and Saturn conjoined at 1°53′ Capricorn, i.e. in pada 2 of Uttara Ashadha, his nama nakshatra pada (19 February 1961).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "This was the most significant moment of Bob Dylan's life and two key planets influencing his nama nakshatra in the right pada would have been the key." (She adds: "The name is to do with recognition and status.")
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nama nakshatra pada degrees; transit positions of Jupiter and Saturn.
Confidence: Definite as presented; note the emphasis on exact pada match, not merely nakshatra match.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Someone changes their name or adopts a spiritual name.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Someone changes their name or adopts a spiritual name.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "It would be a good idea to get the Moon nama nakshatra name."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's nakshatra + pada.
Confidence: Recommendation ("would be a good idea").
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The Moon is in a troubled conjunction, or placed in any of the dusthana houses.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The Moon is in a troubled conjunction, or placed in any of the dusthana houses.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "It may be better to choose the nakshatra that trines the Moon or lagna" rather than the Moon's own nakshatra.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's house from lagna; conjunctions to the Moon; the two trinal nakshatras of the Moon's nakshatra; house positions of those trines from BOTH lagna and Moon.
Confidence: Conditional recommendation — "may be better."
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Dylan's Moon is in Krittika pada 1 with a close conjunction of Saturn; lagna Scorpio.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Dylan's Moon is in Krittika pada 1 with a close conjunction of Saturn; lagna Scorpio.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "His name at present is fine and there is no need to change it. Changing his name to the Moon nakshatra would bring up the Saturn Moon conjunction which would have a more depressing influence." Better: a nakshatra well placed from both the Moon and lagna.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's nakshatra + pada + conjunctions; lagna.
Confidence: Definite in the worked case.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Dylan — the trinal nakshatra of Krittika that falls in his 10th house from lagna and 5th from the Moon is Uttara Phalguni (Leo).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Dylan — the trinal nakshatra of Krittika that falls in his 10th house from lagna and 5th from the Moon is Uttara Phalguni (Leo).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: That is her recommendation. Akshara of Uttara Phalguni are Tay, To, Paa, Pee.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's nakshatra; the trinal nakshatras (same-numbered nakshatra +9 / +18 in the cycle); their houses from lagna AND from the Moon.
Confidence: Definite as applied. [EDITOR NOTE] Krittika is nakshatra 3; its trines by the 9-step cycle are Uttara Phalguni (12) and Uttara Ashadha (21) — consistent with the text, which names Uttara Phalguni as "the trinal nakshatra of Krittika."
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The existing/birth name sits in pada 1 of Krittika.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The existing/birth name sits in pada 1 of Krittika.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "He could choose pada 1 of Uttara Phalguni as his name is in pada 1 of Krittika." Hence the akshara Tay → "Taylor would also have been appropriate."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Pada number of the current name's nakshatra; the akshara list of the target trinal nakshatra.
Confidence: Definite — pada number is carried across.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Birth time unknown, date of birth known.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Birth time unknown, date of birth known.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Traditionally, choose the first consonant of the given name and identify its nakshatra to use as the degree of the ascendant." The pada's degree range is taken as the ascendant and a chart is constructed.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
First consonant of the given name; date of birth; the pada's degree range.
Confidence: Definite as a tradition she endorses from observation.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A person named Cathy — consonant Ca, "which is similar to Ka, as in Sanskrit we do not have a difference between C and K."
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A person named Cathy — consonant Ca, "which is similar to Ka, as in Sanskrit we do not have a difference between C and K."
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Ka resounds with Mrigasira pada 3, which is 00°0′ to 03°20′ Gemini. "These degrees can be taken as an ascendant and a chart constructed if the date of birth is known."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Name's first consonant; transliteration-equivalence rules (C≡K).
Confidence: Definite; note the explicit phonetic-equivalence licence — Sanskrit has no C/K distinction, so Roman spellings are mapped to the nearest Sanskrit akshara.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A transit hits the degrees of the nama-nakshatra pada used as ascendant.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A transit hits the degrees of the nama-nakshatra pada used as ascendant.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Any transits to these degrees – despite natal chart – will be sensitive. Malefic transits would create problems while benefics bring opportunities."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nama pada degree range; transit longitudes; benefic/malefic classification of the transiting planet.
Confidence: Definite; note the striking "despite natal chart" — the name's degrees are held to be independently sensitive.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any nakshatra occupied by any planet or the lagna.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any nakshatra occupied by any planet or the lagna.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The nakshatra is about the mind and the guna reflects the quality of the mind… it reveals how the mind is operating." All the planets will embrace the guna of their nakshatra. "The Moon's position continues to be key, but others should not be ignored."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of every planet and of the lagna (Moon first).
Confidence: Definite, foundational.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet/lagna in Ashwini … Ashlesha (1st–9th).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet/lagna in Ashwini … Ashlesha (1st–9th).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Rajas primary. "Rajas is the cause of activity in mankind. It is the searching quality that as humans, we all have." Translations she gives: 'pollen of the flowers', 'a particle in the sunbeams', 'emotional, moral or mental darkness'. Rajas is "a mental attitude that emphasizes strong emotional impulses." "Rajasic nakshatras are forever active, always seeking answers in the outer world. They remain dissatisfied because answers do not lie in the outer world."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra number of the point being judged.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet/lagna in Magha … Jyeshta (10th–18th).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet/lagna in Magha … Jyeshta (10th–18th).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Tamas primary. "Tamas is the attribute of darkness. The Sanskrit word can be translated as 'ignorance', making it plain that the darkness is a mental one." Tamasic people have "a mental attitude that emphasises sensuality… led by a lack of knowledge or of spiritual insight to a life focusing on human sensual desires." "The tamasic attitude is to embrace desires. They usually view life in the here and now. These desires keep them tied to the world of happiness and unhappiness; through their own needs they create their own problems." "Tamas nakshatras are passive and inert. They can be dispassionate and disinterested in the world around them, which can be taken as selfishness and laziness but at times it is only allowing things to be the way they are."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra number.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A tamasic native who chooses to engage.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A tamasic native who chooses to engage.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "If these people decide to connect, they can be highly spiritual." "Vedic philosophy encourages tamasic people to dispel their darkness with the light of spiritual insight."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Tamas primary + the native's own spiritual orientation (not chart-derivable).
Confidence: Conditional/potential — an explicitly optional outcome.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet/lagna in Mula … Revati (19th–27th).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet/lagna in Mula … Revati (19th–27th).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Sattva primary. "Sattva is the attribute of purity. Sat means being, existing, pure, true and real. Va means where purity dwells." A sattvic person believes in purity of being, thought, and action. "Water is pure sattva. Vegetarianism is sattvic because it rejects killing animals to fulfill the need to eat." "Sattva works very much on the abstract level and sattvic nakshatras are usually happy aspiring to their higher self. They will be calm and collected within relationships. They tend to work on a sense of fairness and love."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra number.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Excess sattva.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Excess sattva.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "While sattva is considered the best guna to have, too much of it can make us dysfunction in the material world we live in." Reinforced at Revati: "the pure sattva of Revati may be tough to deal with in the world we live in, which needs some rajas and tamas too."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Guna triplicity of the Moon/lagna/planets.
Confidence: Definite caution, stated twice.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any nakshatra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any nakshatra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect:
"While the guna divides nakshatras into three groups on a primary level, each of them reflects the gunas on three levels. This reveals three levels of consciousness of the planet. The mind organizes itself in multi-layered levels of consciousness and the soul works in many dimensions."
  - Primary level — "the one whose quality is most obvious. This generates action and the planets will work according to this guna primary."
  - Secondary level — "reflects hidden mental attitude and helps in generating ideas and thoughts."
  - Third level — "reflects a deeper, inner level, that remains hidden from others. This inspires spirituality but can remain dormant until developing spiritually can activate this level of consciousness."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra number of each planet/lagna → look up triplicity (C.6.2).
Confidence: Definite; this is the chapter's central construct.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Nakshatra number.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Nakshatra number.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Rajas 2nd level: 1st–3rd (Ashwini, Bharani, Krittika); 10th–12th (Magha, Purva Phalguni, Uttara Phalguni); 19th–21st (Mula, Purva Ashadha, Uttara Ashadha). Tamas 2nd level: 4th–6th (Rohini, Mrigasira, Ardra); 13th–15th (Hasta, Chitra, Swati); 22nd–24th (Shravana, Dhanishta, Shatabhishak). Sattva 2nd level: 7th–9th (Punarvasu, Pushya, Ashlesha); 16th–18th (Vishakha, Anuradha, Jyeshta); 25th–27th (Purva Bhadrapada, Uttara Bhadrapada, Revati).
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra number.
Confidence: Definite — given as explicit lists.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Nakshatra number.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Nakshatra number.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Rajas 3rd level: Ashwini, Rohini, Punarvasu, Magha, Hasta, Vishakha, Mula, Shravana, Purva Bhadrapada. Tamas 3rd level: Bharani, Mrigasira, Pushya, Purva Phalguni, Chitra, Anuradha, Purva Ashadha, Dhanishta, Uttara Bhadrapada. Sattva 3rd level: Krittika, Ardra, Ashlesha, Uttara Phalguni, Swati, Jyeshta, Uttara Ashadha, Shatabhishak, Revati.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra number.
Confidence: Definite — explicit lists. [EDITOR NOTE] These are exactly nakshatras ≡1, ≡2, ≡0 (mod 3) respectively, i.e. the third level steps R-T-S one nakshatra at a time. Combined with S-CH6-002/003/005 (period 9) and S-CH6-008 (period 3), the whole 27 is a complete base-3 enumeration — every one of the 27 possible triplets occurs exactly once. This is confirmed cell-by-cell against her printed table (C.6.2) with no exceptions.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any triplicity.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any triplicity.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The first level of guna is always the one that is obvious and which the others recognise."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Primary guna.
Confidence: Definite ("always").
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: All three levels carry the same guna.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: All three levels carry the same guna.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "This shows a concentration of the quality." Only three nakshatras qualify — Ashwini (all rajas), Chitra (all tamas), Revati (all sattva) — "the first, middle and last nakshatras."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Guna triplicity.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Two levels carry the same guna, one differs.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Two levels carry the same guna, one differs.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Then the third guna helps to bring out the balancing."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Guna triplicity.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: All three levels differ.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: All three levels differ.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The individual will have many facets and the mind moves within the three qualities constantly." Such nakshatras "have the ability to achieve the balance of the gunas as all qualities will be prominent at some time and their mixture gives a more complete personality."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Guna triplicity.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet/lagna in Ardra, Pushya, Uttara Phalguni, Vishakha [printed "Vishkha"], Purva Ashadha, Shravana.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet/lagna in Ardra, Pushya, Uttara Phalguni, Vishakha [printed "Vishkha"], Purva Ashadha, Shravana.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Six nakshatras express all three gunas within… They have the ability to achieve the balance of the gunas as all qualities will be prominent at some time and their mixture gives a more complete personality." (Marked italics in her table.)
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of the point.
Confidence: Definite, closed list of six.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any nakshatra not in {Ashwini, Chitra, Revati} ∪ {Ardra, Pushya, U Phalguni, Vishakha, P Ashadha, Shravana}.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any nakshatra not in {Ashwini, Chitra, Revati} ∪ {Ardra, Pushya, U Phalguni, Vishakha, P Ashadha, Shravana}.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The rest are 18 nakshatras that have guna imbalance with one guna missing from their triplicity. While this guna may be there in their mental makeup it will not be prominent."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Guna triplicity; identify the missing guna.
Confidence: Definite. [EDITOR NOTE] Naming *which* guna is missing is the operative datum; it is not tabulated by her, so it is derived in C.6.3.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet/lagna in Ashwini (rajas / rajas / rajas).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet/lagna in Ashwini (rajas / rajas / rajas).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The drive to find answers motivates Ashwini. After that all nakshatras will reflect various combinations of guna but the purity of rajas impulse is only in Ashwini."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet/lagna in Chitra, the 14th (tamas / tamas / tamas).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet/lagna in Chitra, the 14th (tamas / tamas / tamas).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The soul is completely caught up in the material work immersed in it yet the tamas can break in Chitra and a special light shine for them." Structurally: "Nakshatras from Ashwini to Chitra are searching in the outer world, becoming involved in it and going down to tamas. From Chitra onwards, tamas starts to unravel."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra.

sutton_nakshatras.description: 29°12′–30°00′ Scorpio and 00°00′–00°48′ Sagittarius — the Jyeshta/Mula gandanta.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: 29°12′–30°00′ Scorpio and 00°00′–00°48′ Sagittarius — the Jyeshta/Mula gandanta.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The gandanta at the end of Scorpio and the beginning of Sagittarius is known as Abhukta Mula. Abhukta means uneaten, not enjoyed, unused, unexpended. Mula means the root. Abhukta Mula has been wrongly given as bad luck. This indicates a soul who is unable to enjoy the blessings of life due to karmic circumstances. It can also indicate the inability to gain stability or get to the roots of our existence." She adds: "This is not as dire as it first appears. The social and emotional support from family and worldly issues may not be there, so the individual needs to find their own strength to develop their inner awareness, to be able to fight their spiritual battles alone. But… it is important that they should not press the self-destruct button and be their own worst enemy. Abhukta Mula is very tough where the individual is living a life of turmoil and many situations come into life that they have no control over. As the soul detaches from the material path, the experience can be painful. All planets will suffer by being placed in these degrees."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet longitude in that range.
Confidence: Definite, with an explicit correction of a traditional misreading ("wrongly given as bad luck") and an explicit de-escalation ("not as dire as it first appears").

The Sun placed in the gandanta point forces the soul to change its direction. But the main connection is with the Moon and the Ascendant."
