sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in a Sampat position.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in a Sampat position.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "This nakshatra is positive… Planets placed within it bring prosperity and wealth during their dasha. Malefics placed here can make a person feel deprived, even though they have good finances. The influence of the transit can impact their prosperity depending on their nature."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet position count from janma; benefic/malefic; dasha.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in a Vipat position.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in a Vipat position.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "In practice planets placed in vipat nakshatras tend to lose some of their power and create obstacles in life. People with planets here can make wrong decisions and their karakas and house rulerships get influenced negatively. Planets in vipat nakshatras do not work well and it is during their dashas that they show their true nature."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Position count; the planet's karakatwa and house lordships; dasha.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in a Kshema position.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in a Kshema position.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Planets placed here are supported and their karaka prosper. Dashas of planets in these nakshatras are good and the transit will have an influence according to the nature of the planet."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Position count; karakatwa; dasha.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in a Prayatak position.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in a Prayatak position.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Planets placed here suffer blocks according to their karaka or house rulership. They can also influence health negatively during their dasha."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Position count; karakatwa; house lordships; dasha.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Venus placed in a prayatak nakshatra from the ascendant or the Moon.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Venus placed in a prayatak nakshatra from the ascendant or the Moon.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "It can bring obstacles in marriage EVEN IF IT APPEARS WELL PLACED IN THE RASHI CHART."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Venus's nakshatra; janma nakshatra from both lagna and Moon; the position count.
Confidence: Definite, and explicitly framed as overriding a favourable rashi-chart reading — a high-value rule for the layer.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in a Sadhana position.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in a Sadhana position.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "*Sadhana* means practice and it is usually referred to as a spiritual practice with the aim of achieving specific goals. All planets placed in sadhana nakshatras do well. They bring accomplishments, attainment and realisation of ambitions. The dasha of planets in sadhana nakshatra usually do well. Malefic transits to sadhana nakshatra can block our good practices and create struggles whereas benefics bring opportunities."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Position count; dasha; transits.
Confidence: Definite — note "all planets."
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in a Naidhana position.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in a Naidhana position.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "*Naidhana* means liable to death or destruction and perishable. These are not easy nakshatras… planets placed in them will bring suffering and difficulty. Transits to naidhana nakshatra are especially challenging for malefics. ⭐ Naidhana nakshatras are linked to the 8th house experience so can bring unexpected events that change the course of life."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Position count; transits.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in a Mitra position.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in a Mitra position.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "All planets placed here are friendly and help in the progress of the chart."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Position count.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet in a Param Mitra position.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet in a Param Mitra position.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "This is a positive position… This is the nakshatra preceding the janma. All planets will be friendly and supportive."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Position count.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The 4th nakshatra from the reference point, and planets in it.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The 4th nakshatra from the reference point, and planets in it.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "*Jati* means a form of lineage fixed by birth, race, family, rank, caste, tribe or class. One can look at a wider definition as in what kind of society we were born into… It is a very good nakshatra as it relates to the first paryay and kshema nakshatra. It deals with our life style, community, and society that support and give comfort. This nakshatra is studied for lineage, our ability to share food, to give oblations to the fire god, as well as the future of our family."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Janma nakshatra (Moon or lagna — she names both here); planets in the 4th nakshatra.
Confidence: Definite; positive.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The 8th nakshatra from janma.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The 8th nakshatra from janma.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "*Matru* means mother so the relationship with the mother is studied from this. A malefic placed here can create problems. Transits to the matru nakshatra can improve or create problems both in one's relationship with the mother and in her own life as well."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Janma nakshatra; planets in the 8th nakshatra; transits.
Confidence: Definite. Note it predicts the mother's own life, not only the relationship.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The 10th nakshatra from janma.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The 10th nakshatra from janma.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Indicates the profession or work that the individual will do. This is the next nakshatra ruled by the same ruler as the janma. If the janma is Rohini, then the karma nakshatra will be Hasta. The nakshatra itself has significance regarding the type of profession chosen and planets placed there will add to the information. Transits to this nakshatra can lead to major career success."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Janma nakshatra; planets in the 10th nakshatra; transits.
Confidence: Definite. [EDITOR NOTE] The 10th from any nakshatra is always the next one with the same Vimshottari lord (9 + 1), so "karma" is always in the same paryay family as janma — internally consistent.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Another person's lagna or Moon falls in your karma nakshatra (the 10th from your janma).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Another person's lagna or Moon falls in your karma nakshatra (the 10th from your janma).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "People who have their lagna or the Moon in this nakshatra can be good for you professionally. If an individual has Vishakha Moon and your Moon is Punarvasu, they will be good for you in supporting your karma – this loosely translates into their ability to help professionally."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Your Moon nakshatra; the other person's Moon or lagna nakshatra.
Confidence: Definite; verified — Vishakha (16) is the 10th from Punarvasu (7).
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The 16th nakshatra from janma.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The 16th nakshatra from janma.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "*Sangha* means unions, groups, associations and close or intimate relationships. *Tika* means to challenge, to hurt, wound or injure. Sanghatika means close associations that are challenging and have the ability to hurt and injure. This is a difficult nakshatra. Planets placed in this nakshatra suffer according to their significations and house rulership. ⭐ If the ascendant ruler is placed in sanghatika nakshatra, there can be a tendency to keep bad company that hurts the individual."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Janma nakshatra; planets in the 16th; the lagna lord's nakshatra.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Another person's Moon nakshatra is the 16th from your janma Moon nakshatra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Another person's Moon nakshatra is the 16th from your janma Moon nakshatra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Relationships with anyone representing the 16th nakshatra from your janma Moon nakshatra usually creates challenging situations and can be destructive. If the janma is Krittika then the sanghatika nakshatra will be Jyeshta. There is incompatibility between Krittika and Jyeshta Moons as Jyeshta has the ability to hurt or challenge Krittika. They can form intimate relationships with each other but these may not be productive for Krittika. It would also create problems when malefic planets transit this nakshatra."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Both Moon nakshatras.
Confidence: Definite; verified — Jyeshta (18) is the 16th from Krittika (3). ⚠️ Note the asymmetry: it hurts the person whose janma it is counted from. Krittika is damaged by Jyeshta, not vice versa.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The 18th nakshatra from janma.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The 18th nakshatra from janma.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "An auspicious one. It means ascent, rising, war, battle, auspicious moment, and planets in this nakshatra are positive. It deals with good karma from a past life and is one of the most positive nakshatras in our chart. Planets placed here will give rise and success during their dasha and their significations are positive. Transits to this nakshatra will enhance the chart."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Janma nakshatra; planets in the 18th; dashas; transits.
Confidence: Definite; one of her two strongest positives.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The 19th nakshatra from janma.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The 19th nakshatra from janma.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The creative nakshatra of the chart. *Aadhana* means taking, placing in the sacred pot, deposit, a receptacle, a ceremony performed before conception, keeping the sacred fire. Aadhana is connected to conception and therefore the aadhana nakshatra is where new projects are conceived and ideas created for the future. The root of our creation is seen from this. ⭐ "The father is studied from aadhana nakshatra. If malefic planets are placed in this nakshatra or the ruler of this nakshatra is not well placed, it can lead to a difficult relationship with him. Malefic transits to this nakshatra can influence the father negatively as well as the creative abilities of an individual."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Janma nakshatra; planets in the 19th; the nakshatra lord of the 19th and its placement; transits.
Confidence: Definite. Note the paired significations — creativity and father.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The 23rd nakshatra from janma.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The 23rd nakshatra from janma.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "It means ruin, annihilation and destruction. Planets placed here can be destroyed. This should be specially studied for medical astrology and health. This nakshatra gives a destructive quality to the planets placed within it and the significations can suffer. Be careful of the transits of Saturn, Mars or Rahu; even the benefics in this nakshatra may not be able to give good results. Relationships with individuals having this nakshatra are not always happy or profitable."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Janma nakshatra; planets in the 23rd; transits of Saturn/Mars/Rahu; partner's Moon nakshatra.
Confidence: Definite; her most destructive nadi.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Electing a time to start something.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Electing a time to start something.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Starting anything good when the Moon is in vinasha nakshatra is not beneficial."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Your janma nakshatra → your vinasha nakshatra (C.9.4); the transiting Moon's nakshatra.
Confidence: Definite; the one explicit muhurta rule in the chapter and directly implementable.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The 25th nakshatra from janma.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The 25th nakshatra from janma.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "*Manas* means the mind and this nakshatra gives a deeper understanding and further clues as to how the mind works. This is a key nakshatra to study on all charts. The nakshatra that rules the manasa especially from the Moon shows how the mind works, and planets placed in the manasa nakshatra will express the quality of the mind. ⚠️ "Saturn, Rahu or Mars or Ketu placed here will give many mental stresses and can create emotional problems like depression too. Malefic transits to this nakshatra are challenging."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Janma nakshatra (especially the Moon's); planets in the 25th.
Confidence: Definite; she calls it "a key nakshatra to study on all charts."
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A transit crossing the manasa nakshatra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A transit crossing the manasa nakshatra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Transits to 25th nakshatra are times of great emotional stress and there is a possibility of wrong thinking and making difficult decisions. The transits that need to be watched are of Saturn, Rahu, Ketu and malefic conjunctions that take place in the manasa nakshatra. A Mars transit can be studied too but as it is a fast-moving planet, it does not stay in one nakshatra for too long." Worked: "In 2014, Mars and Rahu were both in Chitra nakshatra, and due to its retrogression Mars remained in Chitra with Rahu for a much longer time, so people with Chitra as their manasa nakshatra would have felt its influence acutely." ⭐ "A Rahu Ketu transit suggests that the solar and lunar eclipses during that time may be in manasa nakshatra too, bringing added fears and anxieties."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Manasa nakshatra; transit longitudes of Saturn, Rahu, Ketu, Mars; retrogression; eclipse positions.
Confidence: Definite; note retrogression lengthens the effect and eclipses in manasa intensify it.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Saturn transiting into the manasa nakshatra (25th from the Moon).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Saturn transiting into the manasa nakshatra (25th from the Moon).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "When Saturn enters the 25th nakshatra, this can be taken as the start of sade sati. Although technically sade sati begins when Saturn moves into the 12th house from the Moon, in practice the transit to the manasa nakshatra is when the mind starts feeling restless. Saturn's transit through manasa nakshatra creates pressures, stress and mental uncertainty which can lead us to make unwise decisions that lead to the crisis situations when Saturn is transiting over the exalt degrees of the natal Moon."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's nakshatra → manasa nakshatra; Saturn's transit; the Moon's exaltation degree.
Confidence: Definite as her practice, explicitly contrasted with the "technical" definition. [EDITOR NOTE] The 25th nakshatra from the Moon begins ~1.5 nakshatras (≈20°) before the 12th house from the Moon, so this extends sade sati earlier; it does not replace the standard definition, and she says so.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The 27th nakshatra from janma (the one immediately preceding it).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The 27th nakshatra from janma (the one immediately preceding it).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Abhishekha is connected to power and achievement. It is param mitra too and all planets placed here are positive and supportive. Transits to this nakshatra, especially benefics, can raise the status of an individual and bring many good opportunities."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Janma nakshatra; planets in the 27th; transits.
Confidence: Definite; her strongest positive nadi.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Natal chart only.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Natal chart only.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "How the planets relate to each other via nadi nakshatra in the natal chart. This will give clues as to how the nadi nakshatras affect the chart, dasha and bhuktis and its karakas. Karakas placed in negative nakshatras can be damaged. Analyse from the Moon, Sun and lagna points of view, and study what energy each nakshatra is reflecting."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
All planet nakshatras; three reference points.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A running mahadasha with its bhuktis.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A running mahadasha with its bhuktis.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "First the nadi position of the maha dasha ruler is studied from the Moon, and then the maha dasha ruler's relationship with the bhukti rulers is studied FROM ITS OWN POINT OF VIEW. Two sets of information need to be synthesised. It is complex and needs practice… but the result is very good. It gives a deeper understanding to the roles nakshatras play during each period and how planets will change their role as the mahadasha alter. Planets placed in positive nadis from the Moon and the dasha ruler will give great opportunities, whereas difficult nadis can bring crisis."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon nakshatra; mahadasha lord's natal nakshatra (used as a second janma); each bhukti lord's natal nakshatra; the dasha timeline.
Confidence: Definite; ⭐ this is the chapter's most powerful predictive construct — the reference point moves with the mahadasha.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planets moving through the nakshatra mandala.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planets moving through the nakshatra mandala.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Extremely useful; as the planets move through the nakshatra mandala, they will connect to the different nadis and create situations that may not be understood through normal analysis." (Restated at PDF 532: "Transits to these nadi nakshatras are significant and can create issues according to their nature. These are often overlooked as they are not so obvious through other analysis.")
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nadi map from the chosen reference point; transit longitudes.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Two charts.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Two charts.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Nadi nakshatras are important in compatibility. Certain nakshatras from the natal Moon nakshatra are extremely negative. Choosing partners with those nakshatras can bring unhappiness and sorrow." The named ones in this chapter: Sanghatika (16th) — "challenging… can be destructive" (S-CH9-025); Vinasha (23rd) — "relationships with individuals having this nakshatra are not always happy or profitable" (S-CH9-028); Karma (10th) — positive, "good for you professionally" (S-CH9-023); same nakshatra — "not considered good" classically (S-CH9-010).
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon nakshatra of both parties.
Confidence: Definite. ⚠️ She says "certain nakshatras… are extremely negative" but never gives a consolidated list — the three above are collected here from scattered passages.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Oprah — Moon Anuradha, lagna Mula. Mula is the 3rd (vipat) nakshatra from Anuradha.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Oprah — Moon Anuradha, lagna Mula. Mula is the 3rd (vipat) nakshatra from Anuradha.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "This can create lack of understanding between the mind and the body. Her body image (lagna) may be bad. Oprah has suffered from weight issues throughout her life and this may be one of the reasons." ⭐ "Often conflicting or difficult positions are not necessarily negative as it creates the friction that makes an individual keen to succeed."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon nakshatra; lagna nakshatra; the position count between them.
Confidence: Worked case. ⭐ The lagna's nadi position from the Moon is itself a reading — mind vs body.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Oprah's Moon is in Scorpio (debilitated). Its ruler Mars is in Vishakha = abhishekha from the Moon; the co-ruler Ketu is in Punarvasu = samudaya from the Moon.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Oprah's Moon is in Scorpio (debilitated). Its ruler Mars is in Vishakha = abhishekha from the Moon; the co-ruler Ketu is in Punarvasu = samudaya from the Moon.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Mars in abhishekha gives "the ability to control it as well as inspiration for the crowning glory that abhishekha promises. This is an excellent position for the Moon ruler to be in." Ketu in samudaya "gives victory and success. Even though Oprah's Moon is in its debilitated sign, the placement of the two rulers in positive nadis further helped in her success."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's rashi and its ruler(s) — including Ketu as co-ruler of Scorpio; their nakshatras; nadi positions from the Moon.
Confidence: Worked case; a debilitation-mitigation rule via nadi.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Jupiter in Mrigasira = the 16th (sanghatika) from Anuradha.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Jupiter in Mrigasira = the 16th (sanghatika) from Anuradha.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "This may be the reason that she had very difficult issues with men in her early years. Even now she remains unmarried although she does have a partner."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Jupiter's nakshatra; Moon's nakshatra.
Confidence: Worked case; note Jupiter is being read as the karaka for husband.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Oprah's manasa nakshatra from the Moon = Chitra, with no planet in it.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Oprah's manasa nakshatra from the Moon = Chitra, with no planet in it.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Chitra is a creative nakshatra and would give her the many talents she has for acting, writing, presenting etc. She gave up her show in September 2011 at the exact moment Saturn began its transit in Chitra. She would have been emotionally troubled throughout that time following the end of her show. Saturn blocked the mind and delayed all projects and the launch of her TV channel was not successful. The mind would have been troubled with manasa transit of Saturn and she may not have taken the right decisions."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon nakshatra → manasa nakshatra; Saturn's transit ingress dates.
Confidence: Worked timing; ⭐ note an empty manasa nakshatra is still read — its own character describes the mind.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Oprah's lagna is in vipat from the Moon (difficult), but her Moon is in abhishekha from the lagna (excellent).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Oprah's lagna is in vipat from the Moon (difficult), but her Moon is in abhishekha from the lagna (excellent).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Oprah has the Moon placed in the abhishekha nakshatra from the lagna. This is very positive and her mind helps the lagna to resolve any issues that were created by the difficult position of lagna from the Moon."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon and lagna nakshatras, read both ways.
Confidence: Worked case; ⭐ the reciprocal reading is the method for integrating conflicting points of view (S-CH9-003).
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Jupiter is the lagna lord (Sagittarius lagna) and sits in prayatak from the lagna (and sanghatika from the Moon).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Jupiter is the lagna lord (Sagittarius lagna) and sits in prayatak from the lagna (and sanghatika from the Moon).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Not well placed from both the lagna and the Moon, which can further add to relationship issues… being placed in the prayatak or obstacle position may have made her very competitive, always treating every block as an opportunity."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Lagna lord; its nakshatra; nadi position from both lagna and Moon.
Confidence: Worked case; note again the positive reframing of an obstacle position.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Manasa from the lagna (Mula) = Vishakha, with Mars in it.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Manasa from the lagna (Mula) = Vishakha, with Mars in it.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Mars would give a fiery intellect. She may have anger issues that can at times spoil her thinking. Vishakha stands at the threshold of the higher experience and she could have used this quality to create a show where self-improvement was the key. Saturn is in Vishakha nakshatra in 2013 and 2014 and this would continue to block her thinking and bring challenges and uncertainties. Saturn moves out of Vishakha on 30 Nov 2014."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Lagna nakshatra → manasa; planets in it; Saturn's transit dates.
Confidence: Worked case + a dated forward prediction.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planet A occupies a nakshatra ruled by planet B, and planet B occupies a nakshatra ruled by planet A.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planet A occupies a nakshatra ruled by planet B, and planet B occupies a nakshatra ruled by planet A.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Parivartana or mutual reception between Jupiter and Mars ruled nakshatras. Jupiter is in a nakshatra ruled by Mars and Mars is in a nakshatra ruled by Jupiter. This is connecting the 1st house ruler with the 5th house of creativity." (Oprah: lagna lord Jupiter in Mrigasira — Mars-ruled; 5th lord Mars in Vishakha — Jupiter-ruled.)
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Every planet's nakshatra and its Vimshottari lord; house lordships.
Confidence: Definite as applied; [EDITOR NOTE] this is a *nakshatra*-level parivartana, distinct from the classical rashi-level exchange of signs.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any natal chart is to be read through the nakshatras.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any natal chart is to be read through the nakshatras.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: The nakshatras exercise a profound influence on the planets, and the planets reflect the way the mind works. Knowing the nakshatra positions of *all* the planets gives deeper insight into both the material and the spiritual aspects of life.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of every planet + the ascendant.
Confidence: Stated as the governing principle of the chapter.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Deciding what to analyse first.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Deciding what to analyse first.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The most important and the first one to analyse is the influence of the nakshatras on the natal chart." Gunas and nama nakshatra are worked out at the same stage. Only then move on to the nadi nakshatras, which are "an advanced and complex technique which needs time and effort to master".
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Full natal nakshatra set.
Confidence: Definite ordering instruction.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Structuring a whole reading.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Structuring a whole reading.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: There are two ways to analyse the chart — static (what the natal chart reveals) and dynamic (how the chart develops through the maha dashas, their sub-periods and transits).
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Natal chart; Vimshottari dasha sequence with dates; transit ephemeris.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Performing static analysis.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Performing static analysis.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Run this 8-point checklist — (1) nakshatras of the ascendant and the planets, with extra emphasis on the Moon's nakshatra; (2) the rulers of the nakshatra, its qualities, and its relationship with the planet placed in it; (3) the pattern of rulership / any unique patterns revealed by the nakshatras; (4) what houses the nakshatra ruler rules; (5) navamsha, pushkara, ashtamamsha and vargottama; (6) nama nakshatra and gunas; (7) the animal sign of the Moon nakshatra and its impact on sexuality; (8) nadi nakshatras — how the planets fall and how they relate to each other; plus the importance of the manasa (25th) nakshatra from the Moon.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra + pada of Lagna and all nine planets; nakshatra rulers and their house rulerships and placements; navamsha chart; pushkara/ashtamamsha/vargottama flags; guna triplicity per nakshatra; yoni of the Moon nakshatra; navatara grid from the Moon.
Confidence: Definite — this is her own list.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Performing dynamic analysis.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Performing dynamic analysis.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Run this 3-point checklist — (1) what is the nakshatra ruler of the dasha ruler and its subtle influence; (2) nadi nakshatra analysis from the dasha lord; (3) transits through the nadi nakshatra.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Running maha dasha / bhukti lord; the dasha lord's nakshatra and that nakshatra's ruler; navatara grid built from the dasha lord; current transits by nakshatra.
Confidence: Definite — her own list.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Applying any nakshatra technique.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Applying any nakshatra technique.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The nakshatras need to be analysed along with other rules of vedic astrology which are not discussed in this book." Nakshatra findings are an overlay on, not a replacement for, ordinary Parashari analysis.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
A conventional chart analysis completed first.
Confidence: Explicit caution, repeated at PDF 571.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A nakshatra contains no planet and does not hold the ascendant.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A nakshatra contains no planet and does not hold the ascendant.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "We are only influenced by the nakshatras when they are activated due to their position in the ascendant or when planets are placed in them." Exception: the characteristics of the 25th (manasa) nakshatra show the workings of the mind *even if there are no planets placed there.*
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Occupancy of each nakshatra; the 25th nakshatra counted from the Moon.
Confidence: Definite, with one stated exception.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A planet occupies a nakshatra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A planet occupies a nakshatra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The nakshatra ruler acts as a controller of the mentality of the planet." The house positions of the nakshatra rulers are significant too.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Each planet's nakshatra; the ruler of that nakshatra; that ruler's house position.
Confidence: Definite — this is her central mind-reading device.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Blending rashi and nakshatra for one planet.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Blending rashi and nakshatra for one planet.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The ruler of the rashi manages the outer story and the ruler of the nakshatra the inner one, and both of these need to be blended together to make a full analysis."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's rashi + rashi lord; planet's nakshatra + nakshatra lord.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The nakshatra ruler and the planet placed in it are friends or enemies.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The nakshatra ruler and the planet placed in it are friends or enemies.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: The nakshatra ruler sometimes enhances the planet's energy and sometimes detracts from it, according to that relationship.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planetary friendship/enmity between the occupying planet and the nakshatra lord.
Confidence: General principle.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Saturn placed in a Mars-ruled nakshatra — Mrigasira, Chitra or Dhanishta.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Saturn placed in a Mars-ruled nakshatra — Mrigasira, Chitra or Dhanishta.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "It intensifies the stress factor within, as Mars and Saturn are enemies. Saturn's qualities are responsibility, duty, and a good work ethic, so these can suffer while under the influence of action-oriented Mars."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Saturn's nakshatra.
Confidence: Definite; given as her worked illustration of S-CH10-010.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Assessing any nakshatra ruler.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Assessing any nakshatra ruler.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Ascertain four things — (1) strength of the nakshatra ruler and its house placement; (2) what other dignity it acquires (is it atmakaraka, yogi planet, lagna lord?); (3) is it in rajayoga or any other planetary yoga; (4) the lagna-nakshatra rule (S-CH10-013).
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra ruler's strength, house, karaka status (atmakaraka by highest degree), yogi-planet status, lagna lordship, yoga participation.
Confidence: Definite — her own bulleted list.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A planet rules the nakshatra occupied by the ascendant.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A planet rules the nakshatra occupied by the ascendant.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Ruler of the lagna nakshatra is always good and in its dasha gives a rise in status."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Lagna's nakshatra; its ruler; that ruler's dasha dates.
Confidence: Stated absolutely ("always"), but qualified by S-CH10-016.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The rashi ruler and the nakshatra ruler of a point are the same planet.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The rashi ruler and the nakshatra ruler of a point are the same planet.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: This "adds to the intensity" of that planet's expression.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Rashi lord and nakshatra lord of the point in question.
Confidence: Definite. (Her case: Leo lagna in Uttara Phalguni — both Sun.)
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Reading the ascendant.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Reading the ascendant.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: The lagna nakshatra shows the underlying influences of the nakshatra on the rashi lagna. Both the lagna and the lagna-nakshatra ruler must be taken into consideration. The lagna sign decides the temporary benefics and malefics for the natal chart; the ruler of the lagna nakshatra always works well for the chart, giving its supportive qualities to the person and creating positive situations during its dashas.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Lagna rashi; lagna nakshatra + pada; lagna lord; lagna-nakshatra lord.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The ruler of the lagna nakshatra is placed in difficult houses, or carries challenging conjunctions.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The ruler of the lagna nakshatra is placed in difficult houses, or carries challenging conjunctions.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: It "can bring inner weaknesses too" — i.e. the always-good rule (S-CH10-013/015) is modified inwardly, not cancelled.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
House placement and conjunctions of the lagna-nakshatra lord.
Confidence: Stated as a qualification.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The lagna falls in a pushkara degree/navamsha.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The lagna falls in a pushkara degree/navamsha.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The lagna being pushkara helps to strengthen any weakness created by the placement of the lagna lord."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Pushkara status of the lagna degree; house placement of the lagna lord.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A nakshatra's pada places it in a sign especially congenial to that nakshatra's nature.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A nakshatra's pada places it in a sign especially congenial to that nakshatra's nature.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: That pada is "one of the best places to express the nakshatra's qualities". (Her case: the Sagittarius pada of Uttara Phalguni.)
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra + pada + navamsha rashi of the pada.
Confidence: A tendency; asserted, not derived.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Weighing the planets against each other in nakshatra analysis.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Weighing the planets against each other in nakshatra analysis.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The Moon has more significance than other planets in the nakshatra analysis as it is the overall ruler of the nakshatras. The quality of the Moon will give added flavour to the other planets and their mental qualities."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's nakshatra, pada, house, and the nakshatra's deity/qualities.
Confidence: Definite — the Moon's nakshatra outranks all others.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac
sutton_nakshatras.page: PDF 559 (and "extra emphasis on the moon's nakshatra", PDF 552)

sutton_nakshatras.description: The Moon occupies one of the last nakshatras of the zodiac.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The Moon occupies one of the last nakshatras of the zodiac.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: The soul "is thinking of all the responsibilities it must finish before it can move on to the next dimension" — producing a sense of urgency in how the person lives, wanting things done immediately and demanding the same of others.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Ordinal number of the Moon's nakshatra (1–27).
Confidence: A tendency, derived from nakshatra ordinal position.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The Moon is in a private/withdrawn nakshatra and placed in the 8th house.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The Moon is in a private/withdrawn nakshatra and placed in the 8th house.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: The mind "may have remained a mystery to those close" to the native; the 8th-house position adds to the mystical and private quality; the nakshatra "only comes up to connect with others when it is essential".
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's nakshatra character; Moon's house.
Confidence: A tendency.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Any planet is being delineated.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Any planet is being delineated.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Read the nakshatra and the navamsha pada rashi as two separate layers — the pada modifies the nakshatra's expression (e.g. Moon in Uttara Bhadra's Scorpio pada "magnified the intensity"; Sun in Shatabhishak's Capricorn pada gave "a double Saturn influence"; Saturn in Vishakha's Gemini pada "adds to the intellectual prowess"; Mars in Ashwini's Taurus pada "brings a practical and maybe indulgent side").
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra + pada + the pada's navamsha rashi, for every planet.
Confidence: Definite — she applies it to every planet without exception.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A planet is debilitated by pada (i.e. debilitated in the navamsha rashi of its pada) and placed in the 8th house.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A planet is debilitated by pada (i.e. debilitated in the navamsha rashi of its pada) and placed in the 8th house.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Adds to physical weakness and health crisis.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Pada navamsha rashi + planet's debilitation sign; planet's house.
Confidence: Definite in her application (Moon: "he died in his Moon dasha").
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A planet is vargottama (same rashi in rashi chart and navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A planet is vargottama (same rashi in rashi chart and navamsha).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Usually the vargottama position suggests that all planets are comfortable with what they need to achieve." It secures and strengthens the planet's own quality and the affairs of the houses it rules.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Rashi-chart sign and navamsha sign of the planet.
Confidence: "Usually".
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A planet is in pushkara.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A planet is in pushkara.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Pushkara allows the planets to heal themselves."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Pushkara degree/navamsha flag for the planet.
Confidence: Definite, briefly stated.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A planet is vargottama in the nakshatra of its own dispositor's nature, e.g. Jupiter vargottama in Punarvasu (Jupiter's own nakshatra) in Gemini.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A planet is vargottama in the nakshatra of its own dispositor's nature, e.g. Jupiter vargottama in Punarvasu (Jupiter's own nakshatra) in Gemini.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "A special ability to live on multiple dimensions of consciousness and to move seamlessly from one to the other" — success in several unrelated fields at once. Where the nakshatra ruler is the planet itself, the planet's own qualities are further enhanced along with the sign's.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's nakshatra + its ruler; vargottama flag.
Confidence: "Definitely a signature of" — she states this strongly.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A planet is retrograde.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A planet is retrograde.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Retrograde planets are full of ideas, often reflecting them in unconventional ways. Sometimes these ideas are not expressed and at others they can get over-expressed." A retrograde planet that is also vargottama has its quality secured — "powerful, quirky, outside the box" — but the native may still feel they are not fully expressing their talent.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Retrogression flag; vargottama flag.
Confidence: General tendency.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A planet is stationary or almost stationary (about to change direction).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A planet is stationary or almost stationary (about to change direction).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Its expression is intensified and it is made stronger. (Mercury "stationary retrograde… turned direct at 2.15 am, just hours after his birth. This adds to the intensity of the Shravana experience"; exalted Saturn "made even stronger by being almost stationary"; Mercury "strong by being stationary".)
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Planet's daily motion / station times around birth.
Confidence: Definite, applied three times.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Identifying the atmakaraka.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Identifying the atmakaraka.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: The atmakaraka is the planet with the highest degree; this gives it added influence, and its nakshatra describes the soul's journey. Where the atmakaraka's nakshatra symbolism is austere/solitary, the native's life journey is lonely "even though he had partners, a wife and children".
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Degrees of all planets; nakshatra of the highest-degree planet.
Confidence: Definite (standard Jaimini definition, used as such).
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Atmakaraka is vargottama and pushkara in its nakshatra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Atmakaraka is vargottama and pushkara in its nakshatra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Steve Jobs was in harmony with his soul's ambitions — the outer and inner vision was the same." Even when placed in a rival planet's sign and pada this is "a great position".
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Atmakaraka + vargottama/pushkara flags + sign/pada dispositor relations.
Confidence: Definite for her case.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A planet is placed in Mula (and by extension in any gandanta-bearing nakshatra).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A planet is placed in Mula (and by extension in any gandanta-bearing nakshatra).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The first thing to check when a planet is in Mula is whether or not it is gandanta." A planet in pada 3 of Mula is not gandanta.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Exact degree of the planet; pada boundaries of Mula.
Confidence: Definite procedural instruction.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A planet occupies a badhaka house (for Leo lagna, the 9th).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A planet occupies a badhaka house (for Leo lagna, the 9th).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Even a planet otherwise excellently placed there has "weakness in the strength" — a blocking influence expressed through that house's significations. (Mars, best planet for Leo as 4th/9th lord, in own sign Aries in the 9th: "at first glance that looks like an excellent position, but there is an underlying problem as the 9th house is considered badhaka, or a blocking house for Leo.")
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Lagna rashi (to derive badhaka house); planet's house.
Confidence: Definite; she treats it as decisive over surface strength.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Both Rahu and Ketu fall in destructive/fierce nakshatras (e.g. Mula and Ardra).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Both Rahu and Ketu fall in destructive/fierce nakshatras (e.g. Mula and Ardra).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: May reflect the destruction of the birth family and the receiving of a new one (in her case: adoption).
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatras of Rahu and Ketu and their deity natures.
Confidence: Offered as a possibility ("may reflect").
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Testing whether a person's actual name suits their chart.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Testing whether a person's actual name suits their chart.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Take the consonant(s) of the birth (Moon) nakshatra as the indicated sound. If the person's actual name begins with a different sound, find which nakshatra and pada that sound belongs to; if that pada is one occupied by a planet in the native's own chart, "it was the perfect name for him".
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's nakshatra (for its syllables); the sound-to-nakshatra-pada table (Ch.5); the nakshatra + pada of every natal planet.
Confidence: Definite method; her worked case: Moon in Uttara Bhadra gives "Jna" (hard to render in a western name), while "Sa" of *Steve* falls in Shatabhishak pada 2, which is exactly where his Sun is placed.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Reading temperament from the gunas.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Reading temperament from the gunas.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Tally which guna each planet's nakshatra carries and identify the predominance. A predominance of sattva = "a person aiming for purity who may not have been too grounded"; sattvic people "know how to use their talents in the right way".
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Guna (and full guna triplicity) of the nakshatra of each planet and the lagna.
Confidence: Definite method.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Some planets fall in tamas nakshatras in an otherwise sattvic chart.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Some planets fall in tamas nakshatras in an otherwise sattvic chart.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: They give "the necessary grounding or practical approach to life". (Her case: lagna and Saturn in tamas.)
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Guna of each planet's nakshatra.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Planets fall in rajas nakshatras.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Planets fall in rajas nakshatras.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: They give "activity and the quest for the search". Where Ketu is rajasic, "the search of rajas would have been in the past life as reflected by Ketu".
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Guna of Mars/Ketu (or whichever planets are rajasic).
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: There is minimal tamas across the chart.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: There is minimal tamas across the chart.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "This could have made Steve Jobs lack a stable core within."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Guna tally across all planets.
Confidence: A tendency ("could have").
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Reading a single planet's guna in depth.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Reading a single planet's guna in depth.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Use the nakshatra's three-level guna triplicity, not just one guna. Where the Moon has "two levels of sattva, with tamas holding it back", the native aspires to perfection and purity while the deep-down tamas insists there are practical ambitions to fulfil and "still some work to do on earth before he could truly move into the higher realm".
sutton_nakshatras.combination:

sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Dasha/bhukti lord pair.
Confidence: "Usually".
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: ⭐ The last bhukti of a maha dasha (i.e. the dasha is ending).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: ⭐ The last bhukti of a maha dasha (i.e. the dasha is ending).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "As the old dasha ends, it is an important time for change. We need to study the role of the next dasha to understand whether the change will be positive or not."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
The incoming maha dasha lord and its nadi positions.
Confidence: Definite procedural instruction.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The ascendant ruler's maha dasha runs.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The ascendant ruler's maha dasha runs.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Often in the dasha of the ascendant ruler, health issues can come to the fore."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Lagna lord; its dasha dates.
Confidence: "Often".
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The Moon's maha dasha runs (the Moon being by definition the janma nakshatra).
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The Moon's maha dasha runs (the Moon being by definition the janma nakshatra).
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "The Moon is the janma nakshatra during which health issues often become apparent."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon dasha dates.
Confidence: "Often"; in her case it was the death dasha.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: ⭐ The same bhukti lord recurs under two different maha dashas with opposite results.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: ⭐ The same bhukti lord recurs under two different maha dashas with opposite results.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: The difference is explained by two linkage conditions: whether the bhukti lord is the nakshatra ruler of the maha dasha lord, and whether the maha dasha lord is the lagna lord. Sutton's own words: "When Rahu bhukti happened in Venus mahadasha, he was not the ruler of Venus nakshatra and Venus was not the lord of the lagna, so the health issues did not manifest." In Sun maha dasha both conditions held (Rahu rules the Sun's nakshatra Shatabhishak; the Sun is the Leo lagna lord) — and the cancer was diagnosed.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatra of the maha dasha lord and its ruler; lagna lordship; the bhukti lord's identity.
Confidence: Definite — offered as the explanation of a discriminating case. This is the sharpest rule in the chapter.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: ⭐ Timing marriage inside a dasha/bhukti pair.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: ⭐ Timing marriage inside a dasha/bhukti pair.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Look for "secret links" between the dasha and bhukti lords via the 7th house measured from each other and from the ascendant: (a) the bhukti lord sits in a nakshatra whose ruler is placed in the 7th house from the bhukti lord; (b) the dasha lord sits in the nakshatra of a planet that is in the 7th house from the ascendant, and that planet in turn sits in the bhukti lord's nakshatra. "These secret links made the dasha of Venus Rahu the prime time for marriage."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nakshatras and nakshatra-rulers of both dasha and bhukti lords; house positions of those rulers reckoned from the ascendant and from the dasha/bhukti lords.
Confidence: Definite for her case; presented as the answer to "why did the marriage take place in Venus Rahu?"
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Confirming a marriage date by transit.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Confirming a marriage date by transit.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Transiting Jupiter was in Gemini activating Venus and the Rahu Ketu axis of the natal chart."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Transiting Jupiter's sign/nakshatra vs natal Venus and the nodal axis.
Confidence: Confirmatory, not primary.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: ⭐ Analysing a maha dasha through its bhuktis.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: ⭐ Analysing a maha dasha through its bhuktis.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "It is important to study each maha dasha and its nadi nakshatra. A new chart is created and the point of view of the chart of the mahadasha ruler is taken, and how the bhuktis relate to it. Are the nadi flowing smoothly or are they blocked? This gives us a bigger picture and allows us to see things that are not visible from the normal chart points of view."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Maha dasha lord's nakshatra; nakshatras of all nine planets; the Vimshottari nakshatra-ruler sequence.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: ⭐ Constructing the dasha-lord navatara grid.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: ⭐ Constructing the dasha-lord navatara grid.
sutton_nakshatras.effect:
"In order to make this chart for Venus maha dasha, Venus becomes the janma nakshatra and all nakshatra grids are drawn accordingly. Venus is in Uttara Ashadha nakshatra which is ruled by the Sun. The other nakshatras ruled by Sun … will perform the janma role."
  → The janma group is defined by the ruler of the dasha lord's nakshatra, and consists of that ruler's three nakshatras.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
The dasha lord's nakshatra → its ruler → that ruler's three nakshatras.
Confidence: Definite; restated independently at PDF 589 ("Rahu being the nakshatra ruler of the Sun and therefore ruler of the three Janma nakshatras from Sun dasha point of view").
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: ⭐ Assigning the remaining eight navatara positions in the dasha-lord grid.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: ⭐ Assigning the remaining eight navatara positions in the dasha-lord grid.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: They follow the Vimshottari nakshatra-ruler order, one ruler per navatara position, each ruler contributing its three nakshatras. "The next or sampat nakshatra from Venus would be Hasta which is ruled by the Moon and will express the sampat qualities during the Venus dasha. All Moon nakshatras will reflect sampat qualities, and planets placed within them will bring wealth during their bhuktis."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Vimshottari ruler sequence (Ketu–Venus–Sun–Moon–Mars–Rahu–Jupiter–Saturn–Mercury); the dasha lord's nakshatra ruler as the starting point.
Confidence: Definite — and it makes the grid computable by ruler group rather than by counting nakshatras one at a time.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A planet sits in the sampat group of the dasha-lord grid.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A planet sits in the sampat group of the dasha-lord grid.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: It "will bring wealth during their bhuktis".
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Dasha-lord navatara grid; planetary occupancy.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Surveying a whole maha dasha before reading bhuktis.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Surveying a whole maha dasha before reading bhuktis.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Establish which planets are "working for the dasha lord" and which are in difficult nadis from it. Those in difficult nadis "made him struggle, but in the end it made him even more creative and strong". Note that consecutive difficult bhuktis compound (Jupiter bhukti then Saturn bhukti ran back-to-back).
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nadi position of every planet from the dasha lord; the bhukti calendar.
Confidence: Definite; note the explicit refusal to read "difficult" as simply "bad".
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A malefic transits a difficult nadi position (vipat, prayatak, naidhana) counted from the Moon.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A malefic transits a difficult nadi position (vipat, prayatak, naidhana) counted from the Moon.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Challenging. "If all the malefics combine to influence the difficult nadis then the experience can be extremely intense."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Navatara grid from the Moon; current transit nakshatras of Saturn, Mars, Rahu, Ketu.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A benefic transits a good nadi position.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A benefic transits a good nadi position.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Brings opportunities.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
As above, for Jupiter/Venus/Mercury/waxing Moon.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A planet transits janma — meaning the Moon's own nakshatra and the other nakshatras ruled by the same ruler.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A planet transits janma — meaning the Moon's own nakshatra and the other nakshatras ruled by the same ruler.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Affects the mind and can have health issues too."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Ruler of the Moon's nakshatra → all three of that ruler's nakshatras; transit positions.
Confidence: Definite. Note this extends the janma target from one nakshatra to three.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: ⭐ Saturn transits the manasa (25th) nakshatra from the Moon.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: ⭐ Saturn transits the manasa (25th) nakshatra from the Moon.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Saturn's transit to manasa, the 25th nakshatra from the Moon is especially intense and it signals the start of sade sati."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Manasa nakshatra (25th from the Moon); Saturn's transit ingress date into it.
Confidence: Definite; this redefines the practical start of sade sati ahead of the conventional 12th-from-Moon rule.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Other malefics — especially Rahu or Ketu — transit the manasa nakshatra.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Other malefics — especially Rahu or Ketu — transit the manasa nakshatra.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Will also bring emotional stress.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Manasa nakshatra; nodal transit dates.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A malefic transits manasa while its own maha dasha is running.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A malefic transits manasa while its own maha dasha is running.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Turbulence and mental stress; "there may have been some wrong judgements"; disruptive behaviour; roles taken away and a feeling of rejection. But also: such a transit "may have also given him special insight into many of the products which were later introduced".
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Manasa nakshatra; malefic transit dates; concurrent dasha lord.
Confidence: Definite for the stress, tentative ("may") for the insight.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Several malefic transits to manasa fall inside one maha dasha.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Several malefic transits to manasa fall inside one maha dasha.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "This would have been stormy, giving him times of real emotional darkness and despair." (Four such transits inside his Venus dasha.)
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Full list of malefic transits to manasa cross-referenced against the dasha calendar.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A manasa transit occurs but no outer crisis is visible in the biography.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A manasa transit occurs but no outer crisis is visible in the biography.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: ⚠️ It may show only as temperamental outbursts rather than events. "During this time there don't appear to be any problems to cause him mental stress but his infamous temperamental outbursts could have been caused by the impact of the manasa transits."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
As above.
Confidence: Tentative ("could have"). Note her willingness to record a transit that did not visibly deliver — see §F.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Rahu transits manasa during a period of outward professional success.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Rahu transits manasa during a period of outward professional success.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Shows an inner state at odds with the outer one — "a worried and maybe fearful man coming to terms with his mortality", while "professionally he was at his peak".
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Rahu transit dates through manasa; the concurrent biography.
Confidence: Definite in application.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Identifying the diseased organ.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Identifying the diseased organ.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Venus rules the pancreas. A Venus damaged in the nadi (prayatak + vinasha from the Moon) is read as the site of the illness.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Venus's nadi position; planetary body-part significations.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Judging disease from the houses.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Judging disease from the houses.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "As the sixth house from the sixth, the 11th house is the significator of disease." The 8th house "shows long term health matters". The 3rd house is "another house connected to death", and the 7th is "the death giving 7th house".
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
House rulerships and placements of the planets implicated in the dasha.
Confidence: Definite; used to convict Jupiter (11th-house placement + 8th lordship) and Saturn (6th/7th lord in the 3rd).
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A dasha lord carries destructive nadi potential but the illness is not diagnosed during its period.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A dasha lord carries destructive nadi potential but the illness is not diagnosed during its period.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: ⭐ "Although his cancer was not diagnosed in the Venus dasha, Venus' negative potential shows that the cancer was developing during this time and was only revealed in the Sun dasha." A dasha lord in vinasha "would continue working silently on his health throughout the dasha period".
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Nadi position of each dasha lord; the diagnosis date.
Confidence: Definite; a substantive claim about latency — the nadi shows the incubation, a later dasha shows the manifestation.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Assembling a full disease signature at the bhukti level.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Assembling a full disease signature at the bhukti level.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Convergence of: bhukti lord in vipat from the Moon; bhukti lord in a nakshatra ruled by a destructive deity (Mula/Nritti) and itself the nakshatra ruler of the dasha lord, thus transferring that deity's destructiveness to the dasha lord; bhukti lord conjunct the significator of the afflicted organ (Venus/pancreas); and aspected by the 8th lord (long-term health) and the 7th lord (maraka).
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Bhukti lord's nakshatra + deity + nadi position; conjunctions; aspects onto it; house rulerships of the aspecting planets.
Confidence: Definite; her actual reasoning chain for the October 2003 diagnosis.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: An event's time of day is unknown.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: An event's time of day is unknown.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "I usually erect a sunrise chart for the event when time is unknown."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Event date and place; sunrise time.
Confidence: Her standard practice.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: The event Moon could be in either of two nakshatras on that day.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: The event Moon could be in either of two nakshatras on that day.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Narrow it using documentary evidence about the time of day, then commit. (The Moon changed from Ashwini to Bharani at 15:31 hrs; the partnership was drawn up at an apartment "sometime during the day", and "it is unlikely they would have waited for the evening with such an urgency to form the company" → Ashwini.)
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Moon's nakshatra-change time for the day; biographical detail.
Confidence: "We can say with some certainty" — she states her confidence level explicitly.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Reading an event chart against the founder's natal chart.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Reading an event chart against the founder's natal chart.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Read (a) the event Moon's nakshatra quality (Ashwini = "a new dawn and the promise of new ideas"; Bharani = "the incubation of ideas"); (b) the house the transiting Moon falls in from the founder's natal chart; (c) the event Moon's nadi position from the founder's natal Moon — and note that the Moon may move from one nadi to another across the day (here vipat → kshema), which frames the venture's mixed early fortunes.
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Event Moon's nakshatra + sign; founder's natal chart and natal Moon nakshatra.
Confidence: Definite method.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Reading the founder's running dasha at an event.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Reading the founder's running dasha at an event.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Read both dasha and bhukti lords by their natal nadi positions. A bhukti lord in vinasha at the founding "may have contributed to" an immediate loss (the third partner resigned within days) — but its countervailing dignities (atmakaraka, vargottama, pushkara) meant "the setback was only temporary".
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Dasha/bhukti at the event date; nadi positions of both lords from the natal Moon; their dignities.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: Reading transits at an event.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: Reading transits at an event.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: Read the transiting nodes by their nadi position from the natal Moon (transiting Ketu in Bharani = kshema → "bringing a wealth of ideas and prosperity"), and read the bhukti lord's transit position by nadi (Venus transiting Purva Bhadra = param mitra and abhishekha).
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Transit positions by nakshatra at the event; navatara grid from the natal Moon.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

sutton_nakshatras.description: A planet — especially the atmakaraka — is in abhishekha (27th from janma) by transit at the moment of an undertaking.
sutton_nakshatras.exact_rule: A planet — especially the atmakaraka — is in abhishekha (27th from janma) by transit at the moment of an undertaking.
sutton_nakshatras.effect: "Venus in abhishekha shows achievement of life's dearly held ambitions and the crowning of a new king…. Venus is the atmakaraka for Steve Jobs and for him this would have been the first important step on his soul's path."
sutton_nakshatras.combination:
Abhishekha nakshatra (27th from natal Moon); transit position of the atmakaraka/bhukti lord.
Confidence: Definite.
sutton_nakshatras.source: Komilla Sutton – The Nakshatras: The Stars Beyond the Zodiac

laghu_parashari.description: We worship that indescribable effulgence — she who bears the vīṇā and whose lips are red — who dwells in the inner chamber (antaḥpura) of the pure form (śuddhān…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
सिद्धान्तमौपनिषदं शुद्धान्तं परमेष्ठिन।
  शोणाधरं महः किञ्चिच्चद्वीणाधरमुपास्महे।।

Translation: We worship that indescribable effulgence — she who bears the vīṇā and whose lips are red — who dwells in the inner chamber (antaḥpura) of the pure form (śuddhānta) of Brahman as expounded by the Upaniṣads.
laghu_parashari.effect:
Invocatory maṅgalācaraṇa to Sarasvatī; no operative astrological content.

Weight/authority: normal
laghu_parashari.combination:
—

laghu_parashari.description: Everyone gets a kuṇḍalī made but cannot know its fruit. The fruit can be known through the kuṇḍalī, and only a good phalita-jña can state it. The kuṇḍalī is bui…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"कुण्डली तो सभी बनवा लेते हैं, लेकिन उसका फल नहीं जान पाते। फल कुण्डली के द्वारा जाना जा सकता है जो कि अच्छा फलितज्ञ ही बता सकता है। कुण्डली जन्म समय, जन्म स्थान और जन्म तिथि के आधार पर बनायी जाती है।"

Translation: Everyone gets a kuṇḍalī made but cannot know its fruit. The fruit can be known through the kuṇḍalī, and only a good phalita-jña can state it. The kuṇḍalī is built on the basis of birth time, birth place and birth date.
laghu_parashari.effect:
A kuṇḍalī requires exactly three data: time of birth, place of birth, date of birth. Without all three no phala may be pronounced.

Weight/authority: normal
laghu_parashari.combination:
birth time, birth place, birth date

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: Phalita is known by analysing the nine planets beginning with the Sun, the twelve signs, and their mutual relation and relation with the bhāvas etc. While prono…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"कुण्डली में स्थित सूर्यादि नौ ग्रह, बारह राशि और इनका परस्पर व भावादि से सम्बन्ध का विश्लेषण करके फलित जाना जाता है। फलित कहते समय ग्रहों की परस्पर युति व दृष्टि का भी ध्यान रखा जाता है।"

Translation: Phalita is known by analysing the nine planets beginning with the Sun, the twelve signs, and their mutual relation and relation with the bhāvas etc. While pronouncing phalita, the mutual conjunction (युति) and aspect (दृष्टि) of the planets are also kept in mind.
laghu_parashari.effect:
The judgement procedure = (i) 9 grahas, (ii) 12 rāśis, (iii) graha↔graha sambandha, (iv) graha↔bhāva sambandha, (v) yuti and dṛṣṭi overlay. All five layers must be used.

Weight/authority: normal — foundational
laghu_parashari.combination:
full planetary placements by sign and house; conjunctions; aspects

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: Laghu Pārāśarī is a priceless (अनमोल) work of jyotiṣa composed by Maharṣi Parāśara. 42 ślokas composed by Maharṣi Parāśara are collected in it, by which the pha…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"लघुपाराशरी महर्षि पाराशर प्रणीत ज्योतिष का अनमोल ग्रन्थ है। इस ग्रन्थ में महर्षि पाराशर रचित 42 श्लोक को संगृहीत किया गया है जिनके द्वारा किसी भी कुण्डली का फल सरलता से ज्ञात किया जा सकता है।"

Translation: Laghu Pārāśarī is a priceless (अनमोल) work of jyotiṣa composed by Maharṣi Parāśara. 42 ślokas composed by Maharṣi Parāśara are collected in it, by which the phala of any kuṇḍalī can be known easily.
laghu_parashari.effect:
The book's operative content is a closed set of 42 ślokas; their sāra-garbhita phalita-siddhāntas suffice to give a सटीक (exact) reading of any chart.

Weight/authority: अनमोल ग्रन्थ (author's own emphasis)
laghu_parashari.combination:
—

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.exact_rule:

laghu_parashari.description: कुण्डली क्या है?
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"कुण्डली आकाश स्थित ग्रहों का नक्शा है। कुण्डली से यह जान सकते हैं कि जन्म समय कौन सा ग्रह आकाश में किस स्थान पर था। जन्म समय ग्रह जिन राशियों पर रहते हैं, वे राशियां कुण्डली में जिन भावों में रहती हैं उन्हीं पर वे ग्रह लिखे जाते हैं।"

Translation: The kuṇḍalī is a map of the planets situated in the sky. From it one can know which planet was at which place in the sky at birth. The planets are written into whichever bhāva holds the sign the planet occupied at birth.
laghu_parashari.effect:
Placement procedure — a planet is entered in the bhāva that contains its natal sign, not by any independent house calculation.

Weight/authority: normal
laghu_parashari.combination:
planet→sign positions at birth; sign→house mapping

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: जन्म लग्न
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"जन्म लग्न उस राशि को कहते हैं जो जन्म समय क्षितिज के पूर्व भाग में उदित रहती है।"

Translation: Janma-lagna is that sign which is rising on the eastern part of the horizon at the moment of birth.
laghu_parashari.effect:
Lagna = sign on the eastern horizon at birth instant.

Weight/authority: normal
laghu_parashari.combination:

laghu_parashari.description: orientation of the chart
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"कुण्डली को भूमि पर क्रान्तिवृत्त के धरातल में इस प्रकार खड़ी करिए जिससे लग्न पूर्व की ओर एवं सप्तम भाव पश्चिम की ओर पड़े, यही जन्मकालीन आकाश का नक्शा है।"

Translation: Stand the kuṇḍalī on the ground in the plane of the ecliptic so that the lagna falls towards the east and the 7th bhāva towards the west — that is the map of the sky at birth.
laghu_parashari.effect:
The chart is a physical sky-map in the ecliptic plane: 1st = east, 7th = west.
