Hence in Tulā lagna, Venus and in Meṣa lagna, Mars — being aṣṭameśa — form a yoga for benefic results along with malefic ones. The essence: the lagna is supremely auspicious and the 8th supremely inauspicious; the lagneśa has the capacity to REDUCE malefic results; in truth, if the lagneśa is also the aṣṭameśa it becomes a giver of benefic results.
laghu_parashari.effect:
- Meṣa (Aries) lagna → Mars is lagneśa (Aries) and aṣṭameśa (Scorpio) → gives benefic results along with malefic ones.
  - Tulā (Libra) lagna → Venus is lagneśa (Libra) and aṣṭameśa (Taurus) → same.
  - Underlying principle: lagneśa-ship has the power to diminish aśubha-phala; when the two lordships coincide, the lagneśa quality prevails and the planet becomes a śubha-phala-pradātā.
  - These are the only two lagnas where the coincidence occurs.

Weight/authority: प्रबल / विशेष — printed in bold in the source.
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign (test for Aries or Libra).

Exceptions / caveats: the malefic result is reduced, not eliminated — "अशुभफल केसाथ-साथ शुभ फल" —
  both continue. Consistent with LP-050-2 and with LP-046-6 (lagneśa always benefic).

laghu_parashari.description: व्ययाधिपत्य derivation, houses 1–4
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"व्ययाधिपत्य से भी भावेशों में शुभत्व और अशुभत्व इस प्रकार होता है—
  लग्न शरीर भाव है जिसका व्ययेश द्वादशेश है। शरीर का व्यय अशुभ है। अतः द्वादशेश अशुभ है।
  धन भाव का व्यय लग्नेश है। धन शरीर रक्षा के लिए व्यय होता है। यदि लग्नेश अपने धन का व्ययकारक हुआ तो उचित ही है इसलिए शुभ है। अतः लग्नेश शुभ है।
  तीसरे सहज, पराक्रम तथा आयु भाव है जिसका व्ययेश द्वितीयेश हुआ जोकि आयु का व्यय होने केकारण अशुभ और मारक हुआ। अतः द्वितीयेश अशुभ है।
  चौथा सुख भाव है उसका व्ययेश तृतीयेश हुआ। अतः सुख का व्यय होने से तृतीयेश अशुभ हुआ। वस्तुतः तृतीयेश अशुभ है।"

Translation: The benefic/malefic status of house lords can also be derived from vyayādhipatya (being the lord of the 12th from a house):

| Bhāva | Its 12th-lord is | Reasoning | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1st (body) | 12th lord | expenditure of the body is inauspicious | 12th lord = अशुभ |
| 2nd (wealth) | 1st lord | wealth is rightly spent to protect the body | lagneśa = शुभ |
| 3rd (valour / āyu) | 2nd lord | destroys longevity | 2nd lord = अशुभ AND मारक |
| 4th (happiness) | 3rd lord | destroys happiness | 3rd lord = अशुभ |
laghu_parashari.effect:
Derive each lord's nature by asking what it destroys as the 12th-lord of some house.

Weight/authority: प्रबल — this derivation is the book's independent proof of ślokas 6–9.
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign → house lords.

Exceptions / caveats: —

---

laghu_parashari.description: व्ययाधिपत्य derivation, houses 5–12
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"पांचवा विद्या भाव है उसका व्ययेश चतुर्थेश है जोकि शुभ होकर विद्या का नाश हो तो अनुचित है और पापी होकर विद्या का नाश हो तो उचित है। अतः चतुर्थेश शुभग्रह हो तो अशुभ और अशुभग्रह हो तो शुभ माना गया है। अतः पापी चतुर्थेश शुभ व शुभ चतुर्थेश अशुभ माना गया है।
  छठा शत्रु भाव है, उसका व्ययेश पंचमेश है जोकि शत्रु का नाश कारक होने के कारण शुभ है। अतः पंचमेश शुभ है।
  सप्तम स्त्री भाव है जिसका व्ययेश षष्ठेश है। स्त्री का व्यय होने के कारण अशुभ है। अतः षष्ठेश अशुभ है।
  अष्टम आयु भाव है जिसका व्ययेश सप्तमेश है। आयु का नाश होने के कारण मारक है। अतः सप्तमेश अशुभ व मारक है।
  नवम भाग्य भाव है जिसका व्ययेश अष्टमेश है। भाग्य का नाश होने के कारण अशुभ है। अतः अष्टमेश अशुभ है।
  दशम भाव कर्म का है जिसका व्ययेश नवमेश है। कर्म संसार में बन्धन का कारक है। संसार बंधन का व्यय होने से नवमेश शुभ है। अतः नवमेश शुभ है।
  एकादश भाव लाभ है जिसका व्ययेश दशमेश है। दशमेश शुभ होकर लाभ का व्यय करे तो अनुचित है और यदि अशुभ होकर लाभ का व्यय करे तो उचित है। अतः शुभग्रह दशमेश अशुभ और अशुभ ग्रह दशमेश शुभ है।
  द्वादश भाव व्यय है जिसका व्ययेश एकादशेश है। व्यय का नाश अर्थात् व्यय न होने देना कष्टकारक है। यदि व्यय नहीं होगा तो जातक कुछ भी नहीं ले पाएगा। अतः एकादशेश अशुभ है।"
laghu_parashari.effect:
★ This is the source of the kendrādhipatya reversal. Only the two "improper/proper"
  cases — the 4th and 10th lords (both kendras) — flip with the planet's natural class:
  natural benefic → gives malefic results; natural malefic → gives benefic results.
  Every other lordship has a fixed verdict.

Weight/authority: सर्वोत्तम — this derivation is the analytic backbone of the chapter.
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign → all twelve house lords; natural class of the 4th and 10th lords.

Exceptions / caveats: the 1st and 7th lords are *kendra* lords too, yet here get fixed verdicts
  (1st = śubha always, per LP-046-6; 7th = aśubha + māraka). So the reversal is applied by the
  author only to the 4th and 10th lords. Flagged as the author's own restriction of
  kendrādhipatya-doṣa.

laghu_parashari.description: the summary of the derivation
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"उक्त विश्लेषण से यह स्पष्ट होता है कि—
  – त्रिकोण भाव 1,5,9 केस्वामी शुभ हैं।
  – त्रिषडाय भाव 3,6,11 केस्वामी पापी व अशुभ हैं।
  – केन्द्र भाव 1,4,7,10 केस्वामी शुभग्रह हों तो अशुभ व पापग्रह हों तो शुभ हैं।"

Translation: From the above analysis it is clear that:
  - lords of the trikoṇa houses 1, 5, 9 → benefic;
  - lords of the triṣaḍāya houses 3, 6, 11 → malefic (pāpī and aśubha);
  - lords of the kendra houses 1, 4, 7, 10 → if a benefic planet, malefic; if a malefic planet, benefic.
laghu_parashari.effect:
The three-line summary of the entire classification engine. Note the kendra line is
  stated as full REVERSAL (विपरीत), not mere neutralisation — confirming LP-045-3 over the
  literal wording of śloka 7's anuvāda.

Weight/authority: सर्वोत्तम — the operative summary.
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign → house lords; natural class of the kendra lords.

Exceptions / caveats: the lagna is both kendra and trikoṇa; per LP-046-6 the lagneśa is always
  benefic and does not suffer the reversal. Fourth bullet on p.52.

---
laghu_parashari.page: 51 (image LP-051.png), last bullet completed on p.52

laghu_parashari.description: the 2nd, 12th and 8th lords are context-determined
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"– द्वितीयेश, द्वादशेश व अष्टमेश साहचर्य और स्थानानन्तर केअनुरूप फल देते हैं"

Translation: The 2nd, 12th and 8th lords give results according to their association (sāhacarya) and their sthānāntara (the position of their other sign).
laghu_parashari.effect:
The 8th lord joins the 2nd and 12th lords as a "chameleon" lord — its result is set
  by association and by where its second sign falls. (Its baseline remains aśubha per LP-050-1/2;
  this rule governs the *degree*, the "उतार-चढ़ाव".)

Weight/authority: प्रबल — this is the fourth bullet of the p.51 summary, i.e. part of the operative summary.
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign → 2nd, 12th, 8th lords; their conjunctions; the houses their other signs occupy.

Exceptions / caveats: EXTENSION of śloka 8 — the śloka named only the 2nd and 12th lords; the author
  extends the same treatment to the 8th lord. Tag as an extension.

laghu_parashari.description: the reasoning behind the trikoṇa strength order
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"वस्तुतः प्रबलाश्चोत्तरोत्तम की उक्ति सिद्ध होती है कि 1,5,9 उत्तरोत्तर बली होते हैं। स्पष्ट है कि धन केव्यय करने में कोई वीरता नहीं है, अतः लग्नेश सामान्य बली है। उसकी अपेक्षा रोग या शत्रु के नाश में बल व बुद्धि की आवश्यकता होती है, जिस कारण पंचमेश बली है। उसकी अपेक्षा संसार बन्धन से मुक्ति में विशेष बल की आवश्यकता होती है इसलिए नवमेश अधिक बली है।"

Translation: The dictum प्रबलाश्चोत्तरोत्तम is proved: 1, 5, 9 are successively stronger. Spending wealth takes no heroism, so the lagneśa is of ordinary strength; destroying disease or enemies needs strength and intellect, so the 5th lord is strong; liberation from worldly bondage needs special strength, so the 9th lord is stronger still.
laghu_parashari.effect:
लग्नेश < पंचमेश < नवमेश in strength, with the author's rationale (difficulty of the
  task each lord destroys as a vyayeśa).

Weight/authority: प्रबल.
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign → 1st, 5th, 9th lords.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: ★ the remaining strength chains, with reasoning ★
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"सुख के व्यय से सामान्य कष्ट होने के कारण तृतीयेश सामान्य बली है। उसकी अपेक्षा स्त्री के व्यय से विशेष कष्ट होने के कारण तृतीयेश से षष्ठेश अधिक बली है। व्यय का व्यय रुकने से खाना-पीना भी बन्द हो जाएगा इसलिए षष्ठेश से अधिक बली एकादशेश है। इसी प्रकार द्वितीयेश से द्वादशेश एवं द्वादशेश से अष्टमेश बली है। चतुर्थेश से सप्तमेश और सप्तमेश से दशमेश बली है।"

Translation: - Loss of happiness causes ordinary suffering → 3rd lord is of ordinary strength.
  - Loss of the wife causes special suffering → 6th lord is stronger than the 3rd.
  - Blocking expenditure stops even food and drink → 11th lord is stronger than the 6th.
  - Likewise 12th lord stronger than the 2nd; 8th lord stronger than the 12th.
  - 7th lord stronger than the 4th; 10th lord stronger than the 7th.
laghu_parashari.effect:
- Loss of happiness causes ordinary suffering → 3rd lord is of ordinary strength.
  - Loss of the wife causes special suffering → 6th lord is stronger than the 3rd.
  - Blocking expenditure stops even food and drink → 11th lord is stronger than the 6th.
  - Likewise 12th lord stronger than the 2nd; 8th lord stronger than the 12th.
  - 7th lord stronger than the 4th; 10th lord stronger than the 7th.

Weight/authority: सर्वोत्तम — the section's headline deliverable (भावेशों का बलाबल).
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign → identity of every house lord; the two houses each planet owns.

Exceptions / caveats: the lagneśa appears in both the trikoṇa and the kendra chain (LP-046-6:
  contentious but always benefic). Note that the 4th chain (2 < 12 < 8) is not in śloka 7 —
  it is the author's completion of the scheme.

laghu_parashari.description: केन्द्राधिपत्य दोष-विचार (śloka 10) ★ KENDRĀDHIPATYA DOṢA ★
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
केन्द्राधिपत्यदोषस्तु बलवान् गुरुशुक्रयोः॥
मारकत्वेऽपि च तयोर्मारकस्थानसंस्थितिः॥10॥

Translation: "केन्द्रेश(1,4,7,10 का स्वामी) होने का परम दोष बलवान गुरु व शुक्र को होता है। यदि गुरु व शुक्र केन्द्रेश होकर मारक भाव(सप्तम) में पड़ें हैं तो दूसरों की अपेक्षा विशेष मारकत्व दोष वाले होते हैं॥दस॥" — The supreme doṣa of being a kendreśa (lord of 1, 4, 7, 10) attaches most strongly to Jupiter and Venus. And if Jupiter and Venus, being kendreśas, are posited in the māraka bhāva (the 7th), they carry a special mārakatva-doṣa greater than others'.
laghu_parashari.effect:
1. Kendrādhipatya-doṣa is strongest for Jupiter and Venus — i.e. of the natural benefics,
     these two lose their benefic power most completely when they own a kendra.
  2. Aggravation: a kendreśa Jupiter or Venus placed in the 7th (māraka) house acquires a
     special mārakatva-doṣa, exceeding that of any other planet.

Weight/authority: मूल सूत्र (śloka 10) — "परम दोष".
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign → whether Jupiter/Venus owns a kendra (1/4/7/10); the house
  occupied by that planet (test for the 7th).

Exceptions / caveats: the doṣa is graded, not absolute — see LP-052-5.

laghu_parashari.description: विशेष: when BOTH signs fall in kendras
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"विशेष—केन्द्रेश होकर मारक भाव में स्थित होने का दोष गुरु-शुक्र को सर्वाधिक लगता है। केन्द्रेश की यदि दोनों राशियां केन्द्र में पड़ें तो उन्हें शुभफलदाता नहीं कहा जाता है। यह स्थिति मिथुन, कन्या, धनु और मीन लग्नों में बनती है। गुरु की दोनों राशियां केन्द्र में पड़ती हैं परन्तु शुक्र की कभी नहीं पड़ती हैं। शुक्र की जगह गुरु [को कहना चाहिए था क्योंकि इसकी दोनों राशियां केन्द्र में पड़ती हैं। लेकिन फिर भी शुक्र को यहां कहा गया है। — p.53]"

Translation: The doṣa of being a kendreśa posited in a māraka house applies most of all to Jupiter and Venus. If BOTH signs of a kendra lord fall in kendras, that planet is not called a giver of benefic results at all. This situation arises in the Mithuna (Gemini), Kanyā (Virgo), Dhanu (Sagittarius) and Mīna (Pisces) lagnas. Jupiter's two signs *can* both fall in kendras, but Venus's never do.
laghu_parashari.effect:
1. Maximum kendrādhipatya-doṣa = a planet both of whose signs fall in kendras → not a
     benefic at all.
  2. This occurs in exactly four lagnas:

| Lagna | Planet whose both signs are kendras | Which kendras |
|---|---|---|
| मिथुन Gemini | Mercury (Gemini + Virgo) | 1st + 4th |
| कन्या Virgo | Mercury (Virgo + Gemini) | 1st + 10th |
| धनु Sagittarius | Jupiter (Sagittarius + Pisces) | 1st + 4th |
| मीन Pisces | Jupiter (Pisces + Sagittarius) | 1st + 10th |

  3. Venus's two signs (Taurus, Libra) can NEVER both be kendras (they are 5 signs apart).

Weight/authority: विशेष — a named gradation of the doṣa.
laghu_parashari.combination: Lagna sign; the two signs owned by the planet under study.
laghu_parashari.page: 52 (image LP-052.png), sentence completed at the top of p.53

laghu_parashari.description: "…[Guru] should have been named [in place of Venus], because both of his signs fall in kendras. Yet even so Venus has been named here."
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"को कहना चाहिए था क्योंकि इसकी दोनों राशियां केन्द्र में पड़ती हैं। लेकिन फिर भी शुक्र को यहां कहा गया है।"
  (continuation from p.52: "…शुक्र की जगह गुरु[को कहना चाहिए था]")

Translation: "…[Guru] should have been named [in place of Venus], because both of his signs fall in kendras. Yet even so Venus has been named here."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Logically śloka 10 ought to have singled out Jupiter alone (both his signs — Dhanu, Meena — fall in kendras for Mithuna/Kanya/Dhanu/Meena lagnas, whereas Venus's two signs never both fall in kendras). Parashara nonetheless names Venus alongside Jupiter; the justification follows in LP-053-2/3.

Weight/authority: normal (explanatory)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; sign-lordships of Jupiter (Dhanu, Meena) and Venus (Vrishabha, Tula).

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: For these eight lagnas Venus is a kendra lord. Judge his kendrādhipatya-doṣa by the *second* house he also owns: worst where the second sign lands in a maraka (…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
(verbatim, the eight lagna statements)
  - "मेष लग्न में शुक्र की एक राशि केन्द्र(7)में और दूसरी राशि मारक भाव में पड़ती है।"
  - "वृष लग्न में शुक्र की एक राशि केन्द्र(1) में और दूसरी राशि छठे शत्रु भाव में पड़ती है।"
  - "कर्क लग्न में शुक्र की एक राशि केन्द्र(4) में और दूसरी राशि एकादश आय भाव में पड़ती है।"
  - "सिंह लग्न में शुक्र की एक राशि केन्द्र(10) में और दूसरी राशि तृतीय पराक्रम भाव में पड़ती है।"
  - "तुला लग्न में शुक्र की एक राशि केन्द्र(1) में और दूसरी राशि अष्टम मृत्यु भाव में पड़ती है।"
  - "वृश्चिक लग्न में शुक्र की एक राशि केन्द्र(7) में और दूसरी राशि बारहवें व्यय भाव में पड़ती है।"
  - "मकर लग्न में शुक्र की एक राशि केन्द्र(10) में और दूसरी राशि पंचम मित्र भाव में पड़ती है।"
  - "कुम्भ लग्न में शुक्र की एक राशि केन्द्र(4) में और दूसरी राशि नवम भाग्य भाव में पड़ती है।"
laghu_parashari.effect:
For these eight lagnas Venus is a kendra lord. Judge his kendrādhipatya-doṣa by
  the *second* house he also owns: worst where the second sign lands in a maraka (Mesh lagna → 2nd)
  or duḥsthāna (Tula lagna → 8th; Vrishchik lagna → 12th; Vrish lagna → 6th); best where it lands
  in a trikona (Makar lagna → 5th; Kumbha lagna → 9th, i.e. Venus becomes kendra+trikona lord).

Weight/authority: normal
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign only.

Exceptions / caveats: Where the second sign is a trikona (Makar, Kumbha lagna), the trikona-lordship
  clause of śloka 12 (LP-056-1) cancels the doṣa and makes Venus a yogakāraka.

laghu_parashari.description: "Venus's one sign falls in a kendra for the greatest number of lagnas, and his other sign falls in the 2nd, 6th, 7th, 8th, 12th or other houses — that is why Ve…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"शुक्र की एक राशि केन्द्र में सर्वाधिक लग्नों में पड़ती है और दूसरी राशि 2,6,7,8,12 या अन्य भावों में पड़ती है, इसीलिए गुरु केसाथ शुक्र को महत्ता दी गई है।"

Translation: "Venus's one sign falls in a kendra for the greatest number of lagnas, and his other sign falls in the 2nd, 6th, 7th, 8th, 12th or other houses — that is why Venus has been given importance along with Jupiter."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Venus is named with Jupiter as the chief sufferer of kendrādhipatya-doṣa because
  across the twelve lagnas Venus is a kendra lord more often than any other planet, and his
  companion sign most often falls in an evil house (2/6/7/8/12).

Weight/authority: normal
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: "It is clear that a benefic being a kendra lord is inauspicious; so among the four benefics, since Jupiter and Venus possess special benefic-ness, it is only ri…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"स्पष्ट है कि शुभ ग्रहों का केन्द्राधिपति होना अशुभ है, इसलिए चार शुभग्रहों में गुरु और शुक्र में विशेष शुभत्व होने केकारण विशेष दोष होना उचित ही है। यह सर्वविदित है कि विशेष स्वच्छ वस्तु में ही दाग विशेष दिखाई पड़ता है। बुध पापग्रहों केसाथ होने से पाप भी हो जाता है, इसीलिए गुरु, शुक्र से बुध में दोष अल्प कहा गया है। चन्द्रमा पूर्ण रहने पर शुभ और क्षीण होने पर पाप होता है। इसीलिए बुध से भी न्यून दोष चन्द्रमा को कहा गया है।"

Translation: "It is clear that a benefic being a kendra lord is inauspicious; so among the four benefics, since Jupiter and Venus possess special benefic-ness, it is only right that they take a special doṣa. It is universally known that a stain shows most conspicuously on a specially clean object. Mercury turns malefic when in the company of malefics — that is why Mercury's doṣa is said to be less than Jupiter's and Venus's. The Moon is benefic when full and malefic when waning — that is why the Moon is given even less doṣa than Mercury."
laghu_parashari.effect:
The magnitude of kendrādhipatya-doṣa is proportional to the purity of the planet's
  benefic-ness. Purest benefics (Guru, Shukra) → maximum doṣa. Mercury, being contaminated
  by association (with malefics he becomes malefic), → smaller doṣa. Moon, whose benefic status
  is conditional on being waxing/full, → smallest doṣa of the four.

Weight/authority: विशेष (this is the reasoning behind śloka 11)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Which of the four benefics owns the kendra; for Mercury, the planets he
  conjoins; for the Moon, its paksha-bala / waxing-waning state (क्षीण or पूर्ण).

Exceptions / caveats: —

---

laghu_parashari.description: ŚLOKA 11
laghu_parashari.exact_rule: "Less doṣa of marakatva than these two (Jupiter and Venus) should be understood in Mercury, and less than that (Mercury) in the Moon. The Sun and the Moon do not incur the doṣa of being lord of the 8th (रन्ध्रेश)."
laghu_parashari.effect:
(i) Ranking of kendrādhipatya-marakatva among benefics:
  Guru = Shukra (greatest) > Budh > Chandra (least).
  (ii) Exception to the aṣṭameśa rule: Sun and Moon as 8th lords are exempt from the
  8th-lordship blemish.

Weight/authority: प्रबल (core sūtra of the chapter)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; identity of the kendra lord(s); identity of the 8th lord.

Exceptions / caveats: The exemption applies only to Sun (8th lord for Makar lagna) and Moon
  (8th lord for Dhanu lagna). Author qualifies this on p.55 — see LP-055-1.

laghu_parashari.description: व्याख्या (विशेष) on Mercury and the Moon
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"विशेष-बुध की एक राशि यदि सप्तम भाव में पड़ती है तो दूसरी राशि केन्द्र में ही पड़ेगी, जैसे मिथुन, कन्या, धनु और मीन लग्न। यदि बुध केन्द्रेश होकर मारक भाव सप्तम में पड़ जाए तो वह मारक होगा, लेकिन गुरु व शुक्र की अपेक्षा उसमें कम मारकत्व रहेगा।
  इसी प्रकार चन्द्रमा की एक राशि होती है और वह केन्द्र में पड़ जाए तो चौथे व दसवें भाव में तो कम अशुभ होगी, पहले व सातवें भाव में अधिक अशुभ होगी और यदि चन्द्रमा स्वराशि कर्क में सप्तम भाव में बैठ जाए तो उसमें अधिक मारकत्व आ जाएगा लेकिन बुध की अपेक्षा अल्प ही होगा।"

Translation: "Special note — If one of Mercury's signs falls in the 7th house, then his other sign will necessarily fall in a kendra — as in Mithuna, Kanya, Dhanu and Meena lagnas. If Mercury, being a kendra lord, falls in the maraka 7th house, he will be a māraka, but his marakatva will be less than Jupiter's and Venus's.
  In the same way the Moon has one sign; if it falls in a kendra, then in the 4th and 10th it will be less inauspicious, in the 1st and 7th more inauspicious; and if the Moon in his own sign Karka sits in the 7th house, greater marakatva enters him — but it will still be less than Mercury's."
laghu_parashari.effect:
(a) Mercury: for Mithuna, Kanya, Dhanu, Meena lagnas one of his signs is the 7th and the
      other is necessarily also a kendra. If such a Mercury is *placed* in the 7th, he is māraka —
      but weaker than Guru/Shukra.
  (b) Moon as kendra lord: 4th/10th = less inauspicious; 1st/7th = more inauspicious.
  (c) Moon in own sign Karka placed in the 7th acquires increased marakatva — still less
      than Mercury's.

Weight/authority: विशेष
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; house occupied by Mercury / by the Moon; whether Moon is in Karka.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: THE MASTER STATEMENT (author sets it in bold type)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"वस्तुतः स्पष्ट है कि गुरु, शुक्र, बुध व चन्द्रमा यदि केन्द्रों 1,4,7,10 में स्वराशि में न होकर अन्य राशियों में स्थित हों तो उन्हें मारकत्व शक्ति नहीं मिलती है, जब तक केन्द्रेश का केन्द्र भाव में स्थिति अशुभ न हो। अतः मूल भाव यह है कि केन्द्रेश होकर केन्द्र में स्थित होने पर गुरु व शुक्र को, उसकेबाद बुध और फिर चन्द्रमा को मारकत्व प्राप्त होता है। केन्द्रों में भी सप्तम पर विशेष ध्यान देना पड़ता है।"

Translation: "In truth it is clear that if Jupiter, Venus, Mercury and the Moon are situated in the kendras 1, 4, 7, 10 not in their own signs but in other signs, then they do not receive marakatva power — unless the kendra lord's position in the kendra is itself inauspicious. Hence the fundamental sense is this: it is on being a kendra lord AND being placed in a kendra that Jupiter and Venus, then Mercury, then the Moon acquire marakatva. Among the kendras too, the 7th demands special attention."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Kendrādhipatya-doṣa is not automatic from lordship alone. Two conditions:
  1. the planet must be a kendreśa, and
  2. it must be *placed* in a kendra.
  A benefic kendra lord standing in a kendra in a sign not his own does not get marakatva
  power (unless its placement is independently inauspicious). Strength order once triggered:
  Guru/Shukra > Budh > Chandra. The 7th house placement is the most dangerous of the four kendras.

Weight/authority: प्रबल / मूल भाव (author bolds this — the operative core of the whole doctrine)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; which kendra the benefic lord occupies; whether that placement
  is in its own sign; independent affliction of that placement.

Exceptions / caveats: Trikona co-lordship (śloka 12) overrides; own-sign placement (see LP-055-1a).

laghu_parashari.description: the aṣṭameśa exemption explained
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"पूर्व में बतला दिया गया है कि भाग्य भाव का व्ययेश कोई भी हो वह अशुभ होता है। इसकेनियम केअपवाद स्वरूप ग्यारहवें श्लोक की अन्तिम पंक्ति लिखी गई है। सभी अष्टमेश अशुभ होते हैं, लेकिन सूर्य(मकर लग्न में) व चन्द्रमा(धनु लग्न में) अष्टमेश हो तो उन्हें अशुभता का दोष नहीं लगता है। वस्तुतः स्पष्ट अन्य अष्टमेशों की अपेक्षा सूर्य और चन्द्र को अष्टमेश होने का दोष तो [contd. p.55]"

Translation: "It has been stated earlier that whoever is the 12th lord *from* the bhāgya (9th) house is inauspicious. The last line of the eleventh śloka is written as an exception to that rule. All 8th lords are inauspicious, but if the Sun (in Makar lagna) or the Moon (in Dhanu lagna) is the 8th lord, then the blemish of inauspiciousness does not attach to them. In truth, clearly, compared with other 8th lords, the doṣa of being 8th lord for the Sun and the Moon [does attach but is less — contd. p.55]"
laghu_parashari.effect:
The 8th house is the 12th from the 9th (bhāgya-vyaya), hence its lord is inauspicious.
  Exception: Sun as 8th lord (Makar lagna) and Moon as 8th lord (Dhanu lagna) are exempt.

Weight/authority: विशेष (stated as अपवाद — an explicit exception clause)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign (specifically Makar or Dhanu); identity of 8th lord.

Exceptions / caveats: Author immediately qualifies it — see LP-055-1.

---

laghu_parashari.description: [AUTHOR'S OWN] — the qualification of the Sun/Moon exemption
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"लगेगा लेकिन अन्य अष्टमेशों की अपेक्षा कम होगा। ऐसा इसलिए होता है कि सूर्य व चन्द्रमा एक राशि केस्वामी होते हैं।"

Translation: "…[the doṣa] will attach, but it will be less than for other 8th lords. This happens because the Sun and the Moon are lords of one sign only."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Against the plain sense of śloka 11 ("न रन्ध्रेशत्वदोषः"), the author holds that Sun
  (Makar lagna) and Moon (Dhanu lagna) as 8th lords do carry the aṣṭameśa-doṣa — only in
  reduced measure. Reason: they each own a single sign, so no second lordship compounds
  the blemish.

Weight/authority: [AUTHOR'S OWN] — "वस्तुतः" reading, departing from the literal sūtra
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna = Makar (Sun 8th lord) or Dhanu (Moon 8th lord).

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: निष्कर्ष: the five-point operative conclusion of ślokas 10 + 11
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"निष्कर्षतः दसवें व ग्यारहवें श्लोक से ऐसा सिद्ध होता है कि यदि—
  – शुभ ग्रह केन्द्र भाव के स्वामी होकर स्वराशि में हों तो शुभ फल देते हैं।
  – केन्द्र केस्वामी मारक भाव के स्वामी हों या मारक भाव में हों तो मारक फल ही प्राप्त होगा।
  – केन्द्र केस्वामी यदि शुभ भाव 5 या 9 में हों या इनके स्वामियों के साथ सम्बन्ध करते हों तो योगकारक होते हैं।
  – केन्द्रेश अशुभ भावों में हों तो अशुभ फल देते हैं।
  – शुभग्रह सप्तमेश होकर किसी भी केन्द्रेश से सम्बन्ध करे तो योगकारक होता है और निज दशान्तर्दशा में प्रारम्भ में शुभफल और बाद में मारक फल देता है।"

Translation: "In conclusion, from the tenth and eleventh ślokas this is established — that if:
  (a) a benefic is lord of a kendra and is in his own sign, he gives auspicious results;
  (b) a kendra lord is also lord of a maraka house, or is placed in a maraka house, then only
      māraka results will be obtained;
  (c) a kendra lord is in the auspicious houses 5 or 9, or forms a relationship (सम्बन्ध) with
      the lords of those houses, he becomes a yogakāraka;
  (d) a kendreśa placed in inauspicious houses gives inauspicious results;
  (e) a benefic who is 7th lord and forms a relationship with any kendra lord becomes a
      yogakāraka, and in his own daśā-antardaśā gives auspicious results at the beginning
      and māraka results later."
laghu_parashari.effect:
The five-branch decision procedure for any kendra lord. Note (e) is a timing rule:
  the same period is split — śubha-phala in the early part, māraka-phala in the latter part.

Weight/authority: प्रबल / निष्कर्ष (the author's own distilled algorithm)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; kendra lords and their sign/house placement; own-sign status;
  maraka-house lordship (2nd/7th); sambandha (conjunction/aspect/exchange) with 5th/9th lords
  or with kendra lords; Vimshottari daśā–antardaśā of that planet.

Exceptions / caveats: (a) own-sign placement neutralises; (c) trikona connection converts to yoga.

laghu_parashari.description: [AUTHOR'S OWN] — reading of the disputed second pāda of śloka 10
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"दसवें श्लोक के द्वितीय चरण के अर्थ में टीकाकारों के मध्य मतभेद है। लेकिन हमारे मत से यह अर्थ तर्कसंगत लगता है—केन्द्रेश मारक भाव केस्वामी होकर मारक भाव में स्थित हों, यह अर्थ तर्कसंगत लगता है।"

Translation: "Among commentators there is disagreement over the meaning of the second pāda of the tenth śloka. But in our opinion this meaning appears logical — that the kendra lord, *being also lord of a maraka house*, is *situated in* a maraka house; this meaning appears reasonable."
laghu_parashari.effect:
For "मारकत्वेऽपि च तयोर्मारकस्थानसंस्थितिः" the author requires both conditions
  conjointly: the kendreśa must be a maraka-house lord and be placed in a maraka house.
  (Recorded disagreement: "विद्वानों/टीकाकारों में मतभेद है" — other commentators read it otherwise;
  the author does not name their reading here.)

Weight/authority: [AUTHOR'S OWN] — "हमारे मत से"
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; whether the kendra lord also owns 2nd/7th; its house placement.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: the maraka ladder for a benefic 7th lord
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"शुभ ग्रह यदि सप्तम भाव के स्वामी हों तो गुरु सबसे अधिक मारक, शुक्र उससे कम मारक, बुध उससे कम और सप्तमेश यदि चन्द्र हो तो सबसे कम मारक होता है।"

Translation: "If benefics are lords of the 7th house, then Jupiter is the greatest māraka, Venus less than him, Mercury less than that, and if the Moon is 7th lord he is the least māraka of all."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Ranking of maraka strength for a benefic 7th lord:
  Guru > Shukra > Budh > Chandra.
  (By lagna: Guru is 7th lord for Mithuna and Kanya; Shukra for Mesh and Vrishchik;
  Budh for Dhanu and Meena; Chandra for Makar. — derived, not stated on the page.)

Weight/authority: प्रबल
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; identity of 7th lord.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: why Budh and Chandra are the least afflicted kendreśas
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"बुध और चन्द्रमा केन्द्रेश होने से कम दोषयुक्त होते हैं। इसका कारण यह है कि बुध शुभग्रहों के साथ होने से शुभ और पापग्रहों केसाथ होने से पापी होता है और चन्द्रमा का शुभत्व और पापत्व उसकेक्षीणत्व पर निर्भर करता है।"

Translation: "Mercury and the Moon carry less doṣa from being kendra lords. The reason is that Mercury is benefic when with benefics and malefic when with malefics, and the Moon's benefic-ness or malefic-ness depends on its क्षीणत्व (waning/depletion)."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Mercury's and the Moon's kendrādhipatya-doṣa must be modulated by association:
  assess Mercury's conjunctions first; assess the Moon's paksha (waxing/waning) first. Their
  doṣa is intrinsically smaller because their benefic status is itself conditional.

Weight/authority: normal (explanatory)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Planets conjoining Mercury; Moon's tithi/paksha strength (क्षीण vs पूर्ण).

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: ŚLOKA 12 (Sanskrit; translation continues on p.56)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule: "If a malefic planet (Mars) is lord of the 10th house only, he is not a giver of auspicious results; but if he is also lord of a trikona, then he gives auspicious results."
laghu_parashari.effect:
The Rajayoga-karaka clause. A malefic owning a kendra alone → no benefic capacity.
  A malefic owning a kendra + a trikona simultaneously → becomes a giver of auspicious results
  (yogakāraka). Mere 10th-lordship (कर्मेशत्वमात्रतः) is not enough.

Weight/authority: प्रबल (this is the cancellation clause for the entire kendrādhipatya doctrine)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; sign-lordships of the malefic in question (does it own both a
  kendra 1/4/7/10 and a trikona 1/5/9?).

Exceptions / caveats: See LP-056-2 — a malefic that is kendreśa and also trishadāyeśa (3/6/11 lord)
  remains inauspicious.

---

laghu_parashari.description: व्याख्या of śloka 12: Mars stands for all malefics, 10th for all kendras
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"विशेष-इस श्लोक में अशुभ ग्रह के रूप में मंगल एवं केन्द्र के रूप में दसवें भाव की चर्चा की गई है। लेकिन मंगल समस्त अशुभ ग्रहों का और दशम समस्त केन्द्रों का प्रतीक है। श्लोक केअनुसार तो यह योग कर्क और सिंह लग्न में घटित होता है। लेकिन अन्य ग्रहों में देखेंगे तो शनि के लिए वृष व तुला लग्न में घटित होगा।"

Translation: "Special note — In this śloka Mars has been discussed as the representative malefic and the 10th house as the representative kendra. But Mars is the symbol of all malefic planets and the 10th of all kendras. According to the śloka this yoga occurs in Kark and Simha lagna. But if we look at other planets, for Saturn it will occur in Vrish and Tula lagna."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Generalise śloka 12 beyond its literal terms. The kendra+trikona yogakāraka cases named:

| Yogakāraka planet | Lagna | Houses owned |
|---|---|---|
| मंगल (Mars) | कर्क (Cancer) | 10th (Mesh) + 5th (Vrishchik) |
| मंगल (Mars) | सिंह (Leo) | 4th (Vrishchik) + 9th (Mesh) |
| शनि (Saturn) | वृष (Taurus) | 10th (Kumbha) + 9th (Makar) |
| शनि (Saturn) | तुला (Libra) | 4th (Makar) + 5th (Kumbha) |

Weight/authority: विशेष / प्रबल
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; sign-lordships of Mars and Saturn.

Exceptions / caveats: LP-056-2.

laghu_parashari.description: the counter-clause: kendreśa + trishadāyeśa
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"पापग्रह केन्द्रेश होकर त्रिषडायेश भी हो तो अशुभ फलदायी होते हैं।"

Translation: "If a malefic, being a kendra lord, is also lord of a trishadāya house (3rd, 6th, 11th), then it becomes a giver of inauspicious results."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Kendra lordship combined with 3/6/11 lordship (त्रिषडाय) in a malefic → inauspicious.
  This is the mirror image of the trikona clause: trikona co-lordship redeems, trishadāya
  co-lordship condemns.

Weight/authority: प्रबल
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; the malefic's two sign-lordships.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: recorded scholarly disagreement on śloka 12
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"यहां भी टीकाकारों में मतभेद है और कोई मात्र मंगल के लिए कहता है तो कोई समस्त पापग्रहों केलिए कहता है। लेकिन मूल भाव यहां स्पष्ट कर दिया गया है।"

Translation: "Here too there is disagreement among commentators — some say it applies to Mars alone, others say it applies to all malefic planets. But the fundamental sense has been made clear here."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Two positions on record — (i) śloka 12 governs Mars only; (ii) it governs all
  malefics. The author sides with (ii) (see LP-056-1, where he extends it to Saturn).

Weight/authority: normal — both positions recorded per brief §4
laghu_parashari.combination:
—

Exceptions / caveats: —

---

laghu_parashari.description: ŚLOKA 13
laghu_parashari.exact_rule: "Whichever houses Rahu and Ketu are situated in, or whichever house-lords they sit with — in accordance with that, these two shadow-planets (तमोग्रहौ) produce auspicious or inauspicious results, in proportion to strength (बलानुसार)."
laghu_parashari.effect:
The whole of Rahu/Ketu judgement rests on two inputs only:
  1. the house (bhāva) they occupy, and
  2. the house-lord (bhāveśa) / planet they are conjoined with;
  and the result is delivered प्रबलौ / बलानुसार — in proportion to the strength of that
  house or that lord.

Weight/authority: प्रबल / सर्वोत्तम (the author explicitly calls this siddhānta सर्वोत्तम on p.59 — LP-059-4)
laghu_parashari.combination:
House occupied by Rahu and by Ketu; planets conjoined with each and what
  houses those planets own; the strength (bala) of that bhāva/bhāveśa.

Exceptions / caveats: Author's own dissent, LP-058-3.

laghu_parashari.description: why a separate śloka was needed: the nodes own no house
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"विशेष-राहु-केतु किसी भी भाव के स्वामी नहीं हैं। अतः पूर्व कथित भावेश सम्बन्धी सिद्धान्तों के अनुसार राहु-केतु का शुभाशुभ विचार नहीं किया जा सकता है। इसीलिए पाराशर मुनि ने इस श्लोक को रचा है।"

Translation: "Special note — Rahu and Ketu are lords of no house whatsoever. Therefore the auspicious/inauspicious assessment of Rahu-Ketu cannot be made by the previously stated bhāveśa-based principles. It is for this reason that sage Parashara composed this śloka."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Every rule of the preceding chapter that turns on house-lordship is inapplicable to
  Rahu and Ketu. They require a separate mechanism, supplied by śloka 13.

Weight/authority: विशेष — the doctrinal gate for the whole Rahu/Ketu section
laghu_parashari.combination:
—

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: the author's explicit EVALUATION ORDER for Rahu/Ketu
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"सर्वप्रथम यह देखें कि राहु-केतु किस भाव में स्थित हैं। तदोपरान्त पूर्व कथित पाराशरी सिद्धान्तों के द्वारा उस भाव केविषय में जान लें कि वह शुभ है या अशुभ।
  यदि राहु-केतु शुभ भाव में स्थित हैं तो शुभफलदायी और यदि अशुभ भाव में स्थित हैं तो अशुभ फलदायी होंगे।
  इसी प्रकार राहु-केतु जिन ग्रहों केसाथ स्थित हैं, उनकी प्रकृति केअनुसार भी फल देते हैं। अतः राहु-केतु यदि किसी अन्य ग्रह के [contd. p.57] साथ हों तो पहले देखना चाहिए कि वह(ग्रह) किस भाव का स्वामी है, उसी के अनुरूप फल कहना चाहिए। अतः राहु-केतु साथी ग्रहों के अनुरूप फल प्रदान करते हैं।"

Translation: "First of all, see in which house Rahu-Ketu are situated. Thereafter, by means of the previously stated Parashari principles, determine whether that house is auspicious or inauspicious.
  If Rahu-Ketu are situated in an auspicious house they will be givers of auspicious results, and if in an inauspicious house, givers of inauspicious results.
  In the same way, Rahu-Ketu also give results according to the nature of the planets they are situated with. So if Rahu-Ketu are with some other planet, one should first see which house that planet is the lord of, and pronounce the results accordingly. Hence Rahu-Ketu give results in conformity with their companion planets."
laghu_parashari.effect:
PRIORITY ORDER, in the author's own words:
  1. सर्वप्रथम (first of all) — identify the *house* Rahu/Ketu occupy;
  2. तदोपरान्त (thereafter) — using the earlier Parashari principles (kendra / trikona /
     trika / maraka classification), judge whether that house is śubha or aśubha; the node
     inherits that verdict;
  3. इसी प्रकार (likewise) — then take the *conjoined planet*, and first determine which
     house that planet lords; give results per that lordship.
  So the sequence is bhāva first → then the conjoined planet — and the conjoined planet is
  itself read through its house-lordship, not merely through its natural nature.

Weight/authority: प्रबल — the author's operative procedure
laghu_parashari.combination:
House occupied by Rahu/Ketu; the śubha/aśubha classification of that house
  for the given lagna; conjoined planets and their house-lordships.

Exceptions / caveats: —

---

laghu_parashari.description: Rahu/Ketu take the likeness of the planet they sit with
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"तात्पर्य यह है कि यह जिस ग्रह के साथ स्थित होते हैं उसी के अनुरूप फल प्रदान करते हैं, जैसे सूर्य के साथ हैं तो सूर्य सदृश, चन्द्र के साथ हैं तो चन्द्र सदृश, मंगल के साथ हैं तो मंगल सदृश फल प्रदान करते हैं, इसी प्रकार अन्य ग्रहों के साथ समझना चाहिए।"

Translation: "The purport is that whichever planet they are situated with, they give results conforming to that planet — e.g. with the Sun, Sun-like; with the Moon, Moon-like; with Mars, Mars-like results; the same should be understood for the other planets."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Conjunction transfers nature: Rahu/Ketu + X ⇒ node delivers X-like results.

Weight/authority: normal
laghu_parashari.combination:
Planets conjoined with Rahu / with Ketu.

Exceptions / caveats: Author's own objection at LP-058-3 — with Sun or Moon this fails.

laghu_parashari.description: Rahu/Ketu DOUBLE the bhāveśa's result; the nodal yogakāraka clause
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"जिस भाव में राहु-केतु बैठते हैं, उसके भावेश ग्रह केफल को दूना कर देते हैं क्योंकि उसमें राहु-केतु की शक्ति भी आ जाती है। इसीलिए कहा गया है कि राहु या केतु केन्द्र या त्रिकोण में, केन्द्रेश या त्रिकोणेश के साथ युति करें तो योगकारक होते हैं। यह ध्यान रखें कि राहु-केतु का अपना स्वतन्त्र स्वरूप नहीं होता है, इसलिए वे कारक ग्रह की संगति में कारक और मारक ग्रह की संगति में मारक हो जाते हैं।"

Translation: "Whichever house Rahu-Ketu sit in, they double (दूना) the result of the lord of that house, because the power of Rahu-Ketu is added into it. That is why it is said that if Rahu or Ketu, [being] in a kendra or a trikona, form a conjunction (युति) with the kendra lord or the trikona lord, they become yogakāraka. Keep in mind that Rahu-Ketu have no independent form of their own — therefore in the company of a kāraka planet they become kāraka, and in the company of a māraka planet they become māraka."
laghu_parashari.effect:
(a) Doubling rule: a node in house N amplifies the results of the lord of house N — ×2.
  (b) Nodal yogakāraka rule: node placed in a kendra or trikona *and* conjoined (yuti)
      with the kendreśa or trikoṇeśa ⇒ yogakāraka.
  (c) No independent nature: with a kāraka they turn kāraka; with a māraka they turn māraka.

Weight/authority: प्रबल
laghu_parashari.combination:
House occupied by Rahu/Ketu; lord of that house; whether that house is a
  kendra/trikona; whether the kendreśa/trikoṇeśa is conjoined with the node.

Exceptions / caveats: Conjunction only — aspect does not count (LP-057-4, LP-062-2).

laghu_parashari.description: सुश्लोक शतक: the two kinds of "सम्बन्धी" for Rahu/Ketu
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"सुश्लोक शतक के टीकाकार कहते हैं कि जिस भाव में ग्रह रहता है उस भाव का आश्रय लेकर वह अपना फल देता है। राहु-केतु जिस भाव में हों उसके अनुसार फल देते हैं। राहु-केतु को तमोग्रह के साथ-साथ छायाग्रह भी कहते हैं क्योंकि ये प्रकाशमान नहीं हैं। ये जिस ग्रह केसम्बन्धी हों उसका फल देते हैं। सुश्लोक शतक ने दो प्रकार केसम्बन्धी केबताए हैं--
  1. जिस ग्रह केसाथ राहु या केतु हों।
  2. जिस ग्रह केसप्तम में राहु या केतु हों।"

Translation: "The commentator of the Suśloka Śataka says that whichever house a planet occupies, it gives its result taking the support (आश्रय) of that house. Rahu-Ketu give results according to whichever house they are in. Rahu-Ketu are called chāyā-graha (shadow planets) as well as tamo-graha, because they are not luminous. They give the result of whichever planet they are सम्बन्धी (related) to. The Suśloka Śataka has stated two kinds of relation:
  1. the planet Rahu or Ketu is together with (साथ);
  2. the planet in whose 7th Rahu or Ketu stand (सप्तम में)."
laghu_parashari.effect:
A node is "related to" a planet in exactly two ways — (1) same house (conjunction);
  (2) node standing in the 7th from that planet (opposition). Either relation makes the node
  deliver that planet's results.

Weight/authority: normal (cited authority, not the author's own)
laghu_parashari.combination:
House positions of all planets and of Rahu/Ketu; 7th-from counts.

Exceptions / caveats: Sits in tension with LP-057-4, which denies dṛṣṭi-sambandha to the nodes.

laghu_parashari.description: Parashari commentators reject dṛṣṭi-sambandha for the nodes
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"पाराशरी के अन्य टीकाकारों ने राहु-केतु का सहावस्थान(एक साथ अन्य ग्रहों केसाथ बैठना) तो माना है परन्तु राहु-केतु का दृष्टि सम्बन्ध(कोई उनको देखे या ये किसी को देखें) नहीं माना है।"

Translation: "The other commentators of the Parashari have accepted सहावस्थान (co-location — sitting together with other planets) for Rahu-Ketu, but have NOT accepted दृष्टि सम्बन्ध (aspectual relation — whether someone aspects them or they aspect someone) for Rahu-Ketu."
laghu_parashari.effect:
For Rahu/Ketu, only conjunction (same-house co-location) constitutes sambandha.
  Aspects to or from the nodes are not counted as sambandha.

Weight/authority: प्रबल — restated and endorsed by the author on p.62 ("यहां दृष्टि नहीं युति सम्बन्ध को मानना चाहिए", LP-062-2)
laghu_parashari.combination:
House co-tenancy of the nodes.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: the author's reading of 'यदभ्दावगतौ'
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"श्लोक में यह शब्द आया है 'यदभ्दावगतौ' जिसका अर्थ होता है कि जिस ग्रह का जो-जो भाव-वह ग्रह जो फल करेगा वही उस [contd. p.58] भाव में बैठा राहु या केतु करेगा।"

Translation: "In the śloka this word occurs — 'यदभ्दावगतौ' — whose meaning is: whatever houses belong to a planet, whatever result that planet will produce, the very same will the Rahu or Ketu seated in that house produce."
laghu_parashari.effect:
A node occupying a sign delivers the *full* result-set of that sign's lord — including
  that lord's other house-lordship. Worked out on p.58 (LP-058-1).

Weight/authority: normal — the author's reading; contested (LP-058-2)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Sign occupied by the node; both signs owned by that sign's lord; both houses
  those signs represent for the lagna.

Exceptions / caveats: —

---

laghu_parashari.description: the author's reading worked out: BOTH signs of the dispositor apply
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"अतः स्पष्ट है कि मान लीजिए कि मिथुन राशि में राहु बैठा है तो मिथुन और कन्या दोनों राशियों के स्वामी बुध हैं इसलिए राहु चाहे मिथुन में बैठा हो या कन्या में फल बुध के अनुसार ही करेगा। अतः ग्रह की एक राशि में बैठने पर भी दोनों राशियों का आधिपत्य का फल राहु को दिया गया।"

Translation: "So it is clear — suppose Rahu is seated in Mithuna: the lord of both Mithuna and Kanya is Mercury; therefore, whether Rahu sits in Mithuna or in Kanya, he will produce results according to Mercury only. Hence, even though he sits in one sign of a planet, the results of lordship of BOTH signs have been given to Rahu."
laghu_parashari.effect:
[AUTHOR'S POSITION] A node in any sign takes on the entire lordship-result of the
  dispositor, i.e. of *both* houses that dispositor rules for the lagna — not merely the house
  the node physically occupies.

Weight/authority: normal — the author's exegesis of यदभ्दावगतौ
laghu_parashari.combination:
Sign occupied by the node; that sign's lord; both houses that lord owns
  for the given lagna.

Exceptions / caveats: Directly contradicted by other commentators — LP-058-2.

laghu_parashari.description: the rival commentators' reading (recorded मतभेद)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"लेकिन अन्य टीकाकार यह अर्थ नहीं करते हैं। उनके अनुसार इस शब्द का अर्थ है—जिस भाव में राहु या केतु स्थित हों उस भाव का फल राहु या केतु देगा। उदाहरणतः तुला लग्न हो और नौवें भाव में राहु स्थित हो तो मात्र नौवें भाव का ही फल देगा। मिथुन राशि के स्वामी बुध की दूसरी राशि कन्या से या कन्या के आधिपत्य से उसका कोई सरोकार नहीं होगा।"

Translation: "But other commentators do not take this meaning. According to them the word means: whichever house Rahu or Ketu is situated in, Rahu or Ketu will give the result of that house [only]. For example, if it is Tula lagna and Rahu is situated in the 9th house, he will give the result of the 9th house only. He will have no concern whatsoever with Kanya — the second sign of Mercury, lord of Mithuna — nor with the lordship of Kanya."
laghu_parashari.effect:
RIVAL POSITION: the node gives the result of the occupied house only; the
  dispositor's second sign/lordship is irrelevant.
  Worked instance given: Tula lagna, Rahu in the 9th (Mithuna) → gives 9th-house results only.

Weight/authority: normal — both positions recorded per brief §4. The author reports this without
  refuting it; his own preference is LP-058-1.
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; house occupied by the node.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: [AUTHOR'S OWN] — the author's DISSENT from the bhāva/bhāveśa doctrine
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"सामान्य विचार से राहु या केतु किसी भी राशि केस्वामी हों इस पर विचार न करके इनके फल शनि सदृश माने गये हैं जबकि लघुपाराशरी केअनुसार राहु-केतु जिस-जिस भाव में हों उस-उस भाव के अनुसार या जिस भावेश के साथ हों उस भावेश के फलों के अनुसार फल देने वाले होते हैं। लेकिन इनका सारा फल इसी रीति से मिलेगा यह कथन सत्य नहीं जान पड़ता। इसके पार्श्व में कारण यह है कि यदि राहु या केतु चन्द्र या सूर्य के साथ हों तो चन्द्र व सूर्य सदृश फल नहीं दे सकेंगे। यदि राहु सप्तम भाव में हो तो स्त्री के विषय में अशुभ फल किए बिना रहेगा नहीं या पंचम भाव में हो तो सन्तान संबंधी अनिष्ट फल अवश्य देगा। विद्वानों के अनुसार राहु-केतु तीसरे, छठे या ग्यारहवें भाव में हों तो इन भावों के फलों की वृद्धि करते हैं। तीसरे भाव में ये पराक्रम वृद्धि करते हैं, छठे भाव में शत्रुनाश करते हैं और ग्यारहवें भाव में धनलाभ करते हैं। अतः ये ग्रह शुभफल करते हुए भी देखे गये हैं। अतः राहु व केतु भावानुसार या भावेशानुसार फल देते हैं ऐसा पूर्णतः दिखाई नहीं पड़ता है।"

Translation: "By general consideration, without considering whose sign-lord Rahu or Ketu may be, their results have been held to be Saturn-like, whereas according to the Laghu Parashari Rahu-Ketu give results according to whichever house they are in, or according to the results of whichever house-lord they are with. But the statement that all of their results will be obtained by this method alone does not appear to be true. The reason behind this is:
  — if Rahu or Ketu are with the Moon or the Sun, they will not be able to give Moon-like or Sun-like results;
  — if Rahu is in the 7th house, he will not fail to produce inauspicious results regarding the wife;
  — or if [Rahu is] in the 5th house, he will certainly give inauspicious results concerning progeny.
  According to scholars, if Rahu-Ketu are in the 3rd, 6th or 11th house they increase the results of those houses: in the 3rd they increase parākrama (valour/initiative), in the 6th they cause destruction of enemies (शत्रुनाश), and in the 11th they cause gain of wealth (धनलाभ). Hence these planets have also been seen producing auspicious results.
  Therefore, that Rahu and Ketu give results purely according to the house or according to the house-lord does not appear to be wholly the case."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Four standing overrides to the śloka-13 mechanism, per the author:
  1. Node + Sun, or node + Moon → the node cannot deliver Sun-like / Moon-like results.
     (Read: with the luminaries the conjunction-transfer rule breaks down.)
  2. Rahu in the 7th → unavoidable inauspicious results for the wife/spouse, regardless of
     bhāva/bhāveśa reasoning.
  3. Rahu in the 5th → certain misfortune regarding progeny.
  4. Rahu/Ketu in 3rd, 6th, 11th → increase those houses' results — 3rd: parākrama;
     6th: destruction of enemies; 11th: financial gain. (attributed to "विद्वानों के अनुसार")
  Also records the general/other view: Rahu and Ketu are simply read as Saturn-like (शनि सदृश)
  without regard to sign-lordship.

Weight/authority: [AUTHOR'S OWN] — explicit dissent ("सत्य नहीं जान पड़ता", "पूर्णतः दिखाई नहीं पड़ता है").
  Practically the most usable Rahu placement rules in the chapter.
laghu_parashari.combination:
House occupied by Rahu (esp. 3/5/6/7/11); whether the node is conjoined with
  Sun or Moon.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: the sign-lordship controversy opens
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"कुछ ज्योतिषी राहु की राशि मानते हैं और कुछ नहीं मानते हैं।"

Translation: "Some astrologers accept a sign [-lordship] for Rahu and some do not."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Records an open dispute; evidence follows on p.59, verdict on p.60 (LP-060-2).

Weight/authority: normal — मतभेद recorded
laghu_parashari.combination:
—

laghu_parashari.description: the Jātaka-grantha quotation on Rahu/Ketu signs
laghu_parashari.exact_rule: "Kanyā is declared to be Rahu's house; Mithuna is remembered as Rahu's exaltation. Dhanu is declared to be Rahu's debilitation; and Ketu is [in] the seventh [from each of these]."
laghu_parashari.effect:
If sign-lordship for the nodes is admitted: Rahu owns Kanyā (by consensus also
  Mithuna), exalted Mithuna, debilitated Dhanu; Ketu owns Meena (by consensus also Dhanu),
  exalted Dhanu, debilitated Mithuna.

Weight/authority: normal — quoted authority; the author later rejects nodal sign-lordship (LP-060-2)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Sign occupied by Rahu/Ketu.

Exceptions / caveats: LP-060-2 — "इनको मानना उचित नहीं है".

laghu_parashari.description: Pandit Sitaram Jha's ruling
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"पंडित सीताराम झा के अनुसार प्रबल होने पर भी राहु और केतु जिस-जिस भाव में और जिस-जिस भावेश के साथ रहते हैं उसी के अनुसार शुभाशुभ फल देते हैं।"

Translation: "According to Pandit Sitaram Jha, even when strong (प्रबल), Rahu and Ketu give auspicious/inauspicious results only according to whichever house they are in and whichever house-lord they are with."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Strength does not grant the nodes independent significations — even a powerful Rahu/Ketu
  is read exclusively through bhāva + bhāveśa.

Weight/authority: normal (cited authority reinforcing śloka 13)
laghu_parashari.combination:
House occupied; conjoined bhāveśa.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: WHY the nodes have no independent nature (the बिम्बहीन argument)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"कहते हैं कि राहु व केतु ग्रहण के द्वारा सूर्य व चन्द्र के विमर्दक होने के कारण प्रबल और पापग्रह माने गये हैं तो भी आकाश अपने बिम्ब केअभाव में स्वतन्त्र रूप से निज स्वभावानुसार फल नहीं दे सकते हैं। कारण यह है कि राहु के तो सूर्य और चन्द्र के मार्ग के सम्पात प्रदेश रूप, बिम्बहीन हैं, अतः जिस समय जिस राशि में या जिस भावेश के साथ रहते हैं उसी राशि या भावेश के बिम्ब के स्वभावानुसार शुभाशुभ फल कारक कहे गये हैं।"

Translation: "It is said that Rahu and Ketu, being crushers (विमर्दक) of the Sun and Moon by means of eclipse, are held to be powerful and malefic; even so, in the sky, in the absence of a disc/orb (बिम्ब) of their own, they cannot give results independently according to their own nature. The reason is that Rahu is merely the intersection region (सम्पात प्रदेश) of the paths of the Sun and the Moon — orb-less (बिम्बहीन). Therefore, at whatever time, in whatever sign they stand, or with whatever house-lord they stand, they are said to be causes of auspicious/inauspicious results according to the nature of the orb of that sign or that house-lord."
laghu_parashari.effect:
The nodes are strong and malefic in principle (eclipse-causers) but orb-less, hence
  they must borrow the nature of the sign/bhāveśa they are with. This is the physical rationale
  for the entire śloka-13 method.

Weight/authority: normal (rationale)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Sign occupied; conjoined bhāveśa.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: the node axis is fixed 7th-apart; and the सर्वोत्तम summary
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"चन्द्र का भ्रमण मार्ग पृथ्वी के भ्रमण मार्ग को जिन दो स्थानों पर काटता है, उनमें एक को राहु और दूसरे को केतु कहा गया है। राहु से सातवें भाव में केतु सदैव रहता है।
  सार रूप पाराशरी का यह सिद्धान्त सर्वोत्तम है—राहु-केतु जिन-जिन भावों में स्थित हों या जिन-जिन भावों के स्वामियों के साथ बैठे हों, तो उसी के अनुसार शुभाशुभ फल बलानुसार [p.60] करते हैं।"

Translation: "The two places where the Moon's orbital path cuts the Earth's orbital path — one is called Rahu and the other Ketu. Ketu is always in the seventh house from Rahu.
  In essence, this principle of the Parashari is the very best (सर्वोत्तम): Rahu-Ketu, in whichever houses they are situated, or with whichever house-lords they sit, produce auspicious/inauspicious results accordingly, in proportion to strength."
laghu_parashari.effect:
(a) Ketu is invariably 7th from Rahu (180°). (b) The author's final endorsement:
  śloka 13's bhāva + bhāveśa rule is the best principle for the nodes.

Weight/authority: सर्वोत्तम (author's own superlative)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Rahu's house/degree (Ketu follows).

Exceptions / caveats: Tempered by his dissent at LP-058-3.

laghu_parashari.description: announcement of the राहु-केतु राशि चक्रम् and its four sources
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"विभिन्न जातक ग्रन्थों में राहु-केतु के सम्बन्ध में क्या कहा गया है उसका एक चक्र बनाकर दे रहे हैं जिससे आप भली-भांति समझ सकेंगे कि किसने क्या कहा है—राहु-केतु राशि चक्रम्। इसमें पाराशरी, सर्वार्थ चिन्तामणि, जातकाभरण, जैमिनीय सूत्र को आधार मानकर अनमोल ज्ञान देंगे, देखें पृष्ठ 61 राहु-केतु राशि चक्रम्।"

Translation: "We are giving a chakra of what has been said about Rahu-Ketu in various Jātaka texts, so that you may properly understand who said what — the Rahu-Ketu Rāśi Chakram. In it, taking Pārāśarī, Sarvārtha Chintāmaṇi, Jātakābharaṇa and Jaiminīya Sūtra as the basis, we shall give priceless knowledge (अनमोल ज्ञान); see page 61, Rahu-Ketu Rāśi Chakram."
laghu_parashari.effect:
The four authorities collated in the p.61 table are: पाराशरी, सर्वार्थ चिन्तामणि,
  जातकाभरण, जैमिनी सूत्र.

Weight/authority: अनमोल ज्ञान (author's own label for the chakra)
laghu_parashari.combination:
—

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: [AUTHOR'S OWN] — VERDICT: reject nodal sign-lordship, keep śloka 13
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"राहु और केतु को राशियों के स्वामित्व देने में परस्पर विरोधी वाक्य मिलते हैं। इसलिए इनको मानना उचित नहीं है। लेकिन 13वें श्लोक के अनुसार राहु और केतु को जो भाव और शुभाशुभ ग्रहों के सम्बन्ध से शुभाशुभ मानने का सिद्धान्त जो ऊपर कहा गया है, सत्य है।"

Translation: "In assigning sign-lordships to Rahu and Ketu, mutually contradictory statements are found. Therefore it is not proper to accept them. But the principle stated above — of judging Rahu and Ketu auspicious/inauspicious by the house [they occupy] and by their relation with benefic/malefic planets, in accordance with the 13th śloka — is true."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Do not use any sign-lordship, exaltation or debilitation for Rahu/Ketu. Judge them
  solely by (i) the house occupied and (ii) sambandha with benefic/malefic planets, per śloka 13.
  This is the author's ruling on the dispute opened at LP-058-4 and tabulated on p.61.

Weight/authority: [AUTHOR'S OWN] — "इनको मानना उचित नहीं है … सत्य है"
laghu_parashari.combination:
House occupied by the nodes; benefic/malefic planets in relation with them.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: astronomical definition of the nodes
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"यह जान लें कि जिस प्रकार विषुव तथा क्रान्ति इन दो वृत्तों केदो सम्पात बिन्दु को सायन मेषादि एवं सायन तुलादि सम्पात अर्थात् अयन कहते हैं उसी प्रकार क्रान्तिवृत्त तथा चन्द्रमार्ग वृत्ति के दो सम्पातों को राहु और केतु की संज्ञा दी गई है।
  कहने का तात्पर्य यह है कि चन्द्रमा का भ्रमण मार्ग पृथ्वी के भ्रमणमार्ग को जहां दो स्थानों पर काटता है, उनमें से एक बिन्दु राहु और दूसरे को केतु कहते हैं।
  सायन मेषादि सम्पात वह स्थान है जहां से सूर्य भूमध्यरेखा(विषुववृत्त) से उत्तर की ओर जाते हुए दिखाई देता है इसी प्रकार राहु क्रान्तिवृत्त में वह चन्द्रमार्ग तथा पृथ्वीमार्ग का सम्पात स्थान है जहां से चन्द्रमा क्रान्तिवृत्त से उत्तर की ओर होने लगता है अर्थात् चन्द्रमा का शर उत्तर की ओर होने लगता है। इसके विपरीत जहां से सूर्य विषुववृत्त से दक्षिण की ओर होने लगता है वह स्थान सूर्य का सायन तुलादि सम्पात है और इसी प्रकार क्रान्तिवृत्त में जहां से चन्द्रमा दक्षिण शर होने लगता है वह केतु सम्पात है।
  इस प्रकार आप राहु-केतु के विषय में समझ गए होंगे। इसीलिए राहु-केतु छाया ग्रह माने जाते हैं।"

Translation: "Know that, just as the two intersection points of the two circles — the equinoctial (विषुव) and the ecliptic (क्रान्ति) — are called the sāyana Meṣādi and sāyana Tulādi sampāta, i.e. the ayanas, so too the two intersections of the ecliptic and the Moon's orbital circle have been given the names Rahu and Ketu.
  The purport is: where the Moon's orbital path cuts the Earth's orbital path at two places — one of those points is called Rahu and the other Ketu.
  The sāyana Meṣādi sampāta is that place from which the Sun appears to move north of the equator; likewise Rahu is that intersection of the Moon's path and the Earth's path on the ecliptic from which the Moon begins to go north of the ecliptic, i.e. the Moon's latitude (शर) begins to be northward. Conversely, the place from which the Sun begins to go south of the equator is the Sun's sāyana Tulādi sampāta; and likewise the point on the ecliptic from which the Moon begins to have southern latitude is the Ketu sampāta.
  Thus you will have understood the matter of Rahu-Ketu. That is why Rahu-Ketu are held to be chāyā-graha (shadow planets)."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Rahu = ascending node (Moon begins northern latitude); Ketu = descending node
  (Moon begins southern latitude). They are intersection points, not bodies — hence "shadow planets".

Weight/authority: normal
laghu_parashari.combination:
—

Exceptions / caveats: —
