laghu_parashari.description: the chakra, transcribed in full
laghu_parashari.effect:
These are the four classical positions on Rahu/Ketu dignity. They conflict
  (Rahu exalted in Vrishabha per Pārāśarī and Sarvārtha Chintāmaṇi, but in Mithuna per
  Jātakābharaṇa; Rahu's own sign is Kanyā per Pārāśarī/Jātakābharaṇa but Kumbha per Jaimini;
  Ketu's own sign is Meena per Pārāśarī/Jātakābharaṇa but Vrishchik per Jaimini). Because of
  this conflict the author rules (LP-060-2) that none of these lordships should be used —
  only the śloka-13 bhāva/bhāveśa method.

Weight/authority: अनमोल ज्ञान as a reference chakra — but operationally rejected by the author
laghu_parashari.combination:
Sign occupied by Rahu/Ketu (only if one chooses to use one of these systems).

Exceptions / caveats: LP-060-2 supersedes: do not accept nodal sign-lordship at all.

laghu_parashari.description: what Rahu and Ketu actually are; retrograde motion; the 180° rule
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"अतः स्पष्ट है कि वास्तव में राहु और केतु जिस स्थान से सूर्य पृथ्वी तथा चन्द्रमा के कक्षावृत्तों से उत्तर की ओर चलता है उस बिन्दु को राहु तथा जिस सम्पात स्थान से चन्द्रमा क्रान्तिवृत्त से दक्षिण की ओर गमन करता है, उस बिन्दु को केतु माना गया है। राहु-केतु ठोस ग्रह न होकर गगन में चन्द्र के गमन को भली-भांति समझने केलिए दो निर्धारित बिन्दु हैं जिन्हें राहु और केतु कहते हैं।
  राहु का महत्त्व है क्योंकि इसका ही गणित किया जाता है। केतु का गणित नहीं किया जाता है। राहु से 180अंश पर सदैव केतु होता है। यदि मेष राशि में राहु है तो केतु तुला राशि पर होगा। इनकी गति सदैव विलोम रहती है अर्थात् वक्री रहते हैं।"

Translation: "So it is clear that in reality, the point from which [the Moon] moves north of the orbital circles of the Sun/Earth is taken as Rahu, and the intersection point from which the Moon travels south of the ecliptic is taken as Ketu. Rahu-Ketu are not solid planets; they are two determined points in the sky, fixed in order to understand the Moon's motion properly, which are called Rahu and Ketu.
  Rahu is the significant one, because it is Rahu alone that is computed. Ketu is not computed. Ketu is always at 180 degrees from Rahu. If Rahu is in Mesh, Ketu will be in Tula. Their motion is always reversed — that is, they are always retrograde (वक्री)."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Compute Rahu; derive Ketu at exactly Rahu + 180° (7th sign). Both nodes are
  always retrograde (vakrī) — their motion is always विलोम.

Weight/authority: normal — but numerically load-bearing (180 अंश exactly)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Rahu's longitude.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: why they are called तम / छाया graha; and they have no sign of their own
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"राहु-केतु स्थानों पर(सम्पात पर) जब चन्द्रमा आता है तब पृथ्वी पर तम अर्थात् ग्रहण की स्थिति रहती है। इसी दृष्टि से राहु तथा केतु को तम या छाया ग्रह माना जाता है, वास्तव में वे अन्य ग्रहों के सदृश ठोस ग्रह नहीं हैं।
  इन छाया ग्रहों की स्वयं की कोई राशि नहीं है। क्रांतिवृत्त की (पृथ्वी की परिक्रमा मार्ग की) जिस मार्ग पर छाया पड़ती है उस [p.62] समय की वही उनकी राशि होती है।"

Translation: "When the Moon arrives at the Rahu-Ketu points (at the sampāta), then there is tama, i.e. an eclipse condition, upon the Earth. It is from this viewpoint that Rahu and Ketu are held to be tama or chāyā (shadow) planets; in reality they are not solid planets like the others.
  These shadow planets have no sign of their own. Whatever path of the ecliptic (the Earth's orbital path) the shadow falls upon at a given time — that itself is their sign at that time."
laghu_parashari.effect:
The nodes have no permanent rāśi. Their operative "sign" is simply whichever sign
  they currently occupy. This is the doctrinal ground for LP-062-1.

Weight/authority: प्रबल (this is the principle that replaces sign-lordship)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Sign occupied by the nodes at the moment in question.

Exceptions / caveats: —

---

laghu_parashari.description: THE OPERATIVE RAHU/KETU RESULT LIST (house by house)
laghu_parashari.effect:
1. A node becomes the lord of the house it occupies (उस समय वे उस भाव के अधिपति होते हैं) —
     this is the substitute for the lordship it lacks.
  2. If conjoined: result follows the conjoined planet's qualities.
  3. If un-conjoined (अकेला): result follows the house and its lord, per this list —
     | Rahu alone in | Verdict |
     |---|---|
     | trikona (1/5/9) | शुभ — auspicious |
     | 8th | शुभ — auspicious (as an 8th lord in the 8th is reckoned good) |
     | kendra | सम[य] — neutral |
     | 2nd or 7th | मारकेश — a killer |
     | 12th | सम but व्ययकारक — neutral yet causing expenditure |
     | त्रिषडाय (3/6/11) | पापी — malefic |
  4. Intrinsic natures: Rahu = krūra/aśubha; Ketu = sama or śubha.

Weight/authority: प्रबल — this is the ready-reckoner the author leaves the reader with
laghu_parashari.combination:
House occupied by Rahu (and by Ketu); whether any planet is conjoined;
  the lord of the occupied house.

Exceptions / caveats: The 3/6/11 = पापी verdict here should be read alongside LP-058-3, where the
  author records that scholars find Rahu/Ketu in 3/6/11 increase those houses' results
  (parākrama, enemy-destruction, wealth-gain) — i.e. malefic *nature* in upachaya houses
  yields good *outcomes*. Recorded as a tension, not resolved on the page.

laghu_parashari.description: the nodal yogakāraka rule restated: yuti only, not दृष्टि
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"राहु-केतु केन्द्र में होकर त्रिकोणेश से सम्बन्ध करते हैं तब योगकारक होते हैं। यहां दृष्टि नहीं युति सम्बन्ध को मानना चाहिए।"

Translation: "When Rahu-Ketu, being in a kendra, form a relation with the trikoṇeśa, then they become yogakāraka. Here one should accept the yuti (conjunction) relation, not dṛṣṭi (aspect)."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Nodal Rajayoga = node in a kendra + conjoined with the lord of a trikona.
  Aspect does not qualify — only conjunction.

Weight/authority: प्रबल
laghu_parashari.combination:
House occupied by node (must be 1/4/7/10); trikona lords (1st, 5th, 9th lords)
  and whether one of them shares that house.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: the certain-mārakeśa combination for the nodes
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"यह जान लें कि यदि सप्तमस्थ या द्वितीयस्थ राहु-केतु के साथ सौम्य ग्रह द्वितीयेश या सप्तमेश हो तो राहु-केतु निश्चय ही मारकेश होते हैं।"

Translation: "Know this: if, along with a Rahu-Ketu placed in the 7th or in the 2nd, there is a saumya (benefic) planet who is the 2nd lord or the 7th lord, then Rahu-Ketu are certainly (निश्चय ही) mārakeśa."
laghu_parashari.effect:
IF node is in the 2nd or the 7th house, AND a benefic (saumya) planet that owns the
  2nd or the 7th is conjoined with it, THEN that node is definitively a mārakeśa.

Weight/authority: प्रबल — "निश्चय ही"
laghu_parashari.combination:
House of Rahu/Ketu (2nd or 7th); identity and benefic status of the 2nd and
  7th lords; whether such a lord is conjoined with the node.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: chapter colophon
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"इस अध्याय के 12 श्लोकों में आपने फलित के मुख्य पाराशरी सिद्धान्तों को समझा है। अब अगले द्वितीय अध्याय में अन्य श्लोकों के अन्तर्गत फलित का अनमोल ज्ञान प्राप्त करेंगे।
  इत्युडुदायप्रदीप संज्ञाध्यायः प्रथमः॥1॥"

Translation: "In the 12 ślokas of this chapter you have understood the principal Parashari
  principles of phalita. Now, in the next, second chapter, you will obtain priceless knowledge of
  phalita within the other ślokas.
  Thus [ends] the first chapter, the Saṁjñādhyāya, of the Uḍudāyapradīpa. ॥1॥"
laghu_parashari.effect:
Chapter 1 (संज्ञाध्यायः / Uḍudāyapradīpa) closes here.

Weight/authority: normal
laghu_parashari.combination:
Exceptions / caveats: —

---

laghu_parashari.description: श्लोक 14: शुभ फलदायी योग
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
शुभ फलदायी योग
केन्द्रत्रिकोणपतयः संबंधेन परस्परम्॥
इतरैरप्रशक्ताश्चेद्विशेषफलदायकाः ॥14॥

  अनुवाद—केन्द्रेश और त्रिकोणेश में परस्पर सम्बन्ध हो और अन्य भावेशों(केन्द्र–त्रिकोण से भिन्न
  भावों के स्वामी)से सम्बन्ध न हो तो अत्यन्त शुभफलदायी होते हैं॥चौदह॥

Translation: The lords of the kendras and the trikoṇas, when they are in mutual sambandha,
  and are not attached to others (i.e. to the lords of houses other than kendras and trikoṇas),
  are givers of exceptional (viśeṣa) fruit. ॥14॥
laghu_parashari.effect:
IF planet A lords a kendra (1,4,7,10) AND planet B lords a trikoṇa (1,5,9)
  AND A and B are in sambandha with each other
  AND neither A nor B is in sambandha with any lord of 2,3,6,8,11,12
  AND (author's added filter) neither A's nor B's *other* sign is a non-kendra/trikoṇa house
  THEN the pair is अत्यन्त शुभफलदायी — the strongest grade of yogakāraka fruit.

Weight/authority: मूल श्लोक — foundational.
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; lordship map of all 12 houses; both signs of every participant;
  the sambandha graph of the chart (all four tests below).

Exceptions / caveats: Attachment to a triṣaḍāyeśa or aṣṭameśa degrades it — but see LP-065-3, where the
  author insists the degradation is partial (ह्रास), not total.

laghu_parashari.description: सम्बन्ध is of exactly four kinds
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
सम्बन्ध चार प्रकार के होते हैं—

Translation: Sambandha is of four kinds.
laghu_parashari.effect:
The complete enumeration is closed at four: (1) क्षेत्र सम्बन्ध, (2) दृष्टि सम्बन्ध,
  (3) युति सम्बन्ध, (4) क्षेत्र-दृष्टि सम्बन्ध. No fifth type is admitted anywhere on pp.63–76.

Weight/authority: विशेष — the pivot of the book.
laghu_parashari.combination:
none (definitional).

Exceptions / caveats: No relative strength ordering among the four is stated on these pages.
  [gap in source — the book gives an ordering over the HOUSE in which the sambandha forms
  (LP-066-1), not over the TYPE of sambandha. Do not invent one.]

laghu_parashari.description: सम्बन्ध type 1: क्षेत्र सम्बन्ध (mutual sign-exchange)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
1. क्षेत्र सम्बन्ध—इसे अन्योन्य राशि स्थित सम्बन्ध भी कहते हैं। जब दो
  ग्रहों की स्थिति इस प्रकार से हो कि एक की राशि में दूसरा हो तथा दूसरे की राशि में पहला हो तो
  उसे क्षेत्र सम्बन्ध कहते हैं। जैसे मेष या वृश्चिक राशि का सूर्य हो और मंगल सिंह राशि का हो, तो
  सूर्य-मंगल का परस्पर क्षेत्र सम्बन्ध कहेंगे…

Translation: *Kṣetra sambandha*, also called anyonya-rāśi-sthita sambandha (mutual-sign
  relation). When two planets are so placed that the second is in the sign of the first and the
  first is in the sign of the second, that is kṣetra sambandha. E.g. Sun in Aries or Scorpio and
  Mars in Leo → Sun and Mars have mutual kṣetra sambandha.
laghu_parashari.effect:
*Kṣetra sambandha*, also called anyonya-rāśi-sthita sambandha (mutual-sign
  relation). When two planets are so placed that the second is in the sign of the first and the
  first is in the sign of the second, that is kṣetra sambandha. E.g. Sun in Aries or Scorpio and
  Mars in Leo → Sun and Mars have mutual kṣetra sambandha.

Weight/authority: normal (definitional), but highest practical importance.
laghu_parashari.combination:
rāśi of each planet; the sign-lordship table.

Exceptions / caveats: none stated. Sun and Moon rule one sign each, so for them only one leg is
  possible per sign.

---

laghu_parashari.description: क्षेत्र सम्बन्ध, worked kuṇḍalī
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
अधोलिखित कुण्डली में देखें कि सूर्य मंगल की राशि में है और मंगल सूर्य की राशि
  में हैं। इसी को क्षेत्र सम्बन्ध कहते हैं।
laghu_parashari.effect:
Confirms LP-063-3 by demonstration: A in B's sign and B in A's sign, simultaneously.

Weight/authority: normal (illustration).
laghu_parashari.combination: planet signs.

laghu_parashari.description: सम्बन्ध type 2: दृष्टि सम्बन्ध (mutual full aspect)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
2. दृष्टि सम्बन्ध—जब दो ग्रह परस्पर एक दूसरे को पूर्ण दृष्टि से देखते हैं
  तो उनमें दृष्टि सम्बन्ध माना जाता है। जैसे मेष राशि में मंगल हो और तुला राशि में सूर्य हो तो मंगल
  एवं सूर्य में परस्पर दृष्टि सम्बन्ध कहेंगे।

Translation: *Dṛṣṭi sambandha*: when two planets see each other mutually with FULL aspect,
  a dṛṣṭi sambandha is held to exist. E.g. Mars in Aries and Sun in Libra → mutual dṛṣṭi sambandha.
laghu_parashari.effect:
*Dṛṣṭi sambandha*: when two planets see each other mutually with FULL aspect,
  a dṛṣṭi sambandha is held to exist. E.g. Mars in Aries and Sun in Libra → mutual dṛṣṭi sambandha.

Weight/authority: normal (definitional).
laghu_parashari.combination:
rāśi of each planet; the pūrṇa-dṛṣṭi table.

Exceptions / caveats: See LP-067-1 — the author himself later appears to accept a one-way aspect
  as sufficient. Flagged there.

laghu_parashari.description: सम्बन्ध type 3: युति सम्बन्ध (conjunction)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
3. युति सम्बन्ध—जब दो ग्रह एक राशि में युति करें तो उसे युति सम्बन्ध कहते
  हैं। कोई से दो ग्रह परस्पर एक राशि में एक साथ बैठें तो युति सम्बन्ध होता है। जैसे सूर्य-मंगल वृष
  राशि में एक साथ बैठें हों तो कहेंगे कि इनमें परस्पर युति सम्बन्ध है। मान लो कि तुला राशि में बुध
  और शुक्र एक साथ बैठे हैं तो उनमें भी परस्पर युति संबंध होगा। कहने का तात्पर्य यही है कि कोई से
  दो ग्रह एक साथ बैठें तो युति सम्बन्ध होता है।

Translation: *Yuti sambandha*: when two planets are conjoined in one sign. Any two planets
  seated together in one sign have yuti sambandha. E.g. Sun and Mars together in Taurus; or Mercury
  and Venus together in Libra.
laghu_parashari.effect:
*Yuti sambandha*: when two planets are conjoined in one sign. Any two planets
  seated together in one sign have yuti sambandha. E.g. Sun and Mars together in Taurus; or Mercury
  and Venus together in Libra.

Weight/authority: normal (definitional).
laghu_parashari.combination:
rāśi of each planet only.

Exceptions / caveats: none stated.

---

laghu_parashari.description: युति सम्बन्ध, worked kuṇḍalī
laghu_parashari.effect:
Demonstrates both of the p.64 examples in one chart: a conjunction in a sign owned by
  neither participant (Su+Ma in Taurus) is as much a yuti sambandha as one in a sign owned by a
  participant (Me+Ve in Libra).

Weight/authority: normal (illustration).

laghu_parashari.description: सम्बन्ध type 4: क्षेत्र दृष्टि सम्बन्ध (dispositor aspects his tenant)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
4. क्षेत्र दृष्टि सम्बन्ध—जब किसी ग्रह को उसी राशि का स्वामी ग्रह पूर्ण
  दृष्टि से देखता हो तो इसे क्षेत्र दृष्टि सम्बन्ध कहेंगे। जैसे मेष राशि में स्थित सूर्य को मंगल
  मेष राशि का स्वामी मंगल अर्थात् क्षेत्रज्ञ पूर्ण दृष्टि से देखे तो कहेंगे कि परस्पर
  क्षेत्रदृष्टि संबंध है।

Translation: *Kṣetra-dṛṣṭi sambandha*: when the lord of the very sign a planet occupies
  aspects that planet with full aspect. E.g. Sun placed in Aries, and Mars — the lord of Aries,
  i.e. the kṣetrajña (field-knower / dispositor) — aspects him with full aspect: that is
  kṣetra-dṛṣṭi sambandha.
laghu_parashari.effect:
*Kṣetra-dṛṣṭi sambandha*: when the lord of the very sign a planet occupies
  aspects that planet with full aspect. E.g. Sun placed in Aries, and Mars — the lord of Aries,
  i.e. the kṣetrajña (field-knower / dispositor) — aspects him with full aspect: that is
  kṣetra-dṛṣṭi sambandha.

Weight/authority: normal (definitional).
laghu_parashari.combination:
rāśi of each planet; sign-lordship table; pūrṇa-dṛṣṭi table.

Exceptions / caveats: none stated. This is a mixed/hybrid type — one leg of kṣetra (occupancy of
  the other's sign) plus one leg of dṛṣṭi — which is why it is named क्षेत्र-दृष्टि.

laghu_parashari.description: [AUTHOR'S OWN] Contamination diminishes, it does not abolish
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
यह तो स्पष्ट है कि केन्द्रेश और त्रिकोणेश परस्पर सम्बन्धी हों तो अत्यन्त
  शुभफलदायी होते हैं लेकिन ऐसा तभी होता है जब वे त्रिषडायेश या अष्टमेश से सम्बन्ध न रखते हों।
  लेकिन हमारा अनुभव है कि सम्पूर्ण शुभफल समाप्त नहीं होता है, अपितु शुभफल में ह्रास होता है।
  हमारे विचार से निम्न प्रकार फल समझना चाहिए—

Translation: It is clear that a kendreśa and a trikoṇeśa in mutual sambandha are extremely
  auspicious, but only when they hold no sambandha with a triṣaḍāyeśa (3/6/11 lord) or the
  aṣṭameśa (8th lord). But our experience is that the entire auspicious fruit is not destroyed;
  rather there is a DIMINUTION (ह्रास) of the auspicious fruit. In our view the fruit should be
  understood as follows —
laghu_parashari.effect:
Contamination of a kendreśa–trikoṇeśa sambandha by a triṣaḍāyeśa or aṣṭameśa
  reduces the quantum of śubha-phala; it never cancels the yoga. Grade the residue by
  LP-066-1.

Weight/authority: [AUTHOR'S OWN] — "हमारा अनुभव है", "हमारे विचार से". Departs from the plain
  reading of śloka 14.
laghu_parashari.combination:
the sambandha graph including 3/6/11/8 lords.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: [AUTHOR'S OWN] THE FOUR-GRADE LADDER: where the sambandha forms
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
— केन्द्रेश और त्रिकोणेश का सम्बन्ध केन्द्र या त्रिकोण में ही बने तो सर्वोत्तम फलदायी होगा।
— केन्द्रेश और त्रिकोणेश का सम्बन्ध 1, 2, 12वें स्थान में बने तो फल उत्तम होगा।
— केन्द्रेश और त्रिकोणेश का सम्बन्ध शुभ त्रिषडाय(3, 6, 11वें) से बने तो मध्यम फलदायी होगा।
— केन्द्रेश और त्रिकोणेश का सम्बन्ध अशुभ त्रिषडाय और अष्टम स्थान से बने तो निकृष्ट फलदायी
  होगा।

Translation: - sambandha formed in a kendra or a trikoṇa → सर्वोत्तम (best of all)
  - formed in the 1st, 2nd or 12th → उत्तम (excellent)
  - formed through/with the śubha triṣaḍāya (3rd, 6th, 11th) → मध्यम (middling)
  - formed through the aśubha triṣaḍāya and the 8th → निकृष्ट (worst)
laghu_parashari.effect:
- sambandha formed in a kendra or a trikoṇa → सर्वोत्तम (best of all)
  - formed in the 1st, 2nd or 12th → उत्तम (excellent)
  - formed through/with the śubha triṣaḍāya (3rd, 6th, 11th) → मध्यम (middling)
  - formed through the aśubha triṣaḍāya and the 8th → निकृष्ट (worst)

Weight/authority: [AUTHOR'S OWN] — "हमारे विचार से". This is the ladder to use in practice.
laghu_parashari.combination: the house in which the two lords meet / exchange / aspect.

laghu_parashari.description: [AUTHOR'S OWN] Against Parāśara: the sambandha works ANYWHERE
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
पाराशर मुनि ने यह सम्बन्ध केन्द्र या त्रिकोण भाव में ही सर्वोत्तम बताया है।
  लेकिन व्यवहार में केन्द्रेश व त्रिकोणेश का सम्बन्ध कुंडली में कहीं भी हो, शुभफलदायी देखा गया है।
  स्वर्गीय इन्दिरा गांधी एवं स्वर्गीय पं. जवाहर लाल नेहरू की कुंडलियां इस बात का प्रत्यक्ष प्रमाण हैं।

Translation: Sage Parāśara declared this sambandha *sarvottama* only when it forms in a kendra
  or trikoṇa. But in practice, wherever in the chart the kendreśa–trikoṇeśa sambandha occurs, it
  has been observed to be auspicious. The charts of the late Indira Gandhi and the late Pt.
  Jawaharlal Nehru are direct proof of this.
laghu_parashari.effect:
Do not reject a kendreśa–trikoṇeśa sambandha because it forms outside kendra/trikoṇa.
  Detect it anywhere; then grade it by LP-066-1.

Weight/authority: [AUTHOR'S OWN] — explicit disagreement with Parāśara, backed by two worked charts.
laghu_parashari.combination: full sambandha graph.

laghu_parashari.description: Birth data of the two proof-charts
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
इन्दिरा गांधी का जन्म 19 नवम्बर 1917 रात्रि 11 बजकर 11 मिनट पर इलाहाबाद
  में हुआ था। पं. जवाहर लाल नेहरू का जन्म 14 नवम्बर 1889 रात्रि 11 बजकर 3 मिनट पर इलाहाबाद
  में हुआ था।

laghu_parashari.description: Conclusion drawn from both proof-charts
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
अतः स्पष्ट है कि केन्द्रेश व त्रिकोणेश का सम्बन्ध कुंडली में कहीं भी हो,
  शुभफलदायी होता है। दोष युक्त केन्द्र-त्रिकोणों के स्वामी ग्रहों का निर्णय कैसे हो, इसकी चर्चा
  अगले श्लोक में की गई है।

Translation: Hence it is clear that wherever in the chart the kendreśa–trikoṇeśa sambandha
  occurs, it gives auspicious results. How to judge kendra/trikoṇa lords that are themselves
  blemished is discussed in the next śloka.
laghu_parashari.effect:
Detection of a kendreśa–trikoṇeśa sambandha is house-independent; only its *grade*
  (LP-066-1) is house-dependent.

Weight/authority: [AUTHOR'S OWN] — restated as a settled conclusion.
laghu_parashari.combination: sambandha graph; lordship map.

laghu_parashari.description: श्लोक 15: दोष-युक्त केन्द्रेश-त्रिकोणेश का फल विचार
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
दोष-युक्त केन्द्रेश-त्रिकोणेश का फल विचार
केन्द्रत्रिकोणनेतारौ दोषयुक्तावपि स्वयम्॥
सम्बन्धमात्राद्बलिनौ भवेतां योगकारको॥15॥

  अनुवाद—केन्द्र और त्रिकोण के स्वामी ग्रह एवं स्वदोष युक्त हों तो भी मात्र सम्बन्ध से बली और
  योगकारक होते हैं। कहने का तात्पर्य यह है कि बली त्रिकोण और केन्द्र के स्वामी स्वयं दोष युक्त
  होने पर भी यदि वे परस्पर सम्बन्ध करते हों तो वे दोनों योगकारक होते हैं॥पन्द्रह॥

Translation: The leaders (lords) of the kendra and the trikoṇa, even though themselves
  possessed of blemish, become strong and yogakāraka BY THE MERE FACT OF THE SAMBANDHA
  (सम्बन्धमात्रात्). ॥15॥
laghu_parashari.effect:
IF A is a kendreśa and B is a trikoṇeśa (paradigmatically B = 9th lord, A = 10th lord)
  AND either or both carry doṣa
  AND A and B are in sambandha (any of the four types)
  THEN both become balī and yogakāraka anyway — the sambandha *by itself* is sufficient;
  no further remedy or cancellation is needed.

Weight/authority: मूल श्लोक + विशेष. This is the licence that keeps most real charts from being
  written off.
laghu_parashari.combination:
house lordships; doṣa status of each (see LP-067-3); sambandha graph.

Exceptions / caveats: none stated. This directly overrides the "blemish kills the yoga" intuition.

laghu_parashari.description: Operational definition of दोष युक्त (blemished)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
केन्द्रेश व त्रिकोणेश में से कोई एक या दोनों शत्रु राशि या अस्त या नीच राशि में
  हो तो दोष युक्त जानना चाहिए। ऐसा होने पर परस्पर सम्बन्ध मात्र से ही बली और शुभ फलदायी हो जाते हैं।

Translation: If either one, or both, of the kendreśa and trikoṇeśa is in an enemy's sign, or
  combust (asta), or in its sign of debilitation (nīca), it should be known as *doṣa-yukta*.
  When this is so, they become strong and auspicious merely by their mutual sambandha.
laghu_parashari.effect:
If either one, or both, of the kendreśa and trikoṇeśa is in an enemy's sign, or
  combust (asta), or in its sign of debilitation (nīca), it should be known as *doṣa-yukta*.
  When this is so, they become strong and auspicious merely by their mutual sambandha.

Weight/authority: विशेष — this is the definition list the whole doṣa discussion depends on.
laghu_parashari.combination:
planet sign; natural friendship table; combustion status (degree from Sun);
  exaltation/debilitation table; house lordships.

laghu_parashari.description: Pt. Rāmayatta Ojhā's qualification (attribution)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
If the trikoṇeśa and kendreśa are themselves lords of duḥsthānas, or if any other
  planet that lords a duḥsthāna joins their yoga in sambandha, then to some degree there will be
  a shortfall in the auspicious fruit, or actually inauspicious fruit.
laghu_parashari.effect:
A third-party duḥsthāna lord entering the yoga (or the participants' own duḥsthāna
  lordship) partially degrades the yoga — restating LP-065-3 with an outside authority, but
  going one step further: "या अशुभफल होगा" admits the result may turn actually inauspicious.

Weight/authority: cited authority — the author uses it to introduce his numeric scale (LP-068-2).
laghu_parashari.combination: lordships of all planets in the yoga.

laghu_parashari.description: Ojhā's rule completed
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
त्रिकोणेश और केन्द्रेश यदि स्वयं दुःस्थानों के स्वामी हों या इनके योग में अन्य कोई
  ग्रह दुःस्थान का स्वामी होकर सम्बन्ध करेगा तो कुछ अंशो में शुभफलों में न्यूनता होगी या अशुभफल
  होगा। इसके लिए मान निर्धारित करे—

Translation: …there will, to some extent, be a shortfall in the auspicious fruits, or
  inauspicious fruit. For this, assign VALUES (मान) as follows —
laghu_parashari.effect:
The remedy for the vagueness of "कुछ अंशों में" is a numeric scale. This sentence
  is the bridge into LP-068-2.

Weight/authority: normal (linking).

laghu_parashari.description: ★ THE SIGNED VALUE SCALE FOR EVERY LORDSHIP ★
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
Kendra houses: lagneśa +1, caturtheśa +2, saptameśa +3, daśameśa +4.
  Trikoṇa houses: pañcameśa +2, navameśa +4. Triṣaḍāya houses: tṛtīyeśa −1, ṣaṣṭheśa −2,
  ekādaśeśa −3. Mṛtyu-sthāna: aṣṭameśa −6. Māraka houses: dvitīyeśa −0, dvādaśeśa −0.
laghu_parashari.effect:
Kendra houses: lagneśa +1, caturtheśa +2, saptameśa +3, daśameśa +4.
  Trikoṇa houses: pañcameśa +2, navameśa +4. Triṣaḍāya houses: tṛtīyeśa −1, ṣaṣṭheśa −2,
  ekādaśeśa −3. Mṛtyu-sthāna: aṣṭameśa −6. Māraka houses: dvitīyeśa −0, dvādaśeśa −0.

Weight/authority: [AUTHOR'S OWN] — this scale is not in the mūla ślokas; it is the author's
  quantification of Ojhā's "कुछ अंशों में". Highest reusability of anything on these pages.
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign only (to derive lordships) + the identity of the planets in the
  yoga. Nothing else — no degrees, no strength, no aspects.

laghu_parashari.description: → LP-069-1 — Worked arithmetic: Karka lagna, Budha + Maṅgala–Guru yoga
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
मान लो कि कर्क लग्न की कुण्डली है और बुध एवं मंगल-गुरु का योग है तो इसका
  विश्लेषण इस प्रकार होगा—

  | ग्रह व स्वामित्व | मान |
  |---|---|
  | बुध तृतीयेश | −1 |
  | बुध द्वादशेश | −0 |
  | मंगल पंचमेश | +2 |
  | मंगल दशमेश | +4 |
  | गुरु षष्ठेश | −2 |
  | गुरु नवमेश | +4 |

  *[p.69]* यहां योग करा तो शुभफल 10 और अशुभ फल 3 आया अर्थात् शुभफल 7 रहा। इस प्रकार आप कह सकते
  हैं कि इस योग में शुभफल ही प्राप्त होगा।
  इस विश्लेषण से आप किसी भी योग का निश्चित शुभाशुभ फल ज्ञात कर सकते हैं।

Translation: Suppose it is a Cancer-lagna chart and there is a yoga of Mercury with
  Mars–Jupiter. The analysis runs: Mercury (3rd lord) −1; Mercury (12th lord) −0; Mars (5th lord)
  +2; Mars (10th lord) +4; Jupiter (6th lord) −2; Jupiter (9th lord) +4. Summing: auspicious 10
  and inauspicious 3, i.e. a net auspicious 7. Therefore you can say this yoga will yield only
  auspicious fruit. *By this analysis you can determine the definite auspicious/inauspicious
  result of ANY yoga.*
laghu_parashari.effect:
Sum positives and negatives separately, then subtract; report the net and its
  sign. A positive net ⇒ the yoga delivers śubha-phala outright.

Weight/authority: [AUTHOR'S OWN] — "इस विश्लेषण से आप किसी भी योग का निश्चित शुभाशुभ फल ज्ञात कर
  सकते हैं" — the author's own claim of universality.
laghu_parashari.combination: lagna sign; the set of planets in the yoga.

laghu_parashari.description: श्लोक 16: प्रबल राजयोग कारक विचार
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
प्रबल राजयोग कारक विचार
निवसेतां व्यत्ययेन तावुभौ धर्मकर्मणोः॥
एकत्रान्यतरो वापि वसेच्चेद्योगकारकौ॥16॥

  अनुवाद—धर्म(त्रिकोण) और कर्म(केन्द्र) भावों के अधिपति परस्पर अपने भावों में हों, एकत्र हों या
  दोनों में से एक दूसरे के भाव में हों, तो वे योगकारक होते हैं। कहने का तात्पर्य यह है कि केन्द्रेश
  त्रिकोण में हो और त्रिकोणेश केन्द्र में हों, केन्द्रेश-त्रिकोणेश दोनों केन्द्र में हों या त्रिकोण
  में हो या केवल केन्द्रेश त्रिकोण में हो या त्रिकोणेश केन्द्र में हो तो ये तीनों सम्बन्ध राजयोग
  कारक हो जाते हैं और उत्तरोत्तर अल्पबली होते हैं॥सोलह॥

Translation: If the lords of the *dharma* (trikoṇa) and *karma* (kendra) houses dwell
  in each other's houses by exchange (व्यत्ययेन), or together in one place (एकत्र), or
  if even one of the two dwells in the other's house, they are yogakāraka. ॥16॥
  Meaning: kendreśa in a trikoṇa and trikoṇeśa in a kendra; or both together in a kendra or both
  together in a trikoṇa; or only the kendreśa in a trikoṇa, or only the trikoṇeśa in a kendra —
  these three relations all become rājayoga-kāraka, and they are SUCCESSIVELY WEAKER
  (उत्तरोत्तर अल्पबली).
laghu_parashari.effect:
If the lords of the *dharma* (trikoṇa) and *karma* (kendra) houses dwell
  in each other's houses by exchange (व्यत्ययेन), or together in one place (एकत्र), or
  if even one of the two dwells in the other's house, they are yogakāraka. ॥16॥
  Meaning: kendreśa in a trikoṇa and trikoṇeśa in a kendra; or both together in a kendra or both
  together in a trikoṇa; or only the kendreśa in a trikoṇa, or only the trikoṇeśa in a kendra —
  these three relations all become rājayoga-kāraka, and they are SUCCESSIVELY WEAKER
  (उत्तरोत्तर अल्पबली).

Weight/authority: मूल श्लोक — प्रबल (strong).
laghu_parashari.combination:
lagna sign; house occupied by the 9th lord and by the 10th lord (or, generally,
  by any trikoṇeśa and any kendreśa).

Exceptions / caveats: none stated.

laghu_parashari.description: Why 9 and 10: the strength ranking inside each set
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
केन्द्रों में दशम सर्वाधिक बली और त्रिकोणों में नवम सर्वाधिक बली है, इसीलिए
  पाराशर ने कर्म और धर्म भाव की महत्ता वर्णित की है।

Translation: Among the kendras the 10th is the strongest, and among the trikoṇas the 9th is
  the strongest — that is why Parāśara described the importance of the karma and dharma houses.
laghu_parashari.effect:
Rank kendras 10 > 7 > 4 > 1 and trikoṇas 9 > 5 > 1 when choosing which
  kendreśa/trikoṇeśa to build a yoga judgement on.

Weight/authority: विशेष — this is the stated RATIONALE behind Ch.1's ladders.
laghu_parashari.combination: lagna sign.

laghu_parashari.description: → LP-070-1 — The three प्रबल configurations, enumerated as a checklist
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
मूलतः इस श्लोक में 9 और 10 भाव को शुभफलदायी बताते हुए कहते हैं कि—
– नवमेश 10वें हो दशमेश 9वें हो तो यह अन्योन्याश्रित योग है।
– दोनों नवमेश-दशमेश नवम या दशम में युति करें।
*[p.70]* – नवमेश दशम में हो या दशमेश नवम में हो।
इन तीन प्रकार के योगों में से योग हों तो वह शुभफलदायी और बली होते हैं।
ये योग एक प्रकार से राजयोग कारक हैं।

Translation: 1. 9th lord in the 10th AND 10th lord in the 9th → this is an अन्योन्याश्रित (mutually-dependent
     / exchange) yoga.
  2. Both the 9th and 10th lords conjoin, in the 9th or in the 10th.
  3. The 9th lord in the 10th, OR the 10th lord in the 9th (one leg only).

  If any of these three kinds of yoga occurs, it is auspicious and strong. These yogas are, in a
  manner of speaking, rājayoga-kāraka.
laghu_parashari.effect:
A directly runnable three-line test on the 9th and 10th lords. Tier 1 = full exchange
  (अन्योन्याश्रित); Tier 2 = conjunction in either of the two houses; Tier 3 = single one-way
  placement. Descending strength per LP-069-2.

Weight/authority: प्रबल — the author's own explicit label.
laghu_parashari.combination: lagna sign; house of the 9th lord; house of the 10th lord.

laghu_parashari.description: Svarāśi placement of navameśa/daśameśa is itself a rājayoga
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
नवमेश या दशमेश स्वराशि में हों तो भी राजयोग है।

Translation: If the 9th lord or the 10th lord is in its own sign, that too is a rājayoga.
laghu_parashari.effect:
IF the 9th lord occupies one of its own signs, OR the 10th lord occupies one of its own
  signs, THEN a rājayoga exists — no sambandha with a second planet is required.

Weight/authority: विशेष — a standalone, single-planet rājayoga condition.
laghu_parashari.combination: lagna sign; sign occupied by 9th lord and by 10th lord.

laghu_parashari.description: श्लोक 17: सर्वोत्तम राजयोग कारक विचार
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
सर्वोत्तम राजयोग कारक विचार
त्रिकोणाधिपयोर्मध्ये सम्बन्धों येन केनचित्॥
केन्द्रनाथस्य बलिनः भवेत् यदि सुयोगकृत्॥17॥

  अनुवाद—त्रिकोणेशों में बलवान पंचमेश और नवमेश कहे गए हैं। इन दोनों में से किसी एक के साथ बलवान
  केन्द्रेश(दशमेश) का सम्बन्ध हो तो सर्वोत्तम राजयोग बनता है। स्पष्ट है कि नवमेश और पंचमेश के साथ
  बली केन्द्रेश का सम्बन्ध हो तो वह सम्बन्ध शुभफलदायी अर्थात् राजयोग कारक होता है॥सतरह॥

Translation: Among the trikoṇa lords, the 5th and 9th lords are declared the strong ones.
  If the strong kendra lord (the 10th lord) has a sambandha with either one of these two,
  a सर्वोत्तम (best of all) rājayoga is formed. ॥17॥
laghu_parashari.effect:
Among the trikoṇa lords, the 5th and 9th lords are declared the strong ones.
  If the strong kendra lord (the 10th lord) has a sambandha with either one of these two,
  a सर्वोत्तम (best of all) rājayoga is formed. ॥17॥

Weight/authority: सर्वोत्तम — the author's own top grade.
laghu_parashari.combination:
lagna sign; the 5th, 9th and 10th lords; their signs; the four sambandha tests;
  a strength (bala) assessment of each participant.

laghu_parashari.description: Recapitulation of ślokas 14–16
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
ग्रन्थकार ने राजयोगाध्याय राजयोग के सम्बन्ध में अब तक चार श्लोकों में यह कहा
  है— *[then verbatim repetition of the translations of ślokas 14, 15 and 16]*
  … पहले दो श्लोकों में ग्रन्थकार ने निर्दोष केन्द्र व त्रिकोणेश तथा सदोष नवमेश व दशमेश के
  सम्बन्ध की चर्चा की है।

Translation: The author has so far said this in four ślokas of the Rājayoga chapter … In the
  first two ślokas he discussed the sambandha of blemish-free kendra and trikoṇa lords (14) and
  of blemished navameśa and daśameśa (15).
laghu_parashari.effect:
The author has so far said this in four ślokas of the Rājayoga chapter … In the
  first two ślokas he discussed the sambandha of blemish-free kendra and trikoṇa lords (14) and
  of blemished navameśa and daśameśa (15).

Weight/authority: विशेष — the author's own reading of how the four ślokas partition the field.

laghu_parashari.description: Śloka 17 read as the residual clause: two further readings
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
इसके बाद ग्रन्थकार ने 17वें श्लोक में केन्द्रेश व त्रिकोणेश के शेष रहे हुए
  सम्बन्धों की चर्चा की है जिसका भावार्थ इस प्रकार है—
– कोई भी त्रिकोणेश हो वह सदोष हो या निर्दोष, उसका यदि बली केन्द्रेश से सम्बन्ध हो तो ऐसा
  सम्बन्ध शुभफलदायी होता है।
– इसका अन्य अर्थ यह भी हो सकता है कि किसी भी त्रिकोणेश से यदि दशमेश का सम्बन्ध हो तो ऐसा
  सम्बन्ध शुभफलदायी होगा।

Translation: In the 17th śloka the author discusses the remaining sambandhas of kendreśa
  and trikoṇeśa; the sense is:
  1. ANY trikoṇeśa — blemished or unblemished — in sambandha with a STRONG kendreśa gives
     auspicious results.
  2. Another possible sense: ANY trikoṇeśa in sambandha with the DAŚAMEŚA gives auspicious
     results.

laghu_parashari.description: → LP-072-1 — The TEN kendreśa–trikoṇeśa yoga pairs
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
शेष केन्द्रेशों से भी त्रिकोणेश की युति से योग बनते सकते हैं। ये योग इस प्रकार
  हो सकते हैं—
1. नवमेश व लग्नेश के योग
*[p.72]*
2. नवमेश व चतुर्थेश के योग
3. नवमेश व सप्तमेश के योग
4. पंचमेश व लग्नेश के योग
5. पंचमेश व चतुर्थेश के योग
6. पंचमेश व सप्तमेश के योग
7. पंचमेश व दशमेश के योग
8. लग्नेश व चतुर्थेश के योग
9. लग्नेश व सप्तमेश के योग
10. लग्नेश व दशमेश के योग
सभी योगों की क्रमानुसार चर्चा करेंगे जिससे आपको स्पष्टता आ सके और आप अचूक फलित कर सकें।

Translation: Yogas can also be formed by the union of a trikoṇeśa with the remaining
  kendra lords. These yogas can be: (1) navameśa + lagneśa, (2) navameśa + caturtheśa,
  (3) navameśa + saptameśa, (4) pañcameśa + lagneśa, (5) pañcameśa + caturtheśa,
  (6) pañcameśa + saptameśa, (7) pañcameśa + daśameśa, (8) lagneśa + caturtheśa,
  (9) lagneśa + saptameśa, (10) lagneśa + daśameśa.
  *We shall discuss all these yogas in order, so that clarity comes to you and you can pronounce
  results unfailingly (अचूक).*

laghu_parashari.description: Yoga-pair 1: नवमेश व लग्नेश — the planet pair for each of the 12 lagnas

1. नवमेश व लग्नेश के योग इस प्रकार बनेंगे, जैसे—मेष लग्न में गुरु-मंगल, वृष
  लग्न में शनि-शुक्र, मिथुन लग्न में शनि-बुध, कर्क लग्न में गुरु-चन्द्र, सिंह लग्न में मंगल-सूर्य,
  कन्या लग्न में शुक्र-बुध, तुला लग्न में शुक्र-बुध, वृश्चिक में चन्द्र-मंगल, धनु लग्न में

  देखें—पृष्ठ 73।

laghu_parashari.description: How to read every योग चक्रम् plate  [DECODING RULE — derived, flagged]
laghu_parashari.effect:
In each of the 12 North-Indian squares the printed numerals are rāśi numbers, not
  house numbers (verified: Meṣa lagna square has 1 in the top-centre diamond, Vṛṣa has 2,
  Mithuna has 3 … Mīna has 12). The two planetary abbreviations named in the plate title are
  then written as a pair, twice: once in the cell of the first house named in the title
  and once in the cell of the second house named in the title. So the plate diagrams the
  yoga formed by the two lords being conjoined — either in house A or in house B (i.e. one
  in the other's house plus one at home, or both together in either sign).
  Where the two lords are the same planet (e.g. Tulā on p.77), only one abbreviation is
  printed in each of the two cells.

Weight/authority: normal (editorial convention)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign only.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: / LP-85-1 — ★★ THE दशाद्वयी RULE (runs p.84 → p.85)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"According to the Pārāśara principle it is stated in this śloka that the fruit
  of the yoga (formed in the chart on account of whichever planets) is obtained as auspicious
  fruit in the daśādvayī — the 'pair of daśās' — of the yogakārakas, falling within the span
  between the daśā-antardaśās of the yogakāraka planets: namely, THE ANTARDAŚĀ OF ONE AND THE
  PRATYANTAR-DAŚĀ OF THE OTHER."
laghu_parashari.effect:
"According to the Pārāśara principle it is stated in this śloka that the fruit
  of the yoga (formed in the chart on account of whichever planets) is obtained as auspicious
  fruit in the daśādvayī — the 'pair of daśās' — of the yogakārakas, falling within the span
  between the daśā-antardaśās of the yogakāraka planets: namely, THE ANTARDAŚĀ OF ONE AND THE
  PRATYANTAR-DAŚĀ OF THE OTHER."

Weight/authority: ★★ highest.
laghu_parashari.combination:
the two yogakāraka planets; full Vimśottarī expansion to at least
  pratyantar level (MD → AD → PD); the whole span between the two yogakārakas' mahādaśās.

Exceptions / caveats: see LP-85-3 (a malefic MD obstructs) and LP-85-2 (a benefic MD assists).

laghu_parashari.description: Benefic intervening daśās deliver even without sambandha
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
कभी-कभी देखा गया है कि योग कारक ग्रहों के मध्य में पड़ने वाली शुभ ग्रहों की दशाओं में योग का फल
घटित हो जाता है। लेकिन यह लोक प्रचलित है कि जो जन अच्छे हैं वे निःस्वार्थ दूजों के हित के साधक होते
हैं तथा बुरे लोग बिना स्वार्थ के भी लोगों के हित में बाधक होते हैं। अतः योगकारक ग्रहों से सम्बन्धहीन
भी शुभग्रह निज दशा में योग का फल देने में सहायक होकर योगफल की प्राप्ति करा देते हैं।

Translation: "It has sometimes been observed that in the daśās of benefic planets falling in
  between the yogakāraka planets, the fruit of the yoga materialises. But it is a commonplace
  that good people are selflessly the *promoters* (साधक) of others' welfare, while bad people are
  *obstructers* (बाधक) of people's welfare even without self-interest. Therefore even a benefic
  planet wholly unconnected with the yogakārakas becomes, in its own daśā, an assistant in
  giving the yoga's fruit, and causes the yoga-fruit to be obtained."
laghu_parashari.effect:
A benefic (by Pārāśarī reckoning *for that lagna*) whose daśā falls between the
  two yogakārakas' daśās delivers the yoga's fruit in its own daśā, with or without any
  sambandha to the yogakārakas. No strength condition is stated for this case.

Weight/authority: प्रबल (author's stated observation, backed by the śloka's own second half).
laghu_parashari.combination:
Pārāśarī benefic/malefic status of each daśā lord for the given lagna (see
  the p.85 table, LP-85-6); the Vimśottarī order; identity of the yogakārakas.

Exceptions / caveats: — [AUTHOR'S OWN] the साधक/बाधक analogy (good people help unasked, bad people
  hinder unasked) is the author's own explanatory device, not Pārāśara's words.

laghu_parashari.description: ★ WHAT DELAYS OR DENIES: the malefic daśā is a बाधक
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
योगकारक ग्रह सदैव निज फल देने के लिए यद्यपि उद्यत रहता है तथापि पापग्रह निज दशा में उसके बाधक
हो जाते हैं, और शुभग्रह उसके साधक होते हैं।

Translation: "Although the yogakāraka planet is always ready (सदैव उद्यत) to give its own
  fruit, nevertheless malefic planets, in their own daśā, become its obstructers (बाधक), while
  benefic planets are its promoters (साधक)."
laghu_parashari.effect:
"Although the yogakāraka planet is always ready (सदैव उद्यत) to give its own
  fruit, nevertheless malefic planets, in their own daśā, become its obstructers (बाधक), while
  benefic planets are its promoters (साधक)."

Weight/authority: ★ core — the passage's *only* delay/denial statement.
laghu_parashari.combination:
benefic/malefic status of the running MD lord for that lagna.

Exceptions / caveats: materially qualified by LP-86-1/LP-86-2 (a malefic *connected* to the
  yogakārakas does deliver, in proportion to its own bala) and by LP-87-3 (the author's own
  observation that intervening daśās "never fail" regardless).

laghu_parashari.description: ★★ THE IDEAL CONFIGURATION (the passage's own summary sentence)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
तभी तो शुभग्रह की दशा में ही दोनों योग कारकों की अन्तर-प्रत्यन्तर दशा आने पर योगफल का लाभ ठीक
कहा गया है।

Translation: "That is precisely why the gain of the yoga's fruit is said to be *correct /
  assured* (ठीक) when, within the mahādaśā of a BENEFIC planet, the antardaśā and
  pratyantar-daśā of the TWO YOGAKĀRAKAS arrive."
laghu_parashari.effect:
"That is precisely why the gain of the yoga's fruit is said to be *correct /
  assured* (ठीक) when, within the mahādaśā of a BENEFIC planet, the antardaśā and
  pratyantar-daśā of the TWO YOGAKĀRAKAS arrive."

Weight/authority: ★★ highest — this is the operational form of śloka 18.

laghu_parashari.description: Table conventions for the per-lagna benefic table
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
शुभग्रह त्रिकोणेश जिनकी दूसरी राशि त्रिषडाय(3, 6, 11) में नहीं पड़ती है वे कोष्ठक में अंकित है।
जो ग्रह डार्क हैं वे ग्रह मारक हैं। कोष्ठक में अंकित ग्रह योगकारक हैं। मारक ग्रहों की दशा पहले शुभ
फल और बाद में अशुभ फल देती है। अष्टमेश अष्टमस्थ की अन्तर्दशा भी शुभ होती है।
यहां प्रत्येक लग्न केलिए बता रहे हैं-

Translation: "Benefic trikoṇa-lords whose second sign does not fall in the triṣaḍāya
  (3, 6, 11) are marked in parentheses. The planets that are dark (bold) are mārakas.
  The planets marked in parentheses are yogakārakas. The daśā of māraka planets gives
  auspicious fruit first and inauspicious fruit later. The antardaśā of an 8th lord situated in
  the 8th is also auspicious. Here we state it for each lagna —"
laghu_parashari.effect:
1. Test used for yogakāraka status in this table: *is the planet a trikoṇeśa whose OTHER rāśi
     is NOT the 3rd, 6th or 11th?* If yes → yogakāraka → printed in parentheses.
  2. Bold ("dark") = māraka.
  3. Māraka daśā = śubha first, aśubha after (a two-phase daśā).
  4. 8th lord placed in the 8th → its ANTARDAŚĀ is auspicious.

Weight/authority: विशेष. Exceptions: —
laghu_parashari.combination: Lagna sign; house-lordships; the house occupied by the 8th lord.

laghu_parashari.description: ★ TABLE: benefic planets per lagna, and "auspicious even when aṣṭameśa"

  compared against them.

Lagna sign only (pure lookup).

Exceptions / caveats: see LP-85-5a (Tulā's Saturn is un-parenthesised but IS a yogakāraka).
laghu_parashari.page: 85 (rows मेष–तुला) and 86 (rows वृश्चिक–मीन) — images LP-085.png, LP-086.png

laghu_parashari.description: ★ 8th-lord-in-8th antardaśā is auspicious; 8th-lordship does not disqualify
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
अष्टमेश अष्टमस्थ की अन्तर्दशा भी शुभ होती है।

Translation: "The antardaśā of the 8th lord situated in the 8th is also auspicious."
laghu_parashari.effect:
1. 8th lord occupying the 8th house → its ANTARDAŚĀ gives auspicious results. Stated at
     antardaśā level specifically, not mahādaśā.
  2. Independently, for Meṣa (Mars), Mithuna (Saturn), Siṁha (Jupiter), Tulā (Venus),
     Kumbha (Mercury) the 8th lord remains a benefic, because the same planet also owns a
     lagna or a trikoṇa.

Weight/authority: विशेष.
laghu_parashari.combination: Lagna sign; house occupied by the 8th lord.

laghu_parashari.description: Māraka daśā is two-phase
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
मारक ग्रहों की दशा पहले शुभ फल और बाद में अशुभ फल देती है।

Translation: "The daśā of māraka planets gives auspicious fruit first and inauspicious fruit
  later."
laghu_parashari.effect:
A māraka's daśā is not uniformly evil. Front portion = śubha; later portion =
  aśubha. A rājayoga therefore *can* cash out in the early part of a māraka's daśā.

Weight/authority: विशेष. Exceptions: —
laghu_parashari.combination: which planets are 2nd/7th lords; the daśā's start and end dates.

laghu_parashari.description: The question śloka 19 answers
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
अब यहां यह प्रश्न उठता है कि यदि मध्यगत दशा का स्वामी पाराशर केमतानुसार अशुभ हो तो फल कब होगा
और क्या पापग्रह भी सम्बन्धी होने पर भी योगफल देने में सहायक हो सकते हैं, इसकी चर्चा अगले उन्नीसवें
श्लोक में की गई है।

Translation: "Now the question arises: if the lord of the intervening daśā (मध्यगत दशा) is
  inauspicious according to Pārāśara's view, then when will the fruit come; and can malefic
  planets too, when they are *connected*, be of assistance in giving the yoga's fruit? This is
  discussed in the next, nineteenth, śloka."
laghu_parashari.effect: Frames śl.19 as the exception-handler for LP-85-3.
laghu_parashari.combination: — Applies to: all. Weight: normal (transitional). Exceptions: —

laghu_parashari.description: ★★ ŚLOKA 19 — a CONNECTED malefic delivers, in proportion to its own strength
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
योगकारकसंबंधात्पापिनोऽपि ग्रहाः स्वतः।
तत्तद्भुक्त्यनुसारेण दिशेयुर्योगजं   फलम्॥19॥

  *(yogakāraka-saṁbandhāt pāpino'pi grahāḥ svataḥ | tat-tad-bhukty-anusāreṇa diśeyur yogajaṁ
  phalam ||19||)*

Translation: "Even a planet that is itself a malefic (a lord of the 3rd/6th/11th —
  triṣaḍāyeśa), by virtue of having a connection (सम्बन्ध) with the yogakāraka planets, gives
  the yoga's fruit in its own daśā, in accordance with the daśā-antardaśā of the yogakāraka
  planets. The purport is that a malefic planet which forms a connection with the yogakārakas
  gives the yoga's fruit in its own daśā and in the antardaśā of the yogakāraka planets, to the
  extent of / in proportion to its own strength (बल). ||nineteen||"
laghu_parashari.effect:
"Even a planet that is itself a malefic (a lord of the 3rd/6th/11th —
  triṣaḍāyeśa), by virtue of having a connection (सम्बन्ध) with the yogakāraka planets, gives
  the yoga's fruit in its own daśā, in accordance with the daśā-antardaśā of the yogakāraka
  planets. The purport is that a malefic planet which forms a connection with the yogakārakas
  gives the yoga's fruit in its own daśā and in the antardaśā of the yogakāraka planets, to the
  extent of / in proportion to its own strength (बल). ||nineteen||"

Weight/authority: ★★ highest — the only place in the whole passage that makes the SIZE of the
  result a function of a planet's strength.
laghu_parashari.combination:
house-lordships (to identify triṣaḍāyeśas); the sambandha map; a bala
  figure for that malefic (ṣaḍbala, or at minimum dignity/exaltation/own-sign — the text does
  not specify which measure); the MD/AD sequence.

Exceptions / caveats: the mārakatva is unaffected — see LP-86-2.

laghu_parashari.description: विशेष: connection makes it deliver, but does NOT defang it
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
विशेष-अतः योगकारक ग्रहों से सम्बन्धित ग्रह चाहे शुभ हों या अशुभ, वह अपनी मध्यगत दशा में शुभ फल
ही देगा। मारक होने पर भी शुभ फल देगा, यद्यपि उसका मारकत्व कम नहीं होगा।

Translation: "Special note — therefore a planet connected with the yogakāraka planets,
  whether benefic or malefic, will give only auspicious fruit in its own intervening daśā.
  Even if it is a māraka it will give auspicious fruit — although its mārakatva will not be
  reduced."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Sambandha with a yogakāraka converts the *yoga-delivery* behaviour of ANY planet to
  auspicious, without cancelling its killing power. A māraka connected to the yogakāraka will
  both deliver the rājayoga and still act as a māraka.

Weight/authority: विशेष.
laghu_parashari.combination: sambandha map; 2nd/7th lordships.

laghu_parashari.description: निष्कर्ष: an UNCONNECTED intervening daśā lord is judged purely by Pārāśarī status
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
निष्कर्ष वही है कि योग कारक ग्रहों के मध्य में पड़ने वाली मध्यवर्ती दशा का स्वामी ग्रह पाराशर मत से
शुभ होने पर शुभ एवं अशुभ होने पर अशुभ फलदायी होगा।

Translation: "The conclusion is just this: the lord of the intervening daśā falling between
  the yogakāraka planets will be a giver of auspicious results if it is benefic by Pārāśara's
  reckoning, and of inauspicious results if it is malefic."
laghu_parashari.effect:
"The conclusion is just this: the lord of the intervening daśā falling between
  the yogakāraka planets will be a giver of auspicious results if it is benefic by Pārāśara's
  reckoning, and of inauspicious results if it is malefic."
laghu_parashari.combination: lagna-specific benefic/malefic classification of the MD lord.

laghu_parashari.description: Worked illustration of the mechanism (schematic Sun-daśā native)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
मान लो जन्म समय किसी जातक की सूर्य की दशा है। तब अगली दशाएं क्रमशः चन्द्र, मंगल, राहु, गुरु, व शनि
की होगी। यदि योग कारक ग्रह मंगल व गुरु हैं तो मध्यवर्ती दशा राहु की होगी, इस दशा की अन्तर्दशा
(योग कारक ग्रहों केसम्बन्धी ग्रहों की) में भी योग का फल घटित हो सकता है।

Translation: "Suppose a native has the Sun's daśā at birth. Then the succeeding daśās will
  be, in order, Moon, Mars, Rāhu, Jupiter and Saturn. If the yogakāraka planets are Mars and
  Jupiter, then the intervening daśā will be Rāhu's; and in the antardaśās of this daśā
  (namely, of the planets *connected with* the yogakāraka planets) the yoga's fruit can also
  materialise."
laghu_parashari.effect:
"Suppose a native has the Sun's daśā at birth. Then the succeeding daśās will
  be, in order, Moon, Mars, Rāhu, Jupiter and Saturn. If the yogakāraka planets are Mars and
  Jupiter, then the intervening daśā will be Rāhu's; and in the antardaśās of this daśā
  (namely, of the planets *connected with* the yogakāraka planets) the yoga's fruit can also
  materialise."
laghu_parashari.combination: birth Vimśottarī MD sequence; the two yogakārakas; the sambandha map.

laghu_parashari.description: The DURATION of the yoga's manifestation
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
योग के घटित होने की अवधि योगकारक ग्रहों के दशान्तर्दशा केअनुरूप होती है।

Translation: "The period during which the yoga materialises conforms to / is proportionate
  to the daśā-antardaśā of the yogakāraka planets."
laghu_parashari.effect:
The *length* of the good period equals the length of the yogakāraka's MD/AD span. A
  yoga running through Venus's 20-year mahādaśā delivers for far longer than one running through
  the Sun's 6. This is a duration rule, distinct from the onset rules above.
laghu_parashari.combination:
Vimśottarī year-lengths of the yogakāraka planets and their AD spans.
  (Vimśottarī totals: Sun 6, Moon 10, Mars 7, Rāhu 18, Jupiter 16, Saturn 19, Mercury 17,
  Ketu 7, Venus 20 years.)

laghu_parashari.description: Intervening daśās also deliver — if connected AND benefic
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
योगकारक ग्रहों के मध्य में पड़ने वाली मध्यवर्ती दशान्तर्दशा में भी योग का फल घटित हो जाता है।
यदि मध्यवर्ती दशाओं का सम्बन्ध योग कारक ग्रहों से हो और वे पाराशर मतानुसार शुभ हों।

Translation: "In the intervening daśā-antardaśā falling between the yogakāraka planets the
  fruit of the yoga also materialises — if the intervening daśās have a connection with the
  yogakāraka planets and they are benefic according to Pārāśara's view."
laghu_parashari.effect:
"In the intervening daśā-antardaśā falling between the yogakāraka planets the
  fruit of the yoga also materialises — if the intervening daśās have a connection with the
  yogakāraka planets and they are benefic according to Pārāśara's view."
laghu_parashari.combination: sambandha map; lagna-specific benefic status.

laghu_parashari.description: ★ [AUTHOR'S OWN] Intervening daśās never fail to deliver
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
यहां तक भी देखा गया है कि मध्यवर्ती दशाएं चाहे शुभ हों या अशुभ योग से सम्बन्धित फल देने में नहीं चूकती हैं।

Translation: "It has even been observed that the intervening daśās, whether benefic or
  malefic, do not fail to give results connected with the yoga."
laghu_parashari.effect:
In the author's own experience every daśā falling between the two yogakārakas'
  daśās gives *some* yoga-related result, regardless of benefic/malefic status.

Weight/authority: [AUTHOR'S OWN — "देखा गया है"] — offered as observation, not as śāstra.
laghu_parashari.combination: the span between the two yogakārakas' MDs.

laghu_parashari.description: ★ ŚLOKA 20 — the ekādhipatya yogakāraka
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
केन्द्रत्रिकोणाधिपयोरेकत्वे    योगकारकौ।
अन्यत्रिकोणपतिना सम्बन्धो यदि किं परम्॥20॥

  *(kendra-trikoṇādhipayor·ekatve yogakārakau | anya-trikoṇa-patinā sambandho yadi kiṁ param ||20||
  — the wide gap before योगकारकौ is in the original setting.)*

Translation: "When one and the same planet is lord of a kendra and lord of a trikoṇa, it
  becomes a yogakāraka. And if it also forms a connection with some OTHER trikoṇa, then
  what more is there to say? The sense is clear. ||twenty||"
laghu_parashari.effect:
1. One planet owning both a kendra (1/4/7/10) and a trikoṇa (1/5/9) = yogakāraka, by
     lordship alone.
  2. If that same planet additionally forms a sambandha with a *different* trikoṇa (or its
     lord), the yoga is raised to the highest grade ("किं परम्" — what could be better?).

Weight/authority: सर्वोत्तम / सर्वोत्कृष्ट (the section is titled "other BEST yogas").
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; house-lordships; the sambandha map (conjunction, mutual aspect,
  exchange, or — per p.89 — the planet's full aspect falling on the other trikoṇa bhāva).

Exceptions / caveats: none stated in the śloka; the 6th/8th-lordship objection is raised and dismissed
  at pp.89–90 (LP-89-5, LP-89-6, LP-90-1).

laghu_parashari.description: विशेष: the definition restated
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
विशेष-कोई एक ही ग्रह यदि केन्द्र स्थानों में से किसी एक का और साथ ही त्रिकोणों में से किसी एक स्थान
का स्वामी हो तो योगकारक माना जाता है। इस सिद्धान्त के अनुसार बारह लग्नों पर विचार करें तो स्पष्ट होता है-

Translation: "Special note — if any single planet is lord of one of the kendra houses and at
  the same time lord of one of the trikoṇa houses, it is held to be a yogakāraka. Applying this
  principle across the twelve lagnas, the following becomes clear —"
laghu_parashari.effect:
The formal test, restated as a pure lordship test. No strength, placement or
  dignity condition is attached to the *definition* — strength enters only at the delivery
  stage (LP-87-7, LP-87-8, LP-86-1).
laghu_parashari.combination: Lagna sign only. Applies to: all. Weight: विशेष. Exceptions: —

laghu_parashari.description: वृष लग्न: Saturn
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
वृष लग्न में शनि केन्द्र(दशम) एवं त्रिकोण(नवम) का स्वामी होकर एकाधिपति होकर विशेष योगकारक है।

Translation: "In Vṛṣa lagna Saturn, being lord of a kendra (the 10th) and of a trikoṇa (the
  9th), becomes an ekādhipati and is a special (विशेष) yogakāraka."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Vṛṣabha lagna → Saturn is the yogakāraka (owns 9th Capricorn + 10th Aquarius).

Weight/authority: विशेष योगकारक. Exceptions: —
laghu_parashari.combination: Lagna = Taurus. Applies to: career, authority, fortune.

laghu_parashari.description: कर्क लग्न: Mars, with an explicit STRENGTH condition
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
कर्क लग्न में मंगल ग्रह केन्द्र(दशम) और त्रिकोण(पंचम) का स्वामी होता है अतः केन्द्र-त्रिकोण का एकाधिपति
होने से योगकारक है। यदि कर्क लग्न में मंगल स्वराशि, उच्चराशि या शुभ ग्रह से युत या दृष्ट हो तो बलवान
हो जाने से शुभफल ही देगा, यह निश्चित है।

Translation: "In Karka lagna Mars is lord of a kendra (the 10th) and of a trikoṇa (the 5th);
  hence, being the sole lord of a kendra and a trikoṇa, it is a yogakāraka. If in Karka lagna
  Mars is in its own sign, in its exaltation sign, or is conjoined with or aspected by a benefic,
  then, having become strong (बलवान), it will give ONLY auspicious fruit — this is certain
  (निश्चित)."
laghu_parashari.effect:
"In Karka lagna Mars is lord of a kendra (the 10th) and of a trikoṇa (the 5th);
  hence, being the sole lord of a kendra and a trikoṇa, it is a yogakāraka. If in Karka lagna
  Mars is in its own sign, in its exaltation sign, or is conjoined with or aspected by a benefic,
  then, having become strong (बलवान), it will give ONLY auspicious fruit — this is certain
  (निश्चित)."

Weight/authority: निश्चित (the author's own word — "this is certain").
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna = Cancer; Mars's rāśi, its dignity, its conjunctions and the aspects
  falling on it, and the benefic list for Cancer (per LP-85-6: Mars itself and the Moon).

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: सिंह लग्न: Mars, with the same strength condition (plus mūlatrikoṇa)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
सिंह लग्न में मंगल ग्रह केन्द्र(चतुर्थ) और त्रिकोण(नवम) का स्वामी होता है, अतः केन्द्र त्रिकोण का एकाधिपति
होने से योग कारक है। यदि सिंह लग्न में मंगल स्वराशि, उच्च राशि, मूलत्रिकोण या शुभ ग्रह से युत या दृष्ट
हो तो बलवान होने के कारण शुभ फलदायी ही होगा।

Translation: "In Siṁha lagna Mars is lord of a kendra (the 4th) and of a trikoṇa (the 9th);
  hence, being sole lord of a kendra and a trikoṇa, it is a yogakāraka. If in Siṁha lagna Mars is
  in its own sign, exaltation sign, mūlatrikoṇa, or is conjoined with or aspected by a
  benefic, then, being strong, it will be a giver of auspicious results only."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Siṁha lagna → Mars is yogakāraka (owns 4th Scorpio + 9th Aries).
  Strength test as LP-87-7 plus mūlatrikoṇa explicitly added to the list of qualifying
  dignities.

Weight/authority: प्रबल. Exceptions: —
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna = Leo; Mars's rāśi/dignity/conjunctions/aspects; the benefic list for
  Leo (per LP-85-6: Sun and Mars).

laghu_parashari.description: तुला लग्न: Saturn — प्रबल योगकारक
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
तुला लग्न में शनि ग्रह केन्द्र(चतुर्थ) और त्रिकोण(पंचम) का स्वामी होकर प्रबल योग कारक है।

Translation: "In Tulā lagna Saturn, being lord of a kendra (the 4th) and of a trikoṇa (the
  5th), is a powerful (प्रबल) yogakāraka."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Tulā lagna → Saturn is the yogakāraka (owns 4th Capricorn + 5th Aquarius).

Weight/authority: प्रबल योगकारक — the strongest epithet given to any of the six.
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna = Libra. Applies to: property, progeny, general rājayoga.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: मकर लग्न: Venus
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
मकर लग्न में शुक्र ग्रह केन्द्र(दशम) और त्रिकोण(पंचम) का स्वामी होकर विशेष योग कारक है।

Translation: "In Makara lagna Venus, being lord of a kendra (the 10th) and of a trikoṇa (the
  5th), is a special yogakāraka."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Makara lagna → Venus is the yogakāraka (owns 5th Taurus + 10th Libra).

Weight/authority: विशेष योगकारक. Exceptions: —
laghu_parashari.combination: Lagna = Capricorn. Applies to: career, progeny, wealth.

laghu_parashari.description: कुम्भ लग्न: Venus
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
कुम्भ लग्न में शुक्र ग्रह केन्द्र(चतुर्थ) एवं त्रिकोण(नवम) का स्वामी होकर विशेष योगकारक है।
  *(printed "शुक ग्रह" — the shortened form of शुक्र; same planet)*

Translation: "In Kumbha lagna Venus, being lord of a kendra (the 4th) and of a trikoṇa (the
  9th), is a special yogakāraka."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Kumbha lagna → Venus is the yogakāraka (owns 4th Taurus + 9th Libra).

Weight/authority: विशेष योगकारक. Exceptions: —
laghu_parashari.combination: Lagna = Aquarius. Applies to: property, fortune, general rājayoga.

laghu_parashari.description: ★ Only SIX lagnas can have the ekādhipatya yoga
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
वस्तुतः यह योग वृष, कर्क, सिंह, तुला, मकर एवं कुम्भ लग्न की जन्म कुण्डलियों में ही घटित हो सकता है।

Translation: "In fact this yoga can occur only in the birth charts of Vṛṣa, Karka, Siṁha,
  Tulā, Makara and Kumbha lagnas."
laghu_parashari.effect:
"In fact this yoga can occur only in the birth charts of Vṛṣa, Karka, Siṁha,
  Tulā, Makara and Kumbha lagnas."
laghu_parashari.combination: Lagna sign only.

laghu_parashari.description: उत्कृष्ट: which sambandha upgrades each ekādhipati
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
कहने का तात्पर्य यह है कि वृष या तुला लग्न केलिए शनि व बुध सम्बन्ध करें अथवा कर्क या सिंह लग्न में
मंगल व गुरु सम्बन्ध करे अथवा मकर या कुम्भ लग्न में शुक्र व बुध सम्बन्ध करे तो ऐसा योग उत्कृष्ट ही होगा।

Translation: "The purport is that if for Vṛṣa or Tulā lagna Saturn and Mercury form a
  connection, or in Karka or Siṁha lagna Mars and Jupiter form a connection, or in Makara or
  Kumbha lagna Venus and Mercury form a connection, then such a yoga will indeed be
  excellent (उत्कृष्ट)."
laghu_parashari.effect:
"The purport is that if for Vṛṣa or Tulā lagna Saturn and Mercury form a
  connection, or in Karka or Siṁha lagna Mars and Jupiter form a connection, or in Makara or
  Kumbha lagna Venus and Mercury form a connection, then such a yoga will indeed be
  excellent (उत्कृष्ट)."
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; whether the named pair are conjoined / mutually aspecting /
  in exchange.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: TWO kendra lords connecting with ONE trikoṇeśa is stronger than one kendrādhipati
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
इसी प्रकार दो केन्द्र केस्वामी यदि एक त्रिकोणेश से सम्बन्ध करें तो ऐसा सम्बन्ध एक केन्द्राधिपति
केसम्बन्ध की अपेक्षा अधिक प्रबल होगा, जैसे-

Translation: "Likewise, if the lords of two kendras form a connection with one
  trikoṇa lord, such a connection will be more powerful than the connection of a single kendra
  lord, for example —"
laghu_parashari.effect:
A planet owning two kendras, connecting to a trikoṇeśa, outranks a planet owning
  only one kendra connecting to the same trikoṇeśa. This creates a second, independent
  yogakāraka category available to lagnas outside the six of LP-88-4.
laghu_parashari.combination: house-lordships; sambandha map.

laghu_parashari.description: The four lagnas where the two-kendra-lord rule applies  [printed in bold]
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"In Mithuna or Kanyā lagna, if Mercury and Jupiter form a connection with
  Venus, or in Dhanu or Mīna lagna if Mercury or Jupiter forms a connection with Mars, then a
  much better result will be obtained."
laghu_parashari.effect:
"In Mithuna or Kanyā lagna, if Mercury and Jupiter form a connection with
  Venus, or in Dhanu or Mīna lagna if Mercury or Jupiter forms a connection with Mars, then a

Weight/authority: [bold in the original] — अधिक अच्छा फल.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: The hidden import of the śloka's last line
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
श्लोक की अन्तिम पंक्ति में छिपा मत यदि एकाधिपति होने के अतिरिक्त अन्य त्रिकोण से भी सम्बन्ध हो
जाए तो क्या कहना?

Translation: "The view concealed in the last line of the śloka: if, besides being an
  ekādhipati, it also forms a connection with another trikoṇa — then what is there to say?"
laghu_parashari.effect:
Restates LP-87-4 clause 2. The ekādhipatya alone is a yogakāraka; ekādhipatya
  plus another trikoṇa sambandha is the top grade.

laghu_parashari.description: Indira Gandhi introduced
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
यह योग इन्दिरा गांधी की कुण्डली में भी है।
इन्दिरा गांधी का जन्म 19 नवम्बर 1917 को रात्रि 11बजकर 11 मिनट पर इलाहाबाद में हुआ था।
उनकी कुण्डली यहां अंकित कर रहे हैं।
उनका जन्म कर्क लग्न में हुआ था और उनकी जन्म राशि मकर थी।
आप उनकी कुण्डली में यह योग देख सकते हैं।
कुंडली अगले पृष्ठ पर अंकित है।

Translation: "This yoga is present in Indira Gandhi's chart also. Indira Gandhi was born on
  19 November 1917 at 11:11 p.m. at Allahabad. Her chart is set out here. Her birth was in
  Karka lagna and her janma-rāśi was Makara. You can see this yoga in her chart. The chart
  is drawn on the next page."
laghu_parashari.effect: — (biographical setup for the worked example)
laghu_parashari.combination:
— Applies to: — Weight: normal. Exceptions: —

laghu_parashari.description: ★ A kendra+trikoṇa lord is a rājayoga-kāraka regardless of natural benefic/malefic status
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
केन्द्र और त्रिकोण का स्वामी एक ही ग्रह हो तो राजयोग कारक होता है। अब वह शुभ है या अशुभ यह
महत्त्वपूर्ण नहीं है, पर वह होता योगकारक है।

Translation: "If one and the same planet is lord of a kendra and of a trikoṇa, it is a
  rājayoga-kāraka. Now whether it is a benefic or a malefic is NOT important — it is a
  yogakāraka all the same."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Yogakāraka status is conferred by lordship alone. Natural benefic/malefic nature is
  irrelevant to the *status*. (Saturn and Mars, natural malefics, are the yogakārakas for four
  of the six lagnas.)

Weight/authority: ★ core derivation principle.
laghu_parashari.combination:
house-lordships only.

Exceptions / caveats: benefic/malefic status remains relevant at the *delivery* stage (LP-85-3,
  LP-86-3) and to the strength clause (LP-87-7/8) — but not to the *identification*.

laghu_parashari.description: The lagna lord is automatically both kendreśa and trikoṇeśa
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
इसी प्रकार लग्नेश, केन्द्रेश और त्रिकोणेश दोनों है, यहां एक ही भाव केन्द्र व त्रिकोण होने से योगकारक होता है।

Translation: "In the same way the lagna lord is both kendreśa and trikoṇeśa; here, since
  one and the same bhāva is a kendra and a trikoṇa, it becomes a yogakāraka."
laghu_parashari.effect:
The lagna lord qualifies as a yogakāraka in every chart, because the 1st house is
  simultaneously a kendra and a trikoṇa.
laghu_parashari.combination: Lagna sign.

laghu_parashari.description: The objection (शंका): what if the trikoṇeśa also owns the 6th or the 8th?
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
कुछ लोग शंका करते हैं कि मिथुन लग्न की कुंडली में बुध यदि शुक्र केसाथ होकर अन्य त्रिकोणेश से यानि
शनि से सम्बन्ध करे तो वह शनि अष्टमेश भी होता है, कर्क लग्न की कुंडली में गुरु त्रिकोणेश के साथ षष्ठेश
भी होता है, मकर लग्न की कुंडली में नवमेश बुध षष्ठेश भी होता है, कुम्भ लग्न की कुंडली में बुध पंचमेश और
अष्टमेश भी होता है तो ऐसी स्थिति में त्रिकोणेश को षष्ठेश और अष्टमेश का दोष होने पर भी अन्य त्रिकोणेश
से सम्बन्ध वांछनीय होगा क्या?

Translation: "Some people raise the doubt: in a Mithuna-lagna chart, if Mercury, being with
  Venus, forms a connection with the other trikoṇa lord — namely Saturn — that Saturn is also
  the 8th lord; in a Karka-lagna chart Jupiter, along with being a trikoṇa lord, is also the
  6th lord; in a Makara-lagna chart the 9th lord Mercury is also the 6th lord; in a
  Kumbha-lagna chart Mercury is both 5th lord and 8th lord — in such a situation, when the
  trikoṇa lord carries the blemish of 6th- or 8th-lordship, is a connection with the other
  trikoṇa lord still desirable?"
laghu_parashari.effect:
— (statement of the objection; the four cited cases are the test cases)
  - Mithuna: Saturn = 9th (Aquarius) + 8th (Capricorn)
  - Karka: Jupiter = 9th (Pisces) + 6th (Sagittarius)
  - Makara: Mercury = 9th (Virgo) + 6th (Gemini)
  - Kumbha: Mercury = 5th (Gemini) + 8th (Virgo)

Weight/authority: normal (the pūrvapakṣa). Exceptions: —
laghu_parashari.combination: house-lordships. Applies to: yogakāraka derivation.

laghu_parashari.description: / LP-90-1 — ★★ THE RESOLUTION: trikoṇa-lordship OVERRIDES the 6th/8th blemish
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"The clarification of this doubt is this: Maharṣi Pārāśara held the trikoṇa
  lord to be so auspicious that, even when the blemish of 6th- or 8th-lordship is present, if the
  trikoṇa lord and the kendra lord are one and the same planet, and if it forms a connection with
  another — even a blemished — trikoṇa lord, it still constitutes a POWERFUL RĀJAYOGA
  (एक प्रबल राजयोग)."
laghu_parashari.effect:
"The clarification of this doubt is this: Maharṣi Pārāśara held the trikoṇa
  lord to be so auspicious that, even when the blemish of 6th- or 8th-lordship is present, if the

Weight/authority: ★★ prabala rājayoga — highest.
laghu_parashari.combination:
full house-lordship map for the lagna.

Exceptions / caveats: none stated.

"अब इसका सारिणीबद्ध करकेबताते हैं जिससे आपको समझने में आसानी हो। एक ही ग्रह अकेला जो स्वयं योगकारक है। सारिणी में बोल्ड यानि काले में लिखे ग्रह अष्टमेश भी है।"

Translation: "Now we set this out in tabular form so that you may understand it easily. [These are] the single planets which are by themselves yogakāraka. The planets written in bold, i.e. in black, in the table are also the 8th lord."

In the द्वादश लग्न योगकारक ग्रह चक्रम्, a cell printed in bold flags that the named planet is simultaneously the अष्टमेश of that lagna. (Bold cells in the scan: मिथुन → शनि; सिंह → गुरु; कुम्भ → बुध.)

Weight/authority: normal (table-reading convention)
laghu_parashari.combination:

Exceptions / caveats: see LP-091-2.

laghu_parashari.description: "If the 8th lord is not situated in the 8th house, then its relation with the yogakāraka planets will not be सर्वोत्कृष्ट (of the very highest order)."
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"यदि अष्टमेश अष्टमस्थ नहीं है तो उसका योगकारक ग्रहों से सम्बन्ध सर्वोत्कृष्ट नहीं होगा।"

Translation: "If the 8th lord is not situated in the 8th house, then its relation with the yogakāraka planets will not be सर्वोत्कृष्ट (of the very highest order)."
laghu_parashari.effect:
IF a planet in the chakram is also अष्टमेश AND that planet is not placed in the 8th house, THEN its sambandha with yogakāraka planets is downgraded — it is not the best-grade yoga. (Corollary: अष्टमेश *in* the 8th recovers full strength.)

Weight/authority: सर्वोत्कृष्ट-grading rule (author's own qualification)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; identity of 8th lord; house occupied by the 8th lord.

laghu_parashari.description: "For Kanyā lagna, Venus is also the mārakeśa, which is why it is entered in brackets."
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"कन्या लग्न केलिए शुक्र मारकेश भी है जो कोष्ठक में अंकित है।"

Translation: "For Kanyā lagna, Venus is also the mārakeśa, which is why it is entered in brackets."
laghu_parashari.effect:
In the chakram a bracketed planet = that planet is also a māraka for that lagna. Only one such cell exists: कन्या लग्न → (शुक्र). Venus there is 9th lord (trikoṇeśa) but simultaneously 2nd lord (māraka), so its yoga-value is qualified.

Weight/authority: normal
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign (Kanyā); Venus's lordships (2nd and 9th).

Exceptions / caveats: —

Translation: "The planets given in the table are yogakāraka in and of themselves, and if their relation occurs with some other trikoṇeśa, then that will be the very best yoga for that lagna."
laghu_parashari.effect:
IF the self-yogakāraka planet of the lagna (col. 2) forms a sambandha with any of the *other* trikoṇeśas listed (col. 3), THEN the resulting combination is the सर्वोत्कृष्ट योग for that lagna.

Weight/authority: सर्वोत्कृष्ट
laghu_parashari.combination:

Exceptions / caveats: downgraded if the planet is also अष्टमेश and not in the 8th (LP-091-2); or also mārakeśa (LP-091-3).

laghu_parashari.description: "One should grasp the essence, because at the time of prediction it is precisely this knowledge that is of use. While pronouncing results one must keep in mind …
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"सार तत्त्व ग्रहण कर लेना चाहिए क्योंकि फलित करते समय यह ज्ञान ही काम आता है। फल कथन करते समय ध्यान रखना चाहिए कि ये सूत्र किस प्रकार से बनते हैं और इनका फल किस प्रकार अभिव्यक्त होता है। देखें –द्वादश लग्न योगकारक ग्रह चक्रम ।"

While pronouncing results one must keep in mind how these sūtras are formed and how their fruit becomes manifest. See — the Chakram of Yogakāraka Planets for the Twelve Lagnas."
