laghu_parashari.description: SŪTRA 21 (verbatim)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
यदि केन्द्रे त्रिकोणे वा निवसेतां तमो   ग्रहो।
नाथेनान्यतरेणाऽपि        संबंधाद्योकारकौ॥21॥
  (printed exactly thus; संबंधाद्योकारकौ appears to be a press error for संबन्धाद्योगकारकौ — the ग is missing in the scan. [unclear: ग dropped in print])
laghu_parashari.effect:
Rāhu/Ketu are yogakāraka IF (a) they occupy a kendra (1/4/7/10) or a trikoṇa (1/5/9), AND (b) they form a sambandha with the lord of the complementary category — kendra-placed node ↔ trikoṇeśa, trikoṇa-placed node ↔ kendreśa.

Weight/authority: मूल सूत्र (śloka 21)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; house occupied by Rāhu and by Ketu; identity of kendreśas and trikoṇeśas; whether node is conjunct/associated with one of them.

Exceptions / caveats: dṛṣṭi-sambandha not admitted for the nodes (LP-093-3); if the kendreśa involved is पापी the node is not yogakāraka there (LP-093-2).

laghu_parashari.description: विशेष (author's gloss)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"विशेष–भाव स्पष्ट है कि राहु या केतु यदि केन्द्र या त्रिकोण में स्थित हों और उनका किसी केन्द्रेश या त्रिकोणेश से सम्बन्ध हो तो वह योगकारक होता है।"

Translation: "विशेष — The sense is clear: if Rāhu or Ketu be situated in a kendra or trikoṇa and have a relation with any kendreśa or trikoṇeśa, then it becomes yogakāraka."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Slightly wider than the sūtra's literal cross-pairing: node in kendra or trikoṇa + sambandha with any kendreśa or trikoṇeśa → yogakāraka.

Weight/authority: विशेष (author's own clarification)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Node's house; the lord it is associated with and that lord's house-rulership class.

Exceptions / caveats: see LP-093-2 (papi kendreśa disqualifies).

laghu_parashari.description: भाव साहचर्य (how nodes take their nature)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"यह सर्वविदित है कि राहु-केतु जिस भाव में स्थित होते हैं उसी भाव के स्वामी ग्रह के अनुसार फल देते हैं अर्थात् राहु-केतु भाव साहचर्य के अनुसार फल देते हैं।"

Translation: "It is well known that Rāhu and Ketu give results according to the lord of the bhāva in which they are situated — i.e. Rāhu-Ketu give results by *bhāva sāhacarya* (association with the house)."
laghu_parashari.effect:
A node's fruit = the fruit of the lord of the sign/house it occupies. Judge the node through the dispositor.

Weight/authority: सर्वविदित (universally accepted)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Node's occupied sign & house; that sign's lord and its condition.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: worked illustration (Rāhu in Libra)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"मान लो किसी कुण्डली में राहु त्रिकोण या केन्द्र भाव में तुला राशि में है तो राहु का फल शुक्र जैसा होगा।"

Translation: "Suppose in some chart Rāhu is in a trikoṇa or kendra bhāva in the sign Libra — then Rāhu's result will be like Venus's."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Node in Libra (a kendra/trikoṇa for that lagna) → behaves as Venus does for that lagna.

Weight/authority: normal (illustration of LP-092-3)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Node's sign; sign-lord's own yoga-status for the lagna.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: node-in-kendra + trikoṇeśa = full kendra-trikoṇa yoga
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"यहां यह स्पष्ट किया गया है कि केन्द्र में स्थित होकर राहु या केतु त्रिकोणेश से सम्बन्ध (युत या दृष्ट हो) करे तो यह योग उसी प्रकार फलीभूत होता है जिस प्रकार केन्द्र-त्रिकोणेश के पारस्परिक सम्बन्ध से उत्पन्न होता है।"

Translation: "It is made clear here that if Rāhu or Ketu, situated in a kendra, relates with a trikoṇeśa (being conjunct or aspected), then this yoga fructifies in exactly the same manner as the yoga born of the mutual relation of a kendra-lord and a trikoṇa-lord."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Node in kendra + sambandha (यु or दृष्ट) with trikoṇeśa ⇒ treat exactly as a kendreśa–trikoṇeśa rājayoga.

Weight/authority: प्रबल (equated with the standard rājayoga)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Node's house; trikoṇeśa's position; conjunction/aspect between them.

Exceptions / caveats: Note the internal tension: here the author's gloss admits "युत या दृष्ट", but on p.93 he records that the ग्रन्थकार does not accept दृष्टि-सम्बन्ध for the nodes (LP-093-3). Record both positions; in strict grantha-reading, use conjunction/occupancy only.

laghu_parashari.description: [AUTHOR'S OWN / grantha's own मत] pāpagraha in kendra-trikoṇa is *good*
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"कई स्थानों पर राहु का चतुर्थ तथा दशम भाव व पंचम त्रिकोण भाव में रहने का फल अनिष्ट कारक बताया गया हैं। लेकिन इस ग्रन्थ के मतानुसार केन्द्र या त्रिकोण में बैठने वाला पापग्रह उत्तम फल देने वाला है। इसके अलावा उसका सम्बन्ध केन्द्रेश या त्रिकोणेश से हो तो अधिक उत्तम राजयोग कारक फल होने पर आश्चर्य किस बात का। वस्तुतः ग्रन्थकार का आशय यही है कि तमोग्रह अर्थात् राहु या केतु केन्द्र में हों और त्रिकोणेश से सम्बन्ध बने तो शुभयोग कारक होता है।"

Translation: "In many places the result of Rāhu residing in the 4th and 10th bhāvas and in the 5th (a trikoṇa) has been called productive of misfortune. But according to the doctrine of this grantha, a malefic seated in a kendra or trikoṇa is a giver of excellent results. Over and above that, if its relation is with a kendreśa or trikoṇeśa, what is there to be surprised at in its giving still more excellent rājayoga-kāraka results? In truth the author's intent is precisely this: that a tamograha — i.e. Rāhu or Ketu — being in a kendra and forming a relation with a trikoṇeśa, becomes a producer of an auspicious yoga."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Reject the popular verdict that Rāhu in 4/10/5 is malefic. Per this grantha: pāpagraha in kendra or trikoṇa = उत्तम फल; and with kendreśa/trikoṇeśa sambandha = still better rājayoga.

Weight/authority: [AUTHOR'S OWN] — explicit departure from "कई स्थानों पर" (the common view); records that scholars differ
laghu_parashari.combination:
Node's house; sambandha partner.

Exceptions / caveats: —

---

laghu_parashari.description: nodes are छाया/बिम्बहीन; take colour from the graha they join
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"उसी भाव के अनुसार वे फल देते हैं। यह सब जानते हैं कि तमोग्रह को छाया ग्रह भी कहते हैं, ये प्रकाशमान ग्रह नहीं हैं। ये चन्द्रमा के मार्ग में के सम्पात(संयोग) प्रदेश रूप, बिम्बहीन हैं इसलिए जिस समय जिस राशि में या जिस भावेश के बिम्ब केस्वभावानुसार शुभ या अशुभ फलदायी कहे गए हैं। तात्पर्य यही है कि जिस ग्रह के साथ संबंध करें उसी ग्रह के अनुसार फल देते हैं।"

Translation: "They give results according to that same bhāva. Everyone knows that the tamograhas are also called shadow-planets; they are not luminous bodies. They are the nodal (intersection) points on the Moon's path, without a disc (बिम्बहीन) — therefore they are declared auspicious or inauspicious in fruit according to the nature of the sign they are in at that time, or of the disc of the bhāva-lord [they are with]. The purport is precisely this: they give results according to whichever planet they form a relation with."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Rāhu/Ketu have no independent significations. Their fruit = f(sign occupied, bhāva occupied, planet joined). Always resolve a node through its sign-lord and its conjunct planet before predicting.

Weight/authority: normal (foundational)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Node's sign, house, conjunct planet(s), and that planet's own condition/lordships.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: mixed-result configurations & the पापी-केन्द्रेश veto
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"यहां ऐसा समझना चाहिए कि राहु और केतु यदि केन्द्र में किसी त्रिकोणेश के साथ या त्रिकोण में किसी केन्द्रेश के साथ या त्रिकोण में त्रिकोणेश के साथ स्थित हों तो मिश्रित अर्थात् शुभाशुभ फल प्राप्त होगा। ऐसे में यदि केन्द्रेश पापी हो तो वह यहां योगकारक नहीं होगा।"

Translation: "Here it should be understood that if Rāhu and Ketu are situated in a kendra with some trikoṇeśa, or in a trikoṇa with some kendreśa, or in a trikoṇa with a trikoṇeśa, then a mixed — i.e. partly auspicious, partly inauspicious — result will be obtained. In such a case, if the kendreśa is pāpī (malefic), then it will not be yogakāraka here."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Three node-configurations yield mixed (शुभाशुभ) rather than pure results: (i) node in kendra with a trikoṇeśa; (ii) node in trikoṇa with a kendreśa; (iii) node in trikoṇa with a trikoṇeśa. Veto: if the kendreśa in question is a malefic, the combination is not yogakāraka.

Weight/authority: विशेष — a false-positive filter
laghu_parashari.combination:
Node's house; the co-located lord and its class (kendreśa/trikoṇeśa); natural benefic/malefic status of that kendreśa.

Exceptions / caveats: Sits against LP-092-6 (which praises malefics in kendra/trikoṇa); the veto here is on the kendreśa being pāpī, not on the node.

laghu_parashari.description: the grantha rejects दृष्टि-सम्बन्ध for the nodes
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"ग्रन्थकार ने यहां दृष्टि संबंध नहीं माना है, क्योंकि राहु या केतु की अपनी स्वयं की कोई राशि न होने से उससे सप्तम परस्पर दृष्ट योग इस ग्रन्थ का कारक–सम्बन्ध योग नहीं है।"

Translation: "The author of the treatise has not accepted aspect-relation here, because — Rāhu or Ketu having no rāśi of their own — the mutual 7th-house aspect from them is not the kāraka-sambandha yoga of this treatise."
laghu_parashari.effect:
For Rāhu/Ketu, a sambandha counts only by conjunction/co-occupancy, not by aspect (including the mutual 7th aspect). Do not build a nodal rājayoga on dṛṣṭi alone.

Weight/authority: ग्रन्थकार का मत — a hard exclusion
laghu_parashari.combination:
Node's house; whether the claimed link is conjunction or aspect.

Exceptions / caveats: Contradicts the parenthetical "(युत या दृष्ट हो)" on p.92 (LP-092-5). Both positions recorded; the grantha's own position is exclusion of दृष्टि.

laghu_parashari.description: worked illustration (Tulā lagna, Rāhu in 9th in Gemini)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"मान लो तुला लग्न की कुंडली में नवम भाव में मिथुन राशि में राहु स्थित है तो वह राहु नवम भाव का फल देगा। मिथुन राशि का स्वामी बुध इसका कन्या राशि के आधिपत्य का राहु से कुछ भी संबंध नहीं है। जिस भाव में राहु या केतु बैठे हों तो उसके अनुसार ही फल तो देते हैं।"

Translation: "Suppose in a Tulā-lagna chart Rāhu is situated in the 9th bhāva in the sign Gemini — then that Rāhu will give the results of the 9th bhāva. Mercury, lord of Gemini — his lordship of Virgo has no connection whatever with Rāhu. In whatever bhāva Rāhu or Ketu is seated, they give results according to that only."
laghu_parashari.effect:
When resolving a node through its dispositor, use only the sign the node actually occupies (and that bhāva's results). The dispositor's *other* rulership (here Mercury's Virgo = 12th from Libra) is not transferred to the node.

Weight/authority: normal — but methodologically sharp (blocks a common over-reading)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna; node's sign and house; sign-lord's dual lordships.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: SŪTRA 22: राजभंग योग (verbatim)
laghu_parashari.effect:
RĀJABHANGA: IF (9th lord ≡ 8th lord) AND (10th lord ≡ 11th lord), THEN the sambandha of these two planets does not produce rājayoga — the promised yoga is destroyed.

Weight/authority: मूल सूत्र (śloka 22); the chapter's principal cancellation rule
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; lords of 8, 9, 10, 11; whether the 9th and 10th lords are in sambandha.

Exceptions / caveats: p.102 records that śloka 22 is itself framed as an अपवाद (exception) to ślokas 14–17 and 20; and the author's own reading (LP-102-4) softens it where a single planet owns both a kendra and a trikoṇa.

laghu_parashari.description: विशेष (opening of the gloss, continues on p.94)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"विशेष–अतः स्पष्ट है कि त्रिकोण(धर्म) और केन्द्र(कर्म) भाव केस्वामी ग्रह अष्टमेश और एकादशेश हो तो राजयोग भंग हो जाता है। कहने का तात्पर्य यही है कि नवमेश और दशमेश यदि क्रमशः अष्टमेश और लाभेश हों तो इनका सम्बन्ध योगकारक नहीं बन सकता है।"

Translation: "विशेष — Hence it is clear that if the lords of the trikoṇa (dharma) and kendra (karma) bhāvas are the 8th lord and the 11th lord, then the rājayoga is broken. The purport is: if the 9th lord and the 10th lord are respectively the 8th lord and the 11th lord, their relation cannot become yogakāraka."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Restates LP-093-5 as a disqualification test to run before pronouncing any 9th–10th lord rājayoga.

Weight/authority: विशेष
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lords of 8/9/10/11 for the lagna.

Exceptions / caveats: —

---

laghu_parashari.description: exchange/conjunction of 9th & 10th lords = rājayoga, but…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"भाग्येश और दशमेश परस्पर एक दूसरे के स्थान में हों या वे एक साथ हों तो वह राजयोग है। लेकिन इस श्लोक में राजयोग का बाधक योग कहा गया है। पूर्व में कहे अनुसार राजयोग हो परन्तु यदि ये अष्टम या एकादश भाव के अधिपति भी हों तो या उन भावों के स्वामी से सम्बन्ध करते हों तो राजयोग भंग हो जाता है।"

Translation: "If the bhāgyeśa (9th lord) and the dashameśa (10th lord) are in each other's houses (parivartana), or are together, that is a rājayoga. But in this śloka the obstructing (bādhaka) yoga of the rājayoga is stated. Let the rājayoga be as stated earlier — but if these are also lords of the 8th or 11th bhāva, or if they form a relation with the lords of those bhāvas, then the rājayoga is broken."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Two rājabhaṅga triggers, not one: (a) the 9th/10th lord is itself 8th or 11th lord; (b) the 9th/10th lord merely forms a sambandha with the 8th or 11th lord. Either breaks the yoga.

Weight/authority: प्रबल — this is the exhaustive form of रajabhaṅga; (b) is far wider than the bare sūtra
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lords of 8/9/10/11; parivartana or conjunction of 9th & 10th lords; any sambandha of 9th/10th lord with 8th/11th lord.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: the two lagnas where this actually occurs
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"जैसे मेष लग्न में शनि कर्म और एकादश स्थान का स्वामी है, इसी प्रकार मिथुन लग्न में शनि धर्म और अष्टम स्थान का स्वामी है। इन दोनों लग्नों में ही यह योग घटित होगा जबकि कुण्डली में राजयोग होगा, तभी तो वह भंग होगा।"

Translation: "For example, in Meṣa lagna Saturn is lord of the karma (10th) and the 11th; likewise in Mithuna lagna Saturn is lord of the dharma (9th) and the 8th. It is in these two lagnas alone that this yoga will occur — and only when a rājayoga exists in the chart will it then be broken."
laghu_parashari.effect:
The śloka-22 rājabhaṅga configuration is lagna-specific: it can only arise for मेष लग्न (Śani = 10th + 11th) and मिथुन लग्न (Śani = 9th + 8th). And a bhaṅga presupposes a yoga — no yoga, nothing to break.

Weight/authority: विशेष — a hard lagna filter
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; Saturn's lordships.

Exceptions / caveats: LP-094-1(b) extends the damage beyond these two lagnas wherever a 9th/10th lord merely *relates* to the 8th/11th lord.

laghu_parashari.description: विद्वज्जन's rationale
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"विद्वजन कहते हैं कि यदि धर्म का ज्ञाता धर्म का नाशक भी हो और जो कर्म का ज्ञाता व्यय को हटाने वाला भी हो, इस प्रकार के धर्माधिकारी और कर्माधिकारी के सम्बन्ध मात्र से धर्म और राज्य सुख आदि की वृद्धि किस प्रकार हो सकती है?"

Translation: "The learned say: if the one who knows dharma is also the destroyer of dharma, and the one who knows karma is also the remover of expenditure — by the mere relation of such a dharmādhikārī and karmādhikārī, how can dharma and royal comforts etc. increase?"
laghu_parashari.effect:
Rationale, not a fresh dictum: the 8th destroys the 9th's dharma; the 11th merely stops loss. A lord carrying both offices is self-cancelling.

Weight/authority: विद्वज्जन का मत (scholars' position, recorded)
laghu_parashari.combination:
—

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: the two-way statement of rājabhaṅga
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"अतः स्पष्ट है कि जो धर्मेश(नवमेश), अष्टमेश(धर्म का व्यय कारक) भी हो और जो कर्मेश(दशमेश), एकादशेश(व्यय को रोकने वाला) भी हो, तो इन दोनों के सम्बन्ध मात्र से शुभ योग का लाभ नहीं होगा। इसीलिए कहा गया है कि दशमेश, एकादश से सम्बन्ध करे तो राजयोग भंग हो जाता है और भाग्येश, अष्टमेश से सम्बन्ध करे तो भी राजयोग भंग हो जाता है।"

Translation: "Hence it is clear that if the one who is dharmeśa (9th lord) is also aṣṭameśa (the causer of the expenditure of dharma), and the one who is karmeśa (10th lord) is also ekādasheśa (the stopper of expenditure), then by the mere relation of these two there will be no gain of an auspicious yoga. That is why it is said: if the 10th lord relates with the 11th, the rājayoga is broken; and if the 9th lord (bhāgyeśa) relates with the 8th lord, the rājayoga is likewise broken."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Two independent, separately-sufficient breakers — (i) दशमेश ↔ एकादश(-ेश) sambandha → rājayoga bhaṅga; (ii) भाग्येश(9th) ↔ अष्टमेश sambandha → rājayoga bhaṅga. Neither requires the double-lordship of the sūtra.

Weight/authority: प्रबल — the operational rājabhaṅga test
laghu_parashari.combination:
9th, 10th, 8th, 11th lords and their mutual sambandhas (conjunction / exchange / aspect).

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: the सार of the whole rājayoga chapter (ślokas 14–17, 20, 22)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"इस पुस्तक में 14से17, 20 और 22वें श्लोक में राजयोगकारक सूत्र बताए गए हैं। इन सबका सार समझें तो कह सकते हैं कि केन्द्रेश और त्रिकोणेश के सम्बन्ध के कारण राजयोग बनता है। केन्द्रेश निर्बल हो तो कोई राजयोग नहीं बनता है। केन्द्रेश और त्रिकोणेश सम्बन्ध करते हों पर वे दोनों ग्रह यदि अन्य भावों के स्वामी होकर अशुभ या दोषयुक्त हों तो राजयोग निष्फल होता है।"

Translation: "In this book the rājayoga-kāraka sūtras are stated in ślokas 14–17, 20 and 22. Grasping the essence of all of them one may say: rājayoga is formed because of the relation of a kendreśa and a trikoṇeśa. If the kendreśa is weak (निर्बल), no rājayoga at all is formed. If the kendreśa and trikoṇeśa do relate, but both those planets, by lordship of other bhāvas, are inauspicious or doṣayukta, then the rājayoga is fruitless (निष्फल)."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Three-part master test: (1) kendreśa–trikoṇeśa sambandha required; (2) weak kendreśa ⇒ no yoga forms at all; (3) both planets doṣayukta ⇒ yoga forms but is निष्फल.

Weight/authority: सार तत्त्व / सर्वोत्तम — the chapter's summary rule
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna; kendreśa & trikoṇeśa identities; their bala (strength); their other lordships (6/8/12/2/7/11).

Exceptions / caveats: the one-doṣa allowance, LP-095-1.

---

laghu_parashari.description: ONE doṣa is survivable, TWO is fatal
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"यदि केन्द्रेश बली हो और इसका त्रिकोणेश से सम्बन्ध हो तो उस सम्बन्ध मात्र से एक ग्रह का दोष होने पर भी सफल राजयोग बनता है, अतः स्पष्ट है कि त्रिकोणेश या केन्द्रेश स्वभावतः दोषयुक्त हो तो भी सफल राजयोग बनता है। यदि दोनों ग्रह दोषयुक्त हो तो राजयोग निष्फल होता है।"

Translation: "If the kendreśa is strong (बली) and has a relation with the trikoṇeśa, then by that relation alone a successful rājayoga is formed even though ONE planet carries a doṣa. Hence it is clear that even if the trikoṇeśa or the kendreśa is by its own nature doṣayukta, a successful rājayoga still forms. If BOTH planets are doṣayukta, the rājayoga is fruitless (निष्फल)."
laghu_parashari.effect:

laghu_parashari.description: purpose of the lagna-wise survey
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"यहां राजयोग किस प्रकार से शुभ होकर सफल होते हैं और किस प्रकार दूषित होने से निष्फल होते हैं, इसकी चर्चा विस्तार से की गई है। उक्त विचार से राजयोग को समझने में आसानी रहेगी। वैसे भी पाराशरी में केन्द्रेश, त्रिकोणेश के परस्पर सम्बन्ध से अनेक राजयोग की चर्चा की गई है। ये शुभ, शुभाशुभ एवं अशुभ होते हैं।"

Translation: "Here it has been discussed in detail how rājayogas become auspicious and successful, and how, by becoming vitiated, they become fruitless. From the foregoing consideration it will be easy to understand rājayoga. In any case, in Pārāśarī many rājayogas from the mutual relation of kendreśa and trikoṇeśa have been discussed — these are [of three grades:] शुभ, शुभाशुभ and अशुभ."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Every kendreśa–trikoṇeśa rājayoga must be graded into one of three classes: śubha / śubhāśubha (mixed) / aśubha — not simply present-or-absent.

"कर्क लग्न में शुक्र-गुरु योग एवं शुक्र-चन्द्र योग कारक भंग योग हैं।"

Translation: "In Karka lagna, the Śukra–Guru yoga and the Śukra–Candra yoga are kāraka-bhaṅga yogas."
laghu_parashari.effect:
"In Karka lagna, the Śukra–Guru yoga and the Śukra–Candra yoga are kāraka-bhaṅga yogas."

Weight/authority: प्रबल
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna = Cancer; Venus's sambandha with Jupiter or Moon.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: कारक भंग योग: वृश्चिक and मकर लग्न
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"वृश्चिक लग्न में चन्द्र-बुध व सूर्य-बुध योग स्वयं में कारक नहीं हैं। … मकर लग्न में मंगल-बुध योग अशुभ फलदायी है। मंगल-शनि योग कारक भंग योग है।"

Translation: "In Vṛścika lagna the Candra–Budha and Sūrya–Budha yogas are not kāraka in themselves. … In Makara lagna the Maṅgala–Budha yoga is a giver of inauspicious results. The Maṅgala–Śani yoga is a kāraka-bhaṅga yoga."
laghu_parashari.effect:
(a) वृश्चिक: चन्द्र-बुध and सूर्य-बुध are not kāraka by themselves (Mercury = 8th+11th lord). (b) मकर: मंगल-बुध = अशुभ फलदायी; मंगल-शनि = kāraka-bhaṅga.

Weight/authority: प्रबल — note this qualifies the "मकर has no निष्फल yoga" claim of LP-099-5: Capricorn still has kāraka-bhaṅga and अशुभ combinations even though it has no निष्फल one.
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna = Scorpio or Capricorn; the named sambandhas.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: भावार्थ of śloka 22 (the operative two-branch test)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"इस श्लोक का भावार्थ यह है कि नवमेश यदि अष्टमेश हो और वह दशमेश के साथ सम्बन्ध करे या दशमेश एकादशेश हो और वह नवमेश के साथ सम्बन्ध करता हो तो दोनों स्थिति में कारक योग प्राप्त नहीं हो सकता है।"

Translation: "The purport of this śloka is: if the 9th lord is [also] the 8th lord and it forms a relation with the 10th lord; OR if the 10th lord is [also] the 11th lord and it forms a relation with the 9th lord — in BOTH situations the kāraka yoga cannot be obtained."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Two independent branches, either sufficient to destroy the yoga: (i) 9th lord ≡ 8th lord AND it relates with the 10th lord; (ii) 10th lord ≡ 11th lord AND it relates with the 9th lord. Note this is weaker (easier to trigger) than the sūtra's literal reading, which required both double-lordships simultaneously.

Weight/authority: प्रबल — the working form of rājabhaṅga
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna; lords of 8/9/10/11; sambandha of the 9th and 10th lords.

Exceptions / caveats: the अपवाद framing of LP-102-3 and the author's softening at LP-102-4.

laghu_parashari.description: / LP-102-1 — रन्ध्रेश-as-trikoṇeśa with a त्रिषडायाधीश kendreśa
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"रन्ध्रेश यह त्रिकोणेश हो और केन्द्रेश त्रिषडायाधीश हो तो उनकेपरस्पर सम्बन्ध के द्वारा मनुष्य को कारक योग प्राप्त नहीं हो सकता।"

Translation: "If the randhreśa (8th lord) is [also] a trikoṇeśa, and the kendreśa is [also] a triṣaḍāya-lord (lord of the 3rd, 6th or 11th), then by their mutual relation a man cannot obtain the kāraka yoga."
laghu_parashari.effect:
A THIRD rājabhaṅga branch: (8th lord ≡ trikoṇeśa) + (kendreśa ≡ 3/6/11 lord) in mutual sambandha ⇒ no kāraka yoga.

Weight/authority: प्रबल
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna; 8th lord's trikoṇa-lordship; kendreśa's triṣaḍāya lordship; their sambandha.

Exceptions / caveats: LP-102-4 (the author's own softening).

---

laghu_parashari.description: recap of the doctrinal frame
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"पूर्व में कहे हुए श्लोकों में केन्द्र के चारों भाव, त्रिषडाय के तीन भाव, त्रिकोण के तीन भाव इनके शुभत्व और पापत्व की विवेचन हो चुका है। इस श्लोक में तो केन्द्रेश व त्रिकोणेश इनके परस्पर सम्बन्ध के कारण से उत्पन्न हुए कारक फल को अपवाद कहा गया है।"

Translation: "In the earlier ślokas the auspiciousness and malefic-ness of the four kendra bhāvas, the three triṣaḍāya bhāvas and the three trikoṇa bhāvas has already been examined. In this śloka, the kāraka result born of the mutual relation of the kendreśa and trikoṇeśa is stated as an अपवाद (exception)."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Frame-setting: the house-classes (kendra 1/4/7/10; triṣaḍāya 3/6/11; trikoṇa 1/5/9) were settled earlier; śloka 22 introduces the exception clause over them.

Weight/authority: normal
laghu_parashari.combination:
—

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: śloka 22 is an अपवाद to ślokas 14–17 and 20
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"श्लोक 14से17 और 20 में जो राजयोग कारक नियम कहे जा चुके हैं उन नियमों को 22वें श्लोक में अपवाद के रूप में कहा गया है, यह समझना चाहिए।"

Translation: "The rājayoga-kāraka rules already stated in ślokas 14–17 and 20 are stated in śloka 22 in the form of an exception — this should be understood."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Order of application: build the yoga by ślokas 14–17/20, then subtract by śloka 22. Śloka 22 is not a competing rule but an exception clause on the earlier ones.

Weight/authority: विशेष — governs how the whole chapter is to be sequenced
laghu_parashari.combination:
—

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: [AUTHOR'S OWN] the trikoṇeśa's supremacy overrides even 6th/8th-lord doṣa
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"ऐसा लगता है कि आचार्य ने त्रिकोणेश को इतना अधिक शुभ माना है कि षष्ठेश या अष्टमेश का दोष रहने पर भी त्रिकोण और केन्द्र का एक ही स्वामी हो और वह अन्य दोष से युक्त त्रिकोणेश से सम्बन्ध करे तो भी प्रबल राजयोग होता है।"

Translation: "It appears that the Ācārya has held the trikoṇeśa to be so exceedingly auspicious that — even with the doṣa of 6th-lordship or 8th-lordship remaining — if one and the same planet is lord of both a trikoṇa and a kendra, and it forms a relation with a trikoṇeśa that carries some other doṣa, even then a प्रबल (powerful) rājayoga results."
laghu_parashari.effect:
OVERRIDE: single planet owning both a kendra and a trikoṇa + sambandha with an (otherwise doṣayukta) trikoṇeśa ⇒ प्रबल राजयोग, notwithstanding a 6th/8th-lordship doṣa on either side.

Weight/authority: [AUTHOR'S OWN] / प्रबल — framed as his inference ("ऐसा लगता है कि आचार्य ने…")
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna; identity of the kendra+trikoṇa dual-lord (i.e. the p.91 chakram planet); its sambandha with another trikoṇeśa; their 6th/8th lordships.

Exceptions / caveats: stands in tension with LP-095-1 (both-doṣayukta ⇒ निष्फल); the author's carve-out is specifically for the dual kendra+trikoṇa lord.

laghu_parashari.description: chapter colophon and forward pointer
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"इस अध्याय में राजयोगों की चर्चा की गई है। अगले अध्याय में ग्रन्थकार आयु सम्बन्धी योगों की चर्चा आयुर्दायाध्याय नामक तीसरे अध्याय में करेगा।
  इत्युडुदायप्रदीपे राजयोगाफलाध्यायो॥2॥"

Translation: "In this chapter the rājayogas have been discussed. In the next chapter the author will discuss the yogas relating to longevity, in the third chapter named Āyurdāyādhyāya.
  *Thus [ends] in the Uḍudāyapradīpa the Chapter on the Results of Rājayoga. ॥2॥*"
laghu_parashari.effect:
Chapter 2 closes. Chapter 3 = आयुर्दायाध्याय (longevity). Note the colophon is printed राजयोगाफलाध्यायो (with an extra आ) — [printed thus; presumably राजयोगफलाध्यायो]. The work is here called उडुदायप्रदीप (Uḍudāyapradīpa).

Weight/authority: normal
laghu_parashari.combination:
—

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.effect: No doctrinal content — decorative. Recorded only so no cell is thought missed.

laghu_parashari.description: मारक स्थान का निर्णय (śloka 23)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
अष्टमं ह्यायुषः स्थानमष्टमादष्टमं च यत्।
तयोरपि व्ययस्थानं मारकस्थानमुच्यते॥23॥

Translation: The 8th is the house of longevity, and so is the 8th from the 8th (= the
  3rd). The vyaya (12th) house of each of those two is called the māraka sthāna — i.e.
  respectively the 7th (12th from 8th) and the 2nd (12th from 3rd).
laghu_parashari.effect:
8th house = mukhya āyu bhāva; 3rd house = gauṇa āyu bhāva. 7th house = māraka
  corresponding to the 8th; 2nd house = māraka corresponding to the 3rd.

Weight/authority: normal (mūla śloka).
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign only (to fix houses 2, 3, 7, 8).

Exceptions / caveats: none stated here.

laghu_parashari.description: the 8th is the āyu bhāva *because* the 8th lord is the worst malefic
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"इसमें कोई सन्देह नहीं है कि अष्टम भाव ही आयु भाव है क्योंकि अष्टमेश ही
  सर्वाधिक पापी होता है। लेकिन कुण्डली का सर्वाधिक शुभ भाव नवम का बारहवां भाव अष्टम परम अशुभ होगा।"

Translation: There is no doubt that the 8th alone is the āyu bhāva, because the aṣṭameśa
  is the most malefic of all planets. Being the 12th from the 9th — the chart's most
  auspicious house — the 8th is supremely inauspicious.
laghu_parashari.effect:
aṣṭameśa is ranked *sarvādhika pāpī*, above every other functional malefic.

Weight/authority: normal.

laghu_parashari.description: mukhya vs gauṇa māraka
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"इसी प्रकार अष्टम से अष्टम भाव(तृतीय) गौण रूप से आयु भाव होगा। इन दोनों के
  व्यय भाव क्रमशः सप्तम व द्वितीय होते हैं, वस्तुतः ये दोनों मारक भाव हैं। जिस प्रकार आयु भाव मुख्य और
  गौण दो प्रकार के हैं उसी प्रकार मारक स्थानों में भी मुख्य और गौण मारक समझने चाहिएं।"

Translation: The 3rd is the āyu bhāva only *secondarily* (gauṇa). Their vyayas are the
  7th and 2nd respectively; both are truly māraka bhāvas. Just as the āyu bhāvas are of two
  grades (mukhya / gauṇa), so too the māraka sthānas must be understood as mukhya and gauṇa.
laghu_parashari.effect:
The two māraka houses are not equal in rank. Since 8th is mukhya āyu and 3rd
  is gauṇa āyu, the 7th (vyaya of the mukhya) is the mukhya māraka and the 2nd (vyaya of the
  gauṇa) is the gauṇa māraka. *(This is the reading the author uses on p.105 — and reverses on
  pp.106–107. See CONFLICT-A.)*

Weight/authority: normal.
laghu_parashari.combination: Lagna sign.

laghu_parashari.description: strength of 3rd/8th lords sets the *length* of life; strength of 2nd/7th lords sets the *force* of the māraka daśā
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"यह भी जान लें कि तृतीय और अष्टम भाव के स्वामी जिस मान से बली होंगे उसी मान
  से व्यक्ति का आयुष्य होगा, उसी प्रकार द्वितीय और सप्तम भाव के स्वामी जिस मान से बली होंगे उसी मान
  से वे अपनी-अपनी दशाओं में मारक होंगे।"

Translation: In proportion as the lords of the 3rd and 8th are strong, so will the
  native's longevity be; and in proportion as the lords of the 2nd and 7th are strong, so
  strongly will they act as mārakas in their own daśās.
laghu_parashari.effect:
In proportion as the lords of the 3rd and 8th are strong, so will the
  native's longevity be; and in proportion as the lords of the 2nd and 7th are strong, so
  strongly will they act as mārakas in their own daśās.

Weight/authority: normal.
laghu_parashari.combination: Ṣaḍbala / positional strength of the 2nd, 3rd, 7th and 8th lords.

laghu_parashari.description: the मारक भाव diagram
laghu_parashari.effect:
Visual restatement of LP-103-1. No new content, but confirms the house numbering
  is from the lagna, not from the Moon.

laghu_parashari.description: / LP-105-1 — मारक किस ग्रह को समझें? (śloka 24) ← CONFLICT-A lives here
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
तत्राप्याद्यव्ययस्थानाद्द्वितीयं बलवत्तरम्।
तदीशितुस्तत्र गताः पापिनस्तेन संयुताः॥24॥
laghu_parashari.effect: Weight/authority: normal (mūla śloka) — but this is the load-bearing śloka of the chapter.
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; lords of 2 and 7; occupants of 2 and 7 with their śubha/pāpa
  class for that lagna; conjunctions/sambandhas of the 2nd and 7th lords; running MD/AD.

laghu_parashari.description: the four-step māraka-identification protocol (author's expansion of śl.24)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"कुण्डली में मारक(मृत्युप्रद) ग्रहों का निर्णय निम्न प्रकार करना चाहिए–
  – सप्तमेश ग्रह एवं वे पाप ग्रह जो इससे किसी न किसी रूप में जुड़े हुए हैं। इसी प्रकार द्वितीयेश व इससे
  सम्बन्धित पाप ग्रह को भी मारक समझना चाहिए।
  – अष्टमेश और इससे सम्बन्धित पाप ग्रहों को भी मारक समझना चाहिए।
  – बारहवें भाव का स्वामी और इससे सम्बन्धित पापग्रहों को भी मारक समझना चाहिए।
  – प्रत्येक लग्न के लिए मारक निम्न प्रकार समझने चाहिएं–"

Translation: Determine the mārakas thus: (1) the 7th lord and every pāpa graha
  connected with it *in any manner whatsoever*; likewise the 2nd lord and pāpa grahas
  related to it; (2) the 8th lord and pāpa grahas related to it; (3) the 12th lord and
  pāpa grahas related to it; (4) then per-lagna, as the chakra below.
laghu_parashari.effect:
Determine the mārakas thus: (1) the 7th lord and every pāpa graha
  connected with it *in any manner whatsoever*; likewise the 2nd lord and pāpa grahas
  related to it; (2) the 8th lord and pāpa grahas related to it; (3) the 12th lord and
  pāpa grahas related to it; (4) then per-lagna, as the chakra below.

Weight/authority: normal — but note this list already *includes* the 8th and 12th lords, which
  ślokas 25–27 will re-introduce as *later* fallbacks. See LP-107-2 for how to reconcile.
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna; lords of 2, 7, 8, 12; all sambandhas of those four; pāpa/śubha
  classification for that lagna.

laghu_parashari.description: व्ययेश की दशा में मरण की संभावना (śloka 25)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
तेषां दशाविपाकेषु सम्भवे निधनं नृणाम्।
तेषामसम्भवे साक्षाद्व्ययाधीशदशास्वपि॥25॥

Translation: Death of men occurs in the ripening of the daśās of those [mārakeśas]; in
  the impossibility of those, then directly in the daśās of the lord of the 12th as well.
laghu_parashari.effect:
IF none of the mārakeśa daśās (2nd lord, 7th lord, pāpas in/with them) falls in the
  plausible longevity window, THEN the 12th lord's (vyayeśa's) daśā becomes the killer.

Weight/authority: normal.
laghu_parashari.combination: 12th lord; the mārakeśa daśā dates; the āyu-khaṇḍa verdict.

laghu_parashari.description: the author's epistemic disclaimer on death-timing [AUTHOR'S OWN]
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"किसी भी व्यक्ति की कुण्डली पर से उसकी आयु का निश्चित आयु कहना, ज्योतिष शास्त्र
  की सबसे बड़ी, कठिन और गम्भीर समस्या है–मृत्यु का समय निश्चित करना। यदि किसी दैवज्ञ को दैवी कृपा हो
  तो वही ऐसी बात कह सकता है। यह साधारण दैवज्ञ के बस की बात नहीं है। जीवन भर कुंडली बांचने एवं नाना
  प्रकार के ज्योतिष ग्रन्थ पढ़कर भी आयु का निश्चित कथन कर पाना सम्भव नहीं है।"

Translation: To state a definite lifespan from a chart is the greatest, hardest and
  gravest problem of jyotiṣa — fixing the time of death. Only an astrologer with divine grace
  can say such a thing; it is beyond the ordinary astrologer. Even after a lifetime of chart
  reading and studying every kind of jyotiṣa text, a definite statement of longevity is not
  possible.
laghu_parashari.effect:
To state a definite lifespan from a chart is the greatest, hardest and
  gravest problem of jyotiṣa — fixing the time of death. Only an astrologer with divine grace
  can say such a thing; it is beyond the ordinary astrologer. Even after a lifetime of chart
  reading and studying every kind of jyotiṣa text, a definite statement of longevity is not
  possible.

Weight/authority: विशेष — stated as his own considered position.

laghu_parashari.description: the compact restatement of who is a māraka
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"कहने का तात्पर्य यह है कि सप्तम या द्वितीय भावों के स्वामी, सप्तम या द्वितीय
  भावो में स्थित पापग्रह या द्वितीयेश व सप्तमेश के स्वामियों से संबंध करने वाले पापी ग्रह मारक अर्थात्
  मृत्यु कारक होते हैं।" Preceded by: "सप्तम या द्वितीय मारक भाव हैं, उनमें से प्रबल मारक भाव द्वितीय
  भाव है। यदि मारकेशों का संबंधी कोई पाप ग्रह हो तो उसकी दशा में मृत्यु होगी ऐसा कहना चाहिए।"

Translation: In sum: the lords of the 7th or 2nd; pāpa grahas placed in the 7th or 2nd;
  and pāpī grahas that form a relation with the 2nd/7th lords — these are the mārakas, i.e.
  the causes of death. Of the two māraka houses, the stronger is the 2nd.
laghu_parashari.effect:
three-member māraka set (lords / occupants-if-pāpa / pāpa-sambandhīs), with the
  2nd house ranked above the 7th.

Weight/authority: normal.

laghu_parashari.description: अष्टमेश की दशा को मारक समझें (śloka 26)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
अलाभे पुनरेतेषां सम्बन्धेन व्ययेशितुः।
क्वचिच्छुभानां च दशास्वष्टमेशदशासु च॥26॥

Translation: Again, in the absence of those, [death occurs] through relation with the
  vyayeśa — sometimes even in the daśās of benefics [so related] — and in the daśā of the
  8th lord.
laghu_parashari.effect:
Fallback rungs 5 and 6 of the waterfall:
  5. A śubha graha in sambandha with the vyayeśa (12th lord) — note: a *benefic* can kill
     here, purely by contamination through the 12th lord.
  6. The aṣṭameśa (8th lord).

Weight/authority: normal.
laghu_parashari.combination:
12th lord; planets in sambandha with it and their śubha/pāpa class for the
  lagna; 8th lord; daśā sequence.

laghu_parashari.description: अग्रिम-अग्रिम मारकेशों का विचार (śloka 27) ← THE PRIORITY ORDER
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
केवलानां च पापानां दशासु निधनं क्वचित्।
कल्पनीयं बुधैर्नृणां मारकाणामदर्शने॥27॥

Translation: Sometimes death is [to be inferred] in the daśās of mere malefics; the
  wise should imagine it so for men when [proper] mārakas are not seen. Thus, in the absence
  of each preceding māraka's daśā, death is to be conceived in the daśā of the next
  mārakeśa in succession.
laghu_parashari.effect:

  mārakeśa in succession.

Weight/authority: normal (mūla) but the विशेष elevates the ordering to a method.

laghu_parashari.description: शनि की मारकता पर विशेष विचार (śloka 28) ← SATURN AS MASTER SWITCH
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
मारकैः सह सम्बन्धान् निहन्ता पापकृच्छनिः।
अतिक्रम्येतरान् सर्वान् भवत्येव न संशयः॥28॥

Translation: Malefic Saturn, through relation with the mārakas, becomes the slayer,
  transgressing/overriding (अतिक्रम्य) all the others — there is no doubt of this.
laghu_parashari.effect:
Malefic Saturn, through relation with the mārakas, becomes the slayer,
  transgressing/overriding (अतिक्रम्य) all the others — there is no doubt of this.

Weight/authority: विशेष (own section heading) + *न संशयः* in the mūla — the strongest emphasis
  in the chapter.

laghu_parashari.description: / LP-109-1 — [AUTHOR'S OWN] Saturn-as-māraka does *not* by itself shorten life
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"लेकिन हमारा यह मत है कि अनेक कुण्डलियों में शनि मारक होने पर भी उन जातकों
  की आयु अच्छी रही। ऐसे में आयु किस खण्ड में पड़ती है इसका विचार भी अवश्य करना चाहिए।"

Translation: But it is our own opinion that in many charts, even though Saturn was
  the māraka, those natives' longevity was good. In such cases one must necessarily also
  consider which āyu-khaṇḍa the longevity falls into.
laghu_parashari.effect:
Saturn's mārakatva (LP-108-2) is not sufficient for a short life. It must be
  filtered through the āyu-khaṇḍa test before any adverse verdict.

Weight/authority: [AUTHOR'S OWN] — explicit *हमारा यह मत है*, softening the mūla's *न संशयः*.

laghu_parashari.description: THE ĀYU-KHAṆḌA GATE (the chapter's most usable rule)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"सर्वप्रथम आयु देखनी चाहिए कि जातक पूर्णायु, मध्यायु या अल्पायु है।
  पूर्णायु होने पर यदि मारकेशों की दशा आने पर भी मृत्यु नहीं होती है, अपितु मृत्यु तुल्य कष्ट होता है और
  मारक दशा गुजर जाती है। आयु जिस खण्ड में पड़े, उसी खण्ड में मारक दशा पड़े तभी मृत्यु देगी, ऐसा जानना
  चाहिए।"

Translation: First of all one must see whether the native is pūrṇāyu (full-life),
  madhyāyu (medium) or alpāyu (short). If he is pūrṇāyu, then even when a mārakeśa's daśā
  arrives death does not occur — instead there is suffering equal to death (*मृत्यु तुल्य
  कष्ट*) and the māraka daśā passes by. A māraka daśā will give death only when it falls
  inside the same khaṇḍa in which the longevity falls. Know it so.
laghu_parashari.effect:
First of all one must see whether the native is pūrṇāyu (full-life),

  arrives death does not occur — instead there is suffering equal to death (*मृत्यु तुल्य
  कष्ट*) and the māraka daśā passes by. A māraka daśā will give death only when it falls
  inside the same khaṇḍa in which the longevity falls. Know it so.

laghu_parashari.combination:
the dīrgha/madhya/alpa verdict (LP-109-3 … LP-110-2); the māraka daśā
  dates; the native's age at those dates.

laghu_parashari.description: the three āyu classes and their year ranges
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"– सबसे पहले कुण्डली में यह विचार करें कि जातक दीर्घायु, मध्यायु या अल्पायु है।
  – दीर्घायु न्यूनतम 96 वर्ष तक और अधिकतम 120 वर्ष तक समझनी चाहिए।
  – मध्यायु न्यूनतम 64 वर्ष तक और अधिकतम 80 वर्ष तक समझनी चाहिए।
  – अल्पायु न्यूनतम 32 वर्ष तक और अधिकतम 40 वर्ष तक समझनी चाहिए।
  दीर्घायु, मध्यायु और अल्पायु का निर्णय जैमिनी मतानुसार करना चाहिए।"

Translation: | Class | Minimum | Maximum |
  |---|---|---|
  | दीर्घायु / पूर्णायु (long) | 96 years | 120 years |
  | मध्यायु (medium) | 64 years | 80 years |
  | अल्पायु (short) | 32 years | 40 years |
  The determination of these three is to be made according to the Jaimini view.
laghu_parashari.effect:
| Class | Minimum | Maximum |
  |---|---|---|
  | दीर्घायु / पूर्णायु (long) | 96 years | 120 years |
  | मध्यायु (medium) | 64 years | 80 years |

  The determination of these three is to be made according to the Jaimini view.

laghu_parashari.description: दीर्घायु विचार के सूत्र (three sūtras)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"सर्वप्रथम दीर्घायु विचार की चर्चा करेंगे और इसके तीन सूत्र बताएंगे। दीर्घायु का
  विचार करते समय इनको कुण्डली में देखना चाहिए। ये तीन सूत्र इस प्रकार हैं–
  1. चर राशि का लग्नेश और चर राशि का अष्टमेश हो तो दीर्घायु होती है, यह समझना चाहिए।
  2. स्थिर राशि का लग्नेश और द्विस्वभाव राशि का अष्टमेश हो तो दीर्घायु होती है, यह समझना चाहिए।
  3. द्विस्वभाव राशि का लग्नेश और स्थिर राशि का अष्टमेश हो तो दीर्घायु होती है, यह समझना चाहिए।"
- Translation & Rule — DĪRGHĀYU when (lagneśa's sign-modality, aṣṭameśa's sign-modality) is:
  (cara, cara) | (sthira, dvisvabhāva) | (dvisvabhāva, sthira).
laghu_parashari.effect: Weight/authority: normal (सूत्र).
laghu_parashari.combination: sign occupied by the lagneśa; sign occupied by the aṣṭameśa.

laghu_parashari.description: मध्यायु विचार के सूत्र (three sūtras)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"1. चर राशि का लग्नेश और स्थिर राशि का अष्टमेश हो तो मध्यायु होती है, यह
  समझना चाहिए। 2. स्थिर राशि का लग्नेश और चर राशि का अष्टमेश हो तो मध्यायु होती है, ऐसा समझना
  चाहिए। 3. द्विस्वभाव राशि का लग्नेश और द्विस्वभाव राशि का अष्टमेश हो तो मध्यायु होती है, ऐसा
  समझना चाहिए।"
- Rule — MADHYĀYU when (lagneśa, aṣṭameśa) modality is:
  (cara, sthira) | (sthira, cara) | (dvisvabhāva, dvisvabhāva).
laghu_parashari.effect: Weight/authority: normal (सूत्र).

laghu_parashari.description: अल्पायु विचार के सूत्र (three sūtras)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:

  समझना चाहिए। 3. द्विस्वभाव राशि का लग्नेश और चर राशि का अष्टमेश हो तो अल्पायु होती है, ऐसा
  समझना चाहिए।"
- Rule — ALPĀYU when (lagneśa, aṣṭameśa) modality is:
  (cara, dvisvabhāva) | (sthira, sthira) | (dvisvabhāva, cara).

#### Consolidated āyu matrix (LP-109-4 + LP-110-1 + LP-110-2) — verified complete
Rows = modality of the sign occupied by the lagneśa; columns = by the aṣṭameśa.

| लग्नेश ↓ / अष्टमेश → | चर | स्थिर | द्विस्वभाव |
|---|---|---|---|
| चर | दीर्घायु | मध्यायु | अल्पायु |
| स्थिर | मध्यायु | अल्पायु | दीर्घायु |

laghu_parashari.description: the two-of-three concurrence rule + the tie-breaker
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"यहां यह ध्यान रखना चाहिए कि जो आयु तीन या दो प्रकार से मिले वही मान्य होती
  है। यदि तीनों प्रकार से आयु अलग-अलग आए तो जन्म व होरा लग्न से प्राप्त आयु स्वीकार होती है।"

Translation: Note here that the longevity that is obtained by all three or by two of
  the methods is the accepted one. If all three methods yield different results, then the
  longevity obtained from the janma lagna and the horā lagna is accepted.
laghu_parashari.effect:
1. Compute the āyu class three times — reckoning the "lagneśa" from (a) the janma
     lagna, (b) the horā lagna, (c) *the third reckoning* — and take the majority
     verdict (3/3 or 2/3).
  2. On a 3-way split, take the verdict from janma lagna + horā lagna.

Weight/authority: normal.
laghu_parashari.combination: janma lagna; horā lagna (LP-110-4); the unnamed third reference point.

laghu_parashari.description: the पापीग्रह column read as a functional-malefic list

laghu_parashari.description: मारक विचार के अनमोल सूत्र — the framing
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"मारक विचार करते समय अनेक बार ऐसे ग्रहयोग बन जाते हैं कि निर्णय ले पाना कठिन
  हो जाता है। आयु विचार करने में तो यह अत्यन्त कठिन है। ऐसे में यहां कुछ अनमोल सूत्र दे रहें हैं, इन सूत्रों
  को ध्यान में रखकर मृत्यु या आयु का विचार करेंगे तो निर्णय लेने में आसानी रहेगी। ये 26 अनमोल सूत्र इस
  प्रकार हैं–"

Translation: In māraka reckoning, planetary combinations often arise that make a decision
  hard — in longevity reckoning it is extremely hard. Here therefore are some priceless
  sūtras (अनमोल सूत्र); keeping them in view makes the judgement of death or longevity easier.
  These 26 priceless sūtras are as follows —

laghu_parashari.description: अनमोल सूत्र, LIST A (items 1–7) — the death-daśā checklist
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
1. "द्वितीयेश और सप्तमेश में से जो बली हो उसकी दशान्तर्दशा में दूसरे की दशा में मृत्यु होती है।"
  2. "मारक भाव स्थित पापी ग्रह की दशा में मृत्यु संभावित है।"
  3. "मारकेश से संबंध करने वाले पापीग्रह की दशा में।"
  4. "व्ययेश की दशा में मृत्यु संभावित है।"
  5. "व्ययेश के साथ सम्बन्ध करने वाले पापग्रह की दशा में।"
  6. "अष्टमेश की दशा में मृत्यु संभावित है।"
  7. "मारक ग्रह से सम्बन्ध करने वाले पापी शनि की दशा में।"

laghu_parashari.description: सूत्र 12 — pāpa graha in the 8th (MD) with 6th-lord AD
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"अष्टम भाव में स्थित पापग्रह की महादशा में षष्ठेश की अन्तर्दशा मारक हो सकती है।"

Translation: In the mahādaśā of a pāpa graha placed in the 8th house, the antardaśā of
  the 6th lord can be māraka.
laghu_parashari.effect:
MD(pāpa occupant of H8) → AD(6L) = māraka.

Weight/authority: अनमोल सूत्र

laghu_parashari.description: सूत्र 13 — 6th-lord MD, 8th-lord AD
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"षष्ठेश की महादशा में अष्टमेश की अन्तर्दशा मारक हो सकती है।"

Translation: In the 6th lord's mahādaśā, the 8th lord's antardaśā can be māraka.
laghu_parashari.effect:
MD(6L) → AD(8L) = māraka.

Weight/authority: अनमोल सूत्र

laghu_parashari.description: सूत्र 14 — pāpa graha in the 6th (MD) with H8-occupant AD
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"षष्ठ भाव में स्थित पापग्रह की महादशा में अष्टम में स्थित ग्रह की अन्तर्दशा मारक बन सकती है।"

Translation: In the mahādaśā of a pāpa graha placed in the 6th house, the antardaśā of a
  planet placed in the 8th can become māraka.
laghu_parashari.effect:
MD(pāpa occupant of H6) → AD(occupant of H8) = māraka.

Weight/authority: अनमोल सूत्र

laghu_parashari.description: सूत्र 15 — (verbatim duplicate of सूत्र 13)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"षष्ठेश की महादशा में अष्टमेश की अन्तर्दशा मारक हो सकती है।"

Translation: In the 6th lord's mahādaśā, the 8th lord's antardaśā can be māraka.
laghu_parashari.effect:
In the 6th lord's mahādaśā, the 8th lord's antardaśā can be māraka.

Weight/authority: अनमोल सूत्र

laghu_parashari.description: सूत्र 16 — pāpa in the 8th (MD) with H6-occupant AD
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"अष्टम में स्थित पापग्रह की महादशा में षष्ठ में स्थित ग्रहों की अन्तर्दशा मारक बन सकती है।"

Translation: In the mahādaśā of a pāpa graha placed in the 8th, the antardaśā of
  planets placed in the 6th can become māraka.
laghu_parashari.effect:
MD(pāpa occupant of H8) → AD(occupants of H6) = māraka.

Weight/authority: अनमोल सूत्र

laghu_parashari.description: सूत्र 17 — Mercury–Venus conjunction in the 5th
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"बुध–शुक्र की युति पंचम भाव में हो तो वे एक दूसरे की महादशा में दूसरे का अन्तर आने पर मारक बन सकते हैं।"

Translation: If Mercury and Venus are conjoined in the 5th house, then when one's
  mahādaśā runs and the other's antardaśā arrives, they can become māraka.
laghu_parashari.effect:
Bu+Śu yuti in H5 → MD(Bu)/AD(Śu) and MD(Śu)/AD(Bu) are both māraka windows.

Weight/authority: अनमोल सूत्र
laghu_parashari.combination: 5th-house occupancy; Mercury/Venus conjunction; MD/AD sequence.

laghu_parashari.description: सूत्र 18 — Mars as duḥsthāna lord
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"यदि मंगल मारक भाव का या 2, 6, 8, 12वें भाव का स्वामी हो तो इसकी दशान्तर्दशा मारक होती है।"

Translation: If Mars owns a māraka bhāva, or owns the 2nd, 6th, 8th or 12th, then his
  daśā–antardaśā is māraka (stated flatly — "मारक होती है", not "हो सकती है").
laghu_parashari.effect:
Mars lord of 2/6/8/12 (or of a māraka bhāva) → Mars MD and Mars AD are māraka.

Weight/authority: अनमोल सूत्र — note the indicative verb: the author asserts this one without the
  usual "can be" hedge. Mars is thus the second planet after Saturn to be singled out by name.
laghu_parashari.combination: lagna sign → Mars's lordships.

laghu_parashari.description: सूत्र 19 — SATURN AS प्रबल मारक (the p.108 doctrine, sharpened)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"यह जान लें कि शनि शुभ भाव का स्वामी होते हुए भी मारक ग्रह के साथ हो तो वह प्रबल मारक हो जाता है।"

Translation: Know this: even while Saturn is the lord of an auspicious house, if he is
  with (conjoined with) a māraka graha, he becomes a प्रबल (powerful) māraka.
laghu_parashari.effect:
Saturn ∧ (Saturn conjoined with any māraka graha) → Saturn = prabala māraka,
  regardless of Saturn's own lordship being benefic.

Weight/authority: अनमोल सूत्र
laghu_parashari.combination:
Saturn's house-lordships; Saturn's conjunctions; the identified māraka grahas
  (2nd lord + 8th lord deduped; 7th lord always प्रबल — the p.105 chakra).

laghu_parashari.description: सूत्र 20 — 8th lord in the lagna
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"अष्टमेश लग्न भाव में स्थित हो तो निज दशा में मारक बन जाता है।"

Translation: If the 8th lord is placed in the lagna bhāva, he becomes māraka in his own
  daśā ("निज दशा").
laghu_parashari.effect:
8L in H1 → MD(8L) is itself the death window; no antardaśā qualifier required.

Weight/authority: अनमोल सूत्र
laghu_parashari.combination: 8th lord's house placement.
laghu_parashari.page: 113–114 (sentence breaks across the page: p.113 ends "...निज दशा में मारक", p.114 opens "बन जाता है।")

laghu_parashari.description: सूत्र 21 — Rahu daśā of two or more of the native's children
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"जब जातक के परिवार में उसकी दो या दो से अधिक सन्तान की राहु की दशा चल रही हो तो जातक को मृत्युतुल्य कष्ट होता है।"

Translation: When, in the native's family, two or more of his children are running
  Rahu daśā, the native suffers मृत्युतुल्य कष्ट (death-equivalent affliction).
laghu_parashari.effect:
Count the native's children currently in Rahu MD; if ≥ 2 → native gets death-equivalent
  suffering (explicitly not death).

Weight/authority: अनमोल सूत्र
laghu_parashari.combination: birth data of the native's children; their Vimśottarī MD.

laghu_parashari.description: सूत्र 22 — the āyu-khaṇḍa gate made mandatory and prior
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"उक्त योगों के अतिरिक्त यह भी पहले निश्चित कर लेना चाहिए कि जातक दीर्घायु, मध्यायु या अल्पायु योगों के आधार पर मृत्यु की संभावना है या नहीं।"

Translation: Over and above the aforesaid yogas, one must FIRST determine whether, on the
  basis of the दीर्घायु / मध्यायु / अल्पायु yogas, death is even possible for the native or not.
laghu_parashari.effect:
Order of operations is fixed: āyu-khaṇḍa determination precedes every māraka test.
  If the āyu-khaṇḍa does not permit death at that age, the māraka daśā delivers कष्ट, not मृत्यु.

Weight/authority: अनमोल सूत्र
laghu_parashari.combination: the āyu-khaṇḍa determination of Ch.3 (lagneśa/candra/aṣṭameśa triad, etc.).

laghu_parashari.description: सूत्र 23 — the consolidated māraka roster (attributed to विद्वान्)
laghu_parashari.effect:
Build the māraka candidate set from these nine categories, then time with the
  MD/AD sūtras above.

Weight/authority: अनमोल सूत्र (attributed — "विद्वानों के अनुसार", so this is the received view, not
  necessarily the author's own).

laghu_parashari.description: सूत्र 24 (a) — infant/child death and its assigned cause (quoted authority)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"फलित ज्योतिष का प्रसिद्ध ग्रन्थ के अध्याय चार के श्लोक 1व दो में कहा है कि जो बालक निज जन्म के
  पश्चात चार वर्षों के भीतर मरण होता है तो उसका कारण उसके माता–पिता के पाप हैं। उसकेबाद नौ से 12वर्ष के भीतर
  उसकी मृत्यु होती है तो वह निज पापों के कारण मृत्यु को पाता है।"

Translation: A child who dies within four years of birth dies because of the sins of its
  parents; if death comes between the ninth and twelfth year, the child dies on account of
  its own sins.

laghu_parashari.description: सूत्र 24 (b) — THE ARIṢṬA AND ĀYU BRACKETS (numeric)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
- "मनुष्य के जन्म से आठ वर्ष तक बालारिष्ट कहा जाता है।"
  - "20वर्ष तक ग्रहों के योगों के कारण अरिष्ट प्राप्त होता है, इसलिए इसे योगारिष्ट कहते हैं।"
  - "32वर्ष तक अल्पायु, 70वर्ष तक मध्यायु एवं उसके पश्चात 100वर्ष तक की आयु को पूर्णायु कहते हें।"

Translation: - From birth to 8 years → bālāriṣṭa.
  - To 20 years, the ariṣṭa arising from planetary yogas → yogāriṣṭa.
  - To 32 years → alpāyu; to 70 years → madhyāyu; thereafter up to 100 years → pūrṇāyu.
laghu_parashari.combination: the āyu determination; the native's age at the daśā under test.

laghu_parashari.description: सूत्र 24 (c) — the synthesis instruction [AUTHOR'S OWN]
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"आयु का निर्णय करना सर्वाधिक कठिन है। इसलिए विभिन्न प्रकार से आयु का निर्णय करके फिर समन्वय युक्त फल कहना चाहिए।"

Translation: Judging longevity is the most difficult of all. Therefore one should determine
  the āyu by several different methods and only then pronounce a समन्वय युक्त फल — a verdict
  arrived at by reconciliation/synthesis.
laghu_parashari.effect:
Never predict longevity from a single method. Run multiple āyu methods, then
  reconcile.

Weight/authority: विशेष / author's own methodological directive. Echoes the p.112 framing
  ("आयु विचार करने में तो यह अत्यन्त कठिन है"). This licenses — indeed requires — the
  triangulation approach and is the single most important sentence for how to *use* this chapter.

laghu_parashari.description: सूत्र 25 — pāpa grahas in sambandha with the three killer-lords
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"अनेक बार यह देखने को मिलता है कि मारकेश, द्वादशेश, अष्टमेश के साथ संबंध करने वाले पापग्रहों की दशा में निधन होता है।"

Translation: Many times it is observed that death occurs in the daśā of pāpa grahas that
  make sambandha with the mārakeśa, the 12th lord, or the 8th lord.
laghu_parashari.effect:
MD(pāpa graha in sambandha with mārakeśa ∨ 12L ∨ 8L) → निधन.

Weight/authority: अनमोल सूत्र — and note "अनेक बार यह देखने को मिलता है", the author's
  observational-experience marker. [AUTHOR'S OWN — empirical claim]
laghu_parashari.combination:
mārakeśa identification; 12th and 8th lords; their sambandhas (yuti/dṛṣṭi/parivartana);
  pāpa/śubha status of the associates.

laghu_parashari.description: सूत्र 26 — ★★ THE TRANSIT-GATED 2ND+7TH RULE — the chapter's capstone ★★
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"द्वितीयेश और सप्तमेश की दशा–अन्तर्दशा और उस समय में यदि शनि की साढ़े साती आती हो या सूर्य पर से
  शनि भ्रमण कर रहा हो तो उस व्यक्ति का निधन हो जाता है।"

Translation: The daśā–antardaśā of the 2nd lord and the 7th lord — and if at that time
  Saturn's Sāḍhe-Sātī is running, or Saturn is transiting over [the natal] Sun — then that person's
  death occurs.
laghu_parashari.effect:
The daśā–antardaśā of the 2nd lord and the 7th lord — and if at that time
  Saturn's Sāḍhe-Sātī is running, or Saturn is transiting over [the natal] Sun — then that person's
  death occurs.

Weight/authority: अनमोल सूत्र — and the final, culminating item of the 26.
laghu_parashari.combination:
lagna → 2nd lord, 7th lord; Vimśottarī MD/AD; transit Saturn's sign relative
  to the natal Moon (for Sāḍhe-Sātī: Saturn in the 12th, 1st or 2nd from Chandra-lagna); transit
  Saturn's longitude vs the natal Sun's longitude/sign.

laghu_parashari.description: the bridge to the examples
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
"यहां 5 उदारहण दे रहे हैं जिनसे आप सरलता से समझ सकते हैं कि जातक कि कुडली में किन ग्रहों की दशा चल रही थी।"

Translation: "Here I give 5 examples, from which you can easily understand which planets'
  daśā was running in the native's kuṇḍalī."
laghu_parashari.effect:
"Here I give 5 examples, from which you can easily understand which planets'
  daśā was running in the native's kuṇḍalī."

laghu_parashari.description: Sun in 1st, Moon in 2nd, Rāhu in 3rd, Jupiter in 4th, Mercury in 6th, Saturn in 7th, Ketu in 9th, Mars in 10th, Venus in 12th. Houses 5, 8, 11 empty.
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
Chapter-head diagram (North-Indian chart, houses numbered 1–12) placed above the
  banner दशाफलाध्यायः. Glyphs as printed: सू. in 1, चं. in 2, रा. in 3, गु. in 4, बु. in 6,
  श. in 7, के. in 9, मं. in 10, शु. in 12.

Translation: Sun in 1st, Moon in 2nd, Rāhu in 3rd, Jupiter in 4th, Mercury in 6th, Saturn in 7th,
  Ketu in 9th, Mars in 10th, Venus in 12th. Houses 5, 8, 11 empty.
laghu_parashari.effect:
No rule is stated. This is the chapter's decorative frontispiece; no analysis text
  accompanies it anywhere on pp.121–131.

Weight/authority: normal (ornamental)
laghu_parashari.combination:
—

Exceptions / caveats: [caveat: do not treat as a worked example — the author draws no inference from it]

laghu_parashari.description: ← अन्तर्दशा फल का अनमोल सूत्र (the "priceless sūtra")
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
अन्तर्दशा फल का अनमोल सूत्र
न दिशेयुर्ग्रहाः सर्वे स्वदशासु स्वभुक्तिषु॥
शुभाशुभफलं नृणामात्मभावानुरूपतः॥29॥

  Author's Hindi anuvāda, verbatim:
अनुवाद–सभी ग्रह अपनी दशा में जब अपनी अन्तर्दशा आती है तब अपने स्वभावानुसार शुभाशुभ फल पूर्ण रूप से
नहीं देते हैं॥उन्तीस॥

  Author's विशेष, verbatim:
विशेष–इस श्लोक में पाराशर जी ने कहा है कि सूर्यादि ग्रह अपनी महादशा में जब उनकी अन्तर्दशा आती है तो
अपने मौलिक स्वभाव के अनुरूप जातक को शुभ या अशुभ फल नहीं देते हैं।
यहां रचयिता का मूल आशय यही है कि ग्रह विशेष की दशा अनेक वर्षों की होती है और उसका शुभाशुभ फल पूर्ण
दशावधि में एक जैसा नहीं रहेगा।
वैसे भी फलित करते समय अनेक तथ्यों को ध्यान रखना पड़ता है। मात्र एक बात या तथ्य के आधार पर फलित नहीं
होता है। सब फल महादशा में ही या किसी एक अन्तर्दशा में ही मिलते हैं, ऐसा समझना उचित नहीं है। *(sentence
completes on p.122)*

Translation: "All the planets do not give men their auspicious/inauspicious results in
  accordance with their own intrinsic nature (ātma-bhāva) during their own daśā combined with their
  own bhukti (antardaśā)." — Commentary: the Sun etc., when their own antardaśā falls inside their own
  mahādaśā, do not give the native the śubha or aśubha result answering to their fundamental nature.
  The author's reading of the intent: a planet's daśā runs many years, and its śubha/aśubha output
  will not be uniform across the whole daśā period.
laghu_parashari.effect:
1. IF MD lord == AD lord (the planet's own bhukti inside its own daśā), THEN that planet does
     not deliver its characteristic śubha/aśubha result in full.
  2. Never predict from a single factor; never assume the whole promise of a planet discharges
     in the mahādaśā as a block, or inside any one antardaśā.
  3. The output of a mahādaśā is non-uniform in time; it is modulated antardaśā by antardaśā.

Weight/authority: अनमोल सूत्र (the author's own heading — "priceless sūtra"). Highest emphasis in the chapter.
laghu_parashari.combination:
current MD lord; current AD lord; the planet's functional nature for the lagna
  (śubha / pāpa / yogakāraka / māraka as fixed by chapters 1–3); identity test MD lord == AD lord.

Exceptions / caveats: This is a suppression rule, not an abolition — see LP-127-1: the AD's own result still
  exists; only the *MD lord's* rājayoga/māraka delivery is withheld in its own AD.

laghu_parashari.description: "In this chapter we will discuss daśā-phala. From the knowledge of daśā-phala the capacity to pronounce results will arise in you."
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
इस अध्याय में दशाफल की चर्चा करेंगे। दशाफल के ज्ञान से आप में फल कहने की सामर्थ्य आएगी।

Translation: "In this chapter we will discuss daśā-phala. From the knowledge of daśā-phala the
  capacity to pronounce results will arise in you."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Chapter framing: daśā-phala is the faculty that converts static chart-reading into
  predictive statement.

Weight/authority: normal
laghu_parashari.combination:
—

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: "The daśā-antardaśā chapter begins from śloka 29. On this subject the author has spoken special ślokas from 29 up to 40."
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
श्लोक 29 से दशान्तर्दशाध्याय प्रारम्भ होता है। इस संबंध में विशेष श्लोक ग्रन्थकार ने 29 से 40 तक कहे हैं।

Translation: "The daśā-antardaśā chapter begins from śloka 29. On this subject the author has
  spoken special ślokas from 29 up to 40."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Scope marker — the daśā-antardaśā doctrine of Laghu Pārāśarī is contained in ślokas 29–40.

—

laghu_parashari.description: "Śloka 29 states a rule regarding daśā, that all planets, when their own antardaśā arrives inside their own mahādaśā, do not give the auspicious result conformi…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
श्लोक 29 में दशा संबंधी एक नियम कहा है कि सभी ग्रह निज महादशा में जब स्वयं की अन्तर्दशा आती है
  तो आत्मभाव के अनुरूप शुभफल नहीं देते हैं। स्पष्ट है कि महादशानाथ और अन्तर्दशानाथ जब एक ही ग्रह होता है तो
  उसका शुभाशुभ फल नहीं मिलता।

Translation: "Śloka 29 states a rule regarding daśā, that all planets, when their own antardaśā
  arrives inside their own mahādaśā, do not give the auspicious result conforming to their ātma-bhāva.
  It is clear that when the mahādaśā lord and antardaśā lord are one and the same planet, its
  śubha/aśubha result is not obtained."
laghu_parashari.effect:
IF MD lord == AD lord THEN neither the śubha nor the aśubha result of that planet is
  obtained. (Explicit restatement of śl. 29 as an identity test.)

Weight/authority: विशेष (bolded by the author in the printed text)
laghu_parashari.combination:
MD lord; AD lord; equality test.

Exceptions / caveats: See LP-127-1 — the antardaśā *as such* still produces some result; what is withheld is
  the MD lord's own characteristic yield.

laghu_parashari.description: There is a statement in the Pārāśarī: *"svadaśāyāṁ svabhuktau ca narāṇāṁ maraṇaṁ na hi"* — "in one's own daśā and one's own bhukti there is indeed no death of m…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
पाराशरी में एक कथन है कि 'स्वदशायां स्वभुक्तौ च नराणां मरणं न हि' इसके अनुसार मारक ग्रह भी
  निज महादशा में स्वयं की अन्तर्दशा आने पर मारक नहीं बनते।

Translation: There is a statement in the Pārāśarī: *"svadaśāyāṁ svabhuktau ca narāṇāṁ maraṇaṁ na hi"*
  — "in one's own daśā and one's own bhukti there is indeed no death of men." Accordingly, even a
  māraka planet does not become a māraka when its own antardaśā comes inside its own mahādaśā.
laghu_parashari.effect:
IF MD lord == AD lord AND that planet is a māraka for the lagna THEN it does
  not act as a māraka in that sub-period. (Death is ruled out for MD-lord = AD-lord windows.)

Weight/authority: विशेष — quoted with attribution to पाराशरी
laghu_parashari.combination:
MD lord; AD lord; māraka status of that planet for the lagna (2nd/7th lordship and
  the book's māraka doctrine from the earlier chapter).

Exceptions / caveats: None stated. Reaffirmed on p.127 ("वह स्वयं की अन्तर्दशा में मारक भी नहीं बनता है").

laghu_parashari.description: "All planets give śubha/aśubha results, but this result keeps being received in different periods of life in lesser or greater measure. One should not suppose t…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
सभी ग्रह शुभाशुभ फल देते हैं परन्तु यह फल जीवन में अलग–अलग अवधियों में अल्प या अधिक प्रमाण में मिलता
  रहता है। सारा फल महादशा में या किसी एक अन्तर्दशा में देते हैं, ऐसा नहीं समझना चाहिए। जातक को जन्म से मृत्यु तक
  ग्रहों के फल नियमित रूप से मिलते रहते हैं।

Translation: "All planets give śubha/aśubha results, but this result keeps being received in
  different periods of life in lesser or greater measure. One should not suppose that they give the
  entire result in the mahādaśā, or in some one antardaśā. From birth to death the native keeps
  receiving the results of the planets regularly."
laghu_parashari.effect:
A planet's promise is distributed across life in varying quanta; do not concentrate the
  whole prediction in one MD or one AD. Every period yields *something*.

Weight/authority: normal
laghu_parashari.combination:
full Vimśottarī sequence for the life; functional nature of each planet.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: ← definition of आत्मभावानुरूप
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
श्लोक में प्रयुक्त आत्माभावानुरूप शब्द से तात्पर्य यह है कि जिस राशि में, जिस भाव का वह स्वामी है, जिस
  भाव में एवं जिस राशि में वह स्थित है उस ग्रह के साथ वह सम्बन्ध करता हो, जिस भाव को देखता हो, जिन ग्रहों से वह दृष्ट हो,
  जो उसका निज स्वभाव, प्रवृत्ति, गुण, दोष या कारकत्व है, इन सब गुण–दोषों का समवाय ऐसा जो है वह इस शब्द में आत्मसात है।

Translation: "The word *ātma-bhāvānurūpa* used in the śloka means: the sign it is in; the house(s)
  of which it is lord; the house and the sign in which it is placed; the planet with which it makes
  sambandha; the house it aspects; the planets by which it is aspected; its own intrinsic nature,
  tendency, qualities, faults, and kārakatva — the aggregate (samavāya) of all these merits and
  defects is what is absorbed in this word."
laghu_parashari.effect:
"According to its own nature" is not natural benefic/malefic status alone. The operative
  nature of a daśā lord = the *composite* of: (i) its sign; (ii) every house it owns; (iii) the house it
  occupies; (iv) the sign it occupies and sambandha with that sign's dispositor; (v) houses it aspects;
  (vi) planets aspecting it; (vii) its intrinsic svabhāva/pravṛtti/guṇa/doṣa; (viii) its natural kārakatva.

Weight/authority: विशेष (it defines the operative term of the अनमोल सूत्र)
laghu_parashari.combination:
for the daśā lord — occupied sign, occupied house, all house lordships, its
  dispositor and whether sambandha exists with it, houses aspected (full-aspect list), aspecting planets,
  natural benefic/malefic status, natural kārakatva.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: ← definition of आत्मसंबंधी ग्रह
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
आत्मसंबंधी ग्रह वे होते हैं जो परस्पर मित्र या दोनों उच्चस्थ या नीचस्थ हों

Translation: "Ātma-sambandhī planets are those which are mutually friends, or both exalted,
  or both debilitated."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Test for "self-related" (ātma-sambandhī) planets — any one of:
  (a) mutual friendship (natural friendship table), OR (b) both planets exalted, OR (c) both debilitated.

Weight/authority: normal (but load-bearing — feeds śl. 30)
laghu_parashari.combination:
natural friendship relation between MD lord and AD lord; exaltation/debilitation
  status of both planets.

Exceptions / caveats: Note this is a different test from the four formal sambandhas of LP-123-2. The
  author uses both: LP-123-2 is *sambandha*, this is *ātma-sambandha*. [caveat: the text does not
  explicitly reconcile the two lists; treat both as qualifying relations.]

laghu_parashari.description: "Some daivajñas hold that in the antardaśā of those planets which have a relation with itself and whose balābala (relative strength) is similar to its own, the …
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
कुछ दैवज्ञ मानते हैं कि निज से जिनका संबंध है और अपने सदृश जिनका बलाबल है उन ग्रहों की अन्तर्दशा में
  भी ग्रह अपने दशा के फल को देते हैं।

Translation: "Some daivajñas hold that in the antardaśā of those planets which have a relation
  with itself and whose balābala (relative strength) is similar to its own, the planet also gives
  the result of its daśā."
laghu_parashari.effect:
[VARIANT VIEW — "कुछ दैवज्ञ"] Add a strength-matching criterion: AD lord qualifies as a
  delivery window if it is (a) in sambandha with MD lord and (b) of comparable balābala.

Weight/authority: normal — attributed to unnamed "some daivajñas", not the author's own position
laghu_parashari.combination:
sambandha between MD and AD lords; ṣaḍbala / balābala of both planets for a
  similarity comparison.

Exceptions / caveats: The author records but does not endorse it.

laghu_parashari.description: "The author has already stated earlier which planet is śubha, which is aśubha, and which planet becomes māraka."
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
ग्रन्थकार ने पूर्व में यह बताया है कि कौन ग्रह शुभ या कौन ग्रह अशुभ है और कौन ग्रह मारक बनता है।

Translation: "The author has already stated earlier which planet is śubha, which is aśubha, and
  which planet becomes māraka."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Cross-reference / prerequisite: the śubha–aśubha–māraka classification per lagna established
  in the earlier chapters is a required input to everything in chapter 4.

Weight/authority: normal
laghu_parashari.combination:
the lagna-wise śubha / aśubha / yogakāraka / māraka table from chapters 1–3.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: ← सधर्मी ग्रहों का दशाफल (śl. 30)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
सधर्मी ग्रहों का दशाफल
आत्मसम्बन्धिनो ये च ये वा निजसधर्मिणः॥
तेषामन्तर्दशास्वेव दिशन्ति स्वदशाफलम्॥30॥

  Author's anuvāda, verbatim:
अनुवाद–जो ग्रह अपने सम्बन्धी या सधर्मी होते हैं उनकी अन्तर्दशा आने पर ही विशेषतया अपने स्वभावानुसार
शुभाशुभ फल देते हैं कहने का तात्पर्य यह है कि दशानाथ जिन ग्रहों के साथ संबंध करता हो और जो–जो ग्रह दशानाथ
सदृश धर्मवाला होकर वैसा ही फल देने वाला हो तो, उसकी अन्तर्दशा में दशानाथ स्वयं की दशा का फल देता है॥तीस॥

  Author's विशेष opening, verbatim:
विशेष–अतः स्पष्ट है कि पाराशर के मतानुसार दशान्तर्दशाओं का सम्पूर्ण फल सम्बन्ध, सधर्म और मिश्रित गुणता
के अनुसार होता है।

Translation: "Those planets which are ātma-sambandhī (self-related) to it, or which are
  nija-sadharmī (of its own like-dharma) — only in their antardaśās do [planets] deliver the
  result of their own daśā." — The author: the daśā lord gives the result of its own daśā in the
  antardaśā of (i) those planets with which the daśā lord makes sambandha, and (ii) those planets
  which, being of like dharma to the daśā lord, give the same kind of result.
  Hence, per Parāśara, the entire result of daśā-antardaśā depends on sambandha, sadharma, and
  miśrita-guṇatā (mixed quality).
laghu_parashari.effect:
The delivery-window selector.
  The MD lord discharges its own daśā-result only in the antardaśā of a planet that satisfies at
  least one of:
  - (a) sambandha: the AD lord is in one of the four formal relations with the MD lord (LP-123-2), or
    is ātma-sambandhī (LP-122-6);
  - (b) sadharma: the AD lord belongs to the same functional lordship class as the MD lord
    (LP-123-3), i.e. gives the same kind of result.

  In all other antardaśās the MD lord's own promise is not specially delivered (see LP-125-3/31 for
  what happens instead).

Weight/authority: विशेष — the author calls it Parāśara's own doctrine and the basis of the whole chapter
laghu_parashari.combination:
MD lord and AD lord identity; the four sambandha tests between them (sign exchange,
  mutual full aspect, aspect-on-planet-in-own-sign, conjunction); natural friendship + exaltation/
  debilitation for ātma-sambandha; the full functional lordship class of each (kendreśa / trikoṇeśa /
  triṣaḍāyeśa / aṣṭameśa / 2nd–12th) for the sadharma test.

Exceptions / caveats: Overridden at the top by śl. 29 (LP-121-2): the MD lord's own AD is excluded even
  though a planet is trivially "sadharmī" with itself.

laghu_parashari.description: ← the four sambandha types
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
यह तो आप जानते ही हैं कि सम्बन्ध चार प्रकार के होते हैं–
1. जब ग्रह परस्पर एक दूसरे की राशि में हों। यह क्षेत्र संबंध है।
2. दोनों ग्रह परस्पर एक दूसरे को पूर्ण दृष्टि से देखते हों। यह दृष्टि संबंध है।
3. जब कोई ग्रह अपनी राशि में स्थित ग्रह को पूर्ण दृष्टि से देखता हो। यह क्षेत्र दृष्टि संबंध है।
4. जब दो ग्रह एक राशि में युति करें। यह युति संबंध है।

  सम्बन्ध की विस्तृत चर्चा अध्याय 2 में श्लोक संख्या 14 के विशेष शीर्षक के अन्तर्गत कर चुके हैं।

Translation: Sambandha is of four kinds:
  1. When the planets are mutually in each other's signs (exchange / parivartana) — this is
     kṣetra sambandha.
  2. When both planets aspect each other with full aspect — this is dṛṣṭi sambandha.
  3. When a planet aspects with full aspect a planet situated in its own sign — this is
     kṣetra-dṛṣṭi sambandha.
  4. When two planets are in conjunction in one sign — this is yuti sambandha.

  (Detailed discussion given in Chapter 2 under the विशेष heading of śloka 14.)
laghu_parashari.effect:
Two planets are "in sambandha" if and only if one of these four holds. This is a closed
  list. Partial/lesser aspects do not qualify — the text specifies पूर्ण दृष्टि (full aspect) in
  types 2 and 3.

Weight/authority: विशेष (closed definitional list)
laghu_parashari.combination:
sign occupied by each of the two planets; their mutual dispositorship; the full-aspect
  matrix (Mars 4/7/8, Jupiter 5/7/9, Saturn 3/7/10, others 7); conjunction (same sign) test.

Exceptions / caveats: Note type 3 is one-directional as stated (planet A aspects planet B who sits in
  A's own sign); it still counts as a sambandha.

laghu_parashari.description: ← definition of सधर्म / सधर्मी (the key concept)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
यहां सधर्म से तात्पर्य है कि जो अपने जैसा हो अर्थात् परस्पर समानता हो। जैसे त्रिकोणेश–त्रिकोणेश,
  त्रिषडायेश–त्रिषडायेश और केन्द्रेश–केन्द्रेश परस्पर सहधर्मी होंगे।

Translation: "Here *sadharma* means that which is like oneself, i.e. there is mutual sameness.
  For example, trikoṇeśa–trikoṇeśa, triṣaḍāyeśa–triṣaḍāyeśa, and kendreśa–kendreśa will be mutually
  *saha-dharmī*."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Two planets are sadharmī iff they belong to the same functional lordship category for that
  lagna. The categories the author instances are:
  - trikoṇeśa = lord of 5th or 9th (and 1st, which is both kendra and trikoṇa)
  - kendreśa = lord of 1st, 4th, 7th, 10th
  - triṣaḍāyeśa = lord of 3rd, 6th, 11th
  - (p.125 extends the list with aṣṭameśa–aṣṭameśa, and pairs 2nd lord with 12th lord)

  Sadharma is NOT natural friendship, NOT same-element, NOT same-benefic-class. It is *sameness of
  functional office for the given lagna* — two planets that "give the same kind of result".

Weight/authority: विशेष — the chapter's title concept (सधर्मी ग्रहों का दशाफल)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign (to fix house lordships); the complete lordship list of MD lord;
  the complete lordship list of AD lord; classification of each lordship as kendra / trikoṇa /
  triṣaḍāya / 8th / 2nd / 12th.

Exceptions / caveats: Since most planets own two houses, a planet can be sadharmī with different planets on
  different lordships; the author does not give a tie-break, so [caveat: where a planet holds two
  offices, both sadharma links must be considered and the composite of LP-122-5 used to weigh them.]

laghu_parashari.description: ← मिश्रित गुणता (mixed quality)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
इसी प्रकार मिश्रित गुणता से तात्पर्य यह है कि लगभग दोनों प्रकार से फल देना अर्थात् मान लो एक ग्रह अशुभ
  है और दूसरा ग्रह सम, तब न तो अशुभ फल ही होगा और न पूर्णतः सम फल ही होगा, अपितु *(p.124)* दोनों ही फल थोड़े–थोड़े
  मिश्रित गुणता के रूप में मिलेंगे।

Translation: "Similarly *miśrita-guṇatā* means giving results of roughly both kinds — i.e. suppose
  one planet is aśubha and the other is sama; then the result will be neither purely aśubha nor entirely
  sama, but both results will be received in small measure, as mixed quality."
laghu_parashari.effect:
IF MD lord and AD lord are of different qualities (e.g. aśubha × sama) THEN the output
  is a proportional blend of both, not the dominance of either.

Weight/authority: विशेष — named by the author as the third of the three determinants (सम्बन्ध, सधर्म, मिश्रित गुणता)
laghu_parashari.combination:
śubha/aśubha/sama classification of MD lord and of AD lord for the lagna.

Exceptions / caveats: Qualified on p.125 (LP-125-1): the author later says the *third, mixed state does not
  survive* when a benefic is defect-laden or a malefic is benefic-linked — those reduce/augment rather
  than create a genuine third category. [The two statements sit in tension; both transcribed.]

laghu_parashari.description: "Therefore, when considering the result of a daśā-antardaśā, one should state only a coordinated (samanvaya-yukta) result, after a total analysis of the full ci…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
अतः दशान्तर्दशा का फल विचारते समय पूर्ण परिस्थिति और विषय का समग्र विश्लेषण करके समन्वययुक्त फल
  ही कहना चाहिए।

Translation: "Therefore, when considering the result of a daśā-antardaśā, one should state only a
  coordinated (samanvaya-yukta) result, after a total analysis of the full circumstance and of the
  subject matter."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Method rule — never emit a raw single-factor verdict for a daśā-antardaśā. Synthesise
  (i) the full situation of both lords per LP-122-5, and (ii) the specific life-area being asked about,
  into one integrated statement.

Weight/authority: विशेष (method directive)
laghu_parashari.combination:
the full composite of LP-122-5 for both MD and AD lord; the specific question/house
  under enquiry.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: ← [COMMENTATOR: ह. न. काटवे]
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
मराठी टीकाकार ह. न. काटवे इस श्लोक का अर्थ इस प्रकार करते हैं–जिस ग्रह के साथ दशानाथ सम्बन्ध करता हो
  और जो–जो ग्रह दशानाथ के समान फल देने वाले हों उनकी अन्तर्दशा में ही दशानाथ अपना फल देता है।

Translation: The Marathi commentator H. N. Kāṭve interprets this śloka thus: "Only in the
  antardaśā of the planet with which the daśā lord makes sambandha, and of those planets which give the
  same result as the daśā lord, does the daśā lord give its own result."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Kāṭve's reading confirms the exclusivity (*ही / eva*) of śl. 30 — the delivery of the MD
  lord's result is restricted to sambandhī and same-result-giving AD lords.

Weight/authority: विशेष — attributed reading, मराठी टीकाकार ह. न. काटवे
laghu_parashari.combination:
as LP-123-1.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: "To grasp this fact you may also put it thus: just as in the world, when relatives come to one's house and when one's co-religionists/like-natured people come, …
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
यह तथ्य समझने के लिए आप इसे यूँ भी कह सकते हैं कि जिस प्रकार संसार में भी अपने घर में संबंधियों के आने पर
  तथा अपने सधर्मियों के आने पर लोग अपने अधिकार के अच्छे पदार्थ उनको दिखलाते हैं, खिलाते हैं, फिर संबंधियों के चले जाने पर
  सामान्य रूप से जीवनयापन करते हैं, उसी प्रकार ग्रह भी अपनी दशा में अपने संबंधी और सधर्मी की अन्तर्दशा के आने पर विशेष रूप
  से अपना दशाफल देते हैं।

Translation: "To grasp this fact you may also put it thus: just as in the world, when relatives
  come to one's house and when one's co-religionists/like-natured people come, people show them and feed
  them the good things at their disposal, and then, after the relatives depart, live ordinarily — in the
  same way planets too, in their own daśā, give their daśā-result in a special manner when the
  antardaśā of their sambandhī and sadharmī arrives."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Interpretive analogy confirming LP-123-1: outside the sambandhī/sadharmī antardaśās, the
  mahādaśā runs at "ordinary living" level — no special output.

Weight/authority: normal (illustrative)
laghu_parashari.combination:
as LP-123-1.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: ← the two delivery conditions, stated as a procedure
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
स्पष्टतः यह ज्ञात होता है कि दशानाथ–
1. जिस ग्रह के साथ संबंध करके कारक योग उत्पन्न करता हो।
अथवा 2. दशानाथ के सदृश समान धर्म वाला होकर उसकी अन्तर्दशा होकर उसकी अन्तर्दशा हो।–इन दो प्रकार में
दशानाथ अपना फल इस प्रकार करेगा–
(क) सम्बन्ध करने वाले ग्रह की अन्तर्दशा में।
(ख) समानधर्मी ग्रह की अन्तर्दशा में।

Translation: "Clearly it is known that the daśā lord — (1) the planet with which, by making
  sambandha, it produces a kāraka-yoga; or (2) [a planet] being of the same dharma as the daśā
  lord, whose antardaśā it is — in these two ways the daśā lord will give its result thus:
  (a) in the antardaśā of the planet making sambandha [with it];
  (b) in the antardaśā of the same-dharma planet."
laghu_parashari.effect:
