Two-branch delivery test. The MD lord delivers its result in AD of X iff
  (a) MD lord and X are in sambandha — and note the author's added qualifier: the sambandha
  produces a kāraka-yoga; OR (b) X is samāna-dharmī (= sadharmī, same functional class) with MD lord.

Weight/authority: विशेष
laghu_parashari.combination:
sambandha test between MD lord and each AD lord; whether that sambandha constitutes
  a kāraka yoga (i.e. a result-producing combination, e.g. kendra–trikoṇa linkage) — requires the
  functional class of both; sadharma test (same lordship category).

Exceptions / caveats: Printed text has a dittography — "उसकी अन्तर्दशा होकर उसकी अन्तर्दशा हो"
  [printer's repetition; sense unaffected]

laghu_parashari.description: "Here a doubt arises: if these are mutually *viruddhadharmī* (of opposed dharma), what will their result be? The author has stated two kinds of planets — one śu…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
यहां यह शंका होती है कि यदि परस्पर ये विरुद्धधर्मी हों तो इनका फल क्या होगा?
  ग्रन्थकार ने दो प्रकार के ग्रह बताए हैं–एक शुभ और दूसरा पाप।

Translation: "Here a doubt arises: if these are mutually *viruddhadharmī* (of opposed dharma), what
  will their result be? The author has stated two kinds of planets — one śubha and the other pāpa."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Poses the problem case (opposed-dharma MD/AD pair) and states the base binary: every planet
  is fundamentally either śubha or pāpa. (Answer given in LP-124-6 / LP-125-1 / śl. 31.)

Weight/authority: normal
laghu_parashari.combination:
śubha/pāpa nature of MD lord and AD lord for the lagna.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: "Whenever a benefic becomes defect-laden (*doṣayukta*), even then its benefic quality is not entirely destroyed — only a reduction occurs in its benefic quality…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
शुभग्रह जब भी दोषयुक्त बनता है तो भी उसका शुभत्व पूर्णतः नष्ट न होकर उसके शुभत्व में कमी आ जाती है।
  इसी प्रकार पापग्रह के विषय में समझना चाहिए। उसका शुभग्रह से सम्बन्ध होता है तो *(p.125)* उसमें शुभत्व आ जाता है,
  परन्तु उसका अपना साधारण पापत्व तो रहता ही है।

Translation: "Whenever a benefic becomes defect-laden (*doṣayukta*), even then its benefic quality
  is not entirely destroyed — only a reduction occurs in its benefic quality. The same should be
  understood in the case of a malefic: when it has sambandha with a benefic, benefic quality enters it,
  but its own ordinary malefic quality does indeed remain."
laghu_parashari.effect:
- IF a śubha graha is doṣayukta THEN śubhatva is *diminished*, never *abolished*.
  - IF a pāpa graha is in sambandha with a śubha graha THEN it *acquires* some śubhatva, but its
    baseline pāpatva persists.

Weight/authority: विशेष — governs how contaminated planets are scored
laghu_parashari.combination:
natural/functional benefic-malefic status of the planet; the defects attaching to it
  (dusthāna lordship, malefic association/aspect); its sambandhas with benefics.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: "The third, mixed condition does not remain."
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
तीसरी मिश्रित स्थित शेष नहीं रहती है।

Translation: "The third, mixed condition does not remain."
laghu_parashari.effect:
After applying LP-124-6, the outcome resolves to either a reduced-benefic or a
  benefic-tinged-but-still-malefic planet — there is no surviving genuinely-neutral third category at
  the level of a single planet's nature.

Weight/authority: विशेष
laghu_parashari.combination:
as LP-124-6.

Exceptions / caveats: Stands in tension with the *miśrita-guṇatā* of LP-123-4, which applies to the
  MD×AD pair, not to a single planet's own nature. [Read: miśrita-guṇatā describes the blended
  output of a pair; it is not a third species of planet.]

laghu_parashari.description: "If the antardaśā lord is a planet making sambandha with the daśā lord, or is of the same dharma, then the daśā lord gives its result in that one's antardaśā."
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
दशानाथ से अन्तर्दशानाथ संबंध करने वाला ग्रह हो या समानधर्मी हो तो दशानाथ अपना फल उस की अन्तर्दशा में
  करता है।

Translation: "If the antardaśā lord is a planet making sambandha with the daśā lord, or is of the
  same dharma, then the daśā lord gives its result in that one's antardaśā."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Restatement of śl. 30 in operational form: deliver(MD) in AD(X) iff sambandha(MD,X) OR sadharmī(MD,X).

Weight/authority: विशेष
laghu_parashari.combination:
as LP-123-1.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: ← the explicit sadharmī pair list
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
यह जान लें कि अकेला ग्रह अपना स्वयं का फल अपने से संबंध रखने वाले ग्रह की अन्तर्दशा में देता है, जो ग्रह
  उसके स्वभाव और गुणों के अनुकूल है। अतः संबंध होने से परस्पर मित्र ग्रह परस्पर की अन्तर्दशा में, उच्चस्थ–नीचस्थ ग्रह
  परस्पर की दशान्तर्दशा में, त्रिकोणेश–त्रिकोणेश की दशान्तर्दशा में, केन्द्रेश–केन्द्रेश की दशान्तर्दशा में, त्रिषडायेश–त्रिषडायेश
  की दशान्तर्दशा में या अष्टमेश–अष्टमेश की दशान्तर्दशा में अपने फल देते हैं। यदि परस्पर संबंध हो तो एक दूसरे की दशान्तर्दशा
  में योगकारक फल देते हैं अर्थात् पापग्रह दूसरे पापग्रह की अन्तर्दशा में, शुभग्रह शुभग्रह की अन्तर्दशा में, समग्रह समग्रह
  की अन्तर्दशा में, द्वितीयेश द्वादशेश की अन्तर्दशा में अपने फल देता है। यदि ये परस्पर संबंधित न हों तो।

Translation: "Know that a lone planet gives its own result in the antardaśā of a planet related
  to it which is congenial to its nature and qualities. Hence, sambandha being present, they give
  their results: mutual friends in each other's antardaśā; an exalted and a debilitated planet in each
  other's daśā-antardaśā; trikoṇeśa–trikoṇeśa; kendreśa–kendreśa; triṣaḍāyeśa–triṣaḍāyeśa; or
  aṣṭameśa–aṣṭameśa in each other's daśā-antardaśā. If there is mutual sambandha, they give
  yogakāraka results in each other's daśā-antardaśā — that is, a malefic in another malefic's
  antardaśā, a benefic in a benefic's antardaśā, a neutral in a neutral's antardaśā, the 2nd lord in the
  12th lord's antardaśā gives its result. If these are not mutually related, then [see śl. 31]."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Enumerated sadharmī/congenial pairs (the delivery whitelist):

  | # | Pair | Basis |
  |---|---|---|
  | 1 | mutual natural friends | friendship |
  | 2 | exalted planet ↔ debilitated planet | ātma-sambandha (LP-122-6) |
  | 3 | trikoṇeśa ↔ trikoṇeśa | same functional class |
  | 4 | kendreśa ↔ kendreśa | same functional class |
  | 5 | triṣaḍāyeśa ↔ triṣaḍāyeśa | same functional class |
  | 6 | aṣṭameśa ↔ aṣṭameśa | same functional class |
  | 7 | pāpa graha ↔ pāpa graha | same nature |
  | 8 | śubha graha ↔ śubha graha | same nature |
  | 9 | sama graha ↔ sama graha | same nature |
  | 10 | 2nd lord ↔ 12th lord | paired class |

  IF any such pair is additionally in mutual sambandha, THEN they give yogakāraka results
  in each other's daśā-antardaśā.

Weight/authority: विशेष — this is the operative lookup table for śl. 30
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; complete house-lordship list of MD lord and AD lord; natural friendship
  relation; exaltation/debilitation status of both; śubha/pāpa/sama classification of both for the lagna;
  the four sambandha tests between them.

Exceptions / caveats: The pairing "exalted ↔ debilitated" is counter-intuitive but is stated twice
  (here and LP-122-6) — it is deliberate, not a misprint.

laghu_parashari.description: ← शुभाशुभ प्रकृति के अनुरूप दशाफल (śl. 31)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
शुभाशुभ प्रकृति के अनुरूप दशाफल
इतरेषां दशानाथविरूद्धफलदायिनाम्॥
तत्तत्फलानुगुण्येन फलान्यूह्यानि सूरिभिः॥31॥

  Author's anuvāda, verbatim:
अनुवाद–इस प्रकार दशाधीश के विरूद्ध फल देने वाले अन्य ग्रहों की अन्तर्दशा में उनके शुभ या अशुभ प्रकृति के
अनुरूप ही विद्वानों को फल जानना चाहिए॥इकतीस॥

Translation: "For the others, who give results opposed to the daśā lord — the learned should
  infer the results in accordance with the quality of the respective result [of those planets
  themselves]." — i.e. in the antardaśā of other planets that give results contrary to the daśā lord,
  the learned should know the result according to the śubha or aśubha nature of those [AD] planets
  themselves.
laghu_parashari.effect:
The fallback rule. IF the AD lord is not sambandhī and not sadharmī with the
  MD lord (i.e. it is viruddhadharmī / "other") THEN the result of that antardaśā is read from the
  AD lord's own śubha/aśubha nature, not from the MD lord's promise. The MD lord contributes nothing
  special in such an antardaśā.

Weight/authority: विशेष — the second half of the master procedure (complement of śl. 30)
laghu_parashari.combination:
MD lord and AD lord; sambandha test; sadharma test (both negative); the AD lord's
  own śubha/aśubha functional nature for the lagna.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: ← the three dharma classes
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
विशेष–यहां सार तत्त्व यह है कि ग्रह समान धर्म वाले हो सकते हैं जिन्हें सधर्मी कहेंगे, विरोधी धर्म
  वाले भी हो सकते हैं जिन्हें विरूद्ध धर्मी कहेंगे और न शुभ न अशुभ अर्थात् न तो विरोध करते हैं और न समधर्मी ही रहते हैं
  जिन्हें समधर्मी कहेंगे।

Translation: "The essence here is that planets may be of the same dharma — these we call
  *sadharmī*; they may also be of opposed dharma — these we call *viruddhadharmī*; and [there are
  those] neither śubha nor aśubha, i.e. they neither oppose nor remain [fully] of the same dharma —
  these we call *samadharmī*."
laghu_parashari.combination:
functional class and śubha/pāpa nature of MD lord and AD lord for the lagna.

Exceptions / caveats: The printed definition of समधर्मी is self-referentially awkward
  ("न तो विरोध करते हैं और न समधर्मी ही रहते हैं") [read as: neither opposed nor sadharmī]

laghu_parashari.description: ← consolidated summary of ślokas 29–31, item 1
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
विगत् तीनों श्लोकों का सारांश करें तो ग्रह अपना शुभाशुभ फल अन्तर्दशाओं में इस प्रकार देगा–
1. दशाधीश से सम्बन्धित सधर्मी ग्रह की अन्तर्दशा शुभ फलदायी होगी *(p.126)*। दशाधीश में अधिमित्र एवं मित्र
ग्रह की अन्तर्दशा शुभ फलदायी ही होगी।

Translation: "Summarising the last three ślokas, a planet will give its śubha/aśubha result in the
  antardaśās thus: 1. The antardaśā of a sadharmī planet related to the daśā lord will be
  śubha-phaladāyī. The antardaśā of an *adhimitra* (great friend) and *mitra* (friend) planet of the
  daśā lord will certainly be śubha-phaladāyī."
laghu_parashari.effect:
IF AD lord is sambandhita AND sadharmī with MD lord THEN the antardaśā is
  auspicious. IF AD lord is the MD lord's adhimitra or mitra THEN the antardaśā is
  definitely auspicious (emphatic *ही*).

Weight/authority: विशेष (author's own consolidated summary)
laghu_parashari.combination:
sambandha test; sadharma test; the five-fold friendship grade of AD lord w.r.t.
  MD lord (adhimitra / mitra / sama / śatru / adhiśatru) — i.e. the *pañcadhā maitrī* combining natural
  and temporal friendship.

Exceptions / caveats: Subject to the śl. 29 override (MD lord == AD lord).

laghu_parashari.description: ← summary item 2
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
2. दशाधीश से सम्बन्धित समधर्मी ग्रह की अन्तर्दशा मध्यम फलदायी होगी। दशाधीश में सम ग्रह की
  अन्तर्दशा सामान्य फलदायी होगी।

Translation: "2. The antardaśā of a *samadharmī* planet related to the daśā lord will be
  madhyama-phaladāyī (middling in result). The antardaśā of a *sama* (neutral-friendship) planet of
  the daśā lord will be sāmānya-phaladāyī (ordinary in result)."
laghu_parashari.effect:
IF AD lord is sambandhita AND samadharmī with MD lord THEN result is middling.
  IF AD lord is graded *sama* in friendship to MD lord THEN result is ordinary.

Weight/authority: विशेष (author's consolidated summary)
laghu_parashari.combination:
sambandha test; dharma class of AD lord vs MD lord; pañcadhā-maitrī grade of AD lord
  w.r.t. MD lord.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: ← summary item 3
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
3. दशाधीश से सम्बन्धित विरूद्धधर्मी ग्रह की अन्तर्दशा अपनी प्रकृति के अनुसार अशुभ फलदायी होती है।
  दशाधीश में शत्रु और अधिशत्रु ग्रह की अन्तर्दशा अशुभ फलदायी ही होती है।

Translation: "3. The antardaśā of a *viruddhadharmī* planet related to the daśā lord is
  aśubha-phaladāyī according to its own nature. The antardaśā of a śatru (enemy) and adhiśatru
  (great enemy) planet of the daśā lord is certainly aśubha-phaladāyī."
laghu_parashari.effect:
IF AD lord is viruddhadharmī with MD lord THEN result is inauspicious, graded
  by the AD lord's own nature (linking to śl. 31). IF AD lord is śatru/adhiśatru to MD lord
  THEN the antardaśā is definitely inauspicious (emphatic *ही*).

Weight/authority: विशेष (author's consolidated summary)

laghu_parashari.description: ← the five-level administrative hierarchy
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
दशाफल कहते समय यह बात ध्यान में रखनी चाहिए–
महादशानाथ शुभाशुभ फल देने वाला वरिष्ठ अधिकारी है।
वह अपना शासन अन्तर्दशानाथ, प्रत्यन्तर्दशानाथ, सूक्ष्मदशानाथ और प्राणदशानाथ नामक चार कनिष्ठ अधिकारियों
के द्वारा चलाता है।
इस प्रक्रिया में प्रत्येक कनिष्ठ अधिकारी अपने–अपने अधिकार, अवधि एवं बलानुसार कम या अधिक शुभाशुभ फल
प्रदान करता है।

Translation: "When pronouncing daśā results this should be kept in mind: the mahādaśā lord is the
  senior officer who gives the śubha/aśubha result. He runs his administration through four junior
  officers named the antardaśā lord, pratyantardaśā lord, sūkṣmadaśā lord and prāṇadaśā lord. In
  this process each junior officer bestows lesser or greater śubha/aśubha result according to his own
  authority, duration and strength."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Five-level model of daśā delivery: MD (senior) → AD → PD (pratyantar) → sūkṣma → prāṇa (four
  juniors). Each level's output is scaled by that level's (i) adhikāra (authority/jurisdiction),
  (ii) avadhi (duration), (iii) bala (strength).

Weight/authority: विशेष — the author's own governing metaphor for the whole chapter
laghu_parashari.combination:
the full five-level Vimśottarī sub-division for the date in question (MD, AD,
  PD, sūkṣma, prāṇa lords); duration of each; strength (bala) of each lord.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: "Within the mahādaśā lord, the daśā-duration of each officer progressively decreases — the antardaśā is shorter than the mahādaśā, the pratyantardaśā shorter th…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
महादशानाथ में प्रत्येक अधिकारी की दशावधि क्रमशः कम होती जाती है। कहने का तात्पर्य यह है कि महादशा
  से कम अवधि अन्तर्दशा की, अन्तर्दशा से कम अवधि प्रत्यन्तर्दशा की, प्रत्यन्तर्दशा से कम अवधि सूक्ष्मदशा की, सूक्ष्मदशा से कम
  अवधि प्राणदशा की होती है। इसी प्रकार इनके बल में भी न्यूनता आती जाती है।

Translation: "Within the mahādaśā lord, the daśā-duration of each officer progressively
  decreases — the antardaśā is shorter than the mahādaśā, the pratyantardaśā shorter than the
  antardaśā, the sūkṣmadaśā shorter than the pratyantardaśā, the prāṇadaśā shorter than the sūkṣmadaśā.
  In the same way, a diminution also enters into their strength."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Strength decays monotonically with level. MD > AD > PD > sūkṣma > prāṇa, in both duration
  and force of effect. Consequence for practice: the magnitude of an event is set by the highest
  level that supports it; the lower levels only refine the moment.

Weight/authority: विशेष
laghu_parashari.combination:
the level at which a promising combination occurs (MD / AD / PD / sūkṣma / prāṇa).

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: ← the independence rule for unrelated opposed sub-lords
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
कनिष्ठ अधिकारी वरिष्ठ अधिकारी की प्रकृति व प्रमाण में सम धर्मी हों या विरूद्ध धर्मी हों, वरिष्ठ अधिकारी के
  कहने पर ही शासन चलाते हैं लेकिन यदि विरूद्ध धर्मी कनिष्ठ अधिकारी वरिष्ठ अधिकारी से सम्बन्ध नहीं करता हो तो
  विरूद्ध धर्मी कनिष्ठ अधिकारी स्वतन्त्र रहता है और उसके ऊपर वरिष्ठ अधिकारी का कोई शासन नहीं चलता है।

Translation: "Whether the junior officers are *samadharmī* or *viruddhadharmī* to the senior officer
  in nature and in measure, they run the administration only on the senior officer's word — but if a
  viruddhadharmī junior officer does not make sambandha with the senior officer, then that viruddhadharmī
  junior officer remains INDEPENDENT, and no rule of the senior officer operates over him."
laghu_parashari.effect:
The autonomy condition.
  - IF AD/PD/sūkṣma/prāṇa lord is samadharmī with the MD lord — OR is viruddhadharmī but in
    sambandha with it — THEN it operates under the MD lord's control; its output is subordinated
    to and coloured by the MD lord.
  - IF the sub-lord is viruddhadharmī AND has no sambandha with the MD lord — THEN it is
    fully independent; the MD lord exercises no control over it, and the sub-period delivers the
    sub-lord's own agenda outright.

Weight/authority: विशेष — this is the escape-clause that lets a bad AD ruin a good MD
laghu_parashari.combination:
MD lord; sub-period lord at the relevant level; dharma class of the sub-lord
  relative to the MD lord; the four sambandha tests between MD lord and sub-lord.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: "Whether or not the junior officer called the antardaśā lord will be one who does the senior officer's work — even so, the senior officer takes no special care …
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
अन्तर्दशा नाथ नामक कनिष्ठ अधिकारी वरिष्ठ अधिकारी का कार्य करने वाला होगा या नहीं, फिर भी वरिष्ठ
  अधिकारी अपनी स्वयं की अन्तर्दशा में फल देने की विशेष चिन्ता नहीं करता।

Translation: "Whether or not the junior officer called the antardaśā lord will be one who does the
  senior officer's work — even so, the senior officer takes no special care to give results in his own
  antardaśā."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Reinforces śl. 29: independently of the AD lord's cooperativeness, the MD lord makes no
  special effort to produce results during its own antardaśā.

Weight/authority: normal (restatement)
laghu_parashari.combination:
MD lord; AD lord; identity test.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: "It should absolutely not be assumed here that within the mahādaśā lord the antardaśā lord has no result at all. The antardaśā's own result does indeed remain. …
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
यहां यह बिल्कुल नहीं मान लेना चाहिए कि महादशानाथ में अन्तर्दशा नाथ का बिल्कुल फल होता ही नहीं।
  अन्तर्दशा का फल तो रहता ही है। तात्पर्य यह है कि महादशानाथ अपने स्वयं की अन्तर्दशा में राजयोग का फल नहीं देता
  उसी प्रकार वह स्वयं की अन्तर्दशा में मारक भी नहीं बनता है।

Translation: "It should absolutely not be assumed here that within the mahādaśā lord the antardaśā
  lord has no result at all. The antardaśā's own result does indeed remain. The purport is that the
  mahādaśā lord does not give the result of a rājayoga in its own antardaśā; in the same way, it
  does not become a māraka in its own antardaśā either."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Precise scope of the śl. 29 suppression. In an MD-lord = AD-lord window:
  - the antardaśā's ordinary result still occurs;
  - what is withheld is specifically the MD lord's rājayoga delivery and its māraka action.
  So: no crowning success, and no death — but not nothing.

Weight/authority: विशेष — this is the correction that makes śl. 29 usable rather than paralysing

laghu_parashari.description: "Know also that if the mahādaśā lord is śubha and the antardaśā lord is a giver of aśubha results, then it [the period] will give aśubha; and if [the AD lord] i…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
यह भी जान लें कि महादशानाथ शुभ हो और अन्तर्दशा नाथ अशुभ फल दाता हो तो वह अशुभ और यदि
  शुभफल दाता हो तो शुभ फल ही करेगा।

Translation: "Know also that if the mahādaśā lord is śubha and the antardaśā lord is a giver of
  aśubha results, then it [the period] will give aśubha; and if [the AD lord] is a giver of śubha
  results, then it will give only śubha."
laghu_parashari.effect:
The AD lord decides the sign of the result. Given a benefic MD lord, the polarity
  (auspicious vs inauspicious) of the sub-period is set by the AD lord's result-giving nature, not by
  the MD lord's. A good mahādaśā does not immunise a bad antardaśā.

Weight/authority: विशेष — operationally decisive
laghu_parashari.combination:
MD lord's śubha/aśubha status for the lagna; AD lord's śubha/aśubha
  result-giving status for the lagna.

Exceptions / caveats: Read together with LP-126-5: a viruddhadharmī AD lord *in sambandha* with the MD lord is
  moderated by the MD lord; an unrelated one is not.

laghu_parashari.description: ← the six-cell grid of antardaśā types
laghu_parashari.effect:
Every MD×AD pair falls into exactly one of six cells, formed by the cross-product of
  sambandha {present, absent} × dharma {sadharmī, samadharmī, viruddhadharmī}. This is the
  classification step of the timing procedure.

Weight/authority: विशेष / सर्वोत्तम — the single most reusable object on these pages
laghu_parashari.combination:
MD lord; AD lord; the four sambandha tests between them (LP-123-2) plus ātma-sambandha
  (LP-122-6); the dharma class of AD lord relative to MD lord (LP-123-3 / LP-125-5), which itself needs
  the lagna and the complete lordship list of both planets.

Exceptions / caveats: Cell "related sadharmī" excludes the case AD lord == MD lord, which is governed by
  śl. 29 (LP-121-2 / LP-127-1).

laghu_parashari.description: ← the magnitude ladder (ranking of the six cells)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
जो ग्रह सम्बन्धित होकर सधर्मी है उसकी अन्तर्दशा में अधिक फल, समधर्मी में उससे कम फल एवं
  विरूद्धधर्मी में उससे कम फल मिलता है। इससे भी कम असम्बन्धित सधर्मी में, उससे कम फल असम्बन्धित समधर्मी
  में एवं सबसे कम फल असम्बन्धित विरूद्ध धर्मी में मिलता है।

Translation: "In the antardaśā of a planet that is related and sadharmī, the greatest result
  is obtained; in a samadharmī [related], less than that; in a viruddhadharmī [related],
  less than that. Less still in an unrelated sadharmī; less than that in an unrelated
  samadharmī; and the least result in an unrelated viruddhadharmī."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Strict magnitude ordering of the six cells (most → least result delivered):

  | Rank | Cell | Magnitude of result |
  |---|---|---|
  | 1 | सम्बन्धित सधर्मी — related + same-dharma | अधिक फल (greatest) |
  | 2 | सम्बन्धित समधर्मी — related + neutral-dharma | less |
  | 3 | सम्बन्धित विरूद्धधर्मी — related + opposed-dharma | less still |
  | 4 | असम्बन्धित सधर्मी — unrelated + same-dharma | less still |
  | 5 | असम्बन्धित समधर्मी — unrelated + neutral-dharma | less still |
  | 6 | असम्बन्धित विरूद्धधर्मी — unrelated + opposed-dharma | सबसे कम फल (least) |

  Note the ordering is sambandha-dominant: *every* related cell outranks *every* unrelated cell.
  Sambandha matters more than dharma-class.
  Note also this ladder ranks magnitude / quantity of result, not its polarity; polarity comes from
  LP-127-2 and LP-126-1/2/3.

Weight/authority: विशेष / सर्वोत्तम
laghu_parashari.combination:
as LP-127-3.

Exceptions / caveats: The author immediately adds: "इस चर्चा से श्लोक 30 व 31 का अर्थ सरलता से समझ आ जाएगा" —
  this ladder *is* the practical reading of ślokas 30 and 31.

laghu_parashari.description: ← केन्द्रेश और त्रिकोणेश की दशा का फल (śl. 32)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
केन्द्रेश और त्रिकोणेश की दशा का फल
स्वदशायां त्रिकोणेशभुक्तौ केन्द्रपतिः शुभम्॥
दिशेत्सोऽपि तथा नो चेदसंबंधेन पापकृत्॥32॥

  Author's anuvāda, verbatim (p.127 → p.128):
अनुवाद–केन्द्रेश अपनी व त्रिकोणेश की अन्तर्दशा में शुभफल देता है और त्रिकोणेश अपनी व केन्द्रेश की अन्तर्दशा में
शुभफल देता है, यदि दोनों में परस्पर सम्बन्ध हों। *(p.128)* यदि परस्पर सम्बन्ध न हों और केन्द्रेश या त्रिकोणेश
में दोष(त्रिषडायेश या अशुभ भावेश भी हो) तो अशुभ फल होता है॥बत्तीस॥

Translation: "The kendra-pati (kendreśa) gives an auspicious result in his own daśā during the
  trikoṇeśa's bhukti; and he too (the trikoṇeśa) likewise [gives an auspicious result in his own
  daśā during the kendreśa's bhukti] — if not so, [i.e.] by absence of sambandha, [he becomes]
  pāpakṛt." — Author: the kendreśa gives śubha result in its own antardaśā and in the trikoṇeśa's
  antardaśā, and the trikoṇeśa gives śubha result in its own and in the kendreśa's antardaśā, provided
  there is mutual sambandha between the two. If there is no mutual sambandha, and the kendreśa or
  trikoṇeśa carries a doṣa (i.e. is also a triṣaḍāyeśa or lord of an inauspicious house), then the
  result is inauspicious.
laghu_parashari.effect:
The kendra–trikoṇa daśā rule.
  - IF kendreśa and trikoṇeśa are in mutual sambandha THEN each gives auspicious results in
    its own mahādaśā during the other's antardaśā (both directions).
  - IF there is no mutual sambandha AND either of them is doṣayukta (also owns a
    triṣaḍāya house — 3/6/11 — or another inauspicious house) THEN the result is inauspicious.

Weight/authority: विशेष — dedicated section heading
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; identity of the kendreśas (lords of 1, 4, 7, 10) and trikoṇeśas (lords of
  5, 9); the other house each of them owns (to test for triṣaḍāya / 8th / 12th contamination); the
  four sambandha tests between the pair; current MD lord and AD lord.

Exceptions / caveats: Heavily qualified on pp.128–129 (LP-128-3 … LP-129-3): the trikoṇeśa is exempted from
  *pāpakṛt* status, and a clean kendreśa gives śubha even without sambandha.

laghu_parashari.description: ← definitions and the no-contamination condition
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
विशेष–त्रिकोणेश(5 व 9वें भाव के स्वामी ग्रह) अपनी व केन्द्रेश(1, 4, 7, 10वें भाव के स्वामी ग्रह)
  की अन्तर्दशा में परस्पर संबंध होने पर शुभफल देता है। इसी प्रकार केन्द्रेश अपनी और त्रिकोणेश की अन्तर्दशा में परस्पर सम्बन्ध
  होने पर शुभफल देता है। लेकिन यहां यह ध्यान रखना अत्यावश्यक है कि केन्द्रेश व त्रिकोणेश का त्रिषडायेश(3, 6, 11वें भाव
  के स्वामी ग्रह) या अशुभ भावेशों से सम्बन्ध न हो।

Translation: "Trikoṇeśa (the lords of the 5th and 9th houses) gives an auspicious result in its
  own and in the kendreśa's (lords of the 1st, 4th, 7th, 10th houses) antardaśā when there is mutual
  sambandha. Likewise the kendreśa gives an auspicious result in its own and in the trikoṇeśa's antardaśā
  when there is mutual sambandha. But here it is absolutely essential to note that the kendreśa and
  trikoṇeśa must NOT have sambandha with a triṣaḍāyeśa (lords of the 3rd, 6th, 11th houses) or with
  inauspicious house-lords."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Definitions (fixed by the author):
  - केन्द्रेश (kendreśa) = lord of house 1, 4, 7 or 10
  - त्रिकोणेश (trikoṇeśa) = lord of house 5 or 9
  - त्रिषडायेश (triṣaḍāyeśa) = lord of house 3, 6 or 11

  Contamination veto: for the kendra–trikoṇa auspiciousness to hold, neither planet may be in
  sambandha with a triṣaḍāyeśa or with an aśubha-bhāva lord.

Weight/authority: विशेष — the author marks it अत्यावश्यक ("absolutely essential")
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; house lordships of all planets; the sambandhas of the kendreśa and of the
  trikoṇeśa with every triṣaḍāyeśa and every aśubha-bhāva lord (using the four sambandha tests).

Exceptions / caveats: Softened on p.128–129 for the trikoṇeśa specifically (LP-128-5, LP-129-1).

laghu_parashari.description: ← conclusion 1 (trikoṇeśa)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
यहां निष्कर्ष निम्नलिखित रूप में निकलता है–
1. त्रिकोणेश अपनी व केन्द्रेश की अन्तर्दशा में परस्पर शुभ सम्बन्ध होने पर शुभफलदायी होता है। लेकिन
त्रिकोणेश व केन्द्रेश में परस्पर अशुभ सम्बन्ध(त्रिषडायेश या अशुभ भावेशों से भी किसी न किसी रूप में सम्बन्ध रखता है)
तो अशुभ फल ही देगा।

Translation: "The conclusion emerges as follows: 1. The trikoṇeśa, in its own and in the
  kendreśa's antardaśā, is auspicious when there is mutual auspicious sambandha. But if the trikoṇeśa
  and kendreśa have mutually inauspicious sambandha (i.e. one of them holds a sambandha in some form
  with a triṣaḍāyeśa or with inauspicious house-lords), it will give only an inauspicious result."
laghu_parashari.effect:
IF trikoṇeśa ↔ kendreśa sambandha is "clean" (neither carrying a triṣaḍāyeśa/aśubha-bhāveśa
  link) THEN trikoṇeśa's MD with kendreśa AD (and trikoṇeśa's own AD) is auspicious.
  IF either carries a triṣaḍāyeśa / aśubha-bhāveśa link THEN the period gives only
  inauspicious result.

Weight/authority: विशेष (author's own निष्कर्ष)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna; lord of 5th/9th; lord of 1/4/7/10; sambandha between them; and each one's
  sambandhas with 3rd/6th/11th lords and other aśubha-bhāva lords; current MD/AD lords.

Exceptions / caveats: Contradicted in the trikoṇeśa's favour on p.129 (LP-129-1: "त्रिकोणेश की अन्तर्दशा सदैव
  शुभफलदायी होती है"). Both positions transcribed.

laghu_parashari.description: ← conclusion 2 (kendreśa) [TEXTUAL PROBLEM]
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
2. केन्द्रेश अपनी व केन्द्रेश की अन्तर्दशा में परस्पर शुभ सम्बन्ध होने पर शुभफलदायी होता है। लेकिन
  केन्द्रेश व त्रिकोणेश में परस्पर अशुभ सम्बन्ध(त्रिषडायेश या अशुभ भावेशों से भी किसी न किसी रूप में सम्बन्ध रखता है)
  तो अशुभ फल ही देगा।

Translation: "2. The kendreśa, in its own and in the kendreśa's [sic] antardaśā, is
  auspicious when there is mutual auspicious sambandha. But if the kendreśa and trikoṇeśa have mutually
  inauspicious sambandha (holding a sambandha in some form with a triṣaḍāyeśa or with inauspicious
  house-lords), it will give only an inauspicious result."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Mirror of LP-128-2 for the kendreśa: clean mutual sambandha → auspicious; contaminated
  sambandha → only inauspicious.

Weight/authority: विशेष (author's own निष्कर्ष)
laghu_parashari.combination:
as LP-128-2, roles reversed.

Exceptions / caveats: [unclear / probable misprint: the first clause reads "केन्द्रेश अपनी व केन्द्रेश की
  अन्तर्दशा में". Both the parallel with conclusion 1 and the second sentence of the same paragraph
  ("केन्द्रेश व त्रिकोणेश में") and śloka 32 itself require त्रिकोणेश — i.e. "the kendreśa, in its own
  and in the TRIKOṆEŚA's antardaśā". Transcribed verbatim; read as त्रिकोणेश.]

laghu_parashari.description: ← the clean-kendreśa exemption and the paapa-contamination switch
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
कहने का तात्पर्य यह है कि केन्द्रेश अशुभ फल देने वाला नहीं हो तो वह केन्द्रेश अपनी महादशा में,
  त्रिकोणेश की अन्तर्दशा में, दोनों ग्रहों के मध्य सम्बन्ध न रहते हुए भी वह शुभफल देने वाला होता है।
  केन्द्रेश का पापग्रह से सम्बन्ध बनता हो तो वह पापफल देने वाला बनता है।
  यदि त्रिकोणेश का केन्द्रेश के साथ सम्बन्ध बनता हो तो वह कभी भी पापग्रह नहीं बनता है।

Translation: "The purport is this: if the kendreśa is not a giver of inauspicious results, then
  that kendreśa, in its own mahādaśā during the trikoṇeśa's antardaśā, is a giver of auspicious results
  EVEN THOUGH there is no sambandha between the two planets. If the kendreśa forms a sambandha with a
  malefic, then it becomes a giver of malefic results. If the trikoṇeśa forms a sambandha with the
  kendreśa, then it never becomes a malefic."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Three sub-rules that resolve the kendra–trikoṇa question:
  1. Sambandha is not required when the kendreśa is uncontaminated: a clean kendreśa's MD + trikoṇeśa's
     AD = auspicious, sambandha or not.
  2. IF kendreśa is in sambandha with a pāpagraha THEN the kendreśa becomes a pāpaphala-giver
     — this is the switch that flips the pair to inauspicious.
  3. IF trikoṇeśa is in sambandha with a kendreśa THEN the trikoṇeśa never becomes a malefic
     (kendra–trikoṇa linkage permanently purifies the trikoṇeśa).

Weight/authority: विशेष — this is the author's actual resolution of śl. 32
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna; kendreśa identity and whether it gives aśubha results (its other lordship
  + its sambandhas with pāpagrahas); trikoṇeśa identity; sambandha between kendreśa and trikoṇeśa;
  sambandha of kendreśa with any pāpagraha.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: ← trikoṇeśa cannot become a pāpagraha (only doṣayukta)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
त्रिकोणेश का स्वामी होकर षष्ठ तथा अष्टम भाव का स्वामी भी बनता हो तब भी वह पापग्रह नहीं बनता है,
  दोषयुक्त मात्र बनता है। त्रिकोणेश अन्य दोषयुक्त भावों (तीसरे व एकादश) का स्वामी बनना सम्भव ही नहीं।
  बत्तीसवें श्लोक में जो 'पापकृत्' पद आया है वह केन्द्रेश पर ही लागू होता है।

Translation: "Even if, being lord of a trikoṇa, [a planet] also becomes lord of the 6th and 8th
  houses, even then it does not become a malefic — it becomes merely *doṣayukta* (defect-laden).
  It is simply not possible for a trikoṇeśa to become lord of the other defect-bearing houses (the 3rd
  and the 11th). The word 'pāpakṛt' that occurs in the thirty-second śloka applies only to the
  kendreśa."
laghu_parashari.effect:
1. A trikoṇeśa that additionally owns the 6th or 8th is doṣayukta, not a pāpagraha.
  2. A trikoṇeśa can never additionally own the 3rd or 11th (structurally impossible in the
     zodiacal lordship scheme).
  3. The term *pāpakṛt* in śl. 32 attaches exclusively to the kendreśa — never to the trikoṇeśa.

Weight/authority: विशेष — a doctrinal ruling that fixes the reading of the śloka
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; the second house owned by the 5th/9th lord.

Exceptions / caveats: Sub-rule 2 is the author's structural claim; it holds for the standard 12-sign lordship
  scheme where 5th/9th lords cannot simultaneously own 3rd/11th.

laghu_parashari.description: ← trikoṇeśa's antardaśā is ALWAYS auspicious
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
*(p.128)* त्रिकोणेश के साथ सम्बन्ध नहीं करने *(p.129)* वाले पापी केन्द्रेश की महादशा में त्रिकोणेश की
  अन्तर्दशा शुभफलदायी बनती है।
  ग्रन्थकार का आशय है कि पापी केन्द्रेश महादशा में त्रिकोणेश सम्बन्ध नहीं करता हो तो भी वह शुभफल देने वाला होता है।
  निष्कर्षतः त्रिकोणेश की अन्तर्दशा सदैव शुभफलदायी होती है।

Translation: "In the mahādaśā of a malefic kendreśa that makes no sambandha with the trikoṇeśa,
  the trikoṇeśa's antardaśā becomes auspicious. The author's intent is that even in a malefic
  kendreśa's mahādaśā, though the trikoṇeśa makes no sambandha, it is still a giver of auspicious
  results. Conclusively: the trikoṇeśa's antardaśā is ALWAYS auspicious."
laghu_parashari.effect:
IF AD lord is a trikoṇeśa (lord of 5th or 9th) THEN the antardaśā is auspicious —
  unconditionally, regardless of (a) whether the MD-lord kendreśa is malefic, and (b) whether any
  sambandha exists between them.

Weight/authority: विशेष / निष्कर्षतः — the author's flat conclusion, stated as universal (सदैव)
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; identity of the 5th and 9th lords; current AD lord.

Exceptions / caveats: Immediately qualified by LP-129-2 and LP-129-3: a trikoṇeśa that is also lord of a
  pāpa-bhāva can be *pāpakṛt* / *doṣayukta*, and if both kendreśa and trikoṇeśa are pāpakṛt the
  auspicious result fails.

laghu_parashari.description: ← when a trikoṇeśa CAN be pāpakṛt: the four-lagna list
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
क्या त्रिकोणेश पापकृत हो सकता है? त्रिकोणेश यदि पापभाव का भी स्वामी हो तब वह पापकृत हो सकता है।
  उसे दोषयुक्त कह सकते हैं।
जैसे सिंह लगन में पंचमेश, अष्टमेश गुरु।
कुम्भ लगन में पंचमेश, अष्टमेश बुध।
कन्या लगन में पंचमेश, षष्ठेश शनि।
मिथुन लगन में नवमेश, अष्टमेश शनि।

Translation: "Can a trikoṇeśa be *pāpakṛt*? If the trikoṇeśa is also lord of a pāpa-bhāva, then it
  can be pāpakṛt — one may call it *doṣayukta*. For example:
  - Siṁha (Leo) lagna: 5th lord and 8th lord — Jupiter.
  - Kumbha (Aquarius) lagna: 5th lord and 8th lord — Mercury.
  - Kanyā (Virgo) lagna: 5th lord and 6th lord — Saturn.
  - Mithuna (Gemini) lagna: 9th lord and 8th lord — Saturn."
laghu_parashari.effect:
A trikoṇeśa becomes *pāpakṛt / doṣayukta* iff it also owns a pāpa-bhāva (6th or 8th).
  Transcribed table of the author's four instances:

  | Lagna | Planet | Trikoṇa lordship | Pāpa-bhāva lordship |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | सिंह / Leo | गुरु / Jupiter | 5th | 8th |
  | कुम्भ / Aquarius | बुध / Mercury | 5th | 8th |
  | कन्या / Virgo | शनि / Saturn | 5th | 6th |
  | मिथुन / Gemini | शनि / Saturn | 9th | 8th |

Weight/authority: विशेष — a worked lagna-wise list; directly usable
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; the full lordship pair of the 5th and 9th lords.

Exceptions / caveats: Per LP-128-5 the author still classes this as *doṣayukta*, not a full pāpagraha.
  [Note: the author's list is not exhaustive of all lagnas where a trikoṇeśa also owns 6/8 — he gives
  four instances only.]

laghu_parashari.description: ← the both-pāpakṛt veto, and the aṣṭameśa yogakāraka-destroyer
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
उक्त स्थिति में जब केन्द्रेश पापकृत हो और त्रिकोणेश भी सदोष(पापकृत) हो तो केन्द्रेश की महादशा में
  त्रिकोणेश की अन्तर्दशा आने पर शुभफल नहीं होगा। यदि दोनों ही पापकृत नहीं हो तो परस्पर दशान्तर्दशाओं में शुभफल
  मिलने की संभावना रहती है। यदि त्रिकोणेश अष्टमेश न हो तब अष्टमेश के सम्बन्ध से योगकाकरकत्व नष्ट होता है।

Translation: "In the said situation, when the kendreśa is pāpakṛt AND the trikoṇeśa too is
  defective (pāpakṛt), then in the kendreśa's mahādaśā, when the trikoṇeśa's antardaśā arrives, there
  will be NO auspicious result. If neither of the two is pāpakṛt, the possibility of an auspicious
  result in their mutual daśā-antardaśās remains. If the trikoṇeśa is not itself the aṣṭameśa, then
  by sambandha with the aṣṭameśa its yogakāraka-hood is destroyed."
laghu_parashari.effect:
The final resolution of the kendra–trikoṇa period:
  1. IF kendreśa is pāpakṛt AND trikoṇeśa is pāpakṛt THEN kendreśa-MD + trikoṇeśa-AD gives
     no auspicious result (the veto).
  2. IF neither is pāpakṛt THEN their mutual daśā-antardaśās are likely auspicious.
  3. IF the trikoṇeśa is not itself the 8th lord, BUT forms a sambandha with the 8th lord,
     THEN its yogakāraka quality is destroyed.
     *(Contrast: a trikoṇeśa that IS the 8th lord is merely doṣayukta per LP-128-5 — being the aṣṭameśa
     oneself is less damaging than associating with the aṣṭameśa.)*

Weight/authority: विशेष — the operative discriminator; this is what decides gain vs loss
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; identity + full lordships of kendreśa and trikoṇeśa; pāpakṛt status of
  each (does it also own 6/8, or hold sambandha with a pāpagraha); identity of the 8th lord;
  sambandha between the trikoṇeśa and the 8th lord.

Exceptions / caveats: Sub-rule 3 is an important, easily-missed asymmetry: *owning* the 8th ≠ *relating to*
  the 8th lord.

laghu_parashari.description: ← योगकारक व मारक दशा का समन्वय युक्त फल-विचार (śl. 33)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
योगकारक व मारक दशा का समन्वय युक्त फल-विचार
आरम्भो राजयोगस्य भवेन्मारकभुक्तिषु॥
प्रथयन्ति तमारभ्य क्रमशः पापभुक्तयः॥33॥

  Author's anuvāda, verbatim:
अनुवाद–यदि राजयोग कारक ग्रह की महादशा में मारक ग्रहों की अन्तर्दशा हो तो राजयोग का फल क्रमशः बढ़ता है
अर्थात् मनुष्य को उत्तरोत्तर राज्याधिकार से प्रसिद्धि मिलती है। इसी प्रकार पापग्रह की अन्तर्दशा भी क्रमानुसार फल
में वृद्धि करती है॥तैंतीस॥

  Author's विशेष, verbatim (p.129 → p.130):
विशेष–अतः स्पष्ट है कि राजयोग कारक ग्रह की महादशा में मारक ग्रह की अन्तर्दशा चल रही हो तो योग का फल
क्रमशः बढ़ता है। इसी प्रकार पापग्रह की अन्तर्दशा चल रही हो तो भी फल में *(p.130)* क्रमशः वृद्धि होती है।

Translation: "The commencement (ārambha) of a rājayoga occurs in the bhuktis (antardaśās) of
  māraka planets; beginning from that, the pāpa-bhuktis progressively (kramaśaḥ) extend/spread it." —
  Author: if in the mahādaśā of a rājayoga-kāraka planet the antardaśā of māraka planets occurs, the
  result of the rājayoga progressively increases, i.e. the person obtains progressively greater fame
  through royal authority. Likewise the antardaśā of a malefic also increases the result in due order.
laghu_parashari.effect:
The yogakāraka × māraka coordination rule — the counter-intuitive core of the chapter.
  - IF MD lord is a rājayoga-kāraka AND AD lord is a māraka THEN the rājayoga BEGINS —
    and its result *increases progressively* rather than being destroyed.
  - IF MD lord is a rājayoga-kāraka AND AD lord is a pāpagraha THEN the yoga result likewise
    increases progressively.
  So a māraka/pāpa antardaśā inside a yogakāraka mahādaśā is an initiation and escalation window for
  the rājayoga, not a destruction window.

Weight/authority: विशेष — dedicated section heading, "समन्वय युक्त फल-विचार" (coordinated result-judgement)
laghu_parashari.combination:
MD lord and whether it is a rājayoga-kāraka (kendra–trikoṇa lordship / yoga
  participation); AD lord and whether it is a māraka (2nd/7th lordship per the book's māraka
  doctrine) or a pāpagraha for the lagna; the sequence order of antardaśās (for "krama").

Exceptions / caveats: Sharply qualified by LP-130-1 and LP-130-2: the sambandha condition governs the
  intensity, and the delivery is *talk, not appointment*.

laghu_parashari.description: ← the sambandha proportionality (तारतम्य) condition
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
यहां आशय यही है कि राजयोग कारक ग्रह से सम्बन्ध रखने वाले मारक, पाप और शुभ ग्रह की अन्तर्दशा में
  कभी भी योग का फल मिलना प्रारम्भ हो जाता है लेकिन योग की तीव्रता व शुभता में तारतम्य सम्बन्ध के अनुसार ही होता है।

Translation: "The intent here is that in the antardaśā of māraka, pāpa and śubha planets that hold
  a sambandha with the rājayoga-kāraka planet, the result of the yoga may begin to be received at any
  time — but the *tāratamya* (gradation/proportion) in the yoga's INTENSITY and AUSPICIOUSNESS is
  strictly according to the sambandha."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Two separable quantities:
  - Onset (whether the yoga starts): any AD lord — māraka, pāpa or śubha — that is in sambandha
    with the yogakāraka can start the yoga.
  - Intensity + auspiciousness (how much, how good): graded in proportion to the sambandha between
    the AD lord and the yogakāraka.

Weight/authority: विशेष
laghu_parashari.combination:
MD lord = yogakāraka; AD lord's class (māraka / pāpa / śubha) for the lagna; the
  sambandha (which of the four types, and how many) between AD lord and the yogakāraka MD lord.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: ← the "talk but not appointment" rule (māraka AD inside yogakāraka MD)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
जैसे योगकारक ग्रह की महादशा में मारक ग्रह की अन्तर्दशा प्रारम्भ हुई तो राजयोग के घटने के लक्षण
  चर्चा के रूप में होने लगेंगे लेकिन वास्तव में पद प्राप्ति नहीं हो पाती है। इसी प्रकार अन्य सम्बन्धों के लिए समझना चाहिए।

Translation: "For instance, if in the mahādaśā of a yogakāraka planet the antardaśā of a māraka
  planet has begun, the signs of the rājayoga's occurrence will begin to appear in the form of
  *discussion/talk (charchā)* — but in reality the post/position (pada-prāpti) is NOT obtained. In the
  same way it should be understood for the other sambandhas."
laghu_parashari.effect:
IF MD lord is yogakāraka AND AD lord is a māraka THEN the rājayoga manifests only
  as signals, negotiation, discussion, being spoken of — the actual appointment / attainment of
  position does not occur in that antardaśā. Extend the same graded reading to the other sambandha
  cases (i.e. weaker sambandha → more talk, less substance).

Weight/authority: विशेष — a concrete, falsifiable prediction rule; among the most practically useful lines
  in the chapter
laghu_parashari.combination:
MD lord's yogakāraka status; AD lord's māraka status for the lagna; sambandha between
  them.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: ← अन्तर्दशा में तात्कालिक फल: the śubha-first / aśubha-later split
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
स्पष्टतः यह समझना चाहिए कि कारक ग्रह की दशा में जब कभी किसी तत्सम्बन्धी कारक–मारकग्रह की
  अन्तर्दशा आती हो तब वह ग्रह उस अन्तर्दशा में प्रारम्भ में कारक ग्रह शुभफल देकर क्रमशः बाद में अशुभफल देता है।

Translation: "It should clearly be understood that in the daśā of a kāraka planet, whenever the
  antardaśā of some related kāraka-māraka planet arrives, then in that antardaśā that planet first, at
  the BEGINNING, gives the auspicious result of the kāraka planet, and progressively LATER gives the
  inauspicious result."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Intra-antardaśā temporal ordering. When a planet is simultaneously kāraka and māraka
  and is related to the yogakāraka MD lord, its antardaśā splits in time:
  - early part of the AD → the kāraka (auspicious) result manifests;
  - later part of the AD → the māraka/aśubha result manifests, progressively (क्रमशः).

  This is the author's resolution of the "same period is both yogakāraka and māraka" problem: it is
  not a cancellation and not a blend — it is a sequence.

Weight/authority: विशेष — heads the section अन्तर्दशा में तात्कालिक फल; this is the fine-timing mechanism
laghu_parashari.combination:
MD lord = kāraka; AD lord that is both kāraka and māraka (i.e. holds both a
  kendra/trikoṇa lordship and a 2nd/7th lordship, or is otherwise dual-classed); sambandha between MD and
  AD lord; the start and end dates of the antardaśā (to place the transition); the sub-division into
  pratyantar/sūkṣma (per LP-126-3) to locate the crossover more finely.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: "In summary it may be said that the full result is not obtained in one antardaśā; but in the antardaśā of a malefic that makes sambandha with the daśā lord, a l…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
सारांश में यह कह सकते हैं कि एक अन्तर्दशा में पूर्ण फल नहीं मिलता है लेकिन दशानाथ के साथ सम्बन्ध
  करने वाले पापग्रह की अन्तर्दशा में थोड़ा–थोड़ा राजयोग का फल मिलता रहता है।

Translation: "In summary it may be said that the full result is not obtained in one antardaśā;
  but in the antardaśā of a malefic that makes sambandha with the daśā lord, a little of the rājayoga's
  result keeps being received."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Rājayoga delivery is incremental across antardaśās, never complete in one. Even a
  malefic AD lord — provided it is in sambandha with the MD lord — delivers a small instalment of the
  yoga.

Weight/authority: विशेष (author's सारांश)
laghu_parashari.combination:
MD lord and its yoga participation; each AD lord in the mahādaśā and its sambandha
  with the MD lord; AD lord's śubha/pāpa nature.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: ← अन्तर्दशा में तात्कालिक फल (śl. 34)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
अन्तर्दशा में तात्कालिक फल
तत्सम्बन्धिशुभानां च तथा पुनरसंयुजाम्॥
शुभानां तु समत्वेन संयोगो योगकारिणाम्॥34॥

  Author's anuvāda, verbatim:
अनुवाद–योग कारक ग्रह की दशा में उसके सम्बन्धी या असम्बन्धी शुभग्रह की अन्तर्दशा में उसके बलानुसार
तात्कालिक फल मिलता है॥चौंतीस॥

  Author's विशेष, verbatim:
विशेष–यहां यही समझाया गया है कि राजयोग बनाने में जिन ग्रहों का हाथ होता है, उसके सम्बन्धी शुभ ग्रहों की
अन्तर्दशा में राजयोग का फल मिलता है जबकि राजयोग कारक ग्रहों से सम्बन्ध न रखने वाले ग्रहों की अन्तर्दशा में
सामान्य फल ही होता है, विशेष राजयोग नहीं बनता है।

Translation: "Of the benefics related to it, and likewise again of those unconjoined/unrelated —
  but of the benefics, by equality (samatvena), there is conjunction/union of the yoga-producers." —
  Author: in the daśā of a yoga-kāraka planet, in the antardaśā of a related or unrelated benefic,
  the tātkālika (immediate / current-moment) result is obtained according to that benefic's
  strength (balānusāra). — विशेष: the rājayoga result is obtained in the antardaśā of the benefics
  related to the planets that have a hand in forming the rājayoga, whereas in the antardaśā of planets
  not related to the rājayoga-kāraka planets, only an ordinary result occurs — no special rājayoga
  is formed.
laghu_parashari.effect:
The tātkālika (immediate/current) result mechanism:
  - IF MD lord is a yogakāraka AND AD lord is a benefic in sambandha with the yoga-forming
    planets THEN the rājayoga result is delivered, scaled by the AD benefic's own strength (bala).
  - IF MD lord is a yogakāraka AND AD lord is a benefic NOT in sambandha with the
    yoga-forming planets THEN only an ordinary result — no special rājayoga.
  - The magnitude of *tātkālika* delivery is set by बलानुसार — the AD lord's strength.

Weight/authority: विशेष — dedicated section heading; the fine-grained "immediate result" rule
laghu_parashari.combination:
identity of all planets participating in the rājayoga (not just the MD lord);
  MD lord's yogakāraka status; AD lord's benefic status; sambandha between the AD lord and the
  yoga-forming planets; the AD lord's bala (strength) — the only place in the chapter where a
  numerical strength measure is explicitly demanded.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: "It is clear that if the rājayoga begins in the antardaśā of benefics related to the rājayoga-making planets, then happiness and prestige from the state/governm…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
*(p.130)* स्पष्ट है कि जो राजयोग करने वाले ग्रहों के सम्बन्धी शुभग्रहों की *(p.131)* अन्तर्दशा में राजयोग
  प्रारम्भ होए तो राज्य से सुख और प्रतिष्ठा में वृद्धि होती है तथा राजयोग कारक ग्रहों से सम्बन्ध न करने वाले शुभ ग्रहों की
  अन्तर्दशा में राजयोग आरम्भ होए तो सामान्य फल कहना चाहिए, थोड़ा–ज्यादा नहीं होगा, जैसा है वैसा ही बना रहेगा।

Translation: "It is clear that if the rājayoga begins in the antardaśā of benefics related to the
  rājayoga-making planets, then happiness and prestige from the state/government increase; whereas if
  the rājayoga begins in the antardaśā of benefics not related to the rājayoga-kāraka planets, then
  one should predict an ordinary result — there will be no increase or decrease; things will remain
  exactly as they are."
laghu_parashari.combination:
the rājayoga-forming planet set; AD lord's benefic status; sambandha between AD lord
  and the yoga-forming planets.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: "Fundamentally this is understood: a planet that is neither related to the daśā lord nor a yogakāraka must be a malefic, because only such a planet should be th…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
मूलतः यह समझ में आ जाता है कि ऐसा ग्रह जो दशा स्वामी से सम्बन्धित नहीं है और योगकारक भी नहीं है
  तो पापग्रह होना चाहिए क्योंकि अशुभफल देने वाला ग्रह वही ग्रह होना चाहिए। इसीलिए इस प्रकार का असम्बन्धित और
  दशानाथ से योग न करने वाला ग्रह पापग्रह निज अन्तर्दशा में शुभफल न देकर अशुभफल ही देता है।

Translation: "Fundamentally this is understood: a planet that is neither related to the daśā lord
  nor a yogakāraka must be a malefic, because only such a planet should be the giver of inauspicious
  results. Therefore such an unrelated malefic, which forms no yoga with the daśā lord, gives in its own
  antardaśā not an auspicious result but only an inauspicious one."
laghu_parashari.effect:
IF AD lord is (a) not in sambandha with the MD lord AND (b) not a yogakāraka
  THEN treat it as functionally malefic, and its antardaśā gives only inauspicious results.
  (This is the operational identification of the worst cell of LP-127-4.)

Weight/authority: विशेष
laghu_parashari.combination:
MD lord; AD lord; sambandha test between them; AD lord's yogakāraka status for the
  lagna.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: ← the māraka / pāpa / śubha ranking for rājayoga expansion
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
यहां तीन ग्रह हो जाते हैं–मारक, पाप एवं शुभ। ये क्रमशः अधम, मध्यम एवं उत्तम फल प्रदान करेंगे।
  यह सब जानते हैं कि मारक से अधिक बुरा कौन हो सकता है? यहां वह राजयोग का विस्तार करेगा, इसमें सन्देह है, यदि किया तो
  बहुत ही कम होगा। पापग्रह मारक ग्रह सदृश बुरा नहीं होता है इसलिए मारक ग्रह की अपेक्षा पापग्रह की अन्तर्दशा विशेष
  राजयोग में वृद्धि करेगी। इसी प्रकार शुभग्रह जब योगकारक ग्रह से सम्बन्धित हो तो उसके विषय में कहने की आवश्यकता ही
  नहीं है क्योंकि वह तो सर्वाधिक राजयोग में वृद्धि करेगा।

Translation: "Here three [kinds of] planets arise — māraka, pāpa and śubha. These will respectively
  bestow *adhama* (lowest), *madhyama* (middling) and *uttama* (best) results. Everyone knows: who can
  be worse than a māraka? Whether it will expand the rājayoga is doubtful — and if it does, it will be
  very little indeed. A malefic is not as bad as a māraka; therefore, compared to a māraka, a
  malefic's antardaśā will especially increase the rājayoga. Likewise when a benefic is related to
  the yogakāraka planet there is no need even to speak of it, because it will increase the rājayoga the
  most of all."
laghu_parashari.effect:
Three-tier ranking of AD-lord class for rājayoga expansion (within a yogakāraka MD):

  | AD lord class | Grade | Effect on rājayoga |
  |---|---|---|
  | शुभ (benefic) related to yogakāraka | उत्तम (best) | सर्वाधिक वृद्धि — greatest increase |
  | पाप (malefic) | मध्यम (middling) | increases the rājayoga appreciably |
  | मारक (māraka) | अधम (lowest) | doubtful whether it expands it at all; if so, very little |

Weight/authority: विशेष — the quantitative resolution of śl. 33/34
laghu_parashari.combination:
MD lord's yogakāraka status; classification of the AD lord as māraka vs pāpa vs
  śubha for the lagna; sambandha of AD lord with the yogakāraka.

Exceptions / caveats: Note the tension with LP-129-4 (śl. 33 says māraka bhuktis *commence* the rājayoga);
  the author reconciles it here by grading the māraka's contribution as *adhama* — real but minimal,
  and per LP-130-2 expressed as talk rather than attainment.

laghu_parashari.description: ← the no-sambandha cases, and yogakāraka MD + yogakāraka AD
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
ये तीनों प्रकार के फल योगकारक ग्रह सम्बन्ध न होने पर फल इस प्रकार समझना होगा–योगकारक की
  महादशा में असम्बन्धित शुभग्रह की अन्तर्दशा तथा महादशा में योगकारक की अन्तर्दशा सम अर्थात् सामान्य शुभफल करेगी।
  योगकारक ग्रह की महादशा में योगकारक की अन्तर्दशा योग का फल देती है क्योंकि दोनों का सम्बन्ध होता है, वे सधर्मी होते हैं।
  यह दशा भाव, भावेश व राशि के अनुसार मिश्रित फल देगी।

Translation: "These three kinds of result, when there is no sambandha with the yogakāraka planet,
  must be understood thus: in the yogakāraka's mahādaśā, the antardaśā of an unrelated benefic — and in
  [that benefic's] mahādaśā the antardaśā of the yogakāraka — will give a *sama*, i.e. ordinary,
  auspicious result. In a yogakāraka planet's mahādaśā, the antardaśā of a [another] yogakāraka gives
  the result of the yoga, because the two have sambandha and they are SADHARMĪ. This daśā will give mixed
  results according to the *bhāva*, the *bhāveśa*, and the *rāśi*."
laghu_parashari.effect:
1. Yogakāraka MD + unrelated benefic AD (and the reciprocal, benefic MD + yogakāraka AD) → sama /
     ordinary auspicious result only.
  2. Yogakāraka MD + yogakāraka AD → full yoga result, on the stated ground that two yogakārakas are
     in sambandha and are sadharmī (same functional class). *This is the chapter's clearest worked
     application of the sadharmī concept.*
  3. Even so, the yogakāraka×yogakāraka period yields mixed (miśrita) results modulated by the
     bhāva occupied, the bhāveśa, and the rāśi.

Weight/authority: विशेष
laghu_parashari.combination:
identity of all yogakārakas for the lagna; MD and AD lords; sambandha test; sadharma
  test; for the final modulation — the bhāva occupied by the lords, the lord of that bhāva, and
  the rāśi they occupy.

Exceptions / caveats: Subject to the śl. 29 override where the two yogakārakas are the same planet.

laghu_parashari.description: ← the पारस पत्थर (philosopher's stone) principle
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
योगकारक गह[ग्रह] पारस पत्थर सदृश होते हैं, उसके संसर्ग या स्पर्शमात्र से पापग्रह भी अपना पाप प्रभाव
  छोड़कर उसके अनुसार फल देते हैं। कहने का तात्पर्य यही है कि योगकारक ग्रह की महादशा में संबंधी पापग्रह योगकारक
  ग्रहों से प्रभावित होकर फल देते हैं और असंबंधी होने पर योगज अर्थात् मिश्रित फल प्रदान करते हैं।

Translation: "Yogakāraka planets are like the *pāras* stone (philosopher's stone / touchstone that
  turns iron to gold); by mere association or touch with it, even a malefic abandons its malefic influence
  and gives results in accordance with it [the yogakāraka]. The purport is that in a yogakāraka
  planet's mahādaśā, related malefics give their results being influenced by the yogakāraka planets; and
  when unrelated, they bestow *yogaja*, i.e. mixed, results."
laghu_parashari.effect:
The transmutation rule.
  - IF a pāpagraha is in sambandha (association or contact) with a yogakāraka THEN it
    abandons its malefic effect and delivers results in the yogakāraka's own line.
  - IF the pāpagraha is unrelated to the yogakāraka THEN in the yogakāraka's mahādaśā it gives
    yogaja i.e. mixed results.

Weight/authority: विशेष — the author's own closing image for the whole yogakāraka discussion
laghu_parashari.combination:
identity of the yogakāraka(s) for the lagna; identity of the pāpagrahas; the
  sambandha (association / conjunction / aspect / exchange) between each pāpagraha and the yogakāraka;
  current MD and AD lords.

Exceptions / caveats: [Note: the printed text has "गह" for "ग्रह" — obvious typo, transcribed verbatim.]

---

laghu_parashari.description: In the mahādaśā of this benefic (that is engaged/related), the yogakārakas, in their own bhuktis, sometimes bestow the fruit born of the yoga. (35) *Commentary:…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
शुभस्यास्य प्रसक्तस्य दशायां योगकारकाः॥
  स्वभुक्तिषु प्रयच्छन्ति क्वचिद्योगजं फलम्॥35॥
  *अनुवाद*—शुभ ग्रह की महादशा में सम्बन्धी योगकारक ग्रह की अन्तर्दशा आने पर योग का शुभफल क्वचित् देते हैं॥पैंतीस॥
  *विशेष*—श्लोक का भाव स्पष्ट है कि किसी भी शुभग्रह की महादशा में जब भी योगकारक ग्रह की अन्तर्दशा आती है, तब योग का
  फल तत्काल होता है। ऐसा देखा गया है कि कभी-कभी योग कारक ग्रह निज अन्तर्दशा में भी फल देते हैं। स्पष्ट है कि जब
  राजयोग करने वाले ग्रह की महादशा में जब उनकी ही अन्तर्दशा आती है तो उस समय कदाचित् राजयोग के फल मिलते हैं।

Translation: In the mahādaśā of this benefic (that is engaged/related), the yogakārakas, in
  their own bhuktis, sometimes bestow the fruit born of the yoga. (35)
  *Commentary:* In any benefic's MD, whenever a yogakāraka's AD arrives, the yoga's fruit occurs
  immediately (तत्काल). It has been observed that sometimes yogakāraka planets give the fruit
  even in their own AD (i.e. yogakāraka MD → same yogakāraka AD). Clearly, when the MD of a
  rājayoga-forming planet runs and its own AD comes, rājayoga results are *occasionally* (कदाचित्)
  obtained.
laghu_parashari.effect:
IF MD-lord is a śubhagraha AND AD-lord is a yogakāraka related (sambandha) to the MD-lord
  → the yoga's auspicious fruit is delivered, and delivered *promptly* within that AD.
  ALSO: IF MD-lord = AD-lord = a yogakāraka / rājayoga-forming planet (svabhukti) → rājayoga
  results may be delivered, but only *kvacit / kadācit* (occasionally, not guaranteed).

Weight/authority: normal (श्लोक), with author's "तत्काल" emphasis.
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; functional lordships of all planets; identification of
  yogakāraka(s) (kendreśa–trikoṇeśa sambandha); sambandha (conjunction / mutual aspect / exchange)
  between MD-lord and AD-lord; Vimśottarī MD and AD lords for the period judged.

Exceptions / caveats: The word *क्वचित् / कदाचित्* is itself the caveat — svabhukti delivery is
  occasional, not certain. Contrast with the अनमोल सूत्र (śl.29) suppression rule from pp.121–131,
  which can still block rājayoga delivery.

laghu_parashari.description: The two shadow planets (tamograha), if seated in an auspicious bhāva — whether or not they hold a relation with any (benefic) — become yogakārakas according to …
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
तमोग्रहौ शुभरूढ़ावसंबंधेन केनचित्॥
  अंतर्दशानुसारेण भवेतां योगकारकौ॥36॥
  *अनुवाद*—राहु-केतु(तमोग्रह) यदि शुभ भाव में हों और किसी शुभग्रह से सम्बन्ध रखें या न रखें, तब भी अपनी दशा में
  या अन्तर्दशा में योगकारक होते हैं॥छत्तीस॥

Translation: The two shadow planets (tamograha), if seated in an auspicious bhāva — whether or
  not they hold a relation with any (benefic) — become yogakārakas according to the antardaśā,
  i.e. in their own daśā or antardaśā. (36)
laghu_parashari.effect:
IF Rāhu or Ketu occupies a śubha-bhāva → it acts as a yogakāraka in its own MD/AD,
  regardless of whether it has a sambandha with a benefic.

Weight/authority: normal (mūla śloka).
laghu_parashari.combination:
House occupied by Rāhu; house occupied by Ketu; classification of that house
  as śubha (kendra/trikoṇa) vs pāpa (3/6/8/11/12) for that lagna.

Exceptions / caveats: See LP-132-3 — the node must *not* have a pāpa sambandha.

laghu_parashari.description: RĀHU–KETU DAŚĀ DOCTRINE (complete, with priority order)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
*विशेष*—राहु व केतु यदि केन्द्र(विशेष रूप से चौथे व दसवें भाव में) या त्रिकोण में स्थित होकर किसी भी
  ग्रह के साथ सम्बन्ध नहीं करते हों तो उनकी महादशा में योगकारक ग्रहों की अन्तर्दशा में उन ग्रहों के अनुसार शुभयोग कारक
  फल देते हैं। कहने का तात्पर्य यह है कि शुभ भाव में राहु व केतु शुभ सम्बन्ध की अपेक्षा नहीं करते मात्र वे पाप संबंधी नहीं
  होने चाहिएं तभी कथित फल देते हैं। राजयोग रहित शुभग्रहों की अन्तर्दशा में शुभफल होगा ऐसा समझना चाहिए।
  राहु-केतु की यह मूल प्रकृति होती है कि जिस भाव में बैठते हैं और जिस भावेश के साथ युत होते हैं, उन दोनों का प्रभाव लेकर
  सक्रिय होते हैं। यह भी सर्वविदित है कि राहु व केतु केन्द्रेश या *[p.133]* त्रिकोणेश से सम्बन्ध करते हों तो अवश्य ही
  योगकारक होते हैं। ऐसी स्थिति में राहु-केतु किसी अन्य ग्रह के साथ सम्बन्ध करें या न करें, अपनी दशान्तर्दशा में योग का फल
  अवश्य देते हैं।

Translation: If Rāhu/Ketu stand in a kendra (especially the 4th and 10th) or in a trikoṇa
  and form no relation with any planet, then in their MD, during the AD of yogakāraka planets,
  they give auspicious yoga-producing results according to those (AD) planets. Meaning: in an
  auspicious bhāva Rāhu/Ketu do not require an auspicious relation — they must merely not be
  pāpa-related; only then do they give the stated fruit. In the AD of benefics that are devoid of
  rājayoga, one should understand that (merely) auspicious results occur.
  It is the root nature of Rāhu/Ketu that they become active taking the influence of two
  things: (i) the bhāva they sit in, and (ii) the bhāveśa they are conjoined with. It is also
  universally known that if Rāhu/Ketu relate with a kendreśa or trikoṇeśa they are certainly
  yogakāraka; in that state, whether or not they relate with any other planet, they definitely
  give the yoga's fruit in their own daśā-antardaśā.
laghu_parashari.effect:
If Rāhu/Ketu stand in a kendra (especially the 4th and 10th) or in a trikoṇa
  and form no relation with any planet, then in their MD, during the AD of yogakāraka planets,
  they give auspicious yoga-producing results according to those (AD) planets. Meaning: in an
  auspicious bhāva Rāhu/Ketu do not require an auspicious relation — they must merely not be
  pāpa-related; only then do they give the stated fruit. In the AD of benefics that are devoid of
  rājayoga, one should understand that (merely) auspicious results occur.
  It is the root nature of Rāhu/Ketu that they become active taking the influence of two
  things: (i) the bhāva they sit in, and (ii) the bhāveśa they are conjoined with. It is also
  universally known that if Rāhu/Ketu relate with a kendreśa or trikoṇeśa they are certainly
  yogakāraka; in that state, whether or not they relate with any other planet, they definitely
  give the yoga's fruit in their own daśā-antardaśā.

Weight/authority: विशेष.
laghu_parashari.combination:
House of Rāhu; house of Ketu; every planet conjoined with / aspecting each
  node; functional lordship (kendreśa / trikoṇeśa / triṣaḍāyeśa / aṣṭameśa) of each such planet
  for that lagna; the AD-lord within the node's MD and its own yogakāraka status.

Exceptions / caveats: pāpa sambandha of the node cancels the benefic verdict (see LP-133-2).

---

laghu_parashari.description: If Rāhu or Ketu is not (itself) a kāraka and is merely in a trikoṇa, it still gives auspicious results in the AD of a kāraka planet. But if it is in a kendra an…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
राहु या केतु यदि कारक नहीं हो और मात्र त्रिकोण में हो तो भी कारक ग्रह की अन्तर्दशा में शुभफल देता है।
  वह यदि केन्द्र में हो और त्रिकोणेश से सम्बन्ध नहीं करता हो तो परस्पर दशान्तर्दशा में अशुभफल ही देता है।

Translation: If Rāhu or Ketu is not (itself) a kāraka and is merely in a trikoṇa, it still
  gives auspicious results in the AD of a kāraka planet. But if it is in a kendra and forms no
  relation with a trikoṇeśa, then in their mutual daśā-antardaśā it gives only inauspicious
  results.
laghu_parashari.effect:
- Node in trikoṇa, not itself yogakāraka → still gives śubha-phala during the AD of a kāraka.
  - Node in kendra WITHOUT a trikoṇeśa relation → gives aśubha-phala only in the mutual
    MD/AD of the node and that planet.

Weight/authority: normal.
laghu_parashari.combination:
House of node (trikoṇa 1/5/9 vs kendra 1/4/7/10); whether node relates to a
  trikoṇeśa; kāraka status of the AD-lord.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: A Rāhu or Ketu situated in a pāpa-bhāva: the ADs of benefics not sitting with them give only pāpa-phala; then in the ADs of malefics they will of course give pā…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
पापभाव में स्थित राहु या केतु उनके साथ न बैठने वाले शुभग्रहों की अन्तर्दशा पापफल ही देती है, तब पापग्रहों
  की अन्तर्दशा में तो पापफल देंगे ही।

Translation: A Rāhu or Ketu situated in a pāpa-bhāva: the ADs of benefics not sitting with
  them give only pāpa-phala; then in the ADs of malefics they will of course give pāpa-phala.
laghu_parashari.effect:
IF node is in a pāpa-bhāva (3/6/8/11/12) → in the node's MD, ADs of benefics not
  conjoined with the node give malefic results; ADs of malefics give malefic results *a fortiori*.
  (Implied: a benefic conjoined with the node is the only relief.)

Weight/authority: normal.
laghu_parashari.combination:
House of node; which benefics are conjoined with the node (conjunction, not
  mere aspect — text says *साथ न बैठने वाले*); AD-lord identity and śubha/pāpa status.

Exceptions / caveats: benefic in the same house as the node.

laghu_parashari.description: If the daśā-lord is a malefic, the bhuktis of benefics not conjoined/related with it are givers of malefic fruit; (whereas) the bhuktis of benefics conjoined wi…
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
पापो यदि दशानाथः शुभानां तदंसंयुजाम्॥
  भुक्तयः पापफलदास्तत्संयुक् शुभभुक्तयः॥37॥
  *अनुवाद*—पाप ग्रहों की महादशा में उनके असम्बन्धी शुभ ग्रहों की अन्तर्दशा आने पर अशुभ फल ही होता है॥छत्तीस॥
  *[misprint: the numeral word reads "छत्तीसा" (36) under śloka 37 — should be "सैंतीस"]*
  *विशेष*—पापग्रहों की महादशा जब भी आती है तो जो शुभ ग्रह दशानाथ से सम्बन्ध नहीं रखते हैं, जब उनकी अन्तर्दशा आती
  है तो पापफल अर्थात् अशुभ फल ही मिलता है। शुभ फल तो कदापि नहीं मिलता है।

Translation: If the daśā-lord is a malefic, the bhuktis of benefics not conjoined/related
  with it are givers of malefic fruit; (whereas) the bhuktis of benefics conjoined with it
  (are otherwise). (37)
  *Commentary:* Whenever a malefic's MD runs, those benefics that hold no relation with the
  daśānātha give, in their AD, only pāpa i.e. inauspicious fruit. Auspicious fruit is never
  (कदापि नहीं) obtained.
laghu_parashari.effect:
IF MD-lord is pāpa AND AD-lord is a benefic unrelated to the MD-lord → aśubha-phala
  only; śubha-phala is impossible.

Weight/authority: normal, but stated absolutely (*कदापि नहीं*).

laghu_parashari.description: The bhuktis of the yoga-forming planets become givers of mixed fruit; (but) of those not conjoined with it, they become givers of extremely malefic fruit. (38) …
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
भवन्ति मिश्रफलदा भुक्तयो योगाकारिणाम्॥
  अत्यन्तापापफलदा भवन्ति तदसंयुजाम्॥38॥
  *अनुवाद*—पापग्रहों की महादशा में उनके सम्बन्धित शुभ ग्रहों की अन्तर्दशा आने पर मिश्रित फल अर्थात् मिलाजुला शुभाशुभ
  फल होता है और असम्बन्धी योग कारक ग्रहों की अन्तर्दशा में तो अत्यन्त अशुभ फल होता है॥अड़तीस॥

Translation: The bhuktis of the yoga-forming planets become givers of mixed fruit; (but)
  of those not conjoined with it, they become givers of extremely malefic fruit. (38)
  *Translation as the author renders it:* in a malefic's MD, the AD of benefics related to it
  gives mixed (śubhāśubha) fruit; and the AD of unrelated yogakāraka planets gives extremely
  inauspicious fruit.
laghu_parashari.effect:
Within a pāpa MD —
  - AD of a related benefic/yogakāraka → miśra (mixed) fruit.
  - AD of an unrelated yogakāraka → atyanta aśubha (extremely bad) fruit.

Weight/authority: normal.
laghu_parashari.combination:
as LP-133-3, plus yogakāraka status of the AD-lord.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: the two-point सार of śl.37–38
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
…अन्तर्दशा आए तो अत्यन्त अशुभ फल घटित होता है। सार तत्त्व निम्नवत् मिलता है—
  1. पापग्रह की महादशा में असम्बन्धी शुभग्रह की अन्तर्दशा में भी अशुभ फल ही मिलता है। यहां यह ध्यान रखने की बात है कि
     संबंधी शुभग्रह की अन्तर्दशा में मिश्रित फल होता है।
  2. यदि अन्तर्दशा नाथ योग कारक है और पापी महादशा नाथ से सम्बन्ध रखता है तो मिश्रित फल ही होगा।

Translation: (1) In a malefic's MD, even an *unrelated benefic's* AD yields only inauspicious
  fruit; note that a *related* benefic's AD yields mixed fruit. (2) If the AD-lord is a yogakāraka
  and holds a relation with the malefic MD-lord, the fruit will be mixed only.
laghu_parashari.effect:
Related ⇒ mixed; unrelated ⇒ bad. Sambandha with the malefic MD-lord is what converts
  "bad" into "mixed"; it never converts it to "good".

Weight/authority: सार तत्त्व (author's own distillation).
laghu_parashari.combination:
MD-lord pāpa status; AD-lord śubha/yogakāraka status; sambandha flag.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: THE FOUR-CASE MATRIX (śl.37 + 38 read together)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
सही अर्थ में उक्त दो श्लोक 37 व 38 का अर्थ एक साथ करना चाहिए जिससे स्थिति स्पष्ट हो जाए। उक्त दो
  श्लोक का एक साथ विचार करने पर चार प्रकार के भाव ये हैं—
  1. सम्बन्धी योग कारक शुभग्रह की अन्तर्दशा हो तो मिश्रफल अर्थात् मिश्रित या शुभाशुभ मिश्रित फल होगा।
  2. सम्बन्धी योग रहित शुभग्रह की अन्तर्दशा में मिश्रफल में पाप फल अधिक अनुपात में होगा।
  3. असम्बन्धी योग कारक शुभग्रह की अन्तर्दशा में अशुभ फल ही प्राप्त होगा।
  4. असम्बन्धी योग रहित शुभग्रह की अन्तर्दशा में अधिक अशुभ फल ही प्राप्त होगा।

Translation: Ślokas 37 and 38 must be construed together. Doing so yields four cases
  (all inside a malefic MD):
  1. AD of a related, yogakāraka benefic → mixed (śubhāśubha) fruit.
  2. AD of a related, non-yoga benefic → mixed fruit but with the malefic share larger.
  3. AD of an unrelated, yogakāraka benefic → inauspicious only.
  4. AD of an unrelated, non-yoga benefic → more inauspicious only.
laghu_parashari.effect:
Ślokas 37 and 38 must be construed together. Doing so yields four cases
  (all inside a malefic MD):
  1. AD of a related, yogakāraka benefic → mixed (śubhāśubha) fruit.
  2. AD of a related, non-yoga benefic → mixed fruit but with the malefic share larger.
  3. AD of an unrelated, yogakāraka benefic → inauspicious only.
  4. AD of an unrelated, non-yoga benefic → more inauspicious only.

Weight/authority: विशेष / author's systematisation.
laghu_parashari.combination:
MD-lord (pāpa per p.135 definition); AD-lord śubha status; AD-lord yogakāraka
  status; sambandha(MD-lord, AD-lord).

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: → LP-135-1 — THE SIX-CASE LADDER for a पापग्रह महादशा
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
इस चर्चा को समझने के लिए और अधिक स्पष्ट करें तो ज्ञात होगा कि यदि महादशानाथ पापग्रह हो तो—
  – उससे असम्बन्धित शुभग्रहों की अन्तर्दशा अशुभ फल देती है।
  – उससे सम्बन्धित शुभग्रहों की अन्तर्दशा मिश्रित(शुभाशुभ) फल देती है। अशुभ एवं शुभ विरूद्ध धर्मी होने के कारण ऐसा फल करते हैं।
  – उससे असम्बन्धित योगकारक ग्रहों की अन्तर्दशा में अत्यन्त अशुभ फल मिलता है।
  – उससे सम्बन्धित योगकारक ग्रहों की अन्तर्दशा में मिश्रित फल मिलता है। शुभफल अधिक और अशुभ फल कम मिलता है।
  *[p.135]*
  – उसमें सम ग्रह की अन्तर्दशा में अशुभ फल मिलता है लेकिन कुछ कम ही मिलता है।
  – उसमें पापग्रह की अन्तर्दशा आने पर सधर्मी होने के कारण पापफल ही मिलता है।

Translation: If the MD-lord is a malefic, then —
  1. AD of unrelated benefics → inauspicious fruit.
  2. AD of related benefics → mixed (śubhāśubha) fruit — *because the inauspicious and the
     auspicious are of opposed dharma (विरुद्ध धर्मी), such fruit results.*
  3. AD of unrelated yogakārakas → extremely inauspicious fruit.
  4. AD of related yogakārakas → mixed fruit, with more auspicious and less inauspicious.
  5. AD of a sama (neutral) graha → inauspicious fruit, but somewhat less of it.
  6. AD of a pāpagraha → because it is sadharmī, purely malefic fruit.
laghu_parashari.effect:
Rank order of outcomes inside a malefic MD, best→worst:
  related yogakāraka (mixed, good-weighted) > related benefic (mixed) > sama graha (mildly bad)
unrelated benefic (bad) > pāpa AD (purely bad, sadharmī) ≈ unrelated yogakāraka (extremely bad).

Weight/authority: विशेष / author's systematisation.
laghu_parashari.combination:
MD-lord pāpa status; for each AD-lord: śubha / sama / pāpa class for that
  lagna (use the p.135 and p.140 chakras); yogakāraka flag; sambandha flag.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: operational definition of पापग्रह for this chapter
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
यहां पापग्रह से तात्पर्य यह समझना चाहिए अष्टमस्थ, अष्टमेश, त्रिषडायेश व पापयुत मारकेश।

Translation: Here "pāpagraha" must be understood as: (a) a planet posited in the 8th
  (aṣṭamastha), (b) the 8th lord (aṣṭameśa), (c) the lord of 3/6/11 (triṣaḍāyeśa), and (d) a
  mārakeśa that is conjoined with a malefic (pāpayuta mārakeśa).
laghu_parashari.effect:
When applying LP-133-3, LP-133-4, LP-134-2, LP-134-3 and LP-136-1, classify a planet as
  "pāpa" only by this four-item list — not by natural (naisargika) malefic nature.

Weight/authority: विशेष (definitional).
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; house-lordship map; occupants of the 8th house; the 2nd and 7th
  lords (mārakeśas) and whether each is conjoined with a malefic.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: operational definition of शुभग्रह
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
शुभग्रह वह त्रिकोणेश जिसकी दूसरी राशि त्रिषडायेश में न पड़ती हो।

Translation: A "śubhagraha" is that trikoṇeśa whose second sign does not fall on a
  triṣaḍāya (3rd/6th/11th) house.
laghu_parashari.effect:
Planet is functionally benefic for a lagna IFF it lords a trikoṇa (1/5/9) AND its other
  sign is not the 3rd, 6th or 11th.

Weight/authority: विशेष (definitional).
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; both signs of each two-sign planet; which houses those signs fall
  on.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: the two classes of पापी ग्रह
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
पापी ग्रह दो प्रकार के होते हैं एक तो वे जिनकी अपनी दूसरी राशि पापभाव में हो और दूसरे वे जो केन्द्रेश हों।

Translation: Malefic planets are of two kinds: (i) those whose own second sign falls in
  a pāpa-bhāva, and (ii) those that are kendreśas.
laghu_parashari.effect:
Flag a planet पापी if either (i) its second sign occupies 3/6/8/11/12, or (ii) it lords
  a kendra (4/7/10 — and 1 insofar as it is also a kendra).

Weight/authority: विशेष (definitional).
laghu_parashari.combination:
Lagna sign; both signs of each planet; kendra lordships.

Exceptions / caveats: —

laghu_parashari.description: introduction to the chakra
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
शुभाशुभ ग्रहों की लग्नानुसार एक चक्र बनाकर बताते हैं।

Translation: "We now set out, in the form of a chakra, the auspicious and inauspicious planets
  according to lagna."
laghu_parashari.effect:
"We now set out, in the form of a chakra, the auspicious and inauspicious planets
  according to lagna."

Weight/authority: normal.

laghu_parashari.description: लग्नानुसार शुभाशुभ ग्रह चक्रम् (MASTER TABLE #1)
laghu_parashari.effect:
For a given lagna, read each planet's grade off this four-grade scale
  (अति पापी → पापी → शुभ ग्रह → अति शुभ) and feed that grade into every daśā rule above.

Weight/authority: चक्र — highest practical value; the primary lookup table of the method.
laghu_parashari.combination: Lagna sign only.

laghu_parashari.description: मारक दशा का विशेष विचार (when a māraka daśā actually kills)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
सत्यपि स्वेन संबंधे न हन्ति शुभभुक्तिषु॥
  हन्ति सत्यप्यसंबंधे मारकः पापभुक्तिषु॥39॥
  *अनुवाद*—मारक ग्रह अपनी दशा में संबंध होने पर भी शुभग्रहों की अन्तर्दशा में मारक नहीं होता है तथा बिना संबंध के भी
  पाप ग्रहों की अन्तर्दशा में मारक होता है। स्पष्ट है कि मारक ग्रहों की महादशा में उनके साथ संबंध करने वाले शुभग्रहों की
  अन्तर्दशा में दशानाथ मारक नहीं बनता। परन्तु उसके साथ सम्बन्ध रहित पापग्रह की अन्तर्दशा में मारक बनता है॥उनतालिस॥
  *विशेष*—तात्पर्य यही है कि मारक ग्रह की महादशा संबंधी शुभ ग्रहों की अन्तर्दशा में भी मारक नहीं होती है जबकि संबंध न
  होने पर भी पाप ग्रहों की अन्तर्दशा आने पर मारक हो जाती है।

Translation: Even though there be a relation with itself, (the māraka) does not kill in
  the bhuktis of benefics; the māraka does kill in the bhuktis of malefics even though there be
  no relation. (39)
laghu_parashari.effect:
Even though there be a relation with itself, (the māraka) does not kill in
  the bhuktis of benefics; the māraka does kill in the bhuktis of malefics even though there be
  no relation. (39)

Weight/authority: विशेष (the author gives this its own section heading).
laghu_parashari.combination:
Identity of mārakeśas for the lagna (2nd and 7th lords; plus pāpayuta mārakeśa
  per LP-135-2); current MD-lord; current AD-lord; śubha/pāpa class of AD-lord per the p.135 /
  p.140 chakras; sambandha flag between MD- and AD-lord.

Exceptions / caveats: the अपवाद and the mitigating factors in LP-136-2 below.

laghu_parashari.description: the अपवाद and the mitigating factors [AUTHOR'S OWN]
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
जब शुभ ग्रह मृत्युदायक नहीं होता है तो उसका सम्बन्ध पापी महादशा नाथ से हो या न हो मृत्यु तुल्य या
  मृत्यु रूपी कष्ट होने का तो प्रश्न ही नहीं उठता है। लेकिन श्लोक में कहा गया है कि पापी दशानाथ में उन शुभ ग्रह का अन्तर
  आने पर उसका सम्बन्ध चाहे दशानाथ से न हो तो भी मारक हो जाता है। यह अपवाद ही है।
  अनुभव में देखा गया है कि यदि कोई व्यक्ति दीर्घायु है और 36 वर्ष की अवस्था में ही पापग्रह की महादशा में असंबंधी
  पापग्रह की दशा आ जाती है तो मृत्यु तुल्य कष्ट होता है, मृत्यु नहीं होती है। मृत्यु का विचार करते समय यह भी देख लेना
  चाहिए कि जातक की आयु किस खण्ड में आती है।

Translation: When a benefic is not itself death-dealing, then whether or not it relates to the
  malefic MD-lord, the question of death or death-like suffering simply does not arise. But the
  śloka says that in a malefic daśānātha, when the antara of those benefics comes, even without
  relation to the daśānātha it becomes māraka. This is an exception (apavāda).
  It has been seen in experience that if a person is dīrghāyu (long-lived) and at just 36 years
  of age a malefic MD with an unrelated malefic's (antar)daśā arrives, then death-like suffering
  occurs — death does not occur. While judging death one must also check which āyu-khaṇḍa
  (longevity band) the native falls into.
laghu_parashari.effect:
When a benefic is not itself death-dealing, then whether or not it relates to the
  malefic MD-lord, the question of death or death-like suffering simply does not arise. But the
  śloka says that in a malefic daśānātha, when the antara of those benefics comes, even without
  relation to the daśānātha it becomes māraka. This is an exception (apavāda).
  It has been seen in experience that if a person is dīrghāyu (long-lived) and at just 36 years
  of age a malefic MD with an unrelated malefic's (antar)daśā arrives, then death-like suffering
  occurs — death does not occur. While judging death one must also check which āyu-khaṇḍa
  (longevity band) the native falls into.

Weight/authority: अनुभूत / अनुभव में देखा गया है — tag [AUTHOR'S OWN].
laghu_parashari.combination:
Longevity determination (āyu-khaṇḍa) from Ch.3 आयुर्दायाध्यायः; native's age
  at the daśā in question; MD-lord and AD-lord identities; pāpa/śubha class of each; sambandha flag;
  whether the AD-lord is itself mārakeśa/mṛtyu-dāyaka.

Exceptions / caveats: the number "36 वर्ष" is the author's illustrative benchmark, not a fixed law; the
  general instruction is to test the āyu-khaṇḍa first.

laghu_parashari.description: शुक्र-शनि के दशाफल पर विशेष विचार (śl.40)
laghu_parashari.exact_rule:
परस्परदशायां स्वभुक्तौ सूर्यजभार्गवौ॥
  व्यत्ययेन विशेषेण प्रदिशेतां शुभाशुभम्॥40॥
  *अनुवाद*—शनि व शुक्र की महादशा या अन्तर्दशा में विशेषतया इनका शुभाशुभ फल एक दूसरे की दशा में मिलता है अर्थात्
  शनि का फल शुक्रान्तर में और शुक्र का फल शन्यन्तर में मिलता है॥चालीस॥

Translation: In each other's daśā and in their own bhukti, Sūryaja (Saturn) and Bhārgava
